subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: A RECENT STUDY IN PLASTID GENETIC ENGINEERING FROM THE PDS' LABORATORIES HAS GREATLY ADVANCED CHLOROPLAST METABOLIC ENGINEERING OF VALUABLE HETEROLOGOUS TERPENES, WHICH CREATES PROMISING NEW OPPORTUNITIES TO ENHANCE CROP RESILIENCE TO NATURAL ENEMIES AND ABIOTIC STRESSES. FIRST, THE PDS DEVELOPED A MAJOR INNOVATION IN SOLANUM TUBEROSUM (POTATO) PLASTID ENGINEERING BY COMBINING A NOVEL SITE-SPECIFIC TRANSFORMATION VECTOR WITH ENDOGENOUS PLASTID REGULATORY ELEMENTS, ENABLING STRONG TRANSGENE EXPRESSION WITHOUT COMPROMISING PLANT PHENOTYPE. SECOND, THIS PLATFORM WAS SUCCESSFULLY USED TO EXPRESS VALUABLE TERPENE-PRODUCING GENES IN CHLOROPLASTS, GENERATING TRANSPLASTOMIC POTATO LINES WITH NORMAL GROWTH AND STRONG POTENTIAL AS IMPROVED TRAITS. BEFORE THESE NOVEL LINES CAN BE SAFELY RELEASED, A RIGOROUS ENVIRONMENTAL RISK ASSESSMENT IS ESSENTIAL. THIS PROJECT WILL EVALUATE THE ECOLOGICAL EFFECTS OF THREE TRANSPLASTOMIC POTATO GENOTYPES PRODUCING MONOTERPENES, SESQUITERPENES, AND DITERPENES RESPECTIVELY THAT ARE ALREADY AVAILABLE IN THE PDS' LABORATORIES. FOLLOWING COMPREHENSIVE PHENOTYPIC CHARACTERIZATION AND SELECTION OF THE TOP-PERFORMING LINE, WE WILL ASSESS EFFECTS ON TARGET HERBIVORES, BENEFICIAL NON-TARGET INSECTS, NEIGHBORING CROP AND WEED SPECIES, SOIL MICROBIAL COMMUNITIES, AND SOIL PHYSICOCHEMICAL PROPERTIES. BY DELIVERING THIS COMPREHENSIVE ECOLOGICAL ASSESSMENT, THIS STUDY WILL SUPPORT SAFE AGRICULTURAL USE OF TERPENE-PRODUCING TRANSPLASTOMIC POTATO VARIETIES. THIS PROJECT IS STRONGLY ALIGNED WITH THE USDA BRAG PRIORITY AREA, EFFECTS OF GE ORGANISMS RELATIVE TO NON-GE ORGANISMS IN THE CONTEXT OF PRODUCTION SYSTEMS, PARTICULARLY ITS EMPHASIS ON UNDERSTANDING AND INFORMING REGULATORY AGENCIES ON UNINTENDED ECOLOGICAL EFFECTS OF GE ORGANISMS TO MICROBES, ANIMALS, AND RELATED SPECIES.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: THIS PROJECT AIMS TO OPTIMIZE AND FURTHER SCALE UP AN IN-LINE FLOW-THROUGH AND CHEMICAL-FREE UV TREATMENT TRAIN TOWARDS COMMERCIALIZINGPFAS DESTRUCTION IN AGRICULTURAL AND FOOD INDUSTRY APPLICATIONS. THE PROJECT ADDRESSES PRESSING GLOBAL CONTAMINATION RISKS OF PER- AND POLY-FLUOROALKYL SUBSTANCES (PFAS) - ALSO KNOWN AS FOREVER CHEMICALS - IN IRRIGATION WATER AND FOOD PROCESSING WATER RESOURCES, E.G., GROUNDWATER AND RECYCLED MUNICIPAL WASTEWATER EFFLUENT THROUGH A NOVEL DESTRUCTION TECHNOLOGY. THE ABILITY TO COMPLETELY DESTROY PFAS IN AMBIENT ENVIRONMENT USING CHEMICAL-FREE UV LIGHT WITHOUT GENERATING SECONDARY WASTE OR TOXIC BYPRODUCTS WILL FACILITATE NEW AND COMMERCIALLY VIABLE TECHNOLOGIES TO MITIGATE PFAS AND ENABLE COST-EFFECTIVE NONTRADITIONAL WATER REUSE FOR CROP PRODUCTION. THE OVERARCHING GOAL IS SUPPORTED BY WELL-DESIGNEDTASKS TO SCALE UPAN IN-LINE FLOW-THROUGH PILOT-SCALE UV SYSTEM AND OPTIMIZE THE UV TREATMENT TRAIN AND ITS AUTOMATIONFOR PFAS DESTRUCTION IN AGRICUTURE AND FOOD INDUSTRY. THE PROJECT DIRECTLY ADDRESSESTHEPROGRAM AREA PRIORITIES ON WATER QUANTITY AND QUALITY, AND CONSERVATION OF NATURAL RESOURCES. IT WILL IMPROVE AGRICULTURE SUSTAINABILITY AND HEALTH BY DEVELOPING AN INNOVATIVE PFAS TREATMENT FOR NON-TRADITIONAL WATER IRRIGATION AND WATER REUSE.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: FRESH AND FRESH-CUT PRODUCE ARE VULNERABLE TO MICROBIAL CONTAMINATION DURING POSTHARVEST PROCESSING, LEADING TO FOOD SAFETY RISKS, RECALLS, AND FOOD WASTE. THIS PROJECT WILL ADVANCE A FOOD-GRADE ANTIMICROBIAL DISINFECTANT (FAD), A SHELF-STABLE POWDER BASED ON HYDROGEN PEROXIDE. PHASE I DEMONSTRATED ITS ANTIMICROBIAL EFFECTIVENESS AND FEASIBILITY. PHASE II WILL OPTIMIZE PRODUCTION AND STABILITY, EVALUATE ANTIMICROBIAL EFFICACY AND PRODUCT QUALITY, AND VALIDATE PERFORMANCE IN COMMERCIAL PRODUCE WASH SYSTEMS. THE GOAL IS TO PROVIDE THE FRESH PRODUCE INDUSTRY WITH A SAFE, EFFECTIVE, AND SCALABLE ANTIMICROBIAL WASH TECHNOLOGY.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: FARMERS DEPEND ON INSECTS IN TWO VERY DIFFERENT WAYS: POLLINATORS SUCH AS BEES AND BUTTERFLIES HELP PRODUCE CROPS, WHILE INSECT PESTS CAN DAMAGE CROPS AND REDUCE THEIR VALUE. YET GROWERS AND THEIR ADVISERS OFTEN HAVE LIMITED INFORMATION ABOUT WHEN THESE INSECTS ARE PRESENT, HOW ABUNDANT THEY ARE, AND HOW THEIR ACTIVITY CHANGES ACROSS A FARM OR THROUGHOUT THE DAY. CURRENT MONITORING OFTEN DEPENDS ON OCCASIONAL FIELD VISITS, TRAPS, OR CAMERAS THAT REQUIRE SUBSTANTIAL POWER AND PRODUCE LARGE AMOUNTS OF DATA THAT MUST BE REVIEWED. THIS CAN MAKE IT DIFFICULT TO DETECT EMERGING PEST PROBLEMS, UNDERSTAND WHETHER POLLINATORS ARE PROVIDING ADEQUATE SERVICE, OR MAKE WELL-TIMED DECISIONS ABOUT PESTICIDE USE, BENEFICIAL INSECTS, HABITAT MANAGEMENT, AND COMMERCIAL BEE HIVES. BETTER INFORMATION COULD HELP FARMERS PROTECT CROPS AND INCOME WHILE REDUCING UNNECESSARY CHEMICAL APPLICATIONS AND SUPPORTING NATIVE POLLINATORS AND OTHER BENEFICIAL INSECTS.THIS PROJECT WILL DEVELOP AND FIELD-TEST A SMALL, BATTERY-POWERED SMART CAMERA SYSTEM THAT CAN CONTINUOUSLY MONITOR INSECTS IN AGRICULTURAL SETTINGS. THE SYSTEM WILL COMBINE CAMERAS, ENVIRONMENTAL SENSORS, AND LOW-POWER MOTION-SENSING TECHNOLOGY TO DETECT INSECT ACTIVITY, DISTINGUISH DIFFERENT TYPES OF INSECT MOVEMENTS AND BEHAVIORS, AND SEND USEFUL SUMMARIES FROM REMOTE PARTS OF FARMS. DEVICES WILL BE TESTED DURING REPEATED FIELD DEPLOYMENTS UNDER DIFFERENT CROP, WEATHER, LIGHTING, AND INSECT CONDITIONS, AND THEIR RESULTS WILL BE CHECKED AGAINST VIDEO OBSERVATIONS AND OTHER FIELD DATA. FARMERS, PEST CONTROL ADVISERS, RESEARCHERS, AND AGRICULTURAL EXTENSION PERSONNEL WILL ALSO PROVIDE FEEDBACK ON THE USEFULNESS OF THE INFORMATION AND HOW IT SHOULD BE PRESENTED. THE ULTIMATE GOAL IS TO PROVIDE GROWERS WITH PRACTICAL, TIMELY INFORMATION ABOUT PESTS AND POLLINATORS SO THEY CAN MAKE BETTER-INFORMED MANAGEMENT DECISIONS. IF SUCCESSFUL, THE TECHNOLOGY COULD HELP REDUCE CROP LOSSES AND UNNECESSARY PESTICIDE USE, IMPROVE THE EFFECTIVENESS OF POLLINATION AND HABITAT-MANAGEMENT PRACTICES, LOWER MONITORING COSTS, AND PROVIDE RESEARCHERS AND COMMUNITIES WITH BETTER INFORMATION ABOUT INSECTS THAT ARE IMPORTANT TO AGRICULTURE AND HEALTHY ECOSYSTEMS.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: ALASKA NATIVE COMMUNITIES FACE SOME OF THE NATION'S HIGHEST RATES OF FOOD INSECURITY, DIET-RELATED CHRONIC DISEASE, AND ENVIRONMENTAL DISRUPTION, YET ALASKA NATIVE PEOPLE REMAIN CRITICALLY UNDERREPRESENTED ACROSS FOOD, AGRICULTURE, NATURAL RESOURCES, AND HUMAN SCIENCES (FANH) PROFESSIONS. ALASKA NATIVE STUDENTS FACE SIGNIFICANT STRUCTURAL AND CULTURAL BARRIERS TO DEGREE COMPLETION, AND THE NEED FOR A SKILLED, CULTURALLY GROUNDED FANH WORKFORCE HAS NEVER BEEN MORE URGENT TO ADDRESS ALASKA'S INTERCONNECTED FOOD, HEALTH, AND ENVIRONMENTAL CHALLENGES.GROWING OUR OWN: CULTIVATING ALASKA NATIVE LEADERS IN FANH SCIENCES AND FOOD SOVEREIGNTY WILL ESTABLISH THE ALASKA NATIVE FANH FELLOWS PROGRAM AT THE UNIVERSITY OF ALASKA FAIRBANKS (UAF). THIS COHORT-BASED UNDERGRADUATE FELLOWSHIP DIRECTLY ADDRESSES THREE ANNH EDUCATIONAL NEED AREAS: (1) STUDENT RECRUITMENT, RETENTION, AND EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITY; (2) STUDENT EXPERIENTIAL LEARNING; AND (3) CURRICULA DESIGN AND MATERIALS DEVELOPMENT.PROJECT OBJECTIVES ARE TO: (1) ESTABLISH AND IMPLEMENT THE ALASKA NATIVE FANH FELLOWS PROGRAM, RECRUITING TWO COHORTS OF EIGHT FELLOWS FROM FANH AND RELATED DEGREE PROGRAMS; (2) BUILD FELLOWS' FANH KNOWLEDGE, LEADERSHIP CAPACITY, AND PROFESSIONAL SKILLS THROUGHA CROSS-DISCIPLINARY SEMINAR, MENTORSHIP, AND A RESEARCH OR EXTENSION APPRENTICESHIP; (3) SUPPORT FELLOWS IN APPLYING THAT KNOWLEDGE THROUGH SELF-DESIGNED, COMMUNITY-ENGAGED LEADERSHIP PROJECTS ADDRESSING LOCALLY IDENTIFIED FOOD, HEALTH, ENVIRONMENTAL, AND FOOD SOVEREIGNTY PRIORITIES; AND (4) EVALUATE AND DISSEMINATE A REPLICABLE, CULTURALLY GROUNDED FANH WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT MODEL.EXPECTED OUTCOMES INCLUDE TRAINING 16 ALASKA NATIVE AND RURAL UNDERGRADUATE FELLOWS ACROSS TWO COHORTS, DEVELOPING CULTURALLY GROUNDED FANH EDUCATIONAL RESOURCES, IMPLEMENTING COMMUNITY-ENGAGED LEADERSHIP PROJECTS IN ALASKA NATIVE AND RURAL COMMUNITIES, AND DISSEMINATING A REPLICATION TOOLKIT FOR ANNH-SERVING AND RURAL INSTITUTIONS NATIONWIDE.

description: FISHING IS AN IMPORTANT SOURCE OF HEALTHY AND AFFORDABLE FOOD IN HAWAI'I, AND IS CONNECTED TO LOCAL CULTURE, LIVELIHOODS, THE ECONOMY AND COMMUNITY WELL-BEING. YET, RELATIVELY LITTLE IS KNOWN ABOUT HOW POLLUTION ENTERING COASTAL WATERS AFFECTS THE QUALITY AND SAFETY OF COMMONLY EATEN REEF FISH. THIS INFORMATION GAP HAS BECOME PARTICULARLY IMPORTANT FOLLOWING EVENTS SUCH AS THE 2023 LAHAINA WILDFIRE, WHEN COMMUNITY MEMBERS RAISED QUESTIONS ABOUT CONTAMINATION OF COASTAL WATERS AND SAFETY OF LOCALLY CAUGHT SEAFOOD. THIS PROJECT ADDRESSES THESE QUESTIONS WHILE ALSO PREPARING THE NEXT GENERATION OF HAWAI'I PROFESSIONALS TO WORK AT THE INTERSECTION OF COASTAL RESOURCES, FOOD SECURITY AND PUBLIC HEALTH.THE PROJECT WILL BRING TOGETHER EXISTING INFORMATION ON COASTAL WATER QUALITY AND CORAL REEF ECOSYSTEM HEALTH WITH NEW MEASUREMENTS OF CONTAMINANTS IN WATER, SEDIMENT AND COMMONLY CONSUMED REEF FISH IN WEST MAUI. WE WILL ALSO WORK WITH FISHERS AND COMMUNITY MEMBERS TO BETTER UNDERSTAND WHICH FISH PEOPLE EAT, HOW OFTEN THEY EAT THEM, AND HOW LOCALLY CAUGHT SEAFOOD IS SHARED. UNDERGRADUATE AND GRADUATE STUDENTS, AS WELL AS EARLY-CAREER PROFESSIONALS, WILL PARTICIPATE IN THE RESEARCH, ENGAGE WITH COMMUNITY AND AGENCY PARTNERS, AND GAIN HANDS-ON EXPERIENCE THROUGH FIELD, LABORATORY AND OUTREACH ACTIVITIES. PROJECT FINDINGS AND PLACE-BASED LESSONS WILL ALSO BE INCORPORATED INTO UNIVERSITY COURSES, INCLUDING THE NEW FISHERIES GRADUATE PROGRAM. RESULTS WILL BE SHARED WITH COMMUNITIES AND AGENCIES THROUGH MEETINGS, ACCESSIBLE MATERIEALS AND A PUBLIC DECISION-SUPPORT TOOL. ULTIMATELY, THE PROJECT WILL PROVIDE COMMUNITIES AND RESOURCE MANAGERS WITH BETTER INFORMATION FOR MAKING DECISIONS ABOUT SEAFOOD CONSUMPTION AND COASTAL RESOURCES, WHILE STRENGTHENING HAWAI?I'S LOCAL WORKFORCE AND CAPACITY TO PROTECT THE NEARSHORE FOOD SYSTEMS ON WHICH COMMUNITIES DEPEND.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: THE AMERICAN CHESTNUT (CASTANEA DENTATA) WAS ONCE A DOMINANT AND ECOLOGICALLY IMPORTANT TREE SPECIES THROUGHOUT THE EASTERN UNITED STATES BEFORE THE INTRODUCTION OF THE CHESTNUT BLIGHT FUNGUS (CRYPHONECTRIA PARASITICA) FROM ASIA RESULTED IN THE WIDESPREAD MORTALITY OF BILLIONS OF TREES. FOR MORE THAN FOUR DECADES, BREEDING EFFORTS HAVE FOCUSED ON COMBINING THE DISEASE RESISTANCE OF CHINESE CHESTNUT (CASTANEA MOLLISSIMA) WITH THE DESIRABLE GROWTH CHARACTERISTICS, FOREST COMPETITIVENESS, AND GENETIC BACKGROUND OF AMERICAN CHESTNUT. HOWEVER, THE LONG GENERATION TIME OF FOREST TREES AND THE NEED TO EVALUATE LARGE BREEDING POPULATIONS HAVE LIMITED THE SPEED AT WHICH GENETIC IMPROVEMENT CAN BE ACHIEVED. THIS PROJECT AIMS TO ACCELERATE GENETIC GAINS IN AMERICAN CHESTNUT HYBRID POPULATIONS BY INTEGRATING RECURRENT GENOMIC SELECTION WITH HIGH-THROUGHPUT REMOTE SENSING-BASED PHENOTYPING.THE PROJECT WILL COMBINE CONTROLLED POLLINATIONS AMONG HIGH-PERFORMING CHESTNUT HYBRIDS, GENOMIC PREDICTION, CONVENTIONAL FIELD EVALUATIONS, AND ADVANCED REMOTE SENSING TECHNOLOGIES TO IMPROVE SELECTION ACCURACY FOR BLIGHT RESISTANCE, TREE GROWTH, AND COMPETITIVE ABILITY. SEEDLING PROGENY FROM SELECTED CROSSES WILL BE GENOTYPED AND EVALUATED USING GENOMIC PREDICTION MODELS TO IDENTIFY INDIVIDUALS WITH SUPERIOR PREDICTED PERFORMANCE WHILE MAINTAINING HIGH LEVELS OF AMERICAN CHESTNUT ANCESTRY. THE HIGHEST-PERFORMING INDIVIDUALS WILL BE ESTABLISHED IN REGIONAL SEED ORCHARDS FOR FUTURE SEED PRODUCTION, WHILE REMAINING PROGENY WILL BE EVALUATED IN REPLICATED PROGENY TRIALS TO IMPROVE GENOMIC PREDICTION MODELS AND QUANTIFY GENETIC GAINS ACROSS BREEDING CYCLES.TO SUPPORT LARGE-SCALE SELECTION AMONG TENS OF THOUSANDS OF CHESTNUT HYBRIDS, THIS PROJECT WILL DEVELOP AND VALIDATE HIGH-THROUGHPUT PHENOTYPING APPROACHES USING UAS-BASED MULTISPECTRAL, THERMAL, AND THREE-DIMENSIONAL REMOTE SENSING TECHNOLOGIES. THESE APPROACHES WILL ENABLE RAPID, NONDESTRUCTIVE EVALUATION OF TREE HEIGHT, CROWN ARCHITECTURE, BIOMASS DISTRIBUTION, PHYSIOLOGICAL STATUS, AND TRAITS ASSOCIATED WITH BLIGHT RESISTANCE AND FOREST COMPETITIVENESS. REMOTE SENSING-DERIVED PHENOTYPES WILL BE INTEGRATED WITH GENOMIC INFORMATION AND MACHINE LEARNING MODELS TO IMPROVE BREEDING VALUE ESTIMATION AND INCREASE THE EFFICIENCY OF PARENT SELECTION. THE RESULTING GENOMICS-PHENOMICS FRAMEWORK WILL PROVIDE A SCALABLE APPROACH FOR ACCELERATING AMERICAN CHESTNUT IMPROVEMENT AND RESTORATION.THE OUTCOMES OF THIS PROJECT WILL SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF IMPROVED CHESTNUT GERMPLASM WITH ENHANCED DISEASE RESISTANCE, COMPETITIVE GROWTH CHARACTERISTICS, AND ADAPTATION TO A RANGE OF GROWING CONDITIONS. IMPROVED SEED PRODUCED FROM SELECTED TREES WILL SUPPORT FOREST RESTORATION PLANTINGS AND DISTRIBUTION THROUGH THE AMERICAN CHESTNUT FOUNDATION, ITS REGIONAL CHAPTERS, RESTORATION PARTNERS, GROWERS, AND OTHER STAKEHOLDERS THROUGHOUT THE HISTORIC RANGE OF THE AMERICAN CHESTNUT. IN ADDITION, THE DEVELOPED HIGH-THROUGHPUT PHENOTYPING AND GENOMIC S,ELECTION APPROACHES WILL PROVIDE A TRANSFERABLE FRAMEWORK FOR IMPROVING OTHER PERENNIAL TREE SPECIES FACING BIOTIC AND ABIOTIC STRESSES.

description: ALFALFA IS A CORNERSTONE OF THE AGRICULTURAL ECONOMY OF THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST, WITH IDAHO RANKING FIRST IN U.S. PRODUCTION ANNUALLY. AS A PERENNIAL CROP TYPICALLY GROWN FOR FOUR OR MORE YEARS, ALFALFA SERVES AS A SENTINEL HOST THAT ACCUMULATES INSECT-TRANSMITTED PATHOGENS OVER MULTIPLE GROWING SEASONS. DESPITE THE IMPORTANCE OF ALFALFA, LITTLE IS KNOWN ABOUT YIELD AND QUALITY EFFECTS OF PERVASIVE, APHID-VECTORED VIRUSES SUCH AS ALFALFA MOSAIC VIRUS (AMV), BEAN LEAFROLL VIRUS (BLRV), AND PEA STREAK VIRUS (PESV). OUR GROUP RECENTLY FOUND THAT CONVENTIONAL INSECTICIDES CAN REDUCE VECTOR DENSITIES, BUT OFTEN FAIL TO REDUCE VIRUS PREVALENCE OR IMPROVE FORAGE YIELD AND QUALITY IN ESTABLISHED STANDS. THIS PROJECT PROPOSES A NOVEL INTEGRATED MANAGEMENT STRATEGY COMBINING SELECTIVE SOFT INSECTICIDES WITH MINERAL CROP OILS TO SUPPRESS VIRUS TRANSMISSION. THIS APPROACH, SUCCESSFULLY USED IN OUR SEED POTATO STUDIES, USES MINERAL CROP OILS TO INTERFERE WITH APHID PROBING AND VIRION BINDING. OUR PRIMARY OBJECTIVE IS TO EVALUATE THE EFFICACY OF INTEGRATED MINERAL OIL AND SELECTIVE INSECTICIDE ROTATIONS IN REDUCING VIRUS PREVALENCE, SUPPRESSING APHID VECTOR DENSITIES, AND PRESERVING BENEFICIAL ARTHROPODS OVER A FULL THREE-YEAR PRODUCTION CYCLE. WE WILL ALSO CHARACTERIZE THE PREVALENCE OF AMV, BLRV, AND PESV IN COMMERCIAL ALFALFA FIELDS IN IDAHO AND OREGON AND RELATE VIRUS INFECTION TO PRODUCTION AND MANAGEMENT PRACTICES. THIS RESEARCH WILL ENHANCE THE ECONOMIC PROFITABILITY OF GROWERS WHILE ADVANCING SUSTAINABLE INTEGRATED PEST MANAGEMENT STRATEGIES FOR ALFALFA PRODUCTION IN THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: MAINE AND THE WIDER NORTHEAST HAVE A FAST-GROWING SHELLFISH FARMING INDUSTRY, BUT NEARLY ALL OYSTERS AND MUCH OF THE HARVEST ARE SOLD FRESH AND LIVE, ON THE HALF SHELL, THROUGH A SINGLE MARKET. THAT LEAVES GROWERS DANGEROUSLY EXPOSED: WHEN A HARMFUL ALGAE BLOOM FORCES A SHELLFISH-HARVESTING CLOSURE, WHEN A STORM DISRUPTS THE COAST, OR WHEN DEMAND SUDDENLY COLLAPSES--AS IT DID WHEN RESTAURANTS SHUT DOWN DURING THE PANDEMIC--FARMERS CAN LOSE MUCH OF THEIR INCOME ALMOST OVERNIGHT. A MEANINGFUL SHARE OF HARVESTED SHELLFISH IS ALSO DISCARDED SIMPLY BECAUSE IT IS NOT PRETTY ENOUGH FOR THE RAW BAR, EVEN THOUGH IT IS PERFECTLY GOOD, HEALTHY FOOD. CANNING SHELLFISH INTO SHELF-STABLE, PREMIUM TINNED SEAFOOD IS A PROVEN WAY TO ADDRESS THESE PROBLEMS: IT TURNS FORCED DOWNTIME AND DISCARDED PRODUCT INTO SELLABLE INVENTORY, REACHES CUSTOMERS FAR FROM THE COAST, AND STEADIES FARM INCOME. THIS APPROACH HAS STRENGTHENED SEAFOOD COMMUNITIES IN SPAIN AND THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST. YET NORTHEAST PRODUCERS HAVE NEVER HAD THE TESTED RECIPES AND FOOD-SAFETY-APPROVED PROCESSES, THE MARKET EVIDENCE, OR THE BUSINESS NUMBERS THEY NEED TO TRY IT WITH CONFIDENCE. THE STAKES REACH WELL BEYOND INDIVIDUAL FARMS: THIS WORK SUPPORTS COASTAL WORKING WATERFRONTS AND JOBS, REDUCES FOOD WASTE, STRENGTHENS A DOMESTIC SEAFOOD SUPPLY THAT TODAY LEANS HEAVILY ON IMPORTS, AND BUILDS RESILIENCE AGAINST A CHANGING CLIMATE.TO BUILD THAT MISSING FOUNDATION, THE PROJECT BRINGS TOGETHER FOOD SCIENTISTS, A CONSUMER ECONOMIST, AND EXTENSION SPECIALISTS. THE TEAM WILL FIRST ASK MAINE GROWERS DIRECTLY WHAT THEY NEED AND WHAT IS HOLDING THEM BACK. IT WILL THEN DEVELOP AND SAFETY-TEST CANNED SHELLFISH PRODUCTS TOGETHER WITH A COMMERCIAL CANNERY, SO THE RECIPES MEET FEDERAL FOOD-SAFETY REQUIREMENTS. TO LEARN WHETHER CUSTOMERS WILL ACTUALLY BUY THESE PRODUCTS AND WHAT THEY WILL PAY, THE TEAM WILL SURVEY ABOUT 1,500 CONSUMERS AND--UNUSUALLY--HAVE PEOPLE TASTE THE REAL CANNED PRODUCT RATHER THAN SIMPLY REACT TO A LABEL. THOSE FINDINGS FEED A PLAIN-LANGUAGE, FARM-BY-FARM CALCULATOR THAT LETS AN INDIVIDUAL GROWER ENTER THEIR OWN COSTS AND SEE WHETHER CANNING WOULD PAY OFF FOR THEIR OPERATION. GROWERS WILL ALSO VISIT SUCCESSFUL CANNERIES TO SEE THE BUSINESS FIRSTHAND, AND THE LESSONS LEARNED WILL BE PACKAGED INTO AN OPEN, EASY-TO-USE GUIDE AND SHORT TRAINING COURSES.THE ULTIMATE GOAL IS TO GIVE NORTHEAST SHELLFISH FARMERS A PRACTICAL, PROVEN PATH TO DIVERSIFY BEYOND THE FRAGILE FRESH MARKET INTO PREMIUM CANNED PRODUCTS. IF THE PROJECT SUCCEEDS, FARMS WILL HAVE STEADIER INCOME THAT BETTER WITHSTANDS CLOSURES AND MARKET SHOCKS, SHELLFISH THAT WOULD OTHERWISE BE WASTED WILL BECOME NEW REVENUE, AND MAINE CAN BECOME A RECOGNIZED AMERICAN SOURCE OF HIGH-QUALITY CANNED SHELLFISH. THE BROADER BENEFITS INCLUDE NEW AND SUSTAINED COASTAL JOBS, REDUCED DEPENDENCE ON IMPORTED SEAFOOD, LESS FOOD WASTE, AND A MORE RESILIENT REGIONAL FOOD SYSTEM. THE TOOLS, DATA, AND KNOWLEDGE THE PROJECT CREATES ARE DESIGNED TO BE USED ACROSS,THE NORTHEAST AND, ULTIMATELY, BY SHELLFISH-PRODUCING COMMUNITIES NATIONWIDE.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: THE ATTRITION RATE OF FOOD ANIMAL VETERINARIANS IS ALARMINGLY HIGH, WITH EARLY CAREER VETERINARIANS FREQUENTLY CITING A LACK OF MENTORSHIP AS A PRIMARY REASON. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT VETERINARY PRACTICES UTILIZING A STRUCTURED MENTORSHIP RESOURCE WILL HAVE INCREASED RETENTION OF NEW ASSOCIATES AND CONSEQUENTLY WE EXPECT A DECREASE IN THE ATTRITION OF FOOD ANIMAL VETERINARIANS FROM THE PROFESSION.BY USING TARGETED SURVEYS TO DEFINE PERSPECTIVE DIFFERENCES BETWEEN MENTORS AND MENTEES, THE PROJECT WILL DEVELOP A PRACTICAL, STRUCTURED MENTORSHIP TOOLKIT DESIGNED TO FOSTER EFFECTIVE AND SUSTAINABLE RELATIONSHIPS IN FOOD ANIMAL PRACTICE.THIS PROJECT SEEKS TO CREATE AN ELECTRONIC RESOURCE WHICH WILL GUIDE MENTORS AND MENTEES IN DESIGNING INDIVIDUALIZED MENTORSHIP PLANS. IT WILL BE PILOTED IN SELECTED PRACTICES, REFINED BASED ON USER FEEDBACK, AND DISSEMINATED THROUGH PROFESSIONAL ORGANIZATIONS, INDUSTRY NETWORKS, OPEN-ACCESS PUBLICATION, AND CONTINUING EDUCATION EVENTS. ULTIMATELY, THE PROJECT IS INTENDED TO IMPROVE THE ALIGNMENT OF EXPECTATIONS AND ENHANCE JOB SATISFACTION, INCREASING THE RETENTION OF VETERINARIANS WITHIN THE FOOD ANIMAL SECTOR.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: THE UNITED STATES FACES A CRITICAL SHORTAGE OF VETERINARIANS SERVING LIVESTOCK OPERATIONS, PARTICULARLY IN RURAL COMMUNITIES, LIMITING CATTLE PRODUCERS' ACCESS TO TRAINED PROFESSIONALS WHO CAN PROVIDE REPRODUCTIVE AND HERD HEALTH SERVICES. THIS SHORTAGE IS ESPECIALLY IMPORTANT BECAUSE THE CATTLE INDUSTRY IS THE LARGEST LIVESTOCK SECTOR IN THE UNITED STATES AND IS WIDELY DISTRIBUTED ACROSS RURAL AREAS, CREATING A SUBSTANTIAL NEED FOR SKILLED VETERINARY SERVICES. LIMITED EXPOSURE TO FOOD-ANIMAL PRACTICE AND INSUFFICIENT OPPORTUNITIES FOR HANDS-ON TRAINING DURING VETERINARY EDUCATION CAN DISCOURAGE STUDENTS FROM PURSUING CAREERS IN LARGE-ANIMAL PRACTICE AND LEAVE NEW GRADUATES WITH LIMITED CONFIDENCE IN PERFORMING REPRODUCTIVE PROCEDURES. TO ADDRESS THIS NEED, FARMVET (FOOD ANIMAL REPRODUCTIVE MANAGEMENT VIA VETERINARY EXPERIENTIAL TRAINING) WILL RECRUIT AND ENGAGE VETERINARY STUDENTS THROUGH EARLY EXPOSURE TO CATTLE PRACTICE, CONNECTIONS WITH PRODUCERS AND INDUSTRY PROFESSIONALS, AND COMPREHENSIVE HANDS-ON TRAINING IN BOVINE REPRODUCTIVE MANAGEMENT AND REPRODUCTIVE TECHNOLOGIES. TRAINING WILL COMBINE CLASSROOM INSTRUCTION, PEER-REVIEWED EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS, DEMONSTRATIONS, AND INTENSIVE, SUPERVISED EXPERIENCE WITH CATTLE TO HELP STUDENTS DEVELOP THE PRACTICAL SKILLS AND CONFIDENCE NEEDED TO PROVIDE REPRODUCTIVE SERVICES AFTER GRADUATION. FARMVET WILL ALSO PROVIDE ADVANCED REPRODUCTIVE TRAINING TO PRACTICING VETERINARIANS AND ARTIFICIAL INSEMINATION TRAINING TO CATTLE PRODUCERS. THE PROGRAM IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE PARTICIPANTS' KNOWLEDGE, PRACTICAL SKILLS, AND CONFIDENCE; EXPAND THE NUMBER OF VETERINARIANS PREPARED TO PROVIDE REPRODUCTIVE SERVICES; AND INCREASE THE NUMBER OF CATTLE PRODUCERS CAPABLE OF SUCCESSFULLY USING ARTIFICIAL INSEMINATION AND RELATED REPRODUCTIVE MANAGEMENT PRACTICES. BY STRENGTHENING THE FOOD-ANIMAL VETERINARY WORKFORCE AND INCREASING PRODUCER ACCESS TO REPRODUCTIVE EXPERTISE AND TECHNOLOGIES, FARMVET WILL HELP ADDRESS CRITICAL VETERINARY SERVICE NEEDS WHILE SUPPORTING GENETIC IMPROVEMENT, REPRODUCTIVE EFFICIENCY, AND THE LONG-TERM PRODUCTIVITY AND SUSTAINABILITY OF U.S. CATTLE OPERATIONS.

description: WE SPEND OVER $50B ON SNACK FOOD EACH YEAR IN AMERICA, AND CALORIES FROM THOSE SNACKS ACCOUNT FOR NEARLY A QUARTER OF OUR DAILY ENERGY, ARE LOW IN NUTRITIONAL VALUE, AND CONTRIBUTE TO OBESITY AND CHRONIC DISEASE. CONSUMER BEHAVIOR IS SHIFTING, BUT MORE NUTRITIOUS HERITAGE GRAINS REMAIN UNDERREPRESENTED, DUE IN PART TO SNACK MANUFACTURING THAT HAS BEEN OPTIMIZED FOR HIGH-STARCH COMMODITY CROPS. THE GOAL OF THIS PROPOSAL IS TO BUILD ON THE SUCCESS OF OUR PHASE 1 AWARD USING ADVANCED, PRECISION EXTRUSION TO DE-RISK MANUFACTURING OF NUTRITIONALLY-DENSE SNACKS MADE FROM HERITAGE GRAINS AND PULSES. OBJECTIVES INCLUDE OPTIMIZING EXTRUSION PARAMETERS WITH PRECISION MOISTURE CONTROL, INCREASING PROTEIN CONTENT USING CO-EXTRUSION, MAXIMIZING SHELF LIFE, AND DEVELOPING A SET OF COMMERCIALLY-VALIDATED PROTOCOLS TO ENSURE FOOD SAFETY. IF SUCCESSFUL, COMMERCIALIZATION OF THE INNOVATIONS DESCRIBED IN THIS PROPOSAL WILL INCREASE NUTRITIONAL DENSITY IN SNACK FOODS, STRENGTHEN DEMAND FOR HERITAGE GRAINS, AND BUILD A FOUNDATION FOR LASTING COMMERCIAL SUCCESS ACROSS THE SUPPLY CHAIN. PHASE 1 ACTIVITIES LED DIRECTLY TO THE COMMERCIALIZATION OF A HIGH-PROTEIN, HIGH-FIBER PRODUCT SOLD THROUGHOUT THE NORTHEAST. PHASE II ACTIVITIES WILL BROADEN THE SUITE OF GRAINS OPTIMIZED FOR EXTRUSION, STRENGTHEN PRODUCT-MARKET FIT, AND DEEPEN OUR STRATEGIC POSITIONING USING PRECISION MANUFACTURING TO BRING NEW, HEALTHIER FOODS TO MARKET.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: MILK IS A VALUABLE SOURCE OF HIGH QUALITY PROTEIN, VITAMINS AND MINERALS AND AN IMPORTANT CONTRIBUTOR TO GLOBAL HEALTH. INFECTIOUS DISEASES IN DAIRY CATTLE CAN SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCE MILK PRODUCTION AND QUALITY, AND HAVE LARGE ECONOMIC IMPACTS. MASTITIS, OR INFECTION OF THE UDDER, IS THE COSTLIEST DISEASE IN DAIRY CATTLE WORLDWIDE; RESULTING IN ANNUAL LOSSES OF UP TO $20 BILLION. THE BACTERIUM STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS IS A TOP CAUSE OF MASTITIS. WE HAVE CONSTRUCTED A VACCINE THAT CAN BE ADMINISTERED TO THE UDDER WITH THE GOAL OF BLOCKING INFECTION. THIS VACCINE IS MADE OF PROTEIN AND CONTAINS A UNIQUE STRUCTURE THAT SUPPORTS THE INDUCTION OF IMMUNITY IN THE BLOOD AS WELL AS LOCAL IMMUNITY IN THE MILK TO PREVENT BOTH BACTERIAL COLONIZATION AND CLINICAL MASTITIS. DELIVERY TO THE UDDER ALSO HAS THE POTENTIAL TO BE A COST-EFFECTIVE ROUTE THAT LEVERAGES CURRENT FARM DRY-OFF PROTOCOLS.OUR GOAL IS TO PRODUCE THIS VACCINE IN A COST-EFFECTIVE WAY AND ESTABLISH ITS SAFETY AND IMMUNOGENICITY TO SUPPORT THE PATH TO LICENSURE. OUR OBJECTIVES ARE TO 1) OPTIMIZE AND SCALE-UP VACCINE PRODUCTION IN THE LABORATORY, AND 2) ESTABLISH THE ROUTE OF VACCINE DELIVERY FOR OPTIMAL IMMUNE INDUCTION. FOR THIS PROJECT WE ARE BUILDING UPON PHASE I OUTCOMES TO VERIFY VACCINE DESIGN USING A LARGE FIELD TRIAL. STUDIES WILL ESTABLISH A PATH TO INDEPENDENCE FOR A START-UP BIOTECH COMPANY, PENTAMER BIOLOGICS, LLC TO FACILITATE CHALLENGE TRIALS FOR VACCINE LICENSURE. THIS RESEARCH SUPPORTS THE MISSION OF USDA NIFA TO ADVANCE AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH. AN EFFECTIVE LICENSED VACCINE WILL REDUCE ECONOMIC BURDENS ON FARMERS WHILE INCREASING ANIMAL WELFARE AND IMPROVING FOOD PRODUCTION AND QUALITY.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: LIVESTOCK PRODUCERS IN CENTRAL FLORIDA WILL CONTINUE TO FACE DIFFICULTY OBTAINING TIMELY VETERINARY CARE BECAUSE FEWER VETERINARIANS ARE AVAILABLE TO SERVE LIVESTOCK, PRODUCERS OFTEN MUST TRAVEL LONG DISTANCES FOR CARE, TRAFFIC CONGESTION INCREASES TRAVEL TIME, AND MANY FARMS LACK ADEQUATE FACILITIES FOR SAFELY HANDLING ANIMALS. THESE CHALLENGES CAN DELAY TREATMENT AND PREVENTIVE CARE, REDUCE ANIMAL HEALTH AND PRODUCTIVITY, AND MAKE IT HARDER FOR PRODUCERS TO MAINTAIN HEALTHY LIVESTOCK. CENTRAL FLORIDA LARGE ANIMAL VETERINARY SERVICES WILL ADDRESS THESE CHALLENGES BY EQUIPPING A NEWLY CONSTRUCTED VETERINARY TREATMENT FACILITY WHERE LIVESTOCK CAN BE BROUGHT FOR CARE WHILE ALSO MAINTAINING RELIABLE VETERINARY SERVICES AT FARMS FOR PRODUCERS WHO CANNOT TRANSPORT THEIR ANIMALS. THE PROJECT WILL INCREASE THE PRACTICE'S ABILITY TO PROVIDE TIMELY EXAMINATIONS, PREVENTIVE CARE, DIAGNOSTIC TESTING, TREATMENT, AND SURGERY; INCREASE VETERINARY SERVICE CAPACITY BY 20-30 PERCENT WITHIN THREE YEARS; SERVE 75-100 NEW CLIENTS EACH YEAR; AND PROVIDE 3-5 EDUCATIONAL OR TRAINING OPPORTUNITIES ANNUALLY FOR VETERINARY STUDENTS, INTERNS, AND YOUTH AGRICULTURAL ORGANIZATIONS. BY IMPROVING ACCESS TO VETERINARY CARE AND MAKING SERVICES MORE EFFICIENT, THE PROJECT WILL HELP IMPROVE LIVESTOCK HEALTH AND WELFARE, SUPPORT THE NEEDS OF LIVESTOCK PRODUCERS, STRENGTHEN VETERINARY SERVICES IN RURALREGIONS, AND CONTRIBUTE TO A MORE RESILIENT AGRICULTURAL AND FOOD SYSTEM IN CENTRAL FLORIDA.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: THE NEED FOR ADDITIONAL FOOD ANIMAL VETERINARIANS IN RURAL SOUTHEAST MINNESOTA IS A REAL AND TANGIBLE PROBLEM ASOLDER VETERINARIANS RETIRE AND CATTLE OPERATIONS CONTINUE TO EXPAND IN SIZE AND NUMBER, LEAVING MANY PRODUCERS WITHOUT EASY ACCESS TO VETERINARY CARE. THE GOAL OF THIS PROJECT IS TO IMPROVE AND EXPAND THE AVAILABILITY OF OUR VETERINARY SERVICES TO THE SHORTAGE AREA IN SE MN. IN ORDER TO ACCOMPLISH THIS GOAL, WE PLAN TO HIRE A FORTH QUALIFIED LARGE ANIMAL VETERINARIAN,PROVIDING HIM OR HER WITHA VET-TRUCK AND VET-BOX INSERT. IN ADDITION, WE WILL REPLACE OUR OTHER 3 VET-BOX INSERTS WHICH ARE 30+ YEARS OLDAND FREQUENTLY LAY UP OUR TRUCKS AND VETERINARIANS WITH MAINTENANCE REPAIRS. FURTHERMORE, WE WILL PURCHASE A PORTABLE HYDRAULIC CHUTE WITH TUB & ALLEY TO SERVE OUR CURRENT AND FUTURE CLIENTS WHO DON'T HAVE A WORKING FACILITIES FOR SAFE HANDLING AND PROCESSING OF CATTLE. WITH THESE OBJECTIVES WE EXPECT TO BE MORE EFFICIENT AT MEETING THE NEEDS OF OUR CURRENT AND FUTURE CLIENTS. BY PROVIDING VETERINARY SERVICE TO MORE CLIENTELE IN SE MN WE EXPECT TO HAVE A DIRECT IMPACT ON LOCAL LIVESTOCK HEALTH AND THEREFORE:FOOD SAFETY, PUBLIC HEALTH, AND THE PROFITABILITY OF OUR CLIENTS.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: LIVESTOCK PRODUCERS AND FARMERS IN OUR SHORTAGE AREA HAVE HAD AN INCREASINGLY DIFFICULT TIME ACCESSING VETERINARY CARE DUE TO THE NUMBER OF VETERINARIANS RETIRING AND A DECLINING NUMBER OF VETERINARIANS INTERESTED IN TREATING SHEEP, CATTLE, GOATS, AND PIGS. THE GOAL OF THIS PROJECT IS TO INCREASE ACCESS TO VETERINARY CARE, IMPROVE THE HEALTH AND WELFARE OF THE ANIMALS, AND HELP STABALIZE THE FOOD SUPPLY WITHIN THE SHORTAGE AREA. GRANT FUNDING WILL PROVIDE EQUIPMENT NECESSARY TO ACHEIVE THESE GOALS - DEPENDABLE VEHICLE, HYDRAULIC CHUTE, ULTRASOUND, RADIOGRAPH MACHINE, AND VARIOUS INSTRUMENTS AND SUPPLIES. AS A RESULT OF FUNDING FROM THIS GRANT, WE EXPECT TO SIGNIFICANTLY IMPROVE BOTH ACCESS TO VETERINARY CARE AND GREATLY IMPROVE ANIMAL WELFARE. THE ANTICIPATED IMPACT WILL BE HEALTHIER ANIMALS AND ASAFER FOOD SUPPLY CHAIN.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: MANY TEENAGERS DO NOT MEET THE RECOMMENDATIONS FOR A HEALTHY DIET. INCORPORATING HEALTHY SNACK OPTIONS, SUCH AS WALNUTS, MAY BE ONE WAY TO IMPROVE TEEN'S DIETS AND ENSURE THEY GET IMPORTANT NUTRIENTS. ADDITIONALLY, MOST TEENAGERS DO NOT GET ENOUGH SLEEP, AND CHANGING SLEEP HABITS CAN BE CHALLENGING DUE TO SCHOOL SCHEDULES, COMPETING DEMANDS FROM SOCIAL ACTIVITIES AND SCREENS, AND NORMAL CHANGES IN BIOLOGICAL RHYTHMS THAT HAPPEN DURING ADOLESCENCE. WALNUTS ARE A NATURAL SOURCE OF MELATONIN, A SLEEP HORMONE, AS WELL AS OTHER NUTRIENTS THAT MAY HELP TEENS SLEEP, SUCH AS MAGNESIUM AND POLYUNSATURATED FATTY ACIDS. THE GOAL OF THIS PROJECT IS TO TEST WHETHER REPLACING USUAL EVENING SNACKS WITH A SNACK OF 1 OZ OF WALNUTS WILL IMPROVE TEENS' DIET QUALITY AND SLEEP QUALITY. TO DETERMINE THIS, TEENS WILL COMPLETE TWO, 4-WEEK LONG STUDY SESSIONS WHERE THEY WILL BE RANDOMLY ASSIGNED TO EITHER A) EAT WHATEVER EVENING SNACKS THEY WOULD NORMALLY EAT OR B) REPLACE THEIR EVENING SNACK WITH 1 OZ OF WALNUTS. DURING THE STUDY SESSIONS, TEENS WILL WEAR A SLEEP TRACKER WATCH, KEEP A LOG OF THEIR EVENING SNACKS, COMPLETE SURVEYS ABOUT THEIR SLEEP AND MOOD, AND COMPLETE RECORDS OF THEIR DIETARY INTAKE. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT DURING THE WALNUT INTERVENTION, TEENS WILL HAVE BETTER DIET QUALITY AND BETTER SLEEP QUALITY, COMPARED TO WHEN THEY ARE CONSUMING THEIR USUAL SNACKS. THE RESULTS OF THIS STUDY WILL HELP RESEARCHERS AND NUTRITIONISTS DEVELOP STRATEGIES TO HELP TEENS AND THEIR FAMILIES INCORPORATE HEALTHY SNACKS INTO DAILY ROUTINES TO OPTIMIZE HEALTH AND WELL-BEING.

subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture

description: RICE IS A MAJOR STAPLE FOOD CONSUMED BY BILLIONS OF PEOPLE WORLDWIDE AND IS AN IMPORTANT AGRICULTURAL COMMODITY IN ARKANSAS AND THE UNITED STATES. HOWEVER, MOST COMMONLY CONSUMED RICE VARIETIES HAVE A HIGH GLYCEMIC INDEX (GI), MEANING THEY CAN CAUSE A RAPID INCREASE IN BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVELS AFTER CONSUMPTION. FREQUENT CONSUMPTION OF HIGH-GI FOODS IS ASSOCIATED WITH INCREASED RISKS OF CHRONIC HEALTH CONDITIONS, INCLUDING TYPE 2 DIABETES, OBESITY, AND CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASE. AS THE PREVALENCE AND ECONOMIC BURDEN OF THESE DISEASES CONTINUE TO INCREASE, THERE IS A GROWING NEED TO DEVELOP HEALTHIER STAPLE FOODS THAT SUPPORT IMPROVED DIETARY MANAGEMENT WHILE MAINTAINING CONSUMER ACCEPTANCE. DEVELOPING LOW-GI RICE PRODUCTS CAN PROVIDE NEW MARKET OPPORTUNITIES FOR RICE PRODUCERS AND PROCESSORS, INCREASE THE VALUE OF ARKANSAS-GROWN RICE, AND CONTRIBUTE TO IMPROVED PUBLIC HEALTH OUTCOMES.THIS PROJECT WILL EVALUATE DIFFERENT ARKANSAS RICE VARIETIES TO IDENTIFY THOSE WITH NATURAL CHARACTERISTICS ASSOCIATED WITH LOWER BLOOD GLUCOSE RESPONSES. THE PROJECTWILL ANALYZE THE NUTRITIONAL COMPONENTS OF RICE, INCLUDING STARCH, PROTEIN, FIBER, AND OTHER BENEFICIAL COMPOUNDS, AND EVALUATE HOW THESE COMPONENTS INFLUENCE STARCH DIGESTION AND GI. THE PROJECT WILL ALSO EXAMINE HOW COMMON RICE PROCESSING PRACTICES, SUCH AS PARBOILING, MILLING, AND COOKING, CAN BE ADJUSTED TO SLOW STARCH DIGESTION. SELECTED RICE VARIETIES AND OPTIMIZED PROCESSING APPROACHES WILL THEN BE COMBINED TO DEVELOP RICE PRODUCTS WITH THE LOWEST POSSIBLE GLYCEMIC RESPONSE WHILE MAINTAINING DESIRABLE QUALITY AND CONSUMER ACCEPTANCE.THE EXPECTED OUTCOME OF THIS RESEARCH IS THE DEVELOPMENT OF SCIENCE-BASED RECOMMENDATIONS FOR PRODUCING HEALTHIER, LOW-GI RICE PRODUCTS USING ARKANSAS RICE CULTIVARS AND COMMERCIALLY FEASIBLE PROCESSING METHODS. THE FINDINGS WILL BENEFIT RICE FARMERS, BREEDERS, MILLERS, FOOD PROCESSORS, AND CONSUMERS BY CREATING OPPORTUNITIES FOR VALUE-ADDED RICE PRODUCTS WITH ENHANCED NUTRITIONAL BENEFITS. ULTIMATELY, THIS PROJECT WILL STRENGTHEN THE COMPETITIVENESS OF THE ARKANSAS RICE INDUSTRY, SUPPORT AGRICULTURAL INNOVATION, AND PROVIDE CONSUMERS WITH HEALTHIER FOOD CHOICES THAT MAY HELP REDUCE THE RISK AND MANAGEMENT CHALLENGES ASSOCIATED WITH DIET-RELATED CHRONIC DISEASES.

agency: Department of Agriculture
subAgency: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
description: PECAN IS AN IMPORTANT ECONOMIC CROP FOR THE US WITH AN ESTIMATED GLOBAL MARKET VALUE OF ALMOST $1B IN 2025. DESPITE THE HIGH-QUALITY NUTRIENTS AND UNIQUE FLAVOR PROFILE, PECAN NUTS ARE ONLY UTILIZED AS A TOPPING FOR DESSERT AND SNACK (RAW, ROASTED, OR SALTED) AND IN SOME BAKERY AND CONFECTIONERY APPLICATIONS. THERE IS A NEED TO DEVELOP PECAN KERNEL AS HIGH-VALUE FOOD INGREDIENTS. THIS PROJECT WILLDEVELOP HIGH-VALUE PECAN POWDERS WITH EXCELLENT NUTRITIONAL QUALITY AND FUNCTIONALITY. WE WILL ACCOMPLISH THIS BY DETERMINING THE IMPACT OF ISOLATION PH ON PECAN PROTEIN CONCENTRATE, MEASURING DIFFERENT PHYSICOCHEMICAL AND FUNCTIONAL PROPERTIES OF PECAN POWDERS, DETERMINING THE NUTRITIONAL QUALITY OF PECAN POWDERS (AMINO ACID COMPOSITION AND IN VITRO DIGESTIBILITY), AND EVALUATING PRODUCT APPLICATIONS OF PECAN POWDERS IN MUFFINS AND SPONGE CAKES.

description:

description: GLOBAL INITIATIVE FOR NEUROPSYCHIATRIC GENETICS RESEARCH IN EDUCATION - PSYCHIATRIC DISORDERS ARE THE LEADING CAUSE OF YEARS-LIVED WITH DISABILITY IN THE US YET PHARMACEUTICAL PROGRESS HAS BEEN STALLED. BECAUSE MANY PSYCHIATRIC DISORDERS ARE HIGHLY HERITABLE AND EXPANDING GENETIC COLLECTIONS TO POPULATIONS OUTSIDE OF THE US ALLOWS US TO DISCOVER POTENTIALLY CAUSAL LOCI THAT ARE INVARIANT IN US POPULATIONS. THE RECENT INVESTMENT IN GLOBAL COLLECTIONS BY THE NIMH HAS REACHED A CRITICAL JUNCTURE; MUCH OF THE DATA WILL BE RELEASED TO PUBLICLY SHARED REPOSITORIES IN THE COMING YEAR. IF LOCAL SCIENTISTS ARE NOT PREPARED TO ANALYZE AND INTERPRET THESE DATA, THE SCIENTIFIC AND CLINICAL INSIGHTS WILL BE DRIVEN ALMOST ENTIRELY FROM OUTSIDE OF THOSE POPULATIONS, LIMITING RELEVANCE AND MISSING CONTEXT‑SPECIFIC QUESTIONS. TO ADDRESS THIS, WE NEED TO TRAIN MULTIDISCIPLINARY RESEARCH TEAMS WHO CAN CONTRIBUTE TO THE RESEARCH FROM A CLINICAL OR COMPUTATIONAL PERSPECTIVE. THIS APPLICATION IS FOR THE CREATION OF THE GLOBAL INITIATIVE FOR NEUROPSYCHIATRIC GENETICS EDUCATION AND RESEARCH – MAKERERE TRAINING PROGRAM (GINGER-MAK) AS PART OF A LONG RUNNING COLLABORATION BETWEEN THE BROAD INSTITUTE AND MAKERERE UNIVERSITY. THE PRINCIPAL OBJECTIVES OF THE TRAINING GRANT IS TO (1) TRAIN EARLY-CAREER COMPUTATIONAL GENETICISTS IN THE FIELD OF GLOBAL MENTAL HEALTH GENETICS; (2) TRAIN EARLY-CAREER PSYCHIATRISTS IN GENETICS RESEARCH METHODS; (3) BRING TOGETHER THE COHORTS OF PSYCHIATRISTS AND COMPUTATIONAL GENETICISTS TO BUILD MULTI-DISCIPLINARY TEAMS; (4) INTEGRATE PSYCHIATRIC GENETICS COURSEWORK INTO CURRICULUM AT MAKERERE AND (5) EVALUATE ALL COMPONENTS OF THE TRAINING PROGRAM FOR EFFECTIVENESS, IMPACT AND RESEARCH CAPACITY IN ORDER TO DESIGN A REPRODUCIBLE STRUCTURE THAT CAN BE IMPLEMENTED ACROSS OTHER LMIC SETTINGS. WE WILL TRAIN POSTDOCTORAL FELLOWS, INCLUDING COMPUTATIONAL SCIENTISTS AND CLINICAL PSYCHIATRISTS, WITH TWO-YEAR TRAINING FELLOWSHIPS IN PSYCHIATRIC GENETICS AND ANALYTICAL METHODS FOR TRANSLATIONAL RESEARCH. THE GINGER-MAK PROGRAM INCLUDES COURSEWORK, BOTH RESIDENTIAL AND HYBRID, SEMINARS, PRACTICA, PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT AND INDEPENDENT AND COLLABORATIVE RESEARCH IN MENTAL HEALTH. WE WILL ALSO TRAIN LOCAL PRE- AND POST- DOCTORAL STUDENTS THROUGH A SERIES OF SHORT COURSES FOCUSING ON STATISTICAL GENETICS, PSYCHIATRIC GENETICS AND SCIENTIFIC WRITING. FINALLY, BUILDING ANALYTIC CAPACITY IN UGANDA, A COUNTRY WITH A HIGH BURDEN OF UNTREATED PSYCHIATRIC ILLNESS AND RAPIDLY GROWING GENOMIC RESOURCES, IS ESSENTIAL FOR GENERATING CONTEXTUALLY GROUNDED INSIGHTS THAT CANNOT BE PRODUCED FROM US‑BASED ANALYSES ALONE. IN TURN, DISCOVERIES FROM THESE DIVERSE POPULATIONS WILL DIRECTLY BENEFIT THE US BY IMPROVING THE GENERALIZABILITY OF PSYCHIATRIC GENOMICS, SHARPENING CAUSAL INFERENCE, AND ACCELERATING THE DEVELOPMENT OF MORE EFFECTIVE TREATMENTS FOR PATIENTS IN THE US.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: UCSD-UEM PARTNERSHIP: TRAINING THE NEXT GENERATION OF MOZAMBICAN SCIENTISTS IN GLOBAL INFECTIOUS DISEASES AND MALARIOLOGY - MOZAMBIQUE, A PORTUGUESE-SPEAKING, LOW-INCOME COUNTRY IN SOUTHEASTERN AFRICA HAS ONE OF THE HIGHEST RATES OF MALARIA AND NEGLECTED TROPICAL DISEASES (NTDS). THESE NTDS INCLUDE TRYPANOSOMIASIS, LEPROSY, LYMPHATIC FILARIASIS, ONCHOCERCIASIS, RABIES, SCHISTOSOMIASIS, CYSTICERCOSIS AND NEUROCYSTICERCOSIS, SOIL TRANSMITTED HELMINTHS AND TRACHOMA. DESPITE EFFORTS TO CONTROL THESE CLIMATE SENSITIVE, EMERGING/REEMERGING PUBLIC HEALTH TREATS, THEIR INCIDENCE AND PREVALENCE IS STILL HIGH. IN ADDITION TO THEIR IMPACT ON THE MOZAMBICAN POPULATION, AMERICANS WHO TRAVEL, WORK OR ARE DEPLOYED TO MOZAMBIQUE OR IN SIMILAR ENVIRONMENTS ELSEWHERE ARE AT RISK FOR THESE DISEASES – BOTH WHILE IN THOSE COUNTRIES AND AFTER THEY RETURN TO THE US WHERE ONWARD SPREAD CAN OCCUR. IN VIEW OF THIS, WE PROPOSE TO ESTABLISH A GLOBAL INFECTIOUS DISEASES (GID) RESEARCH TRAINING TRACK IN THE EXISTING POST GRADUATE TRAINING PROGRAMS AT EDUARDO MONDLANE UNIVERSITY (UEM) IN MAPUTO, MOZAMBIQUE IN PARTNERSHIP WITH UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA SAN DIEGO (UCSD). WE WILL ESTABLISH A GID PHD RESEARCH TRAINING PROGRAM AT UEM. WE WILL SUPPORT LONG-TERM TRAINING OF THE NEXT GENERATION OF MOZAMBICAN SCIENTISTS AND HIGHLY QUALIFIED PROFESSIONALS IN GID RESEARCH METHODS BOTH THROUGH THE NEWLY ESTABLISHED GID PHD PROGRAM AND THROUGH MEDIUM- AND SHORT-TERM TRAINING IN MENTORED RESEARCH AND PROFESSIONAL TRAINING IN MALARIA AND NTDS. WE WILL ALSO STRENGTHEN RESEARCH ADMINISTRATION AND PROGRAM EVALUATION CAPACITY WITHIN MOZAMBIQUE TO ENABLE TRAINEES TO BECOME INDEPENDENT RESEARCHERS WITH THEIR OWN RESEARCH TEAMS.”

agency: Department of Health and Human Services

recipient.name: CENTRE FOR INFECTIOUS DISEASE RESEARCH IN ZAMBIA

description: BUILDING CAPACITY IN RESEARCH TO ELIMINATE HEPATITIS B VIRUS (BEAT-HBV) - HEPATITIS B VIRUS (HBV) IS A MAJOR GLOBAL INFECTIOUS DISEASE, AFFECTING MILLIONS OF AMERICANS AND HUNDREDS OF MILLIONS OF PEOPLE WORLDWIDE, MAKING COMPLICATIONS FROM VIRAL HEPATITIS AMONG THE TOP 10 CAUSES OF DEATH. IN THE U.S., 1-2 MILLION PEOPLE ARE LIVING WITH CHRONIC HBV INFECTION, WHICH IS A MAJOR CAUSE OF LIVER CANCER. ACUTE HBV INFECTIONS, WHICH CAN SOMETIMES CAUSE LIVER FAILURE REQUIRING LIVER TRANSPLANTATION, HAVE BEEN LINKED TO THE OPIOID EPIDEMIC. THE VIRUS ALSO SPREADS DUE TO IMMIGRATION TO THE U.S. FROM OTHER COUNTRIES AND DURING TRAVEL OF AMERICANS ABROAD. A NEW RESEARCH TRAINING PROGRAM, CALLED BEAT HBV, IS PROPOSED TO ADDRESS THE SHORTAGE OF HBV RESEARCHERS. DESPITE HBV BEING COMMON, THERE IS A MAJOR LACK OF HBV-FOCUSED SCIENTISTS, COMPARED TO OTHER MAJOR INFECTIONS. THE NEED FOR WORKFORCE CAPACITY IN THIS FIELD WAS HIGHLIGHTED IN THE U.S. GOVERNMENT’S PLAN FOR HEPATITIS B CURE RESEARCH. BEAT HBV WILL BE BASED IN ZAMBIA FOR SEVERAL REASONS. FIRST, HBV INFECTION AND HBV-ASSOCIATED LIVER CANCER ARE 20-50 TIMES MORE PREVALENT THAN IN U.S., WHICH MAKES IT EASIER TO RECRUIT PARTICIPANTS AND STUDY THE INFECTION’S NATURAL HISTORY. LOCAL ORGANIZATIONS IN ZAMBIA HAVE WELL-ESTABLISHED RESEARCH PARTNERSHIPS WITH MULTIPLE U.S. UNIVERSITIES, INCLUDING A COLLABORATIVE NIH-SUPPORTED SENTINEL HBV CLINICAL COHORT THAT IS HELPING TO ANSWERING QUESTIONS RELEVANT TO TREATMENT AND PREVENTION OF HBV IN AMERICA. ACCESS TO A LARGE POPULATION OF PATIENTS AND ACTIVE HBV CLINICAL AND TRANSLATIONAL RESEARCH PROVIDES A STRONG TRAINING ENVIRONMENT THAT DOES NOT EXIST IN THE U.S. TRAINEES INCLUDING U.S. AND ZAMBIAN NEW AND EARLY-STAGE INVESTIGATORS, MASTERS, PHD, AND POST-DOC LEVELS WILL LEARN HBV RESEARCH METHODS AND BE TRAINED TO IDENTIFY AND TACKLE THE MOST PRESSING CLINICAL AND PUBLIC HEALTH QUESTIONS FOR THE BENEFIT OF PEOPLE IN THE U.S., ZAMBIA, AND GLOBALLY. FELLOWS IN THE PROGRAM WILL ALSO UNDERTAKE MENTORED RESEARCH TO ANSWER SCIENTIFIC QUESTIONS, SUCH WHAT PREDICTS THE ONSET OF LIVER CANCER IN CHRONIC HBV INFECTION AND WHAT ARE THE BEST IMPLEMENTATION STRATEGIES TO IDENTIFY CHRONIC INFECTIONS IN HARD-TO-REACH POPULATIONS BEFORE THE ONSET OF COMPLICATIONS. RESEARCH BY BEAT HBV TRAINEES WILL ALSO ADVANCE THE U.S. GOVERNMENT’S HBV CURE AGENDA, INCLUDING NOVEL VIRAL AND IMMUNOMODULATORY THERAPIES PLUS DIAGNOSTIC BIOMARKERS, WHICH IS HIGHLY RELEVANT TO AMERICANS SINCE CURRENT THERAPIES LOWER THE VIRUS LOAD BUT NOT ELIMINATE THE RISK OF CANCER. ULTIMATELY, THE PROGRAM WILL BETTER EQUIP THE U.S. TO ACHIEVE HBV ELIMINATION AT HOME AND WITH PARTNER COUNTRIES LIKE ZAMBIA.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: INTERROGATING RNA LOCALIZATION AND LOCAL TRANSLATION DURING SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY INDUCED BY OPIOID USE DISORDER - ABSTRACT OPIOID USE DISORDER (OUD) HAS EMERGED AS ONE OF THE MOST SEVERE PUBLIC HEALTH CRISES IN THE UNITED STATES. A MAJOR CHALLENGE FOR PEOPLE SUFFERING FROM OUD IS THE PERSISTENCE OF RELAPSE VULNERABILITY, WHICH IS MEDIATED BY LONG-LASTING ALTERATIONS IN BRAIN CIRCUITS DRIVEN BY OUD-INDUCED SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY. UNDERSTANDING THE MOLECULAR BASIS OF SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY INDUCED BY OUD IS CRUCIAL FOR DEVELOPING NEW THERAPEUTICS TO TREAT OUD VIA REVERSING OR PREVENTING MALADAPTIVE SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY. EPIGENETICS IS WIDELY RECOGNIZED AS A FUNDAMENTAL MOLECULAR BASIS OF PERSISTENT DRUG ADDICTION AND HAS BEEN DIRECTLY LINKED TO DRUG-EVOKED SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY. INSTEAD OF STUDYING THE EXTENSIVELY CHARACTERIZED EPIGENETIC MECHANISMS WITHIN THE NUCLEUS, THIS PROPOSAL AIMS TO UNDERSTAND HOW A PARTICULAR EPIGENETIC MECHANISM OCCURRING OUTSIDE THE NUCLEUS, THE SPATIOTEMPORAL GENE EXPRESSION REGULATION VIA RNA LOCALIZATION AND LOCAL TRANSLATION, PARTICIPATES IN SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY INDUCED BY OUD. INSPIRED BY TWO WELL-RECOGNIZED DISCOVERIES: 1) RNA LOCALIZATION AND LOCAL TRANSLATION PLAY AN ESSENTIAL ROLE IN SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY DURING LEARNING AND MEMORY PROCESSES, AND 2) OUD-INDUCED SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY PROVIDES THE MOLECULAR BASIS OF OPIOID ADDICTION ONSET AND PERSISTENCE, I HYPOTHESIZE THAT RNA LOCALIZATION AND LOCAL TRANSLATION MIGHT SERVE AS KEY EPIGENETIC MECHANISMS CONTRIBUTING TO SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY INDUCE BY OUD. TO SYSTEMATICALLY INVESTIGATE THIS HYPOTHESIS, I PROPOSE A COMPREHENSIVE AND TRANSFORMATIVE PLATFORM WHICH LEVERAGES ESTABLISHED OUD ANIMAL MODELS WITH CUTTING-EDGE METHODS FOR STUDY OF RNA LOCALIZATION AND LOCAL TRANSLATION. SPECIFICALLY, I WILL FIRST DEVELOP TWO NOVEL METHODS TO PROFILE THE LOCAL TRANSCRIPTOME AND TRANSLATOME AT DESIGNATED PRE- AND POST- SYNAPSES BY INTEGRATING SYNAPSE ISOLATION WITH RNA PROXIMITY LABELING OR RIBOSOME PROFILING. I WILL APPLY THE TWO METHODS FOR PROFILING IN A FENTANYL-TRIGGERED CONDITIONED PLACE PREFERENCE (CPP) MOUSE MODEL TO IDENTIFY RNA CANDIDATES WHOSE SYNAPTIC LOCALIZATION AND/OR LOCAL TRANSLATION ARE CHANGED DURING SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY INVOLVED IN FENTANYL-INDUCED REWARD. NEXT, I WILL DEVELOP A CRISPR METHOD TO PERTURB THE SYNAPTIC LOCALIZATION OF TOP RNA CANDIDATES IN VIVO TO STUDY THE CAUSAL RELATIONSHIP OF RNA LOCALIZATION AND LOCAL TRANSLATION WITH SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY AND BEHAVIORAL IMPACTS IN THE CPP MODEL. FINALLY, I WILL APPLY THIS NEW PLATFORM TO A MOUSE MODEL OF FENTANYL INTRAVENOUS SELF-ADMINISTRATION (IVSA), WHICH BETTER MIMICS KEY ASPECTS OF HUMAN ADDICTION, TO STUDY HOW RNA LOCALIZATION AND LOCAL TRANSLATION PARTICIPATE IN REGULATING SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY INDUCED DURING DIFFERENT STAGES OF FENTANYL “ADDICTION”. I ENVISION THAT THIS PROPOSAL WILL REVOLUTIONIZE OUR UNDERSTANDING OF THE EPIGENETICS OF OUD BY PROVIDING GROUNDBREAKING NEW INSIGHTS INTO HOW RNA LOCALIZATION AND LOCAL TRANSLATION CONTRIBUTE TO OUD- INDUCED SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY AND MEDIATE COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN CELL BODY AND SYNAPSES FOR LONG-TERM CHANGES IN NEURAL CIRCUITS IN OUD. IT WILL ALSO OPEN NEW AVENUES FOR OUD TREATMENT THROUGH CORRECTING OR ENGINEERING KEY RNA LOCALIZATION AND LOCAL TRANSLATION EVENTS TO REVERSE OUD-INDUCED SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY FOR LONG-TERM RELAPSE PREVENTION AND SET THE STAGE FOR FUTURE ANALYSIS OF EPIGENETICS OF OTHER SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS.

description: IDENTIFICATION AND INTERROGATION OF GLIAL GENE SIGNATURES IN VOLITIONAL OPIOID SEEKING - PROJECT SUMMARY DRUG ADDICTION REMAINS A PERVASIVE PUBLIC HEALTH CRISIS, AFFECTING MILLIONS OF INDIVIDUALS WORLDWIDE. DESPITE THE ENORMOUS SOCIETAL COST AND CONTINUED INCREASE IN OPIOID-RELATED OVERDOSES, TREATMENT OPTIONS ARE LIMITED. THIS IS DUE IN PART TO OUR INCOMPLETE UNDERSTANDING OF WHICH MOLECULAR ADAPTATIONS INITIATED BY OPIOID USE ARE NECESSARY FOR THE TRANSITION TO THE ADDICTED STATE. AN INHERENT CHALLENGE IN IDENTIFYING AND ISOLATING THE KEY TRANSCRIPTIONAL CHANGES DRIVING THIS PROCESS IS THE DIVERSE CELLULAR COMPOSITION IN MESOLIMBIC REWARD REGIONS, INCLUDING GLIAL POPULATIONS LIKE ASTROCYTES, MICROGLIA, AND OLIGODENDROCYTES. MORE RECENTLY, CONVERGING LINES OF RESEARCH DEMONSTRATE THAT THESE GLIAL POPULATIONS PLAY A CENTRAL ROLE IN THE TRANSITION TO ADDICTION. HOWEVER, OUR ABILITY TO HARNESS THE THERAPEUTIC POTENTIAL OF GLIAL-SPECIFIC TRANSCRIPTIONAL AND EPIGENETIC MANIPULATIONS IN THE CONTEXT OF ADDICTION HAS BEEN LIMITED BY A LACK OF DETAILED INSIGHT INTO WHICH SPECIFIC GENE SIGNATURES ARE INITIATED DURING PERSISTENT DRUG TAKING, AND THE INABILITY TO SELECTIVELY TARGET THESE ALTERATIONS IN REAL TIME TO INTERROGATE THEIR ROLE IN CELLULAR AND BEHAVIORAL FUNCTION. THE MAJORITY OF TRANSCRIPTOMIC AND CHROMATIN PROFILING IN THE CONTEXT OF OPIOID MISUSE HAS RELIED ON EITHER BULK TISSUE HOMOGENATES OR NEURON-CENTRIC SEQUENCING EXPERIMENTS. WHILE INFORMATIVE, SUCH APPROACHES DO NOT ALLOW FOR IN-DEPTH EXAMINATION OF GLIAL-SPECIFIC MOLECULAR SIGNATURES INDUCED BY DRUGS OF ABUSE. ANOTHER CHALLENGE IN UNDERSTANDING THE COMPLEX NATURE OF DRUG-INDUCED ALTERNATIONS IN GLIA IS THE LACK OF AVAILABLE TOOLS FOR SELECTIVE MODULATION OF GENE TARGETS IN THESE POPULATIONS. TRADITIONAL CRISPR GENE AND EPIGENETIC EDITING APPROACHES HAVE FOCUSED PRIMARILY ON CELL-AGNOSTIC OR NEURONAL MODULATION OF INDIVIDUAL GENE TARGETS. TO OVERCOME THESE HURDLES, THIS PROPOSAL WILL UTILIZE SINGLE-NUCLEI RNA-SEQUENCING (SNRNA-SEQ) AND THE ASSAY FOR TRANSPOSASE-ACCESSIBLE CHROMATIN (SNATAC-SEQ) TO DEFINE GLIAL-SPECIFIC GENE SIGNATURES OF CONTINGENT DRUG USE IN THE MESOLIMBIC REWARD CIRCUITRY OF MALE AND FEMALE RATS. IN ADDITION TO REVEALING NOVEL AND POTENTIALLY SEX-SPECIFIC THERAPEUTIC CANDIDATES, THIS INFORMATION WILL BE UTILIZED TO ENGINEER NEW CRISPR/DCAS9-BASED EPIGENETIC EDITING TOOLS, WHICH WILL ALLOW FOR MANIPULATION OF DRUG-RESPONSIVE GENES IN DISCRETE GLIAL POPULATIONS. THIS APPROACH WILL ENABLE SELECTIVE MODIFICATION OF INDIVIDUAL OR MULTIPLE GENE TARGETS SIMULTANEOUSLY, EFFECTIVELY ALLOWING US TO TEST THE REQUIREMENT OF COMPLEX GLIAL GENE PROGRAMS IN A VOLITIONAL MODEL OF DRUG USE. COLLECTIVELY, THE PROPOSED EXPERIMENTS WILL BE THE FIRST TO DEFINE THE EXACT NATURE AND SCOPE OF GLIAL-SPECIFIC GENE SIGNATURES FOLLOWING SUSTAINED DRUG EXPERIENCE, AND TO MECHANISTICALLY LINK THE REQUIREMENT OF THESE GENE PROGRAMS IN REWARD NEUROCIRCUITRY DURING DRUG SELF-ADMINISTRATION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: LABEL-FREE GLYCAN SEQUENCING: NEW METHODS TO REVEAL THE 'SWEET SIDE' OF HOST-PATHOGEN INTERACTIONS - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT GLYCOCONJUGATES ARE FORMED BY THE ADDITION OF SUGARS TO RNA, PROTEINS, AND LIPIDS. IT IS ESTIMATED THAT UP TO 1012 DIFFERENT BRANCHED GLYCAN STRUCTURES EXIST, AND THESE STRUCTURES CAN HAVE SIGNIFICANT IMPACT ON PROTEIN, LIPID, AND RNA FUNCTION. GLYCOCONJUGATES DISPLAYED ON CELL SURFACES PLAY CRUCIAL ROLES IN REGULATING A WIDE RANGE OF BIOLOGICAL PROCESSES, INCLUDING IMMUNE RESPONSE, CELL ADHESION, MOLECULAR TRAFFICKING, AND SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION. DESPITE THEIR IMPORTANCE, THE VAST MAJORITY OF GLYCANS ARE UNKNOWN AND UNKNOWABLE WITH EXISTING TECHNIQUES. EXISTING METHODS ARE EITHER TARGETED OR DESTRUCTIVE, AND OFTEN FALL SHORT IN PROVIDING THE RESOLUTION AND SPECIFICITY NEEDED TO MAP GLYCANS IN DETAIL, ESPECIALLY ON THEIR SCAFFOLD. THIS PROPOSAL WILL DEVELOP A NOVEL, LABEL-FREE PLATFORM TO SEQUENCE GLYCANS AT HIGH RESOLUTION, COMBINING ADVANCES IN NANOPHOTONICS, RAMAN SPECTROSCOPY, ENZYMATIC CHEMISTRY, AND MACHINE LEARNING. OUR INITIAL FOCUS WILL BE ON GLYCORNA, A NEWLY DISCOVERED CLASS OF GLYCOSYLATED RNA MOLECULES FOUND ON CELL SURFACES, WHICH HAVE IMPLICATIONS IN CRUCIAL CELLULAR COMMUNICATION AND IMMUNE RESPONSES. BY LEVERAGING A NANOSTRUCTURED SILICON CHIP THAT SIGNIFICANTLY ENHANCES RAMAN SCATTERING SIGNALS, WE AIM TO DETECT AND CHARACTERIZE THESE GLYCOCONJUGATES AT THE SINGLE-MOLECULE LEVEL. COUPLED WITH ADVANCED MACHINE LEARNING ALGORITHMS, OUR PLATFORM WILL ENABLE THE CONSTRUCTION OF A COMPREHENSIVE LIBRARY OF GLYCOCONJUGATE RAMAN SPECTRA AND SEQUENCES, WHICH WILL BE INSTRUMENTAL IN IDENTIFYING AND CHARACTERIZING THE GLYCOME IN VARIOUS BIOLOGICAL SAMPLES. WE WILL UTILIZE THIS PLATFORM TO ADDRESS IMPORTANT AND OUTSTANDING QUESTIONS SUCH AS (A) HOW MANY RNAS HAVE GLYCAN SIGNATURES? (B) HOW MANY DIFFERENT GLYCORNA SIGNATURES DO WE SEE IN THE POPULATION (C) ARE THERE CLASSES OF RNA SIGNATURES THAT HAVE MORE GLYCANS ON THEM THAN OTHERS? (D) WITHIN A GIVEN POPULATION OF RNA SIGNATURES WHICH ALSO HAVE GLYCAN SIGNATURES, DO THEY ALL HAVE THE SAME GLYCAN SIGNAL OR IS IT HETEROGENEOUS? WE WILL USE OUR FIRST-OF-ITS-KIND PLATFORM TO COMPARE MAMMALIAN CELL GLYCORNA WITH BACTERIAL GLYCORNA. WE WILL THEN MEASURE MAMMALIAN CELL GLYCORNA PROFILES AFTER EXPOSURE TO VIRAL OR BACTERIAL INFECTION; AND ALSO COMPARE THOSE PROFILES TO VACCINATED CELLS AGAINST THOSE SAME VIRAL/BACTERIAL PATHOGENS. WE ARE ESPECIALLY EXCITED TO INVESTIGATE HOW GLYCORNA IN MODEL ORGANISMS VARIES AS THEIR COMMENSAL BACTERIA ARE MODIFIED TO EXPRESS DISTINCT TUMOR-ASSOCIATED ANTIGENS, AND HOW THOSE GLYCOPATTERNS MIGHT DRIVE IMMUNE RESPONSES. SUBSEQUENTLY, OUR PLATFORM WILL BE EXTENDED TO STUDY GLYCOPROTEINS AND GLYCOLIPIDS, BROADENING ITS APPLICABILITY ACROSS DIFFERENT CLASSES OF GLYCOCONJUGATES. WE ULTIMATELY ENVISION USING THIS TECHNOLOGY FOR SPATIAL GLYCOMIC INVESTIGATIONS, ENABLING SINGLE-CELL ANALYSIS OF GLYCOSYLATION PATTERNS WITHIN COMPLEX TISSUE ENVIRONMENTS. THIS RESEARCH WILL NOT ONLY BRIDGE CRITICAL GAPS IN OUR UNDERSTANDING OF THE GLYCOME BUT ALSO PROVIDE A VERSATILE, GENERALIZABLE TOOL FOR THE SCIENTIFIC COMMUNITY, DRIVING FORWARD DISCOVERIES IN GLYCOBIOLOGY AND INFORMING THE DEVELOPMENT OF NOVEL THERAPEUTIC STRATEGIES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DIRECT, LARGE-SCALE PERTURBATION AND MAPPING OF PROTEIN FUNCTION IN HUMAN CELLS - PROJECT SUMMARY THE ADVENT OF CRISPR-BASED METHODOLOGIES HAS TRANSFORMED OUR ABILITY TO MAP THE COMPLEX RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN GENOTYPES AND PHENOTYPES AT SCALE, BY ENABLING MULTIPLEXED AND COMBINATORIAL GENETIC PERTURBATIONS OF THE HUMAN GENOME. AS POWERFUL AND INFORMATIVE AS THEY HAVE BEEN, THESE METHODS ARE RESTRICTED TO GENETIC PERTURBATIONS AND THE GENETIC MAPPING OF CELLULAR PHENOTYPES. HOWEVER, MANY CELLULAR PHENOTYPES ARE DRIVEN BY CHANGES IN MOLECULAR ACTIVITIES (E.G. PROTEINS TRANSITIONING BETWEEN MULTIPLE CONFORMATIONAL OR PHOSPHORYLATION STATES) AND NOT JUST THE PRESENCE OR ABSENCE OF A GENE PRODUCT. TO DATE, NO METHOD EXISTS TO COMBINATORIALLY PERTURB THE PROTEOME WITH SUCH SCALE AND PRECISION, AND MAP HOW RESULTING CHANGES TO PROTEIN STATES DRIVE CRITICAL CELLULAR AND DISEASE PHENOTYPES. WHAT WE NEED IS AN EQUIVALENT OF POOLED GENETIC PERTURBATIONS FOR PROTEIN CONFORMATIONS, TO CREATE AN EQUIVALENT OF GENE INTERACTION MAPS FOR PROTEINS. WITH SUPPORT FROM THE PIONEER AWARD, WE WILL DEVELOP A TECHNOLOGY TO REALIZE THIS UNADDRESSED GRAND CHALLENGE IN BIOLOGY. LEVERAGING OUR EXPERTISE IN SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY AND CONTINUOUS EVOLUTION, WE WILL GENERATE A NOVEL CLASS OF NANOBODY-BASED PROBES THAT ENABLE PRECISE, MULTIPLEXED, AND GENETICALLY-ENCODED PERTURBATIONS TO PROTEIN CONFORMATIONS/STATES. THESE PROBES WILL EMPOWER A NEW GENERATION OF “CRISPR-LIKE” POOLED SCREENS TO GENERATE LARGE-SCALE, UNBIASED PROTEIN INTERACTION MAPS. WE WILL INITIALLY APPLY THIS TECHNOLOGY TO G-PROTEIN COUPLED RECEPTORS (GPCRS), A SUPERFAMILY OF CELL MEMBRANE RECEPTORS INVOLVED IN MANY ASPECTS OF HUMAN PHYSIOLOGY AND DISEASE. OUR PROTEIN-BASED PROBES WILL ALLOW MILLIONS OF SIMULTANEOUS PERTURBATIONS TO THE SIGNALING STATES OF GPCRS TO BE POOLED WITHOUT LOSING PROBE-PHENOTYPE LINKAGE (MUCH LIKE GRNAS IN CRISPR). OUR TECHNOLOGY WILL ALLOW US TO TACKLE THE MYSTERY OF HOW INTERCONNECTED GPCR NETWORKS REGULATE IMMUNE CELL FUNCTION, SUCH AS THOSE INVOLVED IN CANCER IMMUNOLOGY AND THERAPEUTICS, AND PROVIDE THE FIRST HOLISTIC DESCRIPTIONS OF THE GPCR-OME OPERATING WITHIN HUMAN CELLS. THIS WORK, WHICH TAKES OUR RESEARCH INTO AN EXCITING NEW DIRECTION, WILL PROVIDE A POWERFUL NEW LENS FOR BASIC BIOLOGY AND DISEASE, AND FOSTERS A NEW THERAPEUTIC PARADIGM, IN WHICH WE DEPART FROM DRUGGING INDIVIDUAL GPCR TARGETS, AND TREAT DISEASES BY MODULATING SETS OF RECEPTORS WITH PRECISION NANOBODIES. FINALLY, THIS WORK ESTABLISHES A BLUEPRINT FOR USING FUNCTIONAL CONTINUOUS EVOLUTION SYSTEMS TO GENERATE PROTEIN MODULATORS FOR MANY OTHER CLASSES OF PROTEINS TO MAP THE LANDSCAPE OF HOW INDIVIDUAL MOLECULAR ACTIVITIES COORDINATE TO PRODUCE CELLULAR AND DISEASE PHENOTYPES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: THE IMPACTS OF CONSULTANTS ON FINANCIAL, OPERATIONAL, AND QUALITY OUTCOMES IN THE U.S. HEALTH SYSTEM - ABSTRACT HEALTH CARE DELIVERY ORGANIZATIONS IN THE U.S. ARE INCREASINGLY TURNING TO CONSULTANTS FOR FINANCIAL AND OPERATIONAL EXPERTISE, FUELING THE RAPID EXPANSION OF THE CONSULTING INDUSTRY. ALTHOUGH CONSULTANTS ARE OFTEN HIRED FOR THEIR SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS, THEY ALSO COME WITH SIGNIFICANT COSTS. HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS – PARTICULARLY NONPROFIT HEALTH CARE ORGANIZATIONS – ARE AMONG THE INDUSTRY'S LARGEST CLIENTS. DESPITE THIS GROWING RELIANCE, LITTLE EMPIRICAL RESEARCH HAS EXAMINED THE IMPACT OF CONSULTANTS ON FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE AND PATIENT WELFARE. THIS PROJECT ADDRESSES THAT CRITICAL GAP BY APPLYING MODERN EMPIRICAL METHODS TO EVALUATE THE COSTS AND EFFECTS OF CONSULTANTS AT NONPROFIT HEALTH CARE ORGANIZATIONS. BY CREATIVELY LEVERAGING PUBLICLY AVAILABLE IRS TAX FILINGS (FORM 990) FOR NONPROFIT HEALTH CARE ORGANIZATIONS, USING MACHINE LEARNING TO IDENTIFY CONSULTING CONTRACTS, LINKING TO ORGANIZATIONAL- AND PATIENT-LEVEL DATASETS, AND APPLYING CAUSAL INFERENCE METHODS, I WILL ADDRESS THE FOLLOWING CORE QUESTIONS: 1) HOW MUCH MONEY ARE NONPROFIT HEALTH CARE DELIVERY ORGANIZATIONS SPENDING ON CONSULTANTS? 2) WHAT ARE THE MAJOR TYPES OF NONPROFIT HEALTH CARE DELIVERY ORGANIZATIONS THAT USE CONSULTANTS AND WHICH TYPES OF CONSULTANTS? 3) WHAT ARE THE CAUSAL IMPACTS OF CONSULTANTS ON HEALTH CARE DELIVERY ORGANIZATIONS’ FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE, OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY, AND QUALITY OF CARE? THE INSIGHTS GAINED FROM THIS PROPOSAL PROVIDE UNPARALLELED TRANSPARENCY INTO THE CONSULTING INDUSTRY AND DETERMINE WHETHER THIS INDUSTRY PRODUCES OR UNDERMINES VALUE IN THE U.S. HEALTH SYSTEM. FINDINGS FROM THIS STUDY WILL INFORM POLICIES GOVERNING CONSULTING CONTRACTS, FINANCIAL TRANSPARENCY, NONPROFIT ORGANIZATION ACCOUNTABILITY, AND HEALTH CARE WASTE.

description: EVOLUTION-INSPIRED DISSECTION OF FUNGAL RECOGNITION BY MAMMALIAN IMMUNE RECEPTORS. - PROJECT SUMMARY MAMMALIAN IMMUNE SYSTEMS ARE ONE OF THE FRONT LINES OF RAPID EVOLUTION AND GENETIC INNOVATION. WHILE MAINTAINING THE ORCHESTRATION OF FINELY TUNED IMMUNE RESPONSES THROUGHOUT, THEY MUST COMBAT A WIDE ARRAY OF INVADING MICROBIAL PATHOGENS THAT CAN QUICKLY EVOLVE NEW STRATEGIES TO DISGUISE, MANIPULATE, EVADE, AND DESTROY. THE EVOLUTIONARY BACK-AND-FORTH THAT ENSUES RESULTS IN DIVERSIFICATION OF THE SEQUENCES, STRUCTURES, AND FUNCTIONS OF THE FACTORS INVOLVED. STUDIES OF THESE EVOLUTIONARY ARMS RACES HAVE BEEN INSTRUMENTAL TO OUR UNDERSTANDING OF THE MOLECULAR BASIS OF INTERACTIONS BETWEEN HOSTS AND VIRAL AND BACTERIAL PATHOGENS, AND REVEAL THE WAYS THEY HAVE SHAPED THE EVOLUTION OF THESE SPECIES AND THE VULNERABILITIES THAT REMAIN. DESPITE THESE SUCCESSES WITH VIRUSES AND BACTERIA, STUDIES OF PATHOGENIC FUNGI THAT INTEGRATE EVOLUTIONARY EXPERIMENTAL AND ANALYTICAL FRAMEWORKS HAVE BEEN LARGELY MISSING. FUNGI ARE AN UNDERSTUDIED CLASS OF MICROBIAL PATHOGENS CAPABLE OF INFECTING A DIVERSE RANGE OF ANIMALS, INCLUDING HUMANS, WITH TRULY DEVASTATING EFFECTS ON THE HEALTH OF THESE SPECIES. DESPITE THEIR IMPACT ON HUMAN HEALTH AND MORTALITY, THERE REMAIN MANY OPEN QUESTIONS ABOUT THE NATURE AND EVOLUTION OF INTERACTIONS BETWEEN THESE EUKARYOTIC PATHOGENS AND THE HOSTS THEY INFECT. HERE, WE BRING THIS MISSING EVOLUTIONARY PERSPECTIVE TO THE STUDY OF HOST-FUNGAL INTERACTIONS. IN PREVIOUS WORK, I IDENTIFIED RAPID EVOLUTION AND RECURRENT SEQUENCE DIVERSIFICATION OF FUNGI-DETECTING INNATE IMMUNE RECEPTORS IN MAMMALS. IN PROJECT 1, WE USE THIS HALLMARK OF AN EVOLUTIONARY ARMS RACE AS A LAUNCHPAD FOR UNDERSTANDING— AT THE MOLECULAR LEVEL—HOW MAMMALIAN INNATE IMMUNE SYSTEMS RECOGNIZE FUNGI. BY COMBINING TESTING OF NATURALLY DIVERSIFIED RECEPTOR ORTHOLOGS ALONG WITH EVOLUTION-GUIDED MUTATIONAL SCANNING APPROACHES, WE WILL REVEAL AN UNPRECEDENTED VIEW INTO THE SEQUENCE DETERMINANTS THAT ARE MOST IMPORTANT FOR TUNING THE FUNCTION OF THESE RECEPTORS AS WELL AS THE SELECTIVE PRESSURES THAT DRIVE THEIR EVOLUTION IN MAMMALS. IN PROJECT 2, WE WILL TURN OUR ATTENTION TO THE FUNGI, AND ASK THE QUESTIONS OF WHAT DO FUNGI CHANGE AND HOW DO FUNGI CHANGE IN ORDER TO EVADE DETECTION BY MAMMALIAN IMMUNE SYSTEMS. WE WILL USE A LARGE COLLECTION OF GENETICALLY DIVERSE STRAINS OF THE FUNGAL PATHOGEN, CRYPTOCOCCUS NEOFORMANS, AND ESTABLISH A MOLECULAR BARCODING SYSTEM FOR HIGH- THROUGHPUT STRAIN CHARACTERIZATION. THIS WILL ALLOW US TO EXPLORE THE IMPACTS OF SEQUENCE VARIATION ON RECOGNITION OF FUNGAL CELLS BY MAMMALIAN IMMUNE RECEPTORS AND IMMUNE CELLS. OUR APPROACH WILL INFORM MODELS OF THE ADAPTIVE EVOLUTIONARY PROCESSES THAT HAVE SHAPED THESE FUNGAL STRAINS INTO THE STRAINS WE ENCOUNTER TODAY WHILE ALSO REVEALING THE GENES AND GENETIC VARIANTS THAT PLAY A ROLE IN THIS PROCESS. COLLECTIVELY, THESE PROJECTS WILL PROVIDE A SWEEPING VIEW OF HOW EVOLUTION ON BOTH SIDES OF THESE HOST-FUNGAL INTERACTIONS SHAPES THE OUTCOME OF INFECTION ACROSS SPECIES AND BETWEEN INDIVIDUALS AND WILL GIVE US NEW TOOLS AND INSIGHT TO BETTER COMBAT THESE INFECTIONS IN THE FUTURE.

description: HARNESSING INNOVATIVE PLATFORMS TO STUDY AND PREVENT ACINETOBACTER VENTILATOR-ASSOCIATED PNEUMONIA - PROJECT ABSTRACT/SUMMARY  VENTILATOR-ASSOCIATED PNEUMONIA (VAP) IS A LEADING NOSOCOMIAL INFECTION GLOBALLY. NOTABLY, THE VENTILATED TRACHEA REPRESENTS A UNIQUE ENVIRONMENT ENCOUNTERED AND EXPLOITED BY PATHOGENS. INTUBATION RESULTS IN ACUTE DAMAGE TO THE TRACHEAL EPITHELIUM, RESULTING IN INFLAMMATION AND DEPOSITION OF HOST PROTEINS ON THE ENDOTRACHEAL TUBE (ETT) THAT CAN BE BOUND BY BACTERIA LEADING TO SUBSEQUENT BIOFILM FORMATION. MOREOVER, THE INSERTION OF THE ETT REDUCES MUCOCILIARY FUNCTION. COMBINED WITH THE OBSTRUCTION OF THE TRACHEA CAUSED BY THE ETT, THIS LEADS TO THE FORMATION OF STATIC MUCUS POOLS THAT CAN CONTRIBUTE TO INFECTION BY SHIELDING BACTERIA FROM BOTH THE IMMUNE RESPONSE AND ANTIBIOTIC TREATMENTS. IN ALL, THESE AND OTHER DISTINCT CHARACTERISTICS OF THE ETT MICROENVIRONMENT MUST BE TAKEN INTO CONSIDERATION WHEN ASSESSING BACTERIAL VIRULENCE MECHANISMS AND POTENTIAL PREVENTION AND TREATMENT OPTIONS.  ACINETOBACTER BAUMANNII IS A PATHOGEN THAT CAUSES 30% OF VAP CASES. DESPITE THIS, LITTLE IS KNOWN REGARDING A. BAUMANNII VAP PATHOGENESIS. THIS IS PRIMARILY DUE TO THE LACK OF CLINICALLY RELEVANT IN VITRO AND IN VIVO PLATFORMS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE THAT REFLECT CHARACTERISTICS OF THE HOST MICROENVIRONMENT DESCRIBED ABOVE. IN FACT, THE MOST COMMONLY EMPLOYED IN VITRO METHOD TO ASSESS A. BAUMANNII TUBING ADHERENCE AND BIOFILM FORMATION IS TO INCUBATE BACTERIA WITH THE MATERIAL IN STANDARD CULTURE MEDIA. THIS METHOD NEGLECTS BOTH CHANGES IN BACTERIAL GENE REGULATION THAT COULD BE INDUCED BY THE ETT MICROENVIRONMENT AND THE IMPACT OF HOST FACTORS THAT COULD BIND THE TUBING, MEDIATING BACTERIAL ATTACHMENT. FURTHER, THE MOST COMMON IN VIVO METHOD TO STUDY A. BAUMANNII PULMONARY VIRULENCE IS A MURINE ACUTE PNEUMONIA MODEL THAT REQUIRES THE INTRANASAL DELIVERY OF AN UNNATURALLY HIGH INOCULUM OF ~109 BACTERIA, AND THE READOUT IS BACTERIAL LOAD AT 24-36 HOURS POST-INFECTION. WHILE POSSIBLY REPRESENTING CHARACTERISTICS OF NON-VENTILATOR PNEUMONIA, THIS MODEL ALSO FAILS TO RECAPITULATE DETAILS OF THE ETT MICROENVIRONMENT, IMPLYING THAT MANY FINDINGS FROM THIS MODEL ARE NOT TRANSLATABLE TO VAP INFECTIONS.  IN THIS PROPOSAL, I WILL HARNESS NOVEL PLATFORMS TO INVESTIGATE A. BAUMANNII PATHOGENIC MECHANISMS OF VAP, AS WELL IDENTIFY PREVENTATIVE MEASURES. IN AIM 1, I WILL EMPLOY ENDOTRACHEAL TUBES FROM HUMANS AND A MULTI-OMICS APPROACH TO GENERATE THE FIRST CLINICALLY RELEVANT IN VITRO PLATFORM THAT CAN BE USED TO STUDY BACTERIAL ADHERENCE/BIOFILM FORMATION. FOR AIM 2, I WILL USE A NOVEL MURINE MODEL THAT I HAVE RECENTLY ADAPTED FOR USE WITH A. BAUMANNII TO IDENTIFY THE FIRST VIRULENCE FACTORS REQUIRED FOR VAP PATHOGENESIS. FINALLY, IN AIM 3, I WILL GENERATE A WORKFLOW CONSISTING OF THESE IN VITRO AND IN VIVO PLATFORMS TO TEST PROSPECTIVE TUBING TREATMENTS TO PREVENT A. BAUMANNII VAP. IN ALL, THIS RESEARCH WILL PROVIDE INNOVATIVE CLINICALLY RELEVANT PLATFORMS THAT WILL GREATLY ADVANCE OUR UNDERSTANDING OF VAP. MOREOVER, THE PLATFORMS AND WORKFLOW DESCRIBED HERE SHOULD BE EASILY ADAPTABLE FOR OTHER SIGNIFICANT VAP PATHOGENS IN THE FUTURE, EXPANDING THE OVERALL IMPACT OF THIS WORK.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: CYTOPLASMIC SENSING OF MEMBRANE-REPLICATING RNA VIRUSES - PROJECT SUMMARY INDUCTION OF INNATE IMMUNITY IS CRITICAL TO HOST DEFENSE AGAINST VIRAL PATHOGENS AND IS INITIATED WHEN CYTOSOLIC PATTERN RECOGNITION RECEPTORS (PRRS) RECOGNIZE VIRAL PATHOGEN ASSOCIATED MOLECULAR PATTERS (PAMPS) IN THE CYTOPLASM OF INFECTED CELLS. POSITIVE-STRAND RNA VIRUSES INDUCE HOST CELL MEMBRANE REARRANGEMENT TO FORM MEMBRANE-BOUND VIRAL REPLICATION COMPARTMENTS OR REPLICATION ORGANELLES. THESE REPLICATION COMPARTMENTS SERVE AS SITES OF NASCENT VIRAL RNA SYNTHESIS BUT ALSO SERVE TO SEQUESTER VIRAL RNA AWAY FROM HOST CELL CYTOSOLIC SENSORS. HOWEVER, IT IS WELL APPRECIATED THAT CYTOSOLIC PRRS PLAY A CRITICAL ROLE IN INNATE IMMUNE INDUCTION FOR PATHOGENIC POSITIVE-STRAND RNA VIRUSES. THUS, THERE EXISTS A FUNDAMENTAL PARADOX IN INNATE IMMUNE SENSING OF POSITIVE-STRAND RNA VIRUSES: HOW ARE MEMBRANE-REPLICATING RNA VIRUSES SENSED BY CYTOSOLIC PRRS? THIS PROPOSAL SEEKS TO ADDRESS THIS PARADOX BY IDENTIFYING WHERE PRRS SENSE VIRUSES, DEFINING THE NATIVE LIGANDS OF PRRS DURING INFECTION, AND UNCOVERING HOW VIRUSES REGULATE OR FAIL TO REGULATE THE LOCALIZATION OF THEIR PAMP RNA. WE WILL DEVELOP TOOLS AND FRAMEWORKS WHICH WILL BE BROADLY APPLICABLE TO THE STUDY OF CYTOSOLIC PATTERN RECOGNITION RECEPTORS AND POSITIVE-STRAND RNA VIRUS INFECTION. FIRST, WE WILL DEVELOP A NOVEL PAMP-AGNOSTIC VISUAL SENSOR OF PRR ACTIVATION TO MONITOR IN REAL TIME THE INTRACELLULAR LOCALIZATION OF PRR SENSING. COUPLED WITH REPORTERS OF INNATE IMMUNE ACTIVATION, HOST CELL ORGANELLE TRACKERS, AND FLUORESCENTLY TAGGED VIRUSES WE WILL OBTAIN TIME AND SPACE RESOLVED DATA ON INTRACELLULAR SITES OF RNA SENSING IN RELATION TO VIRAL REPLICATION AND ITS IMPACT ON INNATE IMMUNE ACTIVATION. SECOND, WE WILL IMPLEMENT A PROXIMITY LABELING STRATEGY TO IDENTIFY PRR LIGANDS IN THE SPATIAL CONTEXT OF NATIVE INFECTION AND IDENTIFY IMMUNOSTIMULATORY VIRAL RNAS THAT CONTRIBUTE TO INNATE IMMUNE ACTIVATION. THIRD, WE WILL IMPLEMENT NOVEL RNA-DIRECTED PROXIMITY LABELING FOLLOWED BY QUANTITATIVE MASS SPECTROMETRY TO PROFILE THE PROTEOME OF VIRAL REPLICATION COMPARTMENTS IN INNATE IMMUNE RESPONDING AND NON- RESPONDING CELLS. WE WILL CHARACTERIZE PROTEINS WHICH ARE RECRUITED OR DEPLETED FROM VIRAL REPLICATION COMPARTMENTS TO IDENTIFY NOVEL REGULATORS OF VIRAL RNA LOCALIZATION AND INVESTIGATE THEIR ROLE IN VIRAL PAMP EXPOSURE. IN SUMMARY, WE WILL DEVELOP INNOVATE TOOLS AND APPROACHES THAT WILL ALLOW US TO APPLY A SPATIAL LENS TO RNA VIRUSES SENSING, TRANSFORMING HOW WE UNDERSTAND INNATE IMMUNE RECOGNITION OF MEMBRANE-REPLICATING VIRUSES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: MOLECULAR BASIS FOR ARBOVIRAL FITNESS IN VECTOR AND RESERVOIR HOSTS - PROJECT SUMMARY ARTHROPOD-TRANSMITTED VIRUSES (ARBOVIRUSES) ARE A CLASS OF VIRUSES THAT CAN REPLICATE IN BOTH INSECTS (VECTOR SPECIES) AND VERTEBRATES (RESERVOIR SPECIES), TWO HOSTS THAT ARE SEPARATED BY MORE THAN 700 MILLION YEARS OF EVOLUTION. THESE VIRUSES BRIDGE A SIGNIFICANT EVOLUTIONARY DIVIDE, DEMONSTRATING THEIR IMPRESSIVE VIRAL BREADTH. HOWEVER, WITHIN THE TRANSMISSION CYCLE, THESE VIRUSES ALSO SHOW HIGH SPECIFICITY. ARBOVIRUSES OFTEN RELY ON ONLY A SELECT FEW SPECIES FOR TRANSMISSION, SUCH AS THE AEDES AEGYPTI MOSQUITO FOR YELLOW FEVER VIRUS. THE BIOLOGICAL MECHANISMS THAT FACILITATE THIS EXTREME BREADTH AND HIGH SPECIFICITY REMAIN LARGELY UNKNOWN. INDEED, ARBOVIRUSES HARBOR CLOSE GENETIC RELATIVES WHICH CAN ONLY INFECT AND REPLICATE IN INSECTS, INSECT-SPECIFIC VIRUSES (ISVS). THESE LATTER VIRUSES DISPLAY DEFECTS IN EXECUTING DISTINCT STEPS IN THE VIRAL LIFE CYCLE IN VERTEBRATE CELLS, CONSISTENT WITH LACK OF SELECTIVE PRESSURE LEADING TO ADAPTION TO THE ARTHROPOD HOST. IN THIS PROPOSAL, USING THE ALPHAVIRUS GENUS AS A MODEL, WE APPROACH THIS BIOLOGY THROUGH A MOLECULAR LENS. OUR PRELIMINARY DATA INDICATE THAT ALPHAVIRUSES TRANSMITTED BY AEDES SPECIES ARE UNIQUELY ABLE TO BIND AND ENTER AEDES CELLS, IN COMPARISON TO ALPHAVIRUSES THAT ARE TRANSMITTED BY OTHER SPECIES OF MOSQUITOES. THROUGH DISTINCT APPROACHES WE EXPECT TO (1) IDENTIFY AND CHARACTERIZE CELL SURFACE RECEPTOR(S) THAT MEDIATE THIS PHENOMENON; AND (2) IDENTIFY VIRAL DETERMINANTS THAT DRIVE ENTRY INTO AEDES CELLS. COMPLETION OF THIS AIM, SHOULD YIELD FOUNDATIONAL AND CONCEPTUAL INSIGHT INTO HOW THE VIRIONS ARE ABLE TO ENGAGE DISTINCT NON-CONSERVED HOST MOLECULES BETWEEN ARTHROPOD AND VERTEBRATE HOSTS. SECONDLY, WE WILL UTILIZE INSECT-SPECIFIC ALPHAVIRUSES (ISAS) AS A PLATFORM TO UNDERSTAND THE GENETIC DETERMINANTS OF DUAL-HOST RANGE EXHIBITED BY PATHOGENIC ALPHAVIRUSES. WE WILL FOCUS ON DISSECTING THE MOLECULAR BASIS BY WHICH ISAS ARE UNABLE TO REPLICATE IN VERTEBRATE CELLS. HERE, WE AIM TO “HANDICAP” THE VIRAL GENES RESPONSIBLE FOR REPLICATION IN VERTEBRATES THROUGH A DNA SHUFFLING-BASED APPROACH WITH THE GENES DERIVED FROM ISAS. THIS APPROACH WILL ALLOW US TO PINPOINT GENETIC REGIONS THAT ENABLE REPLICATION IN VERTEBRATE SPECIES. WITH THIS DATA IN HAND, WE WILL BE POSITIONED TO PERFORM MECHANISTIC STUDIES TO UNDERSTAND THE FEATURES AT A BIOCHEMICAL LEVEL THAT MEDIATE VIRUS-HOST COMPATIBILITY. WE ENVISION THAT KNOWLEDGE OBTAINED UPON COMPLETION OF THE PROPOSED STUDIES MAY BE LEVERAGED IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF COUNTERMEASURES THAT COULD DISRUPT TRANSMISSION CYCLE FOR PATHOGENIC ARBOVIRUSES.
