description: THE IMPACT OF ADDING RESTRICTIONS AND INCENTIVES TO A MONTHLY FOOD BENEFIT PROGRAM TO IMPROVE DIET QUALITY: A LONGITUDINAL RCT - PROJECT SUMMARY UNHEALTHY DIET IS ONE OF THE LEADING MODIFIABLE CAUSES OF DEATH IN THE U.S. AND CONTRIBUTES TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF DIET-RELATED CHRONIC CONDITIONS LIKE TYPE 2 DIABETES AND CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASE. CRITICS HAVE LONG ARGUED THAT GIVEN THE POOR DIET QUALITY OF THE AVERAGE AMERICAN, FEDERAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAMS SHOULD PROHIBIT PURCHASES OF UNHEALTHY FOODS WITH PROGRAM BENEFITS. THE SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM (SNAP) IS THE NATION'S LARGEST FOOD ASSISTANCE PROGRAM, SERVING ABOUT 42 MILLION LOW-INCOME AMERICANS MONTHLY. THIS PROGRAM HAS BEEN SHOWN TO HELP REDUCE FOOD INSECURITY. WITH A FEDERAL PRIORITY TO IMPROVE THE DIETS OF AMERICANS, USDA HAS GRANTED WAIVERS TO MANY STATES THAT PLACE RESTRICTIONS ON THE PURCHASE OF UNHEALTHY FOODS WITH SNAP BENEFITS. EVIDENCE IS LACKING ON HOW SUCH A CHANGE WOULD AFFECT PROGRAM RECIPIENTS, WHETHER THEY WOULD IMPROVE DIET QUALITY, OR HOW IT WOULD AFFECT PEOPLE'S EXPERIENCES WITH THE PROGRAM. TO ADVANCE OUR UNDERSTANDING ON THE IMPACTS OF A MONTHLY FOOD BENEFIT PROGRAM WITH RESTRICTIONS AND INCENTIVES, OUR OVERALL OBJECTIVE IS TO EXAMINE THE DEGREE TO WHICH A MONTHLY FOOD BENEFIT INTERVENTION THAT HAS UNHEALTHY FOOD RESTRICTIONS ALONE OR IS PAIRED WITH HEALTHY FOOD INCENTIVES IMPROVES THE QUALITY OF FOOD AND BEVERAGE PURCHASES, QUALITY OF DIETARY INTAKE, AND PROGRAM EXPERIENCES. THE PRIMARY HYPOTHESIS IS THAT RESTRICTIONS WITH INCENTIVES WILL LEAD TO THE GREATEST IMPROVEMENTS IN HEALTHY FOOD PURCHASES AND INTAKE AND THE LARGEST REDUCTIONS IN SUGARY FOOD PURCHASES AND INTAKE, FOLLOWED BY THE RESTRICTIONS ALONE WHEN COMPARED TO THE CONTROL GROUP. STUDY PARTICIPANTS (N=357) WILL BE INCOME-ELIGIBLE FOR SNAP BUT NOT CURRENTLY ENROLLED. PARTICIPANTS IN THIS 12-WEEK STUDY (4 WEEKS BASELINE + 8 WEEKS INTERVENTION) WILL RECEIVE A MONTHLY FOOD BENEFIT FOR GROCERY SHOPPING EVERY FOUR WEEKS FOR 8 WEEKS. THEY WILL BE RANDOMIZED TO ONE OF THREE ARMS: 1) CONTROL; 2) UNHEALTHY FOOD RESTRICTIONS ALONE; OR 3) RESTRICTIONS WITH HEALTHY FOOD INCENTIVES. PARTICIPANTS WILL COMPLETE A SURVEY AND TWO 24-HOUR DIETARY RECALLS AT BASELINE AND AGAIN AT THE END-OF-STUDY. THEY WILL TEXT THE STUDY TEAM RECEIPTS FROM ALL FOOD AND BEVERAGE PURCHASES FOR THE DURATION OF THE STUDY. A SUBSET (N=30) WILL COMPLETE QUALITATIVE INTERVIEWS. THE FIRST AIM IS TO ASSESS HOW A MONTHLY FOOD BENEFIT PROGRAM AFFECTS THE NUTRITIONAL QUALITY OF FOOD AND BEVERAGE PURCHASES BY COMPARING (A) RESTRICTING BENEFITS FROM BUYING SWEETENED DRINKS, CANDY, AND PREPARED DESSERTS, AND (B) THE SAME RESTRICTIONS PLUS A HEALTHY FOOD INCENTIVE FOR A RANGE OF HEALTHY FOODS WITH (C) NO INCENTIVES OR RESTRICTIONS. AIM 2 WILL EVALUATE SUCH A PROGRAM ON DIETARY QUALITY. THE THIRD AIM WILL EXPLORE THE ACCEPTABILITY AND EXPERIENCE OF SUCH A PROGRAM USING SEMI-STRUCTURED INTERVIEWS. THE INTERVIEWS WILL ANSWER HOW RECIPIENTS OF A MONTHLY FOOD BENEFIT PROGRAM WITH RESTRICTIONS AND/OR INCENTIVES EXPERIENCE THE MODEL AND HOW IT AFFECTS THEIR LIKELIHOOD OF APPLYING FOR THE PROGRAM. THE CONTRIBUTIONS FROM THESE AIMS WILL BE SIGNIFICANT BECAUSE THEY ARE EXPECTED TO PROVIDE STRONG EVIDENCE ON HOW PROPOSED CHANGES TO A NUTRITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM AIMED AT IMPROVING DIET WOULD HAVE ON PURCHASING, INTAKE, AND PROGRAMMATIC EXPERIENCES AMONG A LOW-INCOME POPULATION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: TYPE 1 TOGETHER: A MULTISITE RCT OF A PEER MENTOR PROGRAM FOR TEENS WITH TYPE 1 DIABETES - PROJECT SUMMARY FEWER THAN 1 IN 5 ADOLESCENTS WITH TYPE 1 DIABETES (T1D) ACHIEVE THE GLYCEMIC LEVELS RECOMMENDED BY THE AMERICAN DIABETES ASSOCIATION, INCREASING THEIR RISK FOR ACUTE AND LONG-TERM HEALTH COMPLICATIONS. CONTINUOUS GLUCOSE MONITORING SYSTEMS (CGM) CAN IMPROVE THE PHYSICAL AND MENTAL HEALTH OF YOUTH WITH T1D, BUT ONLY IF WORN CONSISTENTLY (≥ 80% OF THE TIME). HOWEVER, ADOLESCENTS ARE LESS LIKELY THAN CHILDREN AND YOUNG ADULTS TO WEAR CGM CONSISTENTLY. BARRIERS TO USING CGM ALIGN WITH THE THREE DOMAINS OF SOCIAL COGNITIVE THEORY, A WIDELY USED THEORY TO UNDERSTAND INFLUENCES ON INDIVIDUALS’ HEALTH BEHAVIORS: PERSONAL (E.G., PERCEIVED BENEFITS AND BURDENS OF CGM, SELF-EFFICACY TO MANAGE DIABETES), BEHAVIORAL (E.G., FAMILY INVOLVEMENT, ADHERENCE), AND ENVIRONMENTAL (E.G., COST, INSURANCE). UNFORTUNATELY, RIGOROUSLY TESTED INTERVENTIONS TO BOLSTER CONSISTENT USE OF CGM ARE LACKING. TYPE 1 TOGETHER IS AN INTERVENTION THAT WAS CO-DEVELOPED IN PARTNERSHIP WITH YOUTH WITH T1D AND THEIR FAMILIES. TYPE 1 TOGETHER COMBINES PEER MENTORING AND SUPPORT FROM A COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKER TO TARGET PERSONAL, BEHAVIORAL, AND ENVIRONMENTAL BARRIERS TO CONSISTENTLY USING CGM. DATA FROM A PILOT RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIAL (RCT) SUGGESTS THAT TYPE 1 TOGETHER IS ACCEPTABLE, FEASIBLE, AND MAY IMPROVE GLYCEMIC LEVELS, CGM WEAR TIME, AND MENTAL HEALTH OUTCOMES AMONG ADOLESCENTS WITH T1D. THE CURRENT PROPOSAL EXTENDS THIS LINE OF RESEARCH AND PROPOSES TO RIGOROUSLY EVALUATE THE EFFICACY OF TYPE 1 TOGETHER IN A MULTISITE RCT. ADOLESCENT-CAREGIVER DYADS (N=180) WILL BE RECRUITED FROM THREE SITES (NEMOURS – DELAWARE, NEMOURS – ORLANDO, UNIVERSITY OF TENNESSEE – MEMPHIS) AND RANDOMIZED 1:1 TO TYPE 1 TOGETHER OR A 6MONTH WAITLIST CONTROL. DURING THE INTERVENTION PHASE, FAMILIES WILL MEET AT LEAST MONTHLY WITH A PEER MENTOR FAMILY AND A COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKER. WE WILL THEN EVALUATE THE EFFICACY OF TYPE 1 TOGETHER IN IMPROVING HEALTH AND PSYCHOSOCIAL OUTCOMES (AIM 1) AND THE EFFECT OF TYPE 1 TOGETHER ON SOCIAL COGNITIVE THEORY CONSTRUCTS (AIM 2). WHILE THE MULTI-SITE RCT IS UNDERWAY, WE WILL ALSO USE A MIXED-METHODS APPROACH INFORMED BY THE PRACTICAL, ROBUST IMPLEMENTATION AND SUSTAINABILITY MODEL TO IDENTIFY STRATEGIES TO IMPLEMENT TYPE 1 TOGETHER AS PART OF ROUTINE CLINICAL CARE. UPON COMPLETION OF THIS PROJECT, WE WILL HAVE DATA REGARDING THE EFFICACY OF TYPE 1 TOGETHER (AIM 1), ELUCIDATE POTENTIAL MECHANISMS UNDERLYING THE INTERVENTION (AIM 2), AND HAVE STRATEGIES TO OVERCOME POTENTIAL BARRIERS TO IMPLEMENTING TYPE 1 TOGETHER MORE BROADLY (AIM 3).

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: INDUCED PLURIPOTENT STEM CELL-DERIVED ENDOTHELIAL CELL THERAPY FOR LIVER DISEASE - ABSTRACT LIVER TRANSPLANTATION IS THE ONLY CURATIVE TREATMENT FOR END-STAGE AND ACUTE LIVER DISEASE; HOWEVER, THE SCARCITY OF DONOR ORGANS UNDERSCORES THE URGENT NEED FOR ALTERNATIVE THERAPIES. HUMAN INDUCED PLURIPOTENT STEM CELLS (HIPSC) COULD PROVIDE AN UNLIMITED SUPPLY OF PATIENT-SPECIFIC LIVER CELLS FOR CELL-REPLACEMENT THERAPY. ALTHOUGH HEPATOCYTES, THE PRIMARY FUNCTIONAL CELLS OF THE LIVER, ARE THE MOST DESIRABLE CELL TYPE TO TRANSPLANT, A MAJOR LIMITATION IS THE INCOMPLETE MATURATION OF HIPSC-DERIVED HEPATOCYTES, WHICH REDUCES THEIR THERAPEUTIC EFFECTIVENESS, PARTICULARLY IN ACUTE LIVER DISEASES THAT REQUIRE RAPID RESTORATION OF FUNCTIONAL CELLS. TO OVERCOME THIS LIMITATION, THIS APPLICATION PROPOSES TRANSPLANTING SUPPORTIVE CELLS THAT ENHANCE THE PROLIFERATION AND FUNCTION OF THE REMAINING HEPATOCYTES. WE WILL LEVERAGE THE WELL-ESTABLISHED SUPPORTIVE ROLE OF LIVER ENDOTHELIAL CELLS (EC), WHICH PROMOTE HEPATOCYTE PROLIFERATION AND FUNCTION THROUGH PARACRINE SIGNALING DURING LIVER REPAIR. THE GOAL OF THIS PROPOSAL IS TO EVALUATE THE THERAPEUTIC POTENTIAL OF IPSC-DERIVED EC (IEC) THERAPY FOR PROMOTING LIVER REGENERATION. ENGRAFTMENT OF HEALTHY ECS IS EXPECTED NOT ONLY TO RESTORE FUNCTIONAL LIVER VASCULATURE BUT ALSO TO RECONSTRUCT THE SUPPORTIVE CELLULAR NICHE REQUIRED FOR THE PROLIFERATION AND FUNCTION OF THE REMAINING HEPATOCYTES, ULTIMATELY ALLEVIATING LIVER DISEASE. THIS APPROACH BUILDS ON OUR LONG-STANDING EXPERTISE IN THE SUPPORTIVE INTERACTIONS BETWEEN HEPATOCYTES AND ECS DURING LIVER DEVELOPMENT. WE PREVIOUSLY OBSERVED THAT ECS FUNCTION AS A NICHE THAT REPRESSES WNT AND NOTCH SIGNALING TO PROMOTE HEPATOCYTE GENERATION FROM PSCS, AND THAT THIS SUPPORT DEPENDS ON ACTIVATION OF VEGFR2. CONSISTENT WITH OUR FINDINGS, OTHERS HAVE SHOWN THAT THE VEGFA/VEGFR2 AXIS ACTIVATES ECS IN INJURED MOUSE LIVERS, INDUCING THE EXPRESSION OF FACTORS SUCH AS WNT2 AND HGF THAT STIMULATE HEPATOCYTE PROLIFERATION. SIMILARLY, WNT2 AND WNT9B SECRETED BY ECS HAVE BEEN SHOWN TO DRIVE HEPATOCYTE PROLIFERATION FOLLOWING PARTIAL HEPATECTOMY. TO SUPPORT OUR PROPOSAL, WE PRODUCED KEY PRELIMINARY DATA DEMONSTRATING THE ROBUST GENERATION OF IECS THAT CONSISTENTLY ENGRAFT IN A MURINE ACUTE LIVER INJURY MODEL INDUCED BY MONOCROTALINE (MCT), AND THAT ENGRAFTMENT WAS SIGNIFICANTLY ENHANCED WHEN MICE WERE TREATED WITH VEGFA MRNA FORMULATED IN LIPID NANOPARTICLES (MRNA-LNP). THIS PROPOSAL WILL THUS TEST THE HYPOTHESIS THAT IEC THERAPY WILL NOT ONLY RESTORE DAMAGED LIVER VASCULATURE BUT ALSO ALLEVIATE THE LIVER DYSFUNCTION BY PROMOTING THE PROLIFERATION AND FUNCTION OF REMAINING MATURE HEPATOCYTES THROUGH ENDOTHELIAL-DERIVED FACTORS. AIM 1 WILL DEVELOP STRATEGIES TO FURTHER PROMOTE VEGFA-MEDIATED IEC ENGRAFTMENT TO REGENERATE A FUNCTIONAL HYBRID HOST VASCULATURE IN THE ACUTE MCT MODEL. AIM 2 WILL DETERMINE THE PRE-CLINICAL THERAPEUTIC BENEFIT OF VEGFA MRNA-LNP-ENHANCED IEC ENGRAFTMENT IN MITIGATING ACUTE AND CHRONIC LIVER DISEASE FEATURES. AIM 3 WILL DEFINE THE CELLULAR AND MOLECULAR MECHANISMS UNDERLYING VEGFA-DRIVEN IEC THERAPY. ALTOGETHER, THIS PROPOSAL WILL PROVIDE CRITICAL INSIGHTS INTO THE PRECLINICAL THERAPEUTIC POTENTIAL OF VEGFA MRNA-LNP-MEDIATED IEC THERAPY AND ELUCIDATE THE ASSOCIATED CELLULAR AND MOLECULAR MECHANISMS FOR TREATING ACUTE AND CHRONIC LIVER DISEASES.

description: TARGETING CELL VOLUME REGULATORY MECHANISMS TO RESTRAIN ALDOSTERONE PRODUCTION - PROJECT SUMMARY SIGNIFICANCE: PRIMARY ALDOSTERONISM (PA) IS CHARACTERIZED BY EXCESSIVE ALDOSTERONE PRODUCTION THAT OCCURS INDEPENDENTLY OF THE RENIN-ANGIOTENSIN SYSTEM. IT STANDS AS THE MOST PREVALENT FORM OF ENDOCRINE-RELATED HYPERTENSION AND SIGNIFICANTLY ELEVATES THE RISK FOR CARDIOVASCULAR COMPLICATIONS AND STROKE. OFTEN DRIVEN BY GENETIC MUTATIONS THAT DISRUPT ION TRANSPORT AND INTRACELLULAR CALCIUM DYNAMICS, PA PRESENTS AN URGENT NEED FOR THERAPIES THAT DIRECTLY TARGET ITS MOLECULAR UNDERPINNINGS. RELEVANCE: BUILDING ON PRELIMINARY FINDINGS, THIS PROJECT EXPLORES VOLUME REGULATORY EFFECTORS (VRES) AS KEY MODULATORS OF CALCIUM OSCILLATIONS IN ZONA GLOMERULOSA (ZG) CELLS—THE CENTRAL SIGNAL INITIATING ALDOSTERONE SYNTHESIS. BY HARNESSING THE PHYSIOLOGICAL PROCESS OF CELL VOLUME REGULATION, WE AIM TO ATTENUATE ALDOSTERONE SECRETION THAT OCCURS INDEPENDENTLY OF RENIN SIGNALING. HYPOTHESIS: WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT ZG CELLULAR MACHINERY MAINTAINING CELL VOLUME HOMEOSTASIS REGULATES AUTONOMOUS AND STIMULI-EVOKED CALCIUM SIGNALING, AND THUS ALDOSTERONE PRODUCTION. SPECIFICALLY, WE PROPOSE THAT TWO WELL-ESTABLISHED CELL VOLUME REGULATORS, THE NA+-K+-CL- COTRANSPORTER 1 (NKCC1) AND THE VOLUME- REGULATED ANION CHANNEL (VRAC), ARE CO-EXPRESSED IN BOTH MOUSE AND HUMAN ZG CELLS AND CAN BE TARGETED TO MEDIATE ZG CELL STEROIDOGENESIS. INNOVATION: OUR APPROACH UTILIZES CHANGES IN EXTRACELLULAR OSMOLARITY TO TRIGGER VOLUME REGULATORY RESPONSES, COMBINED WITH PHARMACOLOGICAL AND GENETIC MANIPULATION OF NKCC1 AND VRAC IN ZG CELLS, BOTH EX VIVO AND IN VIVO. WE UTILIZE INNOVATIVE MOUSE MODELS OF PA AND IMAGING TECHNIQUES TO VALIDATE OUR HYPOTHESIS. AIMS: (1) DETERMINE WHETHER OSMOTIC PERTURBATION ALTERS SPECIFIC ALDOSTERONE SIGNALING PATHWAYS. (2) TO RESOLVE THE ROLE OF VRES IN CONTROLLING THE STEADY-STATE RESPONSIVENESS OF ZG CELLS TO AUTONOMOUS AND STIMULI-EVOKED CALCIUM ACTIVITY AND ALDOSTERONE PRODUCTION, (3) TO ASSESS THE IN VIVO EFFICACY OF TARGETING VRES TO SUPPRESS ALDOSTERONE AUTONOMY. LONG-TERM GOALS: THIS RESEARCH AIMS TO IDENTIFY A NOVEL MECHANISM TO SUPPRESS ALDOSTERONE PRODUCTION AND IDENTIFY NOVEL MOLECULAR TARGETS TO RESTRAIN ALDO-AUTONOMY FOR TREATMENT OF PA-ASSOCIATED HYPERTENSION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: RESTORING Α1,2-FUCOSE TO REBUILD THE MICROBIOTA AND STRENGTHEN THE INTESTINAL BARRIER IN HIV - PROJECT SUMMARY: DESPITE ANTIRETROVIRAL THERAPY (ART), PEOPLE LIVING WITH HIV (PLWH) OFTEN EXPERIENCE PERSISTENT GUT LEAKINESS AND MICROBIAL TRANSLOCATION THAT FUEL CHRONIC INFLAMMATION AND PREMATURE AGING. KEY FEATURES OF THIS INTESTINAL BARRIER DYSFUNCTION ARE REDUCED EPITHELIAL RESILIENCE TO STRESS AND LOSS OF BACTERIA THAT GENERATE SHORT-CHAIN FATTY ACIDS (SCFAS), WHICH SUPPORT EPITHELIAL HEALTH. OUR PRELIMINARY DATA IMPLICATE A NOVEL, TARGETABLE CONTRIBUTOR TO THESE DEFECTS: DEPLETION OF THE INTRINSIC PREBIOTIC GLYCAN Α1,2-FUCOSE. THIS GLYCAN IS PRODUCED BY INTESTINAL EPITHELIAL CELLS IN RESPONSE TO IL-22 AND CAN BE DEGRADED BY Α-L-FUCOSIDASES RELEASED FROM SENESCENT CELLS. Α1,2-FUCOSE SUPPORTS GUT HEALTH THROUGH: 1) A MICROBIOME-INDEPENDENT ARM, IN WHICH Α1,2-FUCOSYLATED EPITHELIAL GLYCOCONJUGATES STABILIZE TIGHT JUNCTIONS AND LIMIT STRESS; AND 2) A MICROBIOME- DEPENDENT ARM, IN WHICH IT FUELS FUCOSE-UTILIZING COMMENSALS TO BOOST SCFA PRODUCTION. WE FOUND THAT Α1,2- FUCOSE IS DEPLETED FROM THE INTESTINES OF PLWH ON ART COMPARED TO HIV-NEGATIVE CONTROLS, AND LOWER LEVELS OF Α1,2-FUCOSE CORRELATED WITH FEWER SCFA-PRODUCING BACTERIA, IMPAIRED BARRIER INTEGRITY, HIGHER INFLAMMATION, AND PREMATURE AGING. IN EX VIVO ANAEROBIC STOOL FERMENTATIONS FROM PLWH, SUPPLEMENTATION WITH CLINICALLY SAFE Α1,2- FUCOSE RESTORED SCFA PRODUCTION. THESE FINDINGS SUGGEST THAT Α1,2-FUCOSE IS A MODIFIABLE CONTROL POINT FOR MICROBIOME COMPOSITION AND EPITHELIAL RESILIENCE IN PLWH, BUT THE UPSTREAM DRIVERS OF ITS LOSS, THE MECHANISMS LINKING ITS DEPLETION TO INTESTINAL DYSFUNCTION, AND THE IN VIVO IMPACT OF Α1,2-FUCOSE REPLETION REMAIN UNKNOWN. OUR CENTRAL HYPOTHESIS IS THAT IMPAIRED IL-22 SIGNALING AND ELEVATED GLYCAN-DEGRADING ENZYME ACTIVITY DEPLETE EPITHELIAL Α1,2-FUCOSE IN PLWH, WEAKENING EPITHELIAL STRESS RESILIENCE AND REDUCING SCFA-PRODUCING TAXA, AND THAT RESTORING Α1,2-FUCOSE WILL REBUILD MICROBIAL HEALTH, STRENGTHEN THE INTESTINAL BARRIER, AND REDUCE INFLAMMATION. AIM 1 WILL DEFINE UPSTREAM DRIVERS OF Α1,2-FUCOSE LOSS BY INTEGRATING HUMAN INTESTINAL TISSUES AND CRYPTS FROM PLWH AND CONTROLS WITH LONGITUDINAL SIV-INFECTED MACAQUE SAMPLES, AND BY USING 3D INTESTINAL ORGANOIDS TO TEST CAUSALITY VIA IL-22 MANIPULATION AND FUCOSIDASE GAIN AND LOSS OF FUNCTION. AIM 2 WILL DETERMINE HOW Α1,2- FUCOSE DEPLETION DISRUPTS INTESTINAL INTEGRITY IN PLWH BY DISSECTING TWO ARMS IN PLWH-DERIVED ORGANOIDS: A MICROBIOME-INDEPENDENT ARM, IN WHICH WE MODULATE FUCOSYLATION AND QUANTIFY BARRIER RESILIENCE AND STRESS RESPONSES, AND A MICROBIOME-DEPENDENT ARM, IN WHICH ORGANOIDS ARE EXPOSED TO PAIRED STOOL FERMENTATION SUPERNATANTS GENERATED WITH OR WITHOUT Α1,2-FUCOSE. AIM 3 WILL EVALUATE WHETHER IN VIVO ADMINISTRATION OF CLINICALLY SAFE Α1,2-FUCOSE IN THE FORM OF 2′-FUCOSYLLACTOSE (2′-FL) IMPROVES GUT BARRIER INTEGRITY IN PLWH BY LEVERAGING SAMPLES FROM AN ONGOING, EXTERNALLY SPONSORED, RANDOMIZED, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED 2′-FL TRIAL IN ART- TREATED PLWH. TOGETHER, THIS PROJECT WILL DEFINE A NOVEL TARGETABLE MECHANISM OF INTESTINAL BARRIER DYSFUNCTION IN PLWH AND TEST Α1,2-FUCOSE REPLETION AS A STRATEGY TO REDUCE GUT PERMEABILITY AND INFLAMMATION IN PLWH.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: AUTOMATED VIDEO-BASED ASSESSMENT OF BASIC LAPAROSCOPIC SURGICAL SKILLS - AUTOMATED VIDEO-BASED ASSESSMENT OF BASIC LAPAROSCOPIC SURGICAL SKILLS ABSTRACT WE PROPOSE TO DEVELOP AND VALIDATE AN AUTOMATED VIDEO-BASED ASSESSMENT (VBA) TOOL FOR THE FUNDAMENTALS OF LAPAROSCOPIC SURGERY (FLS) TASKS LEVERAGING DEEP LEARNING (DL) TECHNOLOGIES. THE FLS PROGRAM IS A PREREQUISITE FOR BOARD CERTIFICATION IN GENERAL SURGERY AND REPRESENTS A PARADIGM SHIFT IN ASSESSING TECHNICAL COMPETENCY BY UTILIZING VALIDATED METRICS RATHER THAN TRADITIONAL TRAINING DEFINED BY HOURS AND ROTATIONS. ADMINISTERING AROUND 3,400 EXAMS ANNUALLY IN THE US AND COVERING FIVE MANUAL TASKS—BIMANUAL PEG TRANSFER, PRECISE PATTERN CUTTING, LIGATING LOOPS, AND SUTURING WITH BOTH INTRACORPOREAL AND EXTRACORPOREAL KNOTTING—FLS HAS BECOME A GLOBAL STANDARD FOR CERTIFICATION. WHILE THE FLS ASSESSMENT SYSTEM IS ESSENTIAL FOR CERTIFYING SURGICAL SKILLS, IT HAS NOTABLE LIMITATIONS. IT RELIES ON MANUAL PROCTORING FOR SUMMATIVE ASSESSMENTS—HIGH- STAKES EVALUATIONS CONDUCTED AT THE END OF TRAINING TO DETERMINE IF A SURGEON HAS ACHIEVED THE REQUIRED COMPETENCY STANDARDS. MANUAL ASSESSMENT IS RESOURCE-INTENSIVE AND LACKS CONSISTENCY, WITH VARIABILITY IN EVALUATIONS AND LIMITED ACCESS FOR TRAINEES IN REMOTE AREAS. ADDITIONALLY, IT LACKS FORMATIVE ASSESSMENTS, WHICH ARE CRITICAL FOR JUNIOR LEARNERS, THAT PROVIDE ONGOING LOW-STAKES FEEDBACK DURING TRAINING TO HELP THEM IDENTIFY AND CORRECT ERRORS EARLY, THUS ACCELERATING SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND IMPROVING LONG-TERM RETENTION. THESE ISSUES UNDERSCORE THE NEED FOR AN AUTOMATED SOLUTION TO PROVIDE CONSISTENT, OBJECTIVE, AND ACCESSIBLE ASSESSMENTS FOR BOTH SUMMATIVE AND FORMATIVE EVALUATION.  IN THIS PROJECT, WE WILL DEVELOP AND VALIDATE A DL-BASED VBA-NET TO DELIVER BOTH SUMMATIVE AND FORMATIVE ASSESSMENTS FOR THE FLS TASKS. OUR INTERDISCIPLINARY TEAM WILL FOCUS ON TWO MAJOR AIMS: (SA1) TO DEVELOP AND VALIDATE THE VBA-NET FOR THE AUTOMATED SUMMATIVE EVALUATION OF ALL FLS TASKS; AND (SA2) TO DEVELOP AN ADVANCED AUTOMATED FORMATIVE FEEDBACK SYSTEM THAT INTEGRATES CLASS ACTIVATION MAPS (CAMS) FOR VISUAL FEEDBACK AND LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS (LLMS) FOR PERSONALIZED VERBAL FEEDBACK. FOR SA1, HUMAN SUBJECT STUDIES WILL COLLECT EXPERT AND NOVICE PROCEDURAL VIDEOS, AS WELL AS VIDEOS FROM NOVICES AS THEY PROGRESS THROUGH LEARNING THE TASKS, PROVIDING THE NECESSARY DATA TO TRAIN AND VALIDATE VBA-NET. FOR SA2, TWO EXPERIMENTS WILL BE PERFORMED: THE FIRST WILL TRAIN LLMS USING EXPERT FEEDBACK ON CAM-GUIDED VIDEOS OF NOVICE PERFORMANCE, AND THE SECOND WILL ASSESS THE IMPACT OF FORMATIVE FEEDBACK ON SKILL ACQUISITION AND RETENTION.  THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE VBA-NET WILL PROVIDE SEVERAL ADVANTAGES, INCLUDING (I) CONSISTENCY BY ELIMINATING THE VARIABILITY AND SUBJECTIVITY OF MANUAL PROCTORING, (II) RESOURCE EFFICIENCY BY ELIMINATING THE NEED FOR PROCTORS, (III) ENHANCED ACCESSIBILITY BY PROVIDING ASSESSMENTS TO TRAINEES IN REMOTE OR UNDERSERVED AREAS, (IV) COMPREHENSIVE FEEDBACK THROUGH BOTH SUMMATIVE AND FORMATIVE ASSESSMENTS, AND (V) SCALABILITY TO EXPAND THE FLS PROGRAM GLOBALLY WITHOUT ADDITIONAL LOGISTICAL CHALLENGES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: ADVANCING CHEMICALLY-MODIFIED APTAMERS FOR ULTRA-SENSITIVE BIOMONITORING AT THE PICOMOLAR-TO-NANOMOLAR SCALE - PROJECT SUMMARY CONTINUOUS BIOCHEMICAL MONITORING CAN TRANSFORM DISEASE MANAGEMENT, EXEMPLIFIED BY LOW-COST CONTINUOUS GLUCOSE MONITORS (CGMS). BUILDING ON THIS SUCCESS, ELECTROCHEMICAL APTAMER SENSORS COULD ENABLE CONTINUOUS MONITORING FOR MANY CHRONIC DISEASES. THE PI AND CO-INVESTIGATOR HAVE DEMONSTRATED APTAMER SENSORS WITH 60 DAYS OF ACCURATE OPERATION IN SERUM, FIRST-IN-HUMAN DATA, AND INTEGRATION INTO COMMERCIAL CGM FORMATS. HOWEVER, CURRENT SENSORS DETECT ONLY MICROMOLAR (ΜM) TO MILLIMOLAR (MM) ANALYTES, WHILE KEY BIOMARKERS SUCH AS INSULIN, NT-PROBNP, AND CYSTATIN C EXIST IN THE PICOMOLAR (PM) TO NANOMOLAR (NM) RANGE. NO TECHNOLOGY HAS ACHIEVED MULTI-DAY IN-VIVO MONITORING IN THIS RANGE DUE TO WEAK POLAR BINDING INTERACTIONS OF STANDARD APTAMERS. CHEMICALLY MODIFIED APTAMERS (CM-APTAMERS) OVERCOME THIS LIMITATION BY ADDING HYDROPHOBIC AND Π-SYSTEM INTERACTIONS, AS USED IN ANTIBODY AND SOMASCAN ASSAYS. YET CM-APTAMERS HAVE NEVER BEEN DEMONSTRATED IN A CONTINUOUS SENSING FORMAT. THE LONG-TERM GOAL OF THE INVESTIGATORS IS TO ADVANCE CONTINUOUS BIOCHEMICAL MONITORING AND THE UNDERLYING PHYSIOLOGICAL THAT SUPPORTS SUCH MONITORING. THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS R01 IS TO ADVANCE THE FUNDAMENTALS FOR PM–NM RANGE MONITORING USING CM-APTAMER SENSORS. THE CENTRAL HYPOTHESIS IS THAT STABLE, HIGH-AFFINITY SENSING IN VIVO REQUIRES COORDINATED ADVANCES IN APTAMER SELECTION, SENSOR FABRICATION, AND ELECTROCHEMICAL MEASUREMENT. SPECIFIC AIMS: AIM 1: DEVELOP CM-APTAMERS FOR INSULIN, NT-PROBNP, AND CYSTATIN C UNDER INTERSTITIAL FLUID CONDITIONS USING RAPID-SELEX METHODS. AIM 2: ENGINEER ELECTROCHEMICAL CM- APTAMER SENSORS WITH >100% SIGNAL RESPONSE AND ±20% ACCURACY IN SERUM FOR >1 WEEK. AIM 3: DEMONSTRATE IN-VIVO MONITORING OF AT LEAST ONE TARGET PM TO NM ANALYTE IN A PORCINE MODEL FOR ≥1 WEEK WITH <±20% VARIABILITY. THIS WORK IS INNOVATIVE AS THE FIRST MULTI-DAY MONITORING OF LOW-ABUNDANCE ANALYTES AND THE FIRST COMPREHENSIVE STUDY OF CM-APTAMER SENSOR FUNDAMENTALS. THE EXPECTED OUTCOME IS PROOF-OF-CONCEPT FOR REAL-TIME PM–NM BIOCHEMICAL MONITORING, ENABLING FUTURE HUMAN STUDIES AND TRANSLATION TO COMMERCIAL DEVICES. THE IMPACT WILL BE TRANSFORMATIVE, ESTABLISHING A NEW CLASS OF CONTINUOUS MOLECULAR DIAGNOSTICS FOR CHRONIC DISEASE MANAGEMENT AND FOR GENERATING NEW FUNDAMENTAL INSIGHTS INTO PHYSIOLOGY.

description: NEW DRUG DELIVERY STRATEGY FOR GUT MICROBIOME - ABSTRACT NEW APPROACHES ARE URGENTLY NEEDED FOR THE TARGETED DELIVERY OF THERAPEUTICS TO THE GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT. WE PROPOSE A NOVEL ORAL INULIN GEL ENGINEERED AS A PLATFORM FOR THE CONTROLLED RELEASE OF BIOACTIVE AGENTS. BY LEVERAGING ADVANCED DRUG DELIVERY PRINCIPLES, THIS PLATFORM MODULATES THE GUT MICROBIOME, ENHANCES LOCAL IMMUNE MODULATION, AND PROMOTES DURABLE THERAPEUTIC EFFECTS. OUR PRELIMINARY STUDIES DEMONSTRATE THAT INULIN GEL–BASED CONSTRUCTS CAN INDUCE ANTIGEN-SPECIFIC TOLERANCE, MITIGATE HARMFUL IMMUNE RESPONSES, AND PROVIDE LONG-LASTING PROTECTIVE EFFECTS. BECAUSE THE FORMULATION IS COMPOSED OF FDA-APPROVED COMPONENTS AND IS SCALABLE FOR MANUFACTURING, IT OFFERS A SAFE AND PRACTICAL PATHWAY FOR TRANSLATION. IF SUCCESSFUL, THIS PROJECT WILL ESTABLISH A BROADLY APPLICABLE BIOENGINEERING PLATFORM THAT ADVANCES ORAL THERAPEUTIC TECHNOLOGIES AND HAS THE POTENTIAL TO TRANSFORM THERAPEUTIC DEVELOPMENT ACROSS A RANGE OF BIOMEDICAL APPLICATIONS.

description: TRANSFORMING ITK-SNAP INTO A MODERN AI-ASSISTED SEGMENTATION PLATFORM - SIGNIFICANT STRUCTURAL GAPS LIMIT THE ADOPTION OF POWERFUL AI-BASED ALGORITHMS FOR MEDICAL IMAGE PROCESSING BY CLINICIANS AND CLINICAL RESEARCHERS. THE AI ECOSYSTEM EVOLVES RAPIDLY, AND MANY POTENTIAL USERS LACK COMPUTATIONAL EXPERTISE AND TIME TO DISCOVER AND UTILIZE THE LATEST ADVANCES, WHILE COMMERCIAL END-USER TOOLS ARE EXPENSIVE AND NARROWLY FOCUSED. ITK-SNAP IS A WIDELY ADOPTED OPEN-SOURCE TOOL FOR 3D/4D MEDICAL IMAGE SEGMENTATION AND QUANTIFICATION THAT PRIORITIZES USER EXPERIENCE, MAINTAINS A GENTLE LEARNING CURVE, AND OFFERS A GENERAL SET OF FEATURES THAT SPAN MANY IMAGING MODALITIES, BIOLOGICAL SYSTEMS, AND MEDICAL SPECIALTIES. WITH OVER A MILLION DOWNLOADS AND THOUSANDS OF CITATIONS, ITK-SNAP IS ALREADY FAMILIAR TO MANY CLINICAL RESEARCHERS, MAKING IT THE IDEAL PLATFORM FOR DELIVERING THE LATEST AI-DRIVEN ADVANCES IN BIOMEDICAL IMAGE ANALYSIS INTO THE HANDS OF CLINICAL RESEARCHERS. THE SPECIFIC AIMS OF THIS APPLICATION FOCUS ON MODERNIZING ITK-SNAP, INTEGRATING FULL-FEATURED ACCESS TO ADVANCED AI-BASED SEGMENTATION ALGORITHMS, PROVIDING NATIVE SUPPORT FOR LONGITUDINAL IMAGING, AND EVALUATION IN THE CONTEXT OF EMERGING ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE THERAPEUTICS. AIM 1 WILL FUTURE-PROOF ITK-SNAP BY ADOPTING MODERN BEST PRACTICES FOR GUI SOFTWARE DESIGN WILL ENABLE SEAMLESS ACCESS TO REMOTE IMAGING ARCHIVES, WHICH ARE INCREASINGLY THE WAY IN WHICH RESEARCHERS STORE AND ACCESS MEDICAL IMAGING DATA. AIM 2 WILL INTEGRATE A DYNAMICALLY GROWING CURATED LIBRARY OF AI-BASED SEGMENTATION MODELS INTO ITK-SNAP, WITH EMPHASIS ON FOUNDATION MODELS FOR INTERACTIVE SEGMENTATION THAT ARE TRAINED ON LARGE MULTI-DOMAIN DATASETS AND CAN TRANSFORM ITERATIVE 2D PROMPTS (CLICKS, SCRIBBLES) INTO COMPLEX 3D SEGMENTATIONS. THIS WILL INCLUDE IMPLEMENTATION OF EFFICIENT DOMAIN ADAPTATION STRATEGIES TO CONTINUOUSLY IMPROVE THE PERFORMANCE OF INTERACTIVE SEGMENTATION MODELS BASED ON USERS' INTERACTIONS. AIM 3 WILL EXTEND ITK-SNAP WITH FULLY INTEGRATED SUPPORT FOR LONGITUDINAL IMAGING DATASETS, INCLUDING AUTOMATED DETECTION OF CORRESPONDING IMAGE VOLUMES, FAST AFFINE AND DEFORMABLE REGISTRATION, SEGMENTATION PROPAGATION, AND CHANGE QUANTIFICATION. AIM 4 WILL EVALUATE THE SUITABILITY OF ITK-SNAP AS A PRECISION MEDICINE PLATFORM FOR MANAGEMENT OF AMYLOID-TARGETING THERAPY IN ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE, WHERE THE FEATURES DEVELOPED IN AIMS 1-3 WILL SUPPORT IDENTIFYING CANDIDATES FOR TREATMENT, MONITORING SIDE EFFECTS, AND EVALUATING TREATMENT EFFICACY FROM SERIAL MRI SCANS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: SCH: ADVANCING AI FAIRNESS FOR TRUSTWORTHY LIVER ORGAN ALLOCATION - PROJECT SUMMARY (SEE INSTRUCTIONS):  LIVER DISEASES, INCLUDING CIRRHOSIS AND LIVER CANCER, AFFECT MORE THAN 100 MILLION INDIVIDUALS IN THE UNITED STATES AND CONTRIBUTE TO  APPROXIMATELY 50,000 DEATHS ANNUALLY. LIVER TRANSPLANTATION REMAINS THE MOST EFFECTIVE TREATMENT FOR MANY PATIENTS WITH END-STAGE  LIVER DISEASE; HOWEVER, THE PERSISTENT SHORTAGE OF DONOR ORGANS LEAVES THOUSANDS OF PATIENTS ON TRANSPLANT WAITING LISTS EACH YEAR.  CURRENT LIVER ALLOCATION SYSTEMS ARE LARGELY DRIVEN BY MEDICAL URGENCY BUT DO NOT FULLY ACCOUNT FOR FACTORS BEYOND MEDICAL URGENCY  THAT INFLUENCE ACCESS TO TRANSPLANTATION AND TRANSPLANT OUTCOMES. AS AI IS INCREASINGLY ADOPTED TO SUPPORT ORGAN ALLOCATION DECISIONS,  THERE IS GROWING INTEREST IN LEVERAGING AI FAIRNESS METHODOLOGIES TO ADDRESS THESE CHALLENGES. HOWEVER, EXISTING AI FAIRNESS  APPROACHES FACE IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS. MOST METHODS ASSUME COMPLETE OUTCOME INFORMATION, DESPITE TRANSPLANT DATA BEING INHERENTLY  CENSORED BECAUSE MANY PATIENT OUTCOMES ARE ONLY PARTIALLY OBSERVED. IN ADDITION, THEY OFTEN FOCUS EITHER ON ENSURING CONSISTENT  TREATMENT OF SIMILAR PATIENTS OR ON MAINTAINING FAIRNESS ACROSS PATIENT GROUPS, WITHOUT ACCOUNTING FOR THE INTERACTION BETWEEN THESE  OBJECTIVES. THEY ALSO PROVIDE LIMITED SUPPORT FOR UNDERSTANDING FAIRNESS–UTILITY TRADE-OFFS IN A MANNER THAT CLINICIANS CAN READILY  INTERPRET. TO ADDRESS THESE CHALLENGES, THIS PROJECT AIMS TO ADVANCE AI FAIRNESS FOR TRUSTWORTHY LIVER ORGAN ALLOCATION UNDER CENSORED  OUTCOMES. SPECIFICALLY, AIM 1 WILL DEVELOP METHODOLOGIES FOR INDIVIDUAL FAIRNESS WITH GROUP AWARENESS UNDER CENSORING, ENABLING THE  IDENTIFICATION AND MITIGATION OF PATIENT-LEVEL UNFAIRNESS WHILE QUANTIFYING ASSOCIATED GROUP-LEVEL EFFECTS. AIM 2 WILL DEVELOP  METHODOLOGIES FOR GROUP FAIRNESS WITH INDIVIDUAL CONSTRAINTS UNDER CENSORING, QUANTIFYING GROUP-LEVEL FAIRNESS OUTCOMES WHILE LIMITING  EXCESSIVE FAIRNESS LOSSES EXPERIENCED BY INDIVIDUAL PATIENTS. AIM 3 WILL DEVELOP A UNIFIED FRAMEWORK THAT INTEGRATES INDIVIDUAL  FAIRNESS, GROUP FAIRNESS, AND CLINICAL UTILITY, TOGETHER WITH INTERPRETABLE TOOLS THAT ENABLE CLINICIANS TO UNDERSTAND FAIRNESS–UTILITY TRADE OFFS AND ALLOCATION DECISIONS. THE PROPOSED METHODS WILL BE EVALUATED USING DATA FROM THE SCIENTIFIC REGISTRY OF TRANSPLANT RECIPIENTS  (SRTR) AND VALIDATED THROUGH COLLABORATION WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF PITTSBURGH MEDICAL CENTER (UPMC), ONE OF THE NATION'S LEADING  TRANSPLANT CENTERS. BY ADVANCING FAIRNESS-AWARE AND INTERPRETABLE AI METHODS FOR CENSORED CLINICAL DATA, THIS PROJECT HAS THE POTENTIAL  TO IMPROVE ORGAN ALLOCATION DECISIONS, SUPPORT PATIENT SURVIVAL, AND ESTABLISH A FOUNDATION FOR THE BROADER DEPLOYMENT OF AI FAIRNESS  METHODOLOGIES IN HIGH-STAKES HEALTHCARE SETTINGS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: PATHOPHYSIOLOGIC IMPACTS OF TIRE AND ROAD WEAR PARTICLES IN HEALTHY AND INFLAMED LUNGS - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT: ROAD AND TIRE WEAR PARTICLES (TRWP) ARE NON-EXHAUST EMISSION PARTICLES OF SIGNIFICANT CONCERN DUE TO THEIR RAPIDLY INCREASING LEVELS AND TRANSFORMATIONS IN THE ENVIRONMENT THAT RELEASE TOXIC CHEMICALS. TIRE-DERIVED PARTICLES ACCOUNT FOR UP TO 26% OF MICROPLASTICS IN THE ENVIRONMENT. WHILE EXHAUST EMISSIONS ARE THE FOCUS OF CURRENT REGULATORY OVERSIGHT, UNFORTUNATELY, NON-EXHAUST EMISSIONS ARE NOT REGULATED. ADDITIONALLY, WHILE THE TOXICITY OF TRWP HAS RECENTLY GARNERED SIGNIFICANT ATTENTION, THE MECHANISTIC BASIS OF ITS TOXIC EFFECTS AND THE ROLE OF THESE PARTICLES IN MODULATING PRE-EXISTING INFLAMMATION HAVE YET TO BE ELUCIDATED. WE IDENTIFY A THREE- FOLD KNOWLEDGE GAP: 1) HOW DO ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS (TEMPERATURE AND O3 LEVELS) INTERACTIVELY IMPACT 6PPD-Q FORMATION ON TRWP, 2) DOES INHALATION EXPOSURE TO 6PPD AND 6PPD-Q FROM TRWP POSE A PULMONARY AND SYSTEMIC HAZARD, AND 3) HOW DO WEAR PARTICLES INTERACT WITH PRE-EXISTING INFLAMMATION/LUNG DISEASE. WE ARE A TEAM OF EXPERTS IN INHALATION TOXICOLOGY, PARTICLE CHEMISTRY, IMMUNE/INFLAMMATORY RESPONSES, REDOX RESPONSES, AND MITOCHONDRIAL BIOLOGY THAT WILL PERFORM IN VITRO AND IN VIVO STUDIES TO ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS. NUCLEOTIDE-BINDING OLIGOMERIZATION DOMAIN, LEUCINE-RICH REPEAT CONTAINING X1 (NLRX1) IS A MITOCHONDRIA-LOCALIZED PATTERN RECOGNITION RECEPTOR IMPLICATED IN INFLAMMATION AND METABOLIC PATHWAYS. HOWEVER, ITS CONTRIBUTION IN AIR POLLUTION AND TRWP-INDUCED BIOLOGICAL RESPONSES IS NOT DESCRIBED. OUR PRELIMINARY DATA DEMONSTRATES O3-MEDIATED CHANGES IN 6PPD-Q LEVELS, NLRX1-DEPENDENT LUNG INFLAMMATION AND SIGNIFICANT AGGRAVATION OF PRE-EXISTING INFLAMMATION BY TRWP EXPOSURE. BASED ON AVAILABLE LITERATURE AND PRELIMINARY DATA, WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT O3 AND HEAT INTERACTIVELY TRANSFORM TRWP INTO CHEMICALLY, BIOLOGICALLY AND OXIDATIVELY REACTIVE PARTICLES THAT INDUCE AN INFLAMMATORY RESPONSE AND AGGRAVATE PRE-EXISTING INFLAMMATION THROUGH NLRX1-MEDIATED PATHWAYS. IN AIM 1, WE WILL DETERMINE OPTIMAL ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS LEADING TO THE TRANSFORMATION OF TRWP FROM THE ROAD SIMULATOR AND QUANTIFY OXIDANTS, SURFACE FUNCTIONAL GROUP CHANGES AND 6PPD/6PPD-Q. ADDITIONALLY, WE WILL DETERMINE THE INHALATION HAZARD OF 6PPD-Q ADSORBED ON ULTRAFINE PARTICLES. IN AIM 2, WE WILL INVESTIGATE THE MECHANISMS OF IN VITRO TOXICITY OF TRWP USING PRIMARY MACROPHAGES AND EPITHELIAL CELLS, AS WELL AS RELEVANT CELL LINES AND WILL APPLY GENETIC AND THERAPEUTIC MANIPULATION OF NLRX1 TO ELUCIDATE ITS CONTRIBUTION. IN AIM 3, WE WILL DETERMINE TRWP-INDUCED INFLAMMATION AND PULMONARY FUNCTION DECLINE IN NLRX1+/+ AND NLRX1-/- MICE. WE WILL DEFINE THE IMPACT OF TRWP EXPOSURE ON LIPOPOLYSACCHARIDE-INDUCED INNATE INFLAMMATION AND HOUSE DUST MITE EXTRACT-INDUCED ALLERGIC INFLAMMATION/LUNG FUNCTION DECLINE. FINALLY, THE INFLAMMATION-REDUCING BENEFIT OF AN NLRX1 AGONIST (NX-13) WILL BE TESTED. THIS PROPOSAL WILL PROVIDE AN UNDERSTANDING OF HOW ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS DICTATE TRWP TRANSFORMATIONS LEADING TO ADVERSE BIOLOGICAL OUTCOMES BY PROVIDING NOVEL MECHANISTIC INSIGHTS INTO CELLULAR AND ORGAN DYSFUNCTION DURING BOTH NORMAL AND PRE-EXISTING INFLAMMATORY CONDITIONS.

description: ENVIRONMENTAL MODIFIERS OF UVR SKIN CARCINOGENESIS: DECIPHERING THE EFFECTS OF MIXED EXPOSURES - PROJECT SUMMARY HUMANS ARE CONSTANTLY EXPOSED TO MIXTURES OF ENVIRONMENTAL INSULTS WITH NOTABLE IMPACT ON HEALTH AND DISEASE, INCLUDING CANCER. THERE IS STRONG EXPERIMENTAL AND EPIDEMIOLOGICAL EVIDENCE THAT THE CARCINOGENIC POTENTIAL OF DNA DAMAGING AGENTS SUCH AS SOLAR ULTRAVIOLET RADIATION (UVR) IS GREATLY AUGMENTED BY ARSENIC. THIS IS IMPORTANT BECAUSE OVER 200 MILLION PEOPLE WORLDWIDE ARE CHRONICALLY EXPOSED TO ARSENIC IN DRINKING WATER AT CONCENTRATIONS ABOVE THE US EPA OR WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION SAFETY STANDARD. EARLY MECHANISTIC STUDIES ESTABLISHED AN ADVERSE IMPACT OF ARSENIC ON DNA REPAIR CAPACITY AND WE DEMONSTRATED THAT ARSENIC DISRUPTS THE ZINC FINGER MOTIFS IN KEY DNA REPAIR PROTEINS, LEADING TO GREATER DNA DAMAGE ACCUMULATION. SUPPLEMENTAL ZINC RESTORES PROTEIN FUNCTION AND REVERSES ARSENIC EFFECTS. OUR RECENT PRELIMINARY RESULTS SHOW THAT ARSENIC ALONE DOES NOT GENERATE MUTATIONS IN HUMAN KERATINOCYTES OR MOUSE SKIN, BUT DRAMATICALLY INCREASES MUTATIONAL BURDEN CAUSED BY UVR EXPOSURE, WITH A MUTATIONAL PROFILE DOMINATED BY THE CHARACTERISTIC C>T MUTATIONS. INTRIGUINGLY, THE DRAMATIC INCREASE IN CPDS AND C>T MUTATIONS BY ARSENIC+UVR VERSUS UVR ALONE ARE NOT RANDOMLY DISTRIBUTED ACROSS THE GENOME. INSTEAD, C>T MUTATIONS ARE MORE ABUNDANT IN CERTAIN GENES AND IN GENE REGULATORY REGIONS. THE GOAL OF THIS PROJECT IS TO SIGNIFICANTLY MOVE THE FIELD FORWARD BY ADDRESSING CRITICAL GAPS IN THE MOLECULAR MECHANISMS UNDERLYING ARSENIC’S REMARKABLE EFFECTS ON AMPLIFYING UVR MUTAGENESIS AND CARCINOGENESIS. WE WILL TEST THE OVERALL HYPOTHESIS THAT ARSENIC DISRUPTION OF NUCLEOTIDE EXCISION REPAIR (NER) PATHWAY IMPAIRS CPD REPAIR AND INCREASES CPD RETENTION, RESULTING IN ENHANCED CPD CONVERSION TO C>T MUTATIONS IN GENE-REGULATORY REGIONS OF CERTAIN CANCER-RELEVANT GENES, THUS AMPLIFYING UVR SKIN CARCINOGENESIS. WE FURTHER HYPOTHESIZE THAT SUPPLEMENTAL ZINC WILL ATTENUATE THESE ARSENIC-DEPENDENT EFFECTS. THESE HYPOTHESES WILL BE TESTED BY THE STATE-OF-THE-ART DNA DAMAGE SEQUENCING, WHOLE GENOME SEQUENCING, AND ADVANCED BIOINFORMATIC APPROACHES, USING NORMAL HUMAN SKIN CELLS IN CULTURE AND AN ESTABLISHED IN VIVO MODEL OF SKIN CARCINOGENESIS. IN AIM 1, WE WILL FOCUS ON HOW ARSENIC INTERRUPTS THE NER PROTEIN COMPLEX AND INHIBITS CPD REPAIR. AIM 2 WILL DETERMINE THE MECHANISM OF ARSENIC ENHANCEMENT OF CPD CONVERSION TO C>T AND HOW THE SITES OF CPD AND C>T ARE CORRELATED IN THE WHOLE GENOME. FINALLY, IN AIM 3, WE WILL DETERMINE THE IN VIVO CONSEQUENCES OF ARSENIC+UVR EXPOSURE IN ANIMAL MODELS AND DATA OBTAINED FROM HUMAN SKIN CANCER SPECIMENS. THE OUTCOMES FROM THESE STUDIES, UTILIZING BOTH NOVEL CPD-SEQ AND MUTATIONAL PROFILES AT THE WHOLE GENOME LEVEL WITH SINGLE NUCLEOTIDE RESOLUTION, ARE EXPECTED TO HAVE AN UNPRECEDENTED OPPORTUNITY TO PROVIDE INSIGHTS ON OUR MECHANISTIC UNDERSTANDING OF HOW ARSENIC, A COMMON ENVIRONMENTAL FACTOR, ENHANCES UVR MUTAGENESIS AND CARCINOGENESIS AND HOW SUPPLEMENTAL ZN CAN COUNTERACT THE EFFECTS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: PRENATAL EXPOSURE TO AMBIENT BTEX AND BIRTH OUTCOMES: MODEL DEVELOPMENT AND EPIDEMIOLOGIC ANALYSIS - ABSTRACT  THE GOAL OF THIS STUDY IS TO INVESTIGATE THE IMPACT OF PRENATAL EXPOSURE TO BTEX COMPOUNDS (BENZENE, TOLUENE, ETHYLBENZENE, AND XYLENE ISOMERS) AND THEIR MIXTURE ON BIRTH OUTCOMES, INCLUDING BIRTH WEIGHT, LOW BIRTH WEIGHT, PRETERM BIRTH AND PRETERM BIRTH SUBTYPES. BTEX COMPOUNDS ARE HAZARDOUS AIR POLLUTANTS KNOWN TO ORIGINATE FROM TRAFFIC AND INDUSTRIAL EMISSIONS. COMPARED TO CRITERIA POLLUTANTS LIKE PARTICULATE MATTERS, FEWER EPIDEMIOLOGIC STUDIES HAVE BEEN DEDICATED TO ANALYZING THE EFFECTS OF BTEX. WHILE LABORATORY STUDIES HAVE FOUND THAT LOW-LEVEL EXPOSURE CAN ADVERSELY IMPACT FETAL DEVELOPMENT, HISTORIC EPIDEMIOLOGIC EXPOSURE METRICS HAVE NOT POSSESSED ADEQUATE SPATIAL AND TEMPORAL RESOLUTION TO UNDERSTAND HOW THESE CHEMICALS AFFECT INFANT BIRTH OUTCOMES ON A POPULATION LEVEL. TO ADDRESS THIS GAP, WE PROPOSE TO DEVELOP A HIGH-RESOLUTION EXPOSURE MODEL FOR BTEX COMPOUNDS ACROSS THE SOUTHWESTERN UNITED STATES FROM 2011 TO 2023. THIS MODEL WILL INTEGRATE A NUMBER OF STATE-OF-THE-ART MODELING APPROACHES, INCLUDING DISPERSION MODELS, CHEMICAL TRANSPORT MODELS, LAND- USE DATA, AND MACHINE LEARNING TECHNIQUES. THE BTEX EXPOSURE METRICS GENERATED FROM THIS MODEL WILL BE LINKED TO A LARGE ADMINISTRATIVE BIRTH DATASET RECORDED AND RETAINED BY THE TEXAS DEPARTMENT OF STATE HEALTH SERVICES FOR SUBSEQUENT EPIDEMIOLOGIC ANALYSIS. SPECIFICALLY, WE WILL ASSIGN TRIMESTER-SPECIFIC AVERAGE EXPOSURES BASED ON GEOCODED MATERNAL RESIDENTIAL ADDRESSES AND DATES OF BIRTH FOR ALL LIVE BIRTHS IN TEXAS BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022, AN ESTIMATED COHORT OF APPROXIMATELY 1 MILLION BIRTHS. GIVEN TEXAS’S LARGE AND DIVERSE POPULATION, ALONG WITH ITS ABUNDANT BTEX EMISSION SOURCES (E.G., REFINERIES AND HIGHWAYS), THIS DATASET WILL PROVIDE ROBUST RESULTS. MULTIVARIABLE LINEAR, LOGISTIC REGRESSION, AND GEOGRAPHICALLY WEIGHTED MODELS WILL BE USED TO ESTIMATE THE ASSOCIATIONS BETWEEN INDIVIDUAL BTEX COMPOUND EXPOSURES AND BIRTH OUTCOMES OF INTEREST. TO EVALUATE THE JOINT EFFECTS OF BTEX MIXTURES AND IDENTIFY CRITICAL EXPOSURE WINDOWS, WE WILL APPLY A NEWLY DEVELOPED EXTENSION OF THE QUANTILE G-COMPUTATION METHOD, WHICH ENABLES SIMULTANEOUS ASSESSMENT OF MULTIPLE CORRELATED POLLUTANTS AND THEIR TIME-SPECIFIC EFFECTS. OVERALL, BY LEVERAGING HIGH-RESOLUTION EXPOSURE ESTIMATES, LARGE BIRTH DATA, AND ADVANCED STATISTICS TOOLS, THIS STUDY WILL GENERATE NOVEL EVIDENCE ON THE CHILD HEALTH RISKS OF AMBIENT BTEX EXPOSURE.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: IMPACT OF ACID, BASE, AND SALT COMPONENTS OF E-CIGARETTES IN PREGNANCY - PROJECT SUMMARY  ELECTRONIC CIGARETTE (E-CIG) USE DURING PREGNANCY HAS BECOME A MAJOR HEALTH CONCERN IN RECENT YEARS AND IS PERPETUATED BY THE PERCEPTION THAT E-CIGS ARE LESS HARMFUL THAN TRADITIONAL COMBUSTIBLE CIGARETTES. RECENT ESTIMATES SHOW 7% OF WOMEN USE E-CIGS IN PREGNANCY, AND 45% VIEW THEM AS LESS HARMFUL AND MAY HELP THEM QUIT OR REDUCE COMBUSTIBLE CIGARETTES IN PREGNANCY. RECENT REPORTS INDICATE E-CIG VAPING LEADS TO HEIGHTENED RISK TO RESPIRATORY INFECTION IN NONPREGNANT ADULTS, BUT THERE IS LIMITED UNDERSTANDING IN THE NEONATAL POPULATION.  WE PERFORMED PRELIMINARY RNA-SEQ ANALYSIS FOLLOWING EXPOSURE TO FREEBASE NICOTINE, THE MOST ADDICTIVE COMPONENT OF A 3RD GEN E-CIG, DURING PREGNANCY IN OUR PRECLINICAL PREGNANT RAT MODEL USING A STATE-OF-THE-ART VAPING SYSTEM WITH A COMMERCIAL E-CIG UNIT THAT ACCURATELY REPLICATES HUMAN EXPOSURE AND USE. OUR NOVEL DATA SHOWED A MAJOR SEPARATION OF IMMUNE-RELATED GENES BETWEEN MALE AND FEMALE FETAL LUNGS, WITH SEX-SPECIFIC DEFICITS IN INNATE IMMUNE PATHWAYS, INCLUDING THE NEUTROPHIL SYSTEM. FLOW CYTOMETRY ANALYSIS OF FETAL LUNGS CONFIRMED SEX SPECIFIC CHANGES IN INNATE IMMUNE CELL POPULATIONS FOLLOWING FREEBASE NICOTINE EXPOSURE, PRIMARILY IN NEUTROPHILS. IMPORTANTLY, OUR PRELIMINARY IN VIVO EXPERIMENTS SHOW SEX-SPECIFIC ENHANCED SUSCEPTIBILITY TO NEONATAL VIRAL INFECTION IN THE FREEBASE NICOTINE-EXPOSED LUNG. OUR COMPELLING PRELIMINARY EVIDENCE DEMONSTRATED THAT NICOTINE AEROSOLS ALTERS BOTH NEONATAL LUNG DEVELOPMENT AND FUNCTION IN A SEX-SPECIFIC MANNER. HOWEVER, THE NEWER 4TH GEN E-CIGS ALSO HAVE AN ACIDIC COMPONENT IN ADDITION TO THE NICOTINE (BASE). ALTHOUGH FREEBASE NICOTINE IS THE MOST STUDIED COMPONENT, WE TESTED THE IMPACT OF AEROSOLIZING THE ACIDIC COMPONENT, BENZOIC ACID, THE ACID USED BY JUUL, A POPULAR MANUFACTURER. PRELIMINARY RNA-SEQ DATA SHOWED BOTH VIRAL-SENSING PATHWAYS, AND TYPE I INTERFERON (IFN) SIGNALING PATHWAYS, WERE DOWNREGULATED IN A SEX-SPECIFIC MANNER FOLLOWING EXPOSURE TO BOTH THE ACIDIC (BENZOIC ACID) AND THE BASIC (NICOTINE) COMPONENTS IN THE LATEST 4TH GEN E-CIGS. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT FETAL EXPOSURE TO AEROSOLIZATION OF BENZOIC ACID (ACID), FREEBASE NICOTINE (BASE), OR IN COMBINATION AS NICOTINE BENZOATE (SALT) ALTERS THE DEVELOPING LUNG IMMUNE ENVIRONMENT IN A SEX- DEPENDENT MANNER, RESULTING IN DEFICIENT ANTIVIRAL INNATE IMMUNE RESPONSES AND INCREASED RISK TO RESPIRATORY VIRAL INFECTIONS. TO TEST THIS HYPOTHESIS, WE WILL (1) IDENTIFY SEX-DEPENDENT ALTERATIONS IN FETAL LUNG IMMUNE CELL FUNCTION, DISTRIBUTION AND INFLAMMATORY PROFILES FOLLOWING GESTATIONAL E-CIG EXPOSURE (CARRIER, BENZOIC ACID, FREEBASE NICOTINE, & NICOTINE BENZOATE SALT), (2) DEFINE THE SEX-DEPENDENT IMPACT OF ACID, BASE, AND SALT COMPONENTS OF E-CIGS ON FETAL LUNG ANTIVIRAL INNATE PATHWAYS USING SINGLE-CELL RNA SEQ, STOCHASTIC MODELING AND REINFORCEMENT ALGORITHMS, AND (3) ASSESS THE SEX-DEPENDENT EFFICACY OF POSTNATAL IFN TREATMENT IN ENHANCING ANTIVIRAL RESPIRATORY RESPONSES AFTER PRENATAL EXPOSURE TO E-CIG’S ACID, BASE, AND SALT COMPONENTS. THESE FINDINGS WILL HELP MANAGING NEONATAL IMMUNE ALTERATIONS THAT MAY DIFFER BASED ON SEX, AND DIRECTLY ADDRESS SEVERAL “RESEARCH AREAS OF EMPHASIS” OF NIEHS STRATEGIC PLAN 2025-2029.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: EXAMINING PATHWAYS OF PFAS EXPOSURE AND THEIR IMPACTS ON HYPERLIPIDEMIA IN A RURAL COMMUNITY IMPACTED BY LAND SPREADING - ABSTRACT PER- AND POLYFLUOROALKYL SUBSTANCES (PFAS) ARE A LARGE CLASS OF SYNTHETIC “FOREVER CHEMICALS” THAT PERSIST IN THE ENVIRONMENT AND HUMAN BODY, AND ARE LINKED TO KIDNEY AND LIVER CANCERS, THYROID DISEASE, LIVER DISEASE, AND HYPERLIPIDEMIA. AN UNDER-RECOGNIZED SOURCE OF PFAS EXPOSURE IS FROM SLUDGE AND BIOSOLIDS FROM WASTEWATER TREATMENT AND INDUSTRIAL PROCESSES, WHICH CAN BE APPLIED ON AGRICULTURAL FIELDS AS FERTILIZER. AS A RESULT, RURAL AMERICANS IN AGRICULTURAL SETTINGS ARE DISPROPORTIONATELY AT RISK OF CONTAMINATED FOOD AND WATER FROM LAND SPREADING. ABOUT 60% OF BIOSOLIDS GENERATED IN THE UNITED STATES ARE LAND- APPLIED, YET THE HEALTH IMPLICATIONS FOR RURAL RESIDENTS REMAIN LARGELY UNKNOWN. THREE BARRIERS LIMIT PROGRESS. FIRST, LIPID METABOLISM IS A KEY MECHANISM BY WHICH PFAS EXPOSURE MAY LEAD TO DOWNSTREAM HEALTH OUTCOMES. YET PRIOR HUMAN HEALTH STUDIES HAVE EXAMINED ONLY A HANDFUL OF LEGACY PFAS, DESPITE >10,000 PFAS EXISTING. SECOND, INDUSTRY HAS REPLACED LEGACY PFAS WITH PRECURSOR COMPOUNDS SUCH AS POLYFLUOROALKYL PHOSPHATE ESTERS (PAPS), WHICH CAN BIO-TRANSFORM INTO PERFLUOROOCTANOIC ACID (PFOA), A CLASSIFIED CARCINOGENIC. SOME INTERMEDIATES ARE ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE MORE TOXIC THAN THEIR END PRODUCTS, YET LITTLE IS KNOWN ABOUT THEIR REAL-WORLD CONTRIBUTION TO HUMAN EXPOSURE. THIRD, BIOMONITORING DATA ARE LARGELY FROM OCCUPATIONAL OR URBAN SETTINGS, OVERLOOKING RURAL PATHWAYS OF EXPOSURE WHERE PFAS ACCUMULATE IN SOIL, GROUNDWATER, SURFACE WATER, AND LOCALLY PRODUCED FOOD. WISCONSIN PROVIDES A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY TO ADDRESS THESE GAPS AS IT HAS SOME OF THE NATION’S HIGHEST PFAS LEVELS IN PRIVATE WELLS (>36,000 PPT), WITH CONTAMINATION LINKED TO BIOSOLID AND PAPERMILL SLUDGE LAND SPREADING. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT PRECURSOR PFAS SIGNIFICANTLY CONTRIBUTE TO THE PERSISTENCE AND BURDEN OF PFAS EXPOSURE, AND THAT ONGOING EXPOSURE VIA LOCAL FOOD, WATER, AIR, AND DUST CONTRIBUTES TO ELEVATED LIPID LEVELS. AIM 1 WILL IDENTIFY ONGOING ROUTES OF EXPOSURE TO PFAS IN AN IMPACTED RURAL COMMUNITY BY ENROLLING 400 RESIDENTS, COLLECTING ENVIRONMENTAL AND BLOOD SAMPLES, QUANTIFYING TARGETED AND UNTARGETED PFAS, AND APPLYING TOXICOKINETIC MODELING. AIM 2 WILL DETERMINE THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN PFAS MIXTURES AND LIPID PROFILES, TESTING WHETHER INCLUSION OF PREVIOUSLY UNIDENTIFIED PFAS STRENGTHENS ASSOCIATIONS WITH CHOLESTEROL, TRIGLYCERIDES, AND SPECIFIC LIPOPROTEIN SUBFRACTIONS. THE PROPOSED RESEARCH IS OF HIGH IMPACT AND WILL SIGNIFICANTLY ADVANCE THE FIELD BY CLARIFYING OUR UNDERSTANDING OF HUMAN EXPOSURE TO PFAS FROM CONTAMINATED LAND SPREADING AND KEY RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN PFAS AND HYPERLIPIDEMIA. FINDINGS WILL INFORM INTERVENTIONS AIMED AT REDUCING EXPOSURE AMONG RURAL RESIDENTS IMPACTED BY PFAS EXPOSURE FROM LAND SPREADING, AND INTERVENTIONS AIMED AT PREVENTING OR TREATING ELEVATED CHOLESTEROL FROM HISTORIC OR CURRENT PFAS EXPOSURE – THEREBY REDUCING RISKS OF DOWNSTREAM CHRONIC HEALTH CONDITIONS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: PFAS EXPOSURE, PFAS MITIGATION, AND ADRD BIOMARKERS AND COGNITION - PROJECT SUMMARY PER- AND POLYFLUOROALKYL SUBSTANCES (PFAS) ARE PERSISTENT ENVIRONMENTAL CHEMICALS WITH KNOWN TOXICOLOGICAL AND NEUROTOXIC EFFECTS. HOWEVER, THEIR ROLE FOR ALZHEIMER’S DISEASE AND RELATED DEMENTIAS (ADRD) REMAINS UNDEREXPLORED, ESPECIALLY FOR MID-LIFE EXPOSURES. FIREFIGHTERS, WHO FACE HIGH OCCUPATIONAL PFAS EXPOSURE THROUGH TREATED GEAR AND FIREFIGHTING FOAMS, REPRESENT A KEY POPULATION FOR UNDERSTANDING THE COGNITIVE AND NEUROLOGICAL IMPACTS OF PFAS. PFAS BIND TO ALBUMIN, THE MOST ABUNDANT PROTEIN IN PLASMA, AND CAN THEORETICALLY BE REMOVED VIA PLASMAPHERESIS OR PLASMA EXCHANGE. PLASMAPHERESIS MAY ALSO HAVE ADDITIONAL BENEFITS, AND HAS SHOWN PROMISE IN OTHER STUDIES AS A POSSIBLE TREATMENT FOR PATIENTS WITH ADRD. IN AN ONGOING RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIAL (RCT) OF FIREFIGHTERS, WE ARE EVALUATING WHETHER REGULAR PLASMA DONATION REDUCES PFAS, AND IMPROVES EPIGENETIC AGE ACCELERATION. PRELIMINARY DATA FROM THIS STUDY SUGGEST BASELINE PFAS LEVELS ARE ASSOCIATED WITH POORER COGNITIVE OUTCOMES, AND PLASMA DONORS EXHIBIT BOTH REDUCED PFAS LEVELS AND DECREASED EPIGENETIC AGE ACCELERATION AT FOLLOW-UP. THIS STUDY LEVERAGES THE EXISTING RCT TO ADDRESS THREE AIMS. AIM 1 WILL ASSESS WHETHER PFAS EXPOSURES AT BASELINE ARE ASSOCIATED WITH CHANGES OVER TIME IN ADRD-RELEVANT OUTCOMES, INCLUDING COGNITION, 124 NEUROLOGICAL PLASMA BIOMARKERS FROM THE NULISA CNS PANEL (INCLUDING AMYLOID BETA 42/40, NEUROFILAMENT LIGHT, GLIAL FIBRILLARY ACIDIC PROTEIN, AND P-TAU217), AND PRODROMAL MARKERS (SLEEP AND DEPRESSION) IN CONTROL PARTICIPANTS (N=350). AIM 2 EVALUATES WHETHER RANDOMIZED ASSIGNMENT TO PLASMA DONATION LEADS TO IMPROVED ADRD-RELATED OUTCOMES (SAME AS IN AIM 1) OVER 1- AND 3-YEAR FOLLOW-UP PERIODS (N=220), AND TO WHAT EXTENT THESE BENEFITS ARE MEDIATED BY PFAS REDUCTION. AIM 3 EXPLORES ADDITIONAL HEALTH EFFECTS OF PLASMA DONATION USING UNTARGETED PROTEOMIC PROFILING AND PROTEOMIC AGE. THIS PROJECT WILL GENERATE NOVEL EVIDENCE ON THE CONTRIBUTION OF PFAS TO COGNITIVE AGING AND THE POTENTIAL OF PLASMAPHERESIS AS A PUBLIC HEALTH INTERVENTION FOR ADRD PREVENTION, AND FOR OTHER HEALTH OUTCOMES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: MECHANISM BEHIND NUCLEAR-SPECIFIC NICOTINAMIDE ADENINE DINUCLEOTIDE (NAD+) SYNTHASE, NICOTINAMIDE MONONUCLEOTIDE ADENYLYL TRANSFERASE-1 (NMNAT1) IN RETINAL PHOTORECEPTOR BIOGENESIS AND HEALTH - PROJECT SUMMARY THE LONG-TERM GOAL OF THIS PROPOSAL IS TO ELUCIDATE THE PRECISE ROLE OF NICOTINAMIDE MONONUCLEOTIDE ADENYLYLTRANSFERASE-1 (NMNAT1) IN THE DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF RETINAL PHOTORECEPTOR NEURONS. MUTATIONS IN NMNAT1 CAUSE LEBER CONGENITAL AMAUROSIS (LCA), A SEVERE EARLY-ONSET BLINDING DISORDER. ALTHOUGH ALL THREE NMNAT ISOFORMS (NMNAT1–3) CONTRIBUTE TO SUBCELLULAR NAD⁺ BIOSYNTHESIS, ESSENTIAL FOR METABOLISM, CELL SURVIVAL, AND GENOMIC STABILITY, NMNAT1 PLAYS A UNIQUELY CRITICAL ROLE IN RETINAL HEALTH. THIS PROJECT SEEKS TO UNDERSTAND WHY NMNAT1 IS INDISPENSABLE FOR PHOTORECEPTOR SURVIVAL AND WHY ITS LOSS LEADS TO PHOTORECEPTOR DEGENERATION, EVEN WHEN SARM1, A KEY PRO-DEGENERATIVE NADASE, IS INHIBITED. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT NMNAT1 REGULATES CRITICAL NAD⁺/NMN POOLS AND POSSESSES ESSENTIAL SARM1-INDEPENDENT, NON-ENZYMATIC FUNCTIONS REQUIRED DURING EARLY RETINAL DEVELOPMENT. OUR FIRST AIM WILL DETERMINE WHETHER ELEVATED NMN IS INTRINSICALLY TOXIC TO PHOTORECEPTORS, INDEPENDENT OF SARM1, A MECHANISM THAT REMAINS POORLY UNDERSTOOD AND REPRESENTS A MAJOR GAP IN THE FIELD. NEXT, WE WILL INVESTIGATE NMNAT1'S NON-ENZYMATIC FUNCTIONS AND ITS COMPARTMENT-SPECIFIC ROLES IN MAINTAINING NAD⁺ HOMEOSTASIS. TOGETHER, THESE STUDIES WILL GUIDE THE DEVELOPMENT OF TARGETED GENE THERAPIES FOR LCA. THE EXPECTED IMPACT IS TO ESTABLISH A NEW PARADIGM FOR NMNAT1 FUNCTION IN SUBCELLULAR NAD⁺ REGULATION AND ITS POTENTIAL CHAPERONE-LIKE ROLES, REVEALING NOVEL THERAPEUTIC STRATEGIES FOR RESTORING VISION IN NMNAT1- ASSOCIATED RETINAL DISEASES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services

recipient.name: TRUSTEES OF THE UNIVERSITY OF PENNSYLVANIA, THE

description: THE ROLE OF RETINAL MICROSOMAL TRIGLYCERIDE TRANSFER PROTEIN IN VISION - PROJECT SUMMARY CENTRAL TO RETINAL LIPID HOMEOSTASIS IS THE REGULATION OF INPUT AND EXPORT PATHWAYS WHICH DEFINES THE INTRACELLULAR POOL OF RPE LIPIDS AND WHICH, WHEN DYSREGULATED, IS ASSOCIATED WITH PATHOLOGIC LIPID ACCUMULATION, A HALLMARK OF MANY DEGENERATIVE RETINAL DISEASES. THE RPE MANAGES TRANSPORT OF LIPIDS INTO AND OUT OF THE NEURAL RETINA (NR) AND, UPTAKE OF FAT-SOLUBLE VITAMINS FROM THE CHOROID AS WELL AS THE METABOLISM OF INGESTED OUTER SEGMENT (OS) LIPIDS, LIPID RECYCLING TO NR AND DE NOVO LIPID SYNTHESIS. MUCH OF THE LIPID POOL IN RPE IS STORED IN LIPID DROPLETS (LD); WHILE LIKELY INITIALLY PROTECTIVE EXCESS ACCUMULATION OF LD CAN INDUCE CELLULAR DYSFUNCTION AND TOXICITY. LIPID PACKAGING AND TRANSPORT OCCURS VIA APOPROTEIN B (APOB) CONTAINING LIPOPROTEINS (BLPS); THESE SPECIALIZED LIPID TRANSPORT PARTICLES MADE UP OF STRUCTURAL APO-PROTEINS HOLD TOGETHER A LIPID CORE RICH IN TRIGLYCERIDES AND ESTERIFIED CHOLESTEROL. THROUGH THE ASSEMBLY AND SECTION OF BLPS, LIPIDS CAN BE REMOVED EN MASS, THUS PREVENTING LIPOTOXICITY. MICROSOMAL TRIGLYCERIDE TRANSFER PROTEIN (MTP), ENCODED BY THE MTTP GENE, IS THE MASTER REGULATOR OF BLP ASSEMBLY. TO OUR KNOWLEDGE, OUR STUDIES ARE THE FIRST TO DEVELOP A METABOLICALLY INTACT, IN VIVO, SYSTEM DEMONSTRATING THAT LOCAL, RPE-SPECIFIC, MTP–ACTIVITY AND BLP ASSEMBLY AND SECRETION MAINTAINS RPE AND NR LIPID HOMEOSTASIS. WE SHOW THAT LOSS OF MTP IN THE RPEMTTP MOUSE DECREASES RPE-ASSOCIATED BLP, AND ENHANCES LIPID DROPLET ACCUMULATION, RETINAL CHOLESTEROL AND SUB-RETINAL DEPOSITS CULMINATING IN RETINAL DEGENERATION AND LOSS OF ROD CELL FUNCTION. THE COMPLEX ROLE OF MTP-ACTIVITY IN VISUAL FUNCTION IS HIGHLIGHTED IN PATIENTS WITH AGE-RELATED RETINAL DEGENERATION. AS WELL AS THOSE WITH ABETALIPOPROTEINEMIA (ABL). INDIVIDUALS DEFICIENT IN MTP ACTIVITY HAVE PROGRESSIVE VISION LOSS WITH AGE DESPITE SUPPLEMENTATION WITH FAT-SOLUBLE VITAMINS. PATIENTS WITH AMD ACCUMULATE SUB-RETINAL AND SUB-RPE DEPOSITS OFTEN RICH IN BLP CONSTITUTES AND SUFFER VISION LOSS WITH AGE. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT THE RETINA RELIES ON LOCAL, RPE-MTP-DEPENDENT LIPID PROCESSING TO MAINTAIN LIPID BALANCE THROUGH REGULATED LIPID TRANSPORT VIA BLPS AND LIPID DROPLET UPKEEP TO SUSTAIN METABOLIC SYNERGY WITH THE NR FOR RETINAL HEALTH. WE WILL DETERMINE HOW RPE-MTP ACTIVITY CONTRIBUTES TO LIPID TRAFFICKING IN THE RETINA WITH AN EMPHASIS ON CHOLESTEROL BALANCE (SPECIFIC AIM 1). IN SPECIFIC AIM 2, WE ASK WHETHER RPE-SPECIFIC MTP ACTIVITY IS NECESSARY FOR RETINAL METABOLIC SYNERGY. IN SPECIFIC AIM 3, WE FOCUS ON THE ROLE OF MTP-DEPENDENT PROCESSES IN MAINTAINING LIPID DROPLET FUNCTION WITH EMPHASIS ON RETINYL ESTER STORAGE AND LIPID EXPORT. THESE STUDIES WILL ESTABLISH THE ROLE OF RETINAL PIGMENT EPITHELIA MTP IN SUSTAINING VISION AND HAVE BROADER IMPLICATIONS IN THE TREATMENT OF DEGENERATIVE AND ABL-ASSOCIATED VISION LOSS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: REGULATORY NETWORKS IN LENS DEVELOPMENT - THE LENS IS ESSENTIAL FOR OUR HIGH-RESOLUTION VISION. ALTERATIONS IN LENS DEVELOPMENT/HOMEOSTASIS CAUSES CATARACT (LOSS OF TRANSPARENCY). IN ~50% OF AMERICANS AGE >80, CATARACT CAUSES VISION LOSS, AND ITS PREVALENCE WILL DOUBLE BY 2050. IMPORTANTLY, CATARACT SURGERY ADDS SUBSTANTIAL COSTS TO US MEDICARE (>$3.4 BILLION ANNUALLY). THUS, DEFINING LENS REGULATORY MECHANISMS IS ESSENTIAL FOR UNDERSTANDING THE PATHOLOGY OF ITS DEFECTS. TOWARD THIS GOAL, WE DEVELOPED A WEB-BASED RESOURCE ISYTE (INTEGRATED SYSTEMS TOOL FOR EYE GENE DISCOVERY) TO PREDICT NEW PATHWAYS LINKED TO EYE/LENS DEFECTS. WE APPLIED ISYTE TO IDENTIFY MANY TRANSCRIPTION FACTORS (TFS) AND RNA- BINDING PROTEINS (RBPS) WHOSE DEFICIENCIES CAUSE EYE/LENS DEFECTS. THIS HAS ADVANCED OUR UNDERSTANDING OF TRANSCRIPTIONAL AND POST-TRANSCRIPTIONAL GENE EXPRESSION CONTROL MECHANISMS IN EYE/LENS DEVELOPMENT. YET, HOW LENS REGULATORY NETWORKS ARE COORDINATELY CONTROLLED BY THE INTERPLAY OF TRANSCRIPTIONAL AND POST-TRANSCRIPTIONAL FACTORS REMAINS ILL-DEFINED. FURTHER, THE MECHANISMS THAT CONTROL THE EXTRAORDINARY ABUNDANCE OF SPECIFIC LENS MRNAS (E.G., CRYSTALLINS, MEMBRANE PROTEINS), MUTATIONS/DEFICIENCY OF WHICH CAUSE HUMAN CATARACT, ARE UNCLEAR. IT IS UNKNOWN WHETHER TRANSCRIPTION REGULATORS THAT PREVIOUSLY WERE CONSIDERED TO ONLY HAVE A UBIQUITOUS ROLE IN GENE EXPRESSION CONTROL, ACTUALLY PLAY A SELECTIVE FUNCTION FOR THE MASSIVE TRANSCRIPTIONAL UPREGULATION OF KEY LENS MRNAS. THIS PROPOSAL ADDRESSES THESE MAJOR KNOWLEDGE-GAPS. WE HAVE NOW APPLIED ISYTE TO IDENTIFY A KEY NEW REGULATOR, ELL2 (ELONGATION FACTOR FOR RNA POLYMERASE II 2), IN THE LENS. WE MADE A NEW ELL2-TARGETED LENS CONDITIONAL KNOCKOUT (ELL2CKO) MOUSE MODEL AND FIND THAT ELL2 DEFICIENCY CAUSES FULLY-PENETRANT LENS DEFECTS. FURTHER, WE FIND ELL2 IS REGULATED BY KEY CATARACT-LINKED RBPS. THUS, WE PROPOSE TO TEST A NEW PARADIGM-SHIFTING HYPOTHESIS: ELL2, PREVIOUSLY BELIEVED TO BE INVOLVED IN ONLY THE GENERAL ASPECTS OF TRANSCRIPTION, IS NECESSARY FOR THE MASSIVE BUILD-UP OF SELECT CATARACT-LINKED MRNAS IN THE LENS. THIS WILL BE TESTED BY THE FOLLOWING GOALS. AIM 1: CHARACTERIZE ELL2CKO LENS TO DEFINE THE MORPHOLOGICAL AND CELLULAR FEATURES UNDERLYING ITS PATHOLOGY. PERFORM RNA-SEQ ON ISOLATED EPITHELIAL AND FIBER CELLS AND SINGLE CELL RNA-SEQ ON ELL2CKO LENS TO DETERMINE THE CELL- SPECIFIC AND SPATIOTEMPORAL IMPACTS OF ELL2 DEFICIENCY ON THE LENS TRANSCRIPTOME. PERFORM TMT PROTEOMICS TO DEFINE THE PROTEIN CHANGES IN THE ELL2-DEFICIENT LENS. AIM 2: UNCOVER THE MECHANISM OF ELL2-MEDIATED CONTROL OF KEY CATARACT-LINKED GENES BY: DEFINING CHROMATIN CHANGES IN ELL2CKO LENS; DEFINING ELL2’S DIRECT GENE-TARGETS BY LENS CHROMATIN ASSAYS; AND EXAMINING ELL2’S TRANSCRIPTIONAL CONTROL OVER KEY HUMAN CATARACT-LINKED TARGETS, E.G. CRYSTALLINS, AQUAPORIN, AS WELL AS OTHER IMPORTANT LENS GENES. THESE NEW ELL2 DATA WILL BE ANALYZED IN THE CONTEXT OF OTHER LENS TF AND RBP-PERTURBATION DATASETS TO DEFINE REGULATORY NETWORKS IN LENS BIOLOGY/PATHOLOGY. THE EXPECTED OVERALL IMPACT OF THIS INNOVATIVE PROPOSAL IS THAT IT WILL RESULT IN FUNDAMENTAL ADVANCES IN THE MECHANISTIC AND CONCEPTUAL UNDERSTANDING OF GENE EXPRESSION CONTROL IN LENS DEVELOPMENT, DEFINE THE RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN TRANSCRIPTIONAL AND POST-TRANSCRIPTIONAL REGULATORS, AND UNCOVER NEW HIGH-PRIORITY GENES RELEVANT TO LENS BIOLOGY.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: UNDERSTANDING THE DEVELOPMENT OF PATHOGENIC CD8 T CELLS IN HLA-B*27-ASSOCIATED ACUTE ANTERIOR UVEITIS - PROJECT SUMMARY (ABSTRACT) UVEITIS IS A POTENTIALLY BLINDING DISEASE THAT TYPICALLY AFFLICTS WORKING-AGE ADULTS. THE FUNDAMENTAL DRIVERS OF OCULAR INFLAMMATION REMAINS POORLY DEFINED, WHICH HINDERS THE DEVELOPMENT OF NEW DIAGNOSTICS AND THERAPEUTICS. THE INHERITED HLA-8*27 ALLELE IS ASSOCIATED WITH ACUTE ANTERIOR UVEITIS, PROVIDING A WELL-DEFINED POPULATION OF PATIENTS TO HELP INVESTIGATE THE BASIC MECHANISMS OF INFLAMMATORY UVEITIS. RECENT EVIDENCE SUGGESTS THAT PATHOGENIC CDB T CELLS HAVE A CENTRAL ROLE IN THE PATHOGENESIS OF HLA-8*27-ASSOCIATED ACUTE ANTERIOR UVEITIS (B27AAU) THROUGH MOLECULAR MIMICRY. THESE PATHOGENIC CD8 T CELLS INITIALLY RECOGNIZE A BACTERIAL PEPTIDE ANTIGEN FROM THE INTESTINE (YEIH), FOLLOWED BY CROSS-REACTIVITY TO SELF-ANTIGENS, WHICH LEADS TO AUTOIMMUNITY. THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS PROPOSAL IS TO IDENTIFY THE FACTORS THAT PROGRAM THESE CROSS-REACTIVE CD8 T CELLS TO PROMOTE UVEITIS PATHOGENESIS. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT TWO KEY FACTORS DURING INITIAL ACTIVATION OF CROSS-REACTIVE T CELLS ARE IMPORTANT FOR IMPRINTING A PATHOGENIC PROGRAM: INFLAMMATORY EVENTS IN THE INTESTINE AND T CELL RECEPTOR (TCR) CROSS-REACTIVITY. FIRST, WE WILL USE PUBLIC DATASETS AND SINGLE-CELL RNA SEQUENCING OF PROSPECTIVE COHORTS TO EXAMINE WHETHER INTESTINAL INFLAMMATION PROMOTES THE DEVELOPMENT OF PATHOGENIC CDB T CELLS IN B27AAU. SECOND, WE WILL COMPARE NON-CROSS-REACTIVE CD8 T CELLS THAT REACT TO THE YEIH ANTIGEN BUT NOT SELF-ANTIGENS WITH CROSS-REACTIVE CDB T CELLS THAT RECOGNIZE BOTH THE YEIH ANTIGEN AND AUTOANTIGENS THROUGH MOLECULAR MIMICRY. THESE COMPARISONS WILL BE EVALUATED BY PERFORMING SINGLE-CELL RNA SEQUENCING AND FLOW CYTOMETRY IN SAMPLES FROM HLA-8*27' HEALTHY CONTROLS AND B27AAU PATIENTS. THIRD, WE WILL ANALYZE CANDIDATE TRANSCRIPTION FACTORS (CEBPD, RORA, RUNX2, BHLHE40, AND ZBTB16) USING LENTIVIRAL EXPRESSION AND CRISPR INHIBITION IN PRIMARY CDB T CELLS TO IDENTIFY KEY TRANSCRIPTION FACTORS DRIVING THE DIFFERENTIATION OF UVEITOGENIC T CELLS IN B27AAU AND OTHER FORMS OF UVEITIS. COLLECTIVELY, SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THESE STUDIES WILL HELP DEFINE THE ORIGINS OF B27AUU, WHICH MAY APPLY TO OTHER FORMS OF UVEITIS.

description: OXIDATIVE STRESS AND NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME ACTIVATION IN EYE LENS PATHOBIOLOGY DURING AGING - ABSTRACT: DESPITE A WEALTH OF REPORTS DEMONSTRATING A LINK BETWEEN INFLAMMATORY RESPONSE AND AGE-RELATED DISEASES (ARDS), THE FACTORS THAT CAUSALLY LINK TO AGING PATHOLOGIES ARE POORLY UNDERSTOOD. RECENTLY, INCREASING LEVELS OF OXIDATIVE STRESS-DRIVEN NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME ACTIVATION HAS BEEN IMPLICATED AS A MAJOR RISK FACTOR FOR AGING- RELATED DISEASES. THE DYSREGULATION OF ANTIOXIDANT PATHWAY AND REACTIVE OXYGEN SPECIES (ROS) AMPLIFICATION IN AGING HAVE NOW BEEN FOUND TO EXACERBATE NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME ACTIVATION-MEDIATED INFLAMMATORY RESPONSES AND DEVELOPMENT OF AGE-RELATED BLINDING DISORDERS. THE DETAILED MOLECULAR PATHWAYS UNDERLYING THIS ADVERSE SIGNALING AND CAUSES FOR ROS AMPLIFICATION AND RELATED OCULAR PATHOLOGIES WITH ADVANCING AGE, HOWEVER, REMAIN ELUSIVE. RECENTLY, USING EYE LENS/LENS EPITHELIAL CELLS (LECS) AS A MODEL, I FOUND THAT AGING LECS UNDER CONDITIONS OF OXIDATIVE STRESS REVEAL A DRAMATIC INCREASE IN TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR KLF9 (KRUPPEL-LIKE FACTOR 9) EXPRESSION, RESULTING IN KLF9-DEPENDENT ANTIOXIDANT GENES SUPPRESSION WITH ROS AMPLIFICATION AND CELL DAMAGE. HOWEVER, THIS ADVERSE SIGNALING ENSUES IN AGING LENSES/LECS, CAUSING ABERRANT TXNIP (THIOREDOXIN INTERACTING PROTEIN) EXPRESSION AND NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME ACTIVATION-DRIVEN AGING PATHOLOGIES OR CELL DEATH-TYPE ARE NOT EXPLORED. OUR PRELIMINARY DATA USING EACH OF THESE FACTORS SHOW THAT: 1) INCREASED ROS LEVEL IS ASSOCIATED WITH NF-ΚB ACTIVATION-DEPENDENT INCREASED KLF9 EXPRESSION IN AGING; 2) LIKE OXIDATIVE STRESS OR AGING LECS, LECS OVEREXPRESSING KLF9 DISPLAY EXCESSIVE ROS AND NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME ACTIVATION-EVOKED SIGNALING; 3) AGING LECS SHOW INCREASED TXNIP EXPRESSION WITH REDUCED LEVELS OF THIOREDOXIN (TRX1) AND NRF2 (NFE2-RELATED FACTOR 2), A REPRESSOR OF TXNIP; 4) IN CONTRAST TO AGING LECS AND LECS OVEREXPRESSING KLF9, THESE LECS WHEN TREATED WITH AN ANTIOXIDANT, LIKE PRDX6 (PEROXIREDOXIN 6) DO NOT SHOW NF-ΚB/KLF9/NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME AXIS- MEDIATED INFLAMMATORY SIGNALING. BACKED WITH THESE OBSERVATIONS, THE CENTRAL HYPOTHESIS OF THIS PROPOSAL IS THAT AGING/OXIDATIVE STRESS CAUSES ABERRANT EXPRESSION OF KLF9 VIA NF-ΚB, AND THAT SUBSEQUENTLY RESULTS IN KLF9- MEDIATED ANTIOXIDANT SUPPRESSION AND ROS AMPLIFICATION, LEADING TO NLRP3 ACTIVATION-MEDIATED PATHOLOGIES VIA THE FEED-FORWARD VICIOUS CYCLES WITHIN LENS MICROENVIRONMENT (THAT ARE OPERATIVE DURING AGING AND OXIDATIVE STRESS WITH INCREASE TXNIP). USING IN-VITRO AND IN-VIVO APPROACHES, WE WILL TEST OUR HYPOTHESIS VIA THREE SPECIFIC AIMS: 1) EXPLORE THE MOLECULAR MECHANISMS UNDERLYING NF-ΚB-KLF9-ANTIOXIDANT AXIS MEDIATED INDUCTION OF NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME INFLAMMATORY PATHWAY IN AGING/OXIDATIVE STRESS IN-VITRO; 2) DETERMINE THAT KLF9’S ABERRANT EXPRESSION ALTERS ITS TRANSCRIPTIONAL REPROGRAMMING, LEADING TO NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME ACTIVATION PATHWAY; 3) DETERMINE THE MECHANISM(S) INVOLVED IN THE PROGRESSION OF NF-ΚB-KLF9-AND NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME-MEDIATED SIGNALING IN VIVO IN A MOUSE MODEL OF AGE-RELATED CATARACT. UNDERSTANDING THE MECHANISMS RESPONSIBLE FOR OXIDATIVE/AGING-INDUCED NLRP3 INFLAMMASOME ACTIVATION-MEDIATED LENS PATHOBIOLOGY WILL SET THE STAGE FOR FUTURE DEVELOPMENT OF NOVEL THERAPEUTICS AIMED AT DAMPING OXIDATIVE/AGING/NLRP3-ASSOCIATED CATARACT FORMATION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DECODING CURVATURE-DEPENDENT KERATOCONUS PATHOLOGY USING AN ENGINEERED HUMAN CORNEA CHIP - PROJECT SUMMARY KERATOCONUS (KC) IS A PROGRESSIVE CORNEAL DISORDER AFFECTING MILLIONS WORLDWIDE, CHARACTERIZED BY CORNEAL THINNING, PROTUSION, AND IRREGULAR ASTIGMATISM. DESPITE ITS PREVALENCE, THE PRECISE MECHANISMS UNDERLYING KC REMAIN UNCLEAR, HINDERING THE DEVELOPMENT OF EFFECTIVE TREATMENTS BEYOND CORNEAL CROSS-LINKING AND TRANSPLANTATION. THIS PROJECT AIMS TO DEVELOP AN ADVANCED IN VITRO KC MODEL USING A MICROFABRICATED ORGAN CHIP PLATFORM, ADDRESSING THE LIMITATIONS OF CURRENT ANIMAL MODELS AND PROVIDING A MORE ACCURATE, ETHICALLY SOUND, AND CONTROLLABLE PLATFORM FOR STUDYING KC PATHOGENESIS. OUR APPROACH WILL ESTABLISH AN ANATOMICALLY AND PHYSIOLOGICALLY RELEVANT CORNEA CHIP, PROVIDING EXPERIMENTAL ACCESS TO MECHANISTIC INVESTIGATIONS OF INTERACTIONS BETWEEN CORNEAL EPITHELIAL, STROMAL, AND ENDOTHELIAL CELLS IN THE CONTEXT OF KC.  THE PROJECT CONSISTS OF THREE SPECIFIC AIMS: 1) INVESTIGATE CURVATURE-DEPENDENT CELLULAR RESPONSES IN EPITHELIAL, STROMAL, AND ENDOTHELIAL CELLS USING A CURVATURE ARRAY CHIP, IDENTIFYING MECHANOTRANSDUCTION PATHWAYS DRIVING PATHOLOGICAL REPROGRAMMING AND VALIDATING THERAPEUTIC TARGETS THROUGH GENE KNOCKOUT STUDIES; 2) ENGINEER BIOMIMETIC INTERFACIAL MEMBRANES (EPITHELIAL BASEMENT MEMBRANE AND DESCEMET'S MEMBRANE) USING CO-CULTURE APPROACHES TO INVESTIGATE HOW GEOMETRIC STRESS CONCENTRATIONS DISRUPT MEMBRANE INTEGRITY AND DISTINGUISH ACTIVE PATHWAY-MEDIATED FROM PASSIVE MECHANICAL DAMAGE; AND 3) DEVELOP AN INTEGRATED MULTI-LAYER CORNEA CHIP WITH CONTROLLABLE CURVATURE TO INVESTIGATE MECHANOBIOLOGICAL CROSSTALK, VALIDATE THE PLATFORM COMPREHENSIVELY, AND TEST THERAPEUTIC INTERVENTIONS TARGETING MECHANOTRANSDUCTION AND MATRIX DEGRADATION PATHWAYS AT DIFFERENT DISEASE STAGES. BY COMBINING EXPERTISE IN BIOENGINEERING, OPHTHALMOLOGY, AND CORNEAL BIOLOGY, THIS PROJECT AIMS TO CREATE A PHYSIOLOGICALLY RELEVANT KC MODEL THAT WILL ADVANCE OUR UNDERSTANDING OF THE PERPETUATION CYCLE MECHANISMS, IDENTIFY MECHANOBIOLOGICAL TIPPING POINTS, AND FACILITATE THE DISCOVERY OF THERAPEUTIC TARGETS FOR INTERRUPTING THIS PROGRESSIVE CORNEAL DISORDER.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: MACHINE LEARNING-DRIVEN MULTIFUNCTIONAL PEPTIDE ENGINEERING FOR SUSTAINED INTRAOCULAR PRESSURE LOWERING - PROJECT SUMMARY GLAUCOMA IS THE LEADING CAUSE OF IRREVERSIBLE VISION LOSS WORLDWIDE. INTRAOCULAR PRESSURE (IOP) REDUCTION IS THE ONLY CLINICALLY PROVEN APPROACH TO PREVENT GLAUCOMATOUS VISION LOSS, AND EYE DROPS ARE THE MOST COMMON MODALITY FOR IOP LOWERING. HOWEVER, POOR PATIENT ADHERENCE TO EYE DROP REGIMENS IS A SIGNIFICANT BARRIER TO EFFECTIVE IOP REDUCTION AND PREVENTION OF DISEASE PROGRESSION. AS GLAUCOMA IS A CHRONIC DISEASE THAT TYPICALLY REQUIRES TREATMENT FOR YEARS OR EVEN DECADES, THERE IS CONSIDERABLE INTEREST IN SUSTAINED DRUG DELIVERY PLATFORMS FOR GLAUCOMA TREATMENT. THE MOST COMMON APPROACH FOR DEVELOPING SUSTAINED DELIVERY SYSTEMS IS TO EMPLOY A DEGRADABLE OR NON-DEGRADABLE MATRIX THAT BOTH CONTAINS THE DRUG AND CONTROLS THE RATE AT WHICH DRUG EXITS THE DEVICE. EVEN FOR A BIODEGRADABLE MATRIX, THE RATE OF MATRIX DEGRADATION MAY BE MUCH SLOWER THAN THE DURATION OF DRUG RELEASE, RESULTING IN ACCUMULATION OF EXCIPIENTS AND OCULAR SIDE EFFECTS. OUR APPROACH UTILIZES PEPTIDE ENGINEERING TO IMPART MELANIN BINDING PROPERTIES TO PEPTIDE-DRUG CONJUGATES, AND ALLOWS FOR INJECTION IN LIQUID FORM WITH A SMALL GAUGE NEEDLE WITHOUT THE NEED FOR AN IMPLANT. WE DEVELOPED AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) METHODOLOGY THAT ADAPTS THE SUPER LEARNING (SL) APPROACH TO ENGINEER MULTIFUNCTIONAL PEPTIDES THAT EFFICIENTLY ENTER CELLS, BIND TO MELANIN, AND HAVE LOW CYTOTOXICITY. WE DEMONSTRATE HERE THAT HIGH-THROUGHPUT SCREENING FOR MELANIN BINDING COMBINED WITH THE SL MODEL IDENTIFIED 780 PEPTIDES THAT OUT-PERFORMED PEPTIDES REPORTED IN THE LITERATURE. WHEN A PROMISING 12-MER PEPTIDE WAS CONJUGATED TO BRIMONIDINE (AVAILABLE AS A TOPICAL DROP THAT MUST BE ADMINISTERED 3X/DAY), THE RESULT WAS IOP LOWERING FOR UP TO 18 DAYS WITH A SINGLE INJECTION. HERE, WE WILL USE OUR HIGH-THROUGHPUT SCREENING/SL METHODOLOGY TO FURTHER IMPROVE THE PHYSICOCHEMICAL PROPERTIES OF THE ENGINEERED PEPTIDES TO PRODUCE PEPTIDE-DRUG CONJUGATES THAT LAST UP TO A FEW MONTHS WITH A SINGLE INJECTION. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT INCREASING THE PEPTIDE LENGTH TO 18- AND 24-MERS WILL ALLOW FOR INCREASED MELANIN BINDING CAPACITY AND PEPTIDE-DRUG CONJUGATE SOLUBILITY, FURTHER INCREASING THE INTRAOCULAR LOADING AND DURATION OF THERAPEUTIC EFFECT COMPARED TO THE 12-MER. WE ANTICIPATE THAT SUSTAINED IOP LOWERING WILL BE ACHIEVED WITH IMPROVED OCULAR SAFETY. AIM 1 WILL INCLUDE DEVELOPING A GENERATIVE MACHINE LEARNING MODEL THAT WILL BE USED TO EXPAND THE PEPTIDE LIBRARY TO 18- AND 24-MERS WITH FURTHER IMPROVED PROPERTIES. WE WILL IDENTIFY AT LEAST 3 NEW PEPTIDE-DRUG CONJUGATES USING A VARIETY OF IN VITRO AND COMPUTATION METHODS TO THEN TEST IN AIM 2 FOR PHARMACOKINETICS AND PHARMACODYNAMICS IN RABBITS. TWO OF THESE PEPTIDE- DRUG CONJUGATES WILL THEN BE TESTED HEAD-TO-HEAD WITH THE 12-MER PEPTIDE-DRUG CONJUGATE IN AIM 3 FOR PHARMACODYNAMICS AND SAFETY WITH REPEATED INJECTION FOR A TOTAL OF 1 YEAR.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: ENABLING TECHNOLOGIES FOR PRE-CLINICAL AND TRANSLATIONAL RESEARCH USING 3-DIMENSIONAL ADULT RETINA TISSUE CULTURE - ABSTRACT: 3-DIMENSIONAL (3D) CULTURES OF ANIMAL- OR HUMAN-DERIVED ADULT RETINAL TISSUES OFFER PHYSIOLOGICAL COMPLEXITY AND MATURITY IN AN EXPERIMENTALLY APPROACHABLE FORMAT, WHICH IS ESSENTIAL FOR DISEASE MODELING, DRUG TESTING, AND REGENERATIVE MEDICINE. HOWEVER, THEIR WIDESPREAD ADOPTION HAS BEEN HINDERED BY THE CHALLENGES IN MAINTAINING ADULT TISSUES IN CULTURE BECAUSE OF CELL LOSS, TISSUE REMODELING, AND ULTIMATELY, DETERIORATION. BARRIERS OF CURRENT- GENERATION 3D RETINA CULTURES INCLUDE 1) UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS DUE TO METABOLITE FLUCTUATIONS AND WASTE ACCUMULATION, 2) SLOW AND CUMBERSOME ITERATION OF TEST CONDITIONS, 3) A HEAVY RELIANCE ON ENDPOINT ANALYSIS (CROSS-SECTIONAL DATA), WHICH REQUIRES LARGE NUMBERS OF SAMPLES THAT LACK CONNECTIVITY ACROSS TIMEPOINTS, 4) CHALLENGES IN MONITORING CELL AND TISSUE VIABILITY IN THE ABSENCE OF LABELS, AND (5) THE CHALLENGE OF TRACKING LIVE CELLS IN THE ABSENCE OF GENETICALLY-ENCODED FLUORESCENT PROTEIN REPORTERS. IN THIS TECHNOLOGY FOCUSED PROJECT, WE WILL DEVELOP, IN AIM 1, A CUSTOM SCALABLE MICROFLUIDIC PLATFORM THAT WILL BE INTEGRATED INTO THE AIR-LIQUID INTERFACE CULTURE FORMAT FOR RETINAL TISSUE THAT WILL STABILIZE CULTURE CONDITIONS OVER EXISTING METHODOLOGY. THIS PLATFORM WILL FEATURE PROGRAMMABLE CONTROL OF FACTOR DELIVERY AND WITHDRAWAL, ENABLE MULTIPLEXING OF TEST CONDITIONS, AND WILL BE COMPATIBLE WITH IMAGING MODALITIES. IN AIM 2, WE WILL DEVELOP DYNAMIC CONTRAST-OPTICAL COHERENCE MICROSCOPY FOR CELLULAR-RESOLUTION LABEL-FREE IMAGING OF CULTURED RETINA. THIS WILL ENABLE LONGITUDINAL IMAGE CAPTURE TO ASSESS CELL AND TISSUE VIABILITY AND TRACK CHANGES IN CELL MORPHOLOGY WITHOUT THE NEED FOR LABELS SUCH AS FLUORESCENT REPORTERS. IN AIM 3, WE WILL DEVELOP GENE-SPECIFIC FLUORESCENT BIOSENSORS FOR CELL TRACKING BASED ON ADAR RNA EDITING. THIS APPROACH WILL NOT REQUIRE CELL-SPECIFIC PROMOTERS AND WILL ENABLE LONGITUDINAL FLUORESCENCE-BASED IMAGING IN THE ABSENCE OF GENETICALLY ENCODED REPORTERS. EACH OF THESE TECHNOLOGIES WILL BE DEVELOPED AND BENCHMARKED USING EXPERIMENTALLY AMENABLE MOUSE MODELS. IN AIM 4, THE TECHNOLOGIES WILL BE TRANSLATED TO ADULT HUMAN RETINA CULTURE. THESE TECHNOLOGIES, WHEN INTEGRATED, WILL UNIQUELY OVERCOME BOTTLENECKS IN THE EFFICIENCY AND VARIABILITY OF PRE-CLINICAL AND TRANSLATIONAL RESEARCH USING 3D CULTURES OF ADULT RETINAL TISSUES AND PROVIDES, FOR THE FIRST TIME, ACCESS TO QUANTITATIVE LONGITUDINAL DATA ON CELL/TISSUE STRUCTURE, STATE, AND FUNCTIONAL CHANGES, TO ALLOW FOR MORE ROBUST AND REPRODUCIBLE APPLICATIONS OF 3D RETINA CULTURE OF MURINE OR HUMAN ORIGIN.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: NOVEL ULTRAHIGH RESOLUTION OCT BIOMARKERS IN AGE-RELATED MACULAR DEGENERATION - AGE-RELATED MACULAR DEGENERATION (AMD) CURRENTLY AFFECTS ~20 MILLION ELDERLY PEOPLE IN THE US ALONE, WITH THE NUMBER PROJECTED TO RISE RAPIDLY DUE TO THE AGING POPULATION. LATE DISEASE VISION LOSS OFTEN RESULTS FROM PHOTORECEPTOR CELL DEATH; AND TREATMENT OPTIONS REMAIN LIMITED. DETECTING AND UNDERSTANDING IMPAIRMENTS AT EARLIER STAGES CAN GREATLY BENEFIT CLINICAL MANAGEMENT AND FACILITATE THERAPEUTIC DISCOVERY, WHEN THE DAMAGE MAY BE REVERSIBLE. THIS PROGRAM WILL DEVELOP AND APPLY NOVEL OPTICAL COHERENCE TOMOGRAPHY (OCT) METHODS FOR DETECTING AND MONITORING OF AMD ASSOCIATED PHOTORECEPTOR CHANGES. AIM 1 WILL INVESTIGATE CONE PHOTORECEPTOR FUNCTION IMPAIRMENTS IN AMD. CONES ARE ESSENTIAL FOR FINE CENTRAL VISION, THE UNDERSTANDING AND PRESERVATION OF WHICH HAVE MEANINGFUL QUALITY OF LIFE IMPACTS. WE WILL ADVANCE OCT SPLIT-SPECTRUM AMPLITUDE-DECORRELATION OPTORETINOGRAPHY (SSADOR) AND VALIDATE OBJECTIVE, QUANTITATIVE SSADOR METRICS AS SURROGATE MARKERS OF CONE VISUAL FUNCTION. THE CLINICAL STUDIES HAVE BOTH CROSS-SECTIONAL AND LONGITUDINAL COMPONENTS, WHICH WILL ENROLL TWO INDEPENDENT COHORTS OF EARLY AND INTERMEDIATE AMD PATIENTS AND AGE MATCHED NORMAL CONTROLS. WE WILL TEST THE HYPOTHESIS THAT A REDUCTION IN CONE LIGHT RESPONSES DIFFERENTIATES BETWEEN NORMAL AGING VERSUS AMD EYES AND AMONG DISEASE SEVERITY CATEGORIES. ADDITIONALLY, WE WILL TEST THE HYPOTHESIS THAT WORSE RESPONSES CONFER A HIGHER PROGRESSION RISK. THE STUDY WILL ALSO INVESTIGATE THE SPATIOTEMPORAL CORRELATION BETWEEN CONE IMPAIRMENT AND AMD LESIONS INCLUDING DRUSEN, SUBRETINAL DRUSENOID DEPOSITS (SDD), PIGMENTARY ABNORMALITIES, ETC. AIM 2 WILL INVESTIGATE ROD FUNCTION IMPAIRMENTS IN AMD. RODS MEDIATE LOW LIGHT VISION; AND ONE OF THE EARLIEST SYMPTOMS OF AMD IS IMPAIRED TRANSITION FROM BRIGHT TO DIMLY LIT ENVIRONMENTS. SSADOR TESTS CAN BE ADAPTED TO ROD PHYSIOLOGY TO ISOLATE THEIR RESPONSES. WE WILL MONITOR ROD RESPONSE RECOVERY AFTER AN INTENSE BLEACHING FLASH, A PROCESS KNOWN AS DARK ADAPTATION. USING THE SAME AMD AND CONTROL COHORTS, THE PLANNED STUDIES WILL TEST IF ROD SPECIFIC SSADOR METHODS CAN MEASURE A DELAY IN DARK ADAPTATION THAT SIGNIFIES AMD PATHOLOGY AND CORRESPONDS TO DISEASE SEVERITY. ADDITIONALLY, WE WILL TEST THE HYPOTHESIS THAT PROFOUND DELAYS INDICATE INCREASED RISK OF DISEASE PROGRESSION. AIM 3 WILL EMPLOY ULTRAHIGH RESOLUTION DIRECTIONAL OCT FOR ASSESSING OUTER RETINAL MORPHOLOGICAL ALTERATIONS. DIRECTIONAL OCT INTERROGATES THE DEPENDENCE OF RETINAL LAYER APPEARANCE (E.G., INTENSITY) ON THE IMAGING LIGHT ANGLE. WHEN COMBINED WITH ULTRAHIGH IMAGING RESOLUTION, IT PROMISES TO OFFER INSIGHTS INTO THE BANDS’ ANATOMICAL ORIGINS, AS WELL AS ENABLE EARLY DETECTION AND MONITOR SUBTLE CHANGES OVER A SHORT PERIOD OF TIME. IN A SERIES OF PILOT CLINICAL STUDIES, WE WILL INVESTIGATE IF “MISDIRECTED” PHOTORECEPTORS, E.G., A CHANGE OR LOSS IN THE ELLIPSOID ZONE (EZ) DIRECTIONAL REFLECTIVITY, INDICATE AMD DAMAGE AND PRECEDES ONSET OF ATROPHY. FINALLY, WE WILL COMBINE CONE AND ROD FUNCTIONAL METRICS TOGETHER WITH OCT MORPHOLOGICAL MARKERS TO DEVELOP A COMPUTATIONAL MODEL FOR PREDICTING RETINA HEALTH, WITH THE LONG TERM GOAL OF IMPROVING DISEASE DIAGNOSIS, FURTHERING OUR UNDERSTANDING OF AMD PATHOGENESIS, AND HELPING AMD PATIENTS ACHIEVE BETTER VISUAL OUTCOMES.

description: MECHANISMS OF HIGHER-ORDER THALAMIC CONTROL OVER VISUAL CORTICAL PROCESSING - PROJECT SUMMARY CEREBRAL CORTICAL NETWORKS SEAMLESSLY INTEGRATE DIVERSE SOURCES OF SENSORY AND CONTEXTUAL INFORMATION TO COORDINATE APPROPRIATE BEHAVIORS. THIS PROCESS REQUIRES PRECISE ROUTING OF INFORMATION BETWEEN DISTINCT, FUNCTIONALLY DEFINED CORTICAL AREAS. DYSFUNCTIONAL ROUTING OF THESE SIGNALS UNDERLIES A RANGE NEUROLOGICAL AND PSYCHIATRIC DISORDERS, FROM SPATIAL NEGLECT FOLLOWING TRAUMA TO SENSORY PROCESSING AND ATTENTION DEFICITS IN AUTISM AND SCHIZOPHRENIA. THUS, IT IS ESSENTIAL TO UNDERSTAND THE SYNAPTIC MECHANISMS UNDERLYING THE FLOW OF INFORMATION ACROSS SPATIALLY EXTENDED CORTICAL NETWORKS AND ITS DYNAMIC ALTERATION DURING DIFFERENT BEHAVIORAL STATES. DIRECT, MONOSYNAPTIC CORTICOCORTICAL (CC) CONNECTIONS HAVE TRADITIONALLY BEEN CONSIDERED THE PRIMARY MODE OF CORTICAL COMMUNICATION. YET, CORTICAL REGIONS CAN ALSO INTERACT THROUGH HIGHER-ORDER (HO) REGIONS OF THE THALAMUS. THESE TRANSTHALAMIC CONNECTIONS CONSIST OF A SOURCE CORTICAL AREA PROVIDING CORTICOTHALAMIC (CT) INPUT TO THE HO THALAMUS FOLLOWED BY CONSTITUENT THALAMIC NEURONS SENDING PROCESSED VERSIONS OF THIS INPUT TO OTHER CORTICAL TARGETS IN THE FORM OF THALAMOCORTICAL (TC) OUTPUTS. THUS, HO THALAMUS IS LIKELY VITAL TO THE DYNAMIC COORDINATION OF CORTICAL AREAS. YET, THE SYNAPTIC MECHANISMS UNDERLYING THIS COORDINATION REMAIN POORLY UNDERSTOOD. A SIGNIFICANT IMPEDIMENT TO UNDERSTANDING THE FUNCTIONAL ORGANIZATION OF HO THALAMIC CIRCUITS IS THE SHEER COMPLEXITY OF SYNAPTIC SIGNAL FLOW WITHIN THESE CIRCUITS: DISTINCT TRANSTHALAMIC PATHWAYS LINKING DIFFERENT CORTICAL REGIONS IN BOTH FEEDFORWARD AND FEEDBACK DIRECTIONS ARE PHYSICALLY INTERMINGLED, COMPLICATING PATHWAY- SPECIFIC INTERROGATION. FURTHER COMPLEXITY ARISES FROM THE STRONG DEPENDENCE OF BOTH THALAMIC NEURON SPIKING ACTIVITY AND CT SYNAPTIC EFFICACY ON BEHAVIORAL AND BRAIN STATE (E.G. AROUSAL). HOW THESE DYNAMIC STATE VARIABLES INFLUENCE TRANSTHALAMIC SIGNALING IS UNKNOWN. ADDITIONALLY, WHILE PERCEPTUALLY GUIDED BEHAVIOR OFTEN REQUIRES SPECIFIC PATTERNS OF LONG-RANGE INTERACTIONS ACROSS THE CORTEX, THE ROLES OF TRANSTHALAMIC PATHWAYS IN THESE INTERACTIONS HAVE NOT BEEN DETERMINED. IN THIS PROJECT, WE WILL BRING STATE-OF-THE-ART GENETIC AND OPTICAL TOOLS TO BEAR ON THESE ESSENTIAL ISSUES REGARDING THE FUNCTIONAL INTEGRATION OF THE HO THALAMUS WITH CORTICAL NETWORKS. WE USE THE MOUSE VISUAL SYSTEM AS A MODEL, WELL-SUITED DUE TO ITS PREVIOUSLY CHARACTERIZED HIERARCHICAL ORGANIZATION. THIS PROJECT HAS 3 AIMS. (1) BY COMBINING OPTOGENETIC TOOLS WITH HIGHLY SELECTIVE METHODS FOR SYNAPTIC PATHWAY LABELING IN EX VIVO BRAIN SLICES, WE WILL UNCOVER THE FUNDAMENTAL PROPERTIES OF DISTINCT HO TC SYNAPSES WITHIN THE CORTEX, AS WELL AS THEIR INTEGRATION WITH CC PATHWAYS. (2) WE WILL USE A RANGE OF EX VIVO AND AWAKE IN VIVO RECORDING METHODS TO UNDERSTAND BOTH THE CELLULAR BASIS FOR STATE-DEPENDENT SPIKING DYNAMICS IN HO THALAMIC NEURONS AS WELL AS THE STATE-DEPENDENT SHIFTS IN CT SYNAPTIC EFFICACY IN THE HO THALAMUS. (3) USING MULTISPECTRAL FLUORESCENCE RECORDING TECHNIQUES IN MICE PERFORMING SENSORY DETECTION TASKS, WE WILL DETERMINE HOW BOTH CC AND TRANSTHALAMIC PATHWAYS ARE INTEGRATED TO DRIVE OPTIMAL BEHAVIORAL PERFORMANCE. THIS PROJECT WILL YIELD MUCH-NEEDED INSIGHT INTO THE FUNDAMENTAL MECHANISMS UNDERLYING CORTEX-WIDE SYNAPTIC SIGNALING.

description: MOLECULAR MECHANISMS OF OUTER SEGMENT RENEWAL. - PROJECT SUMMARY MOLECULAR MECHANISMS OF OUTER SEGMENT RENEWAL THIS PROPOSAL UNCOVERS FUNDAMENTAL MOLECULAR MECHANISMS UNDERPINNING THE CONSTANT RENEWAL OF PHOTORECEPTOR OUTER SEGMENTS – A NEVER-ENDING PROCESS THAT IS CRUCIAL FOR OUR VISION. DEFECTS IN OUTER SEGMENT RENEWAL UNDERLIE MANY INHERITED RETINAL DEGENERATIVE DISEASES THAT LEAD TO COMPLETE BLINDNESS IN HUMANS. ELUCIDATING HOW OUTER SEGMENTS ARE RENEWED AT THE MOLECULAR LEVEL IS THE KEY TO DEVELOPING NOVEL THERAPIES. HERE, WE INVESTIGATE UNANSWERED QUESTIONS ABOUT HOW THE OUTER SEGMENT’S LIGHT SENSITIVE MEMBRANE MATERIAL IS SHAPED INTO FLATTENED MEMBRANE DISCS, HOW THESE DISCS ARE STRUCTURALLY STABILIZED AND HOW THEIR MOLECULAR COMPOSITION IS CONTROLLED. EVERY DAY, DOZENS OF NEW DISC MEMBRANES ARE BUILT AT THE BASE OF EACH OUTER SEGMENT AND AN EQUAL NUMBER OF OLD DISCS ARE DISCARDED FROM THE TIP. THE TREMENDOUS NEVER-ENDING FLUX OF DISC PROTEINS AND LIPIDS INTO THE OUTER SEGMENT INITIALLY MUST PASS THROUGH THE NARROW CONNECTING CILIUM THAT PHYSICALLY LINKS THE NEWLY FORMING DISCS AND PHOTORECEPTOR CELL BODY. THE CONNECTING CILIUM ALSO ACTS AS A CILIARY GATE REGULATING PROTEIN ENTRY INTO THE DISCS. ONCE PROTEIN AND MEMBRANE MATERIAL PASS THROUGH THE CONNECTING CILIUM, THE CILIARY PLASMA MEMBRANE EVAGINATES INTO LARGE MEMBRANE PROTRUSIONS THAT SUBSEQUENTLY FLATTEN INTO NEWLY FORMING DISC LAMELLAE. IN THIS PROPOSAL, WE ELUCIDATE MOLECULAR MECHANISMS THAT DRIVE THE FLATTENING OF THE NEWLY FORMING DISCS, THEIR STABILIZATION AND HOW THEIR CONTENT IS REGULATED. WE FOCUS ON TWO OUTER SEGMENT PROTEINS CRITICAL FOR THESE PROCESSES, PRCD AND KIAA1549, BOTH OF WHICH ARE LINKED TO RETINITIS PIGMENTOSA IN HUMANS. IN AIM 1, WE INVESTIGATE THE ROLE OF THE DISC-SPECIFIC PROTEIN PRCD. OUR PRELIMINARY DATA SHOW THAT IN THE ABSENCE OF PRCD, THE NEWLY FORMING DISCS DELAMINATE AND BLEB AS EXTRACELLULAR VESICLES, WHICH ACCUMULATE IN THE INTERPHOTORECEPTOR SPACE. WE WILL ADDRESS THE MOLECULAR MECHANISM BY WHICH PRCD SUPPORTS THE STRUCTURE OF NEWLY FORMING DISCS AS THEY PROTRUDE FROM THE CILIUM. IN AIM 2, WE FOCUS ON KIAA1549 AND ITS ROLE IN DISC FORMATION. OUR PRELIMINARY DATA INCLUDE A NEWLY GENERATED KIAA1549-/- MOUSE AND SUGGEST THIS PROTEIN MAY PARTICIPATE IN REGULATING PROTEIN FLUX INTO THE DISC MEMBRANES AND/OR IN THE STRUCTURAL CONNECTION THAT SUPPORTS THE CILIARY POCKET. OUR PROPOSED EXPERIMENTS LEVERAGE INNOVATIVE BIOCHEMICAL, PROTEOMICS AND ADVANCED ELECTRON MICROSCOPY TECHNIQUES TO ELUCIDATE THESE BASIC MOLECULAR MECHANISMS. BY DISCOVERING HOW DISCS ARE BUILT AND STABILIZED WE WILL ANSWER LONG-STANDING QUESTIONS ABOUT HOW OUR VISION WORKS AT THE MOLECULAR LEVEL AND PROVIDE NEW MOLECULAR ENTRY POINTS FOR TREATING RETINAL DISEASE.

description: EXPORT AND INTEGRATION OF OPHTHALMIC OPTICAL COHERENCE TOMOGRAPHY DATA ACROSS INSTITUTIONS (OCT) - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT OPTICAL COHERENCE TOMOGRAPHY (OCT), A THREE-DIMENSIONAL HIGH-RESOLUTION IN-VIVO IMAGING TECHNOLOGY, HAS BE- COME THE GOLD STANDARD OF OPHTHALMIC DIAGNOSTICS, INDISPENSABLE FOR DETECTING AND MONITORING THE LEADING CAUSES OF BLINDNESS WORLDWIDE. AT MASS. EYE AND EAR (MEE) ALONE, OVER 1,500 OCT SCANS ARE PERFORMED EVERY DAY, ADDING TO MILLIONS OF EXISTING SCANS THAT REPRESENT AN UNTAPPED TREASURE FOR “BIG DATA” MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH. YET THIS POTENTIAL REMAINS LOCKED: MANUFACTURERS STORE OCT DATA IN OVER TEN PROPRIETARY, UNDOCUMENTED FORMATS, AND EVEN WHEN OFFICIAL EXPORT TOOLS EXIST, THEY ARE PROHIBITIVELY SLOW. FOR EXAMPLE, EXPORTING MEE'S FULL HEIDELBERG SPECTRALIS DATASET WOULD TAKE AN ESTIMATED 11 YEARS. AS A RESULT, OCT IMAGING DATA IS EFFECTIVELY INACCESSIBLE FOR LARGE-SCALE RESEARCH AND AI APPLICATIONS. THIS PROJECT WILL CHANGE THAT. WE WILL DELIVER A COMPREHENSIVE, OPEN-SOURCE SOLUTION THAT UNLOCKS OCT DATA FOR THE ENTIRE RESEARCH COMMUNITY. OUR TEAM BRINGS TOGETHER WORLD-CLASS EXPERTISE IN OPHTHALMOLOGY, MACHINE LEARNING, AND SYSTEM-LEVEL PROGRAMMING, INCLUDING LEADERS OF THE IRIS AND SOURCE REGISTRIES THAT TOGETHER COVER OVER 70 MILLION PATIENTS BUT CURRENTLY LACK OCT IMAGING DUE TO THESE BARRIERS. AIM 1 WILL ESTABLISH A UNIFIED, OPEN OCT DATA FORMAT WITH DUAL IMPLEMENTATIONS: A DICOM VERSION FOR SEAMLESS INTEGRATION INTO CLINICAL IT SYSTEMS, AND AN HDF5 VERSION ENGINEERED FOR MACHINE LEARNING SPEED AND EFFICIENCY. HIGH-PERFORMANCE RUST-BASED CONVERTERS WILL TRANSLATE ALL MAJOR VENDOR FORMATS INTO THIS STANDARD. AIM 2 WILL DELIVER TURNKEY REPOSITORY SOFTWARE THAT AUTOMATES DATA EXTRACTION FROM PICTURE ARCHIVING AND COMMUNICATION SYSTEMS (PACS) OR DEVICES, SUPPORTS FLEXIBLE DE-IDENTIFICATION, AND PROVIDES RESEARCHER-FRIENDLY PROGRAMMING INTERFACES IN C, PYTHON, AND R. AIM 3 WILL DEPLOY THIS INFRASTRUCTURE ACROSS 17 U.S. INSTITUTIONS WITHIN THE PROJECT TEAM AND THE SOURCE CONSORTIUM AS THE INITIAL LAUNCH SITES, CREATING THE FIRST-EVER DISTRIBUTED, FEDERATED OCT IMAGING REPOSITORY WITH AUTOMATED UPDATES AND SEAMLESS CROSS-SITE INTEGRATION. THE REPOSITORY SOFTWARE IS DESIGNED FOR BROAD, NATIONWIDE ADOPTION: ANY OPHTHALMIC CENTER WITH A SUPPORTED PICTURE ARCHIVING AND COMMUNICATION SYSTEM (PACS) WILL BE ABLE TO IMPLEMENT ITS OWN LOCAL REPOSITORY WITHOUT SPECIALIZED EXPERTISE. THIS MEANS THAT IN THE LONG RUN, VIRTUALLY EVERY OCT SCAN PERFORMED IN THE U.S. CAN BE- COME SEARCHABLE, SHAREABLE, AND AI-READY. ONCE ACCOMPLISHED, THIS PROJECT WILL TRANSFORM OPHTHALMIC RESEARCH BY TURNING FRAGMENTED, INACCESSIBLE IMAGING INTO A UNIFIED NATIONAL RESOURCE. IT WILL ENABLE UNPRECEDENTED LARGE-SCALE MACHINE LEARNING STUDIES, ACCELERATE DISCOVERY AND REPRODUCIBILITY, AND DIRECTLY FUEL INNOVATION IN THE DIAGNOSIS AND TREATMENT OF BLINDING EYE DISEASES.
