description: ELUCIDATING GUT MICROBIOTA-DRIVEN TUFT-2 CELL EXPANSION AS A RISK FACTOR FOR NEOPLASTIC ADENOMA DEVELOPMENT IN EARLY-ONSET CRC AMONG BLACK US RESIDENTS - YOUNG (< 50 YEARS) INDIVIDUALS WITH AFRICAN ANCESTRY HAVE A HIGHER RATE OF EARLY-ONSET COLORECTAL CANCER (EOCRC) THAN OLDER INDIVIDUALS OF AFRICAN ANCESTRY AND WHITE PATIENTS IN THE US. THIS IS BECAUSE THEY ARE AT A GREATER RISK OF METACHRONOUS ADENOMA FORMATION, WHICH DEVELOPS IN THE SAME LOCATION AFTER SURGICAL REMOVAL OF INITIAL POLYPS. DESPITE ADVANCES IN CRC SCREENING, THERE ARE STILL NO CLINICAL BIOMARKERS TO PREDICT THE FORMATION OF AGGRESSIVE METACHRONOUS ADENOMAS IN THE COLON. OUR LONG-TERM GOAL IS TO ACCELERATE THE DEVELOPMENT OF MICROBIOTA-DRIVEN TUFT-2 CELL EXPANSION AS A CLINICAL AND CELLULAR BIOMARKER FOR PREDICTING AGGRESSIVE ADENOMA FORMATION IN EOCRC. THE OVERALL OBJECTIVES OF THIS PROPOSAL ARE TO DETERMINE THE MECHANISMS BY WHICH GUT MICROBIOTA-DRIVEN TUFT-2 CELL EXPANSION AFFECTS ADENOMA FORMATION IN EOCRC PATIENTS AND TO EXAMINE HOW THIS IMPACT VARIES ACROSS GENETIC ANCESTRIES. THE CENTRAL HYPOTHESIS IS THAT GUT MICROBIOTA-DRIVEN TUFT-2 CELL EXPANSION EXACERBATES ADENOMA DEVELOPMENT IN EOCRC PATIENTS WITH AFRICAN ANCESTRY COMPARED TO WHITE EOCRC PATIENTS. THE RATIONALE FOR THIS PROJECT IS THAT A DETERMINATION OF MOLECULAR MECHANISMS BY WHICH GUT MICROBIOTA-DRIVEN TUFT-2 CELL EXPANSION ACCELERATES ADENOMA DEVELOPMENT IN EOCRC PATIENTS WITH AFRICAN ANCESTRY IS LIKELY TO OFFER A STRONG SCIENTIFIC FRAMEWORK WHEREBY NEW STRATEGIES TO REDUCE GENETIC ANCESTRY-BASED DIFFERENTIAL CLINICAL BURDEN CAN BE DEVELOPED. THE CENTRAL HYPOTHESIS WILL BE TESTED BY PURSUING TWO SPECIFIC AIMS: 1) TO TEST THE HYPOTHESIS THAT GUT MICROBIOTA FROM EOCRC PATIENTS CAUSES DISTINCT TUFT-2 CELL EXPANSION TRAJECTORIES; AND 2) TO TEST THE HYPOTHESIS THAT GUT MICROBIOTA-DRIVEN TUFT-2 CELL EXPANSION EXACERBATES ADENOMA FORMATION IN EOCRC PATIENTS. GNOTOBIOTIC AND APC/MIN+ MOUSE MODELS ARE NECESSARY TO RIGOROUSLY ESTABLISH CAUSALITY AND ACCOUNT FOR NATIVE STROMAL AND IMMUNE INTERACTIONS IN A PHYSIOLOGICALLY INTACT SYSTEM THAT CANNOT BE CAPTURED BY IN VITRO MODELS ALONE. UNDER THE FIRST AIM, FECAL MICROBIOTA FROM EOCRC PATIENTS WILL BE TRANSPLANTED INTO THE COLON OF THESE MOUSE MODELS TO ANALYZE THE IMPACT OF GUT MICROBIOTA ON INTER AND INTRACELLULAR COMMUNICATION USING SINGLE-CELL OMICS. FOR THE SECOND AIM, COLONIC ORGANOIDS WILL BE CULTURED WITH THE SUPERNATANT OF MICROBIOTA-ACTIVATED TUFT- 2 CELLS. THE RESEARCH PROPOSED IN THIS APPLICATION IS INNOVATIVE AS IT FOCUSES ON THE MICROBIOTA-DRIVEN EXPANSION OF TUFT-2 CELLS ASSOCIATED WITH AN INCREASE IN ADENOMA PRECURSOR CELLS. THE PROPOSED RESEARCH IS SIGNIFICANT BECAUSE IT IS EXPECTED TO PROVIDE STRONG SCIENTIFIC JUSTIFICATION FOR FUTURE TRANSLATIONAL STUDIES FOCUSED ON THE NORMAL-ADENOMA-CARCINOMA SEQUENCE IN CRC. ULTIMATELY, SUCH KNOWLEDGE HAS THE POTENTIAL TO OFFER NEW OPPORTUNITIES TO DEVELOP INNOVATIVE THERAPIES TO REDUCE THE GENETIC ANCESTRY-ASSOCIATED DIFFERENTIAL CLINICAL BURDEN IN EOCRC.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: INNOVATIVE FLAME-RETARDANT ANTIMICROBIAL TEXTILES FOR HEALTHCARE AND PROTECTIVE APPLICATIONS - PROJECT ABSTRACT THIS PROPOSAL AIMS TO CREATE A TEXTILE FINISH THAT BOTH EXCELS AS AN ANTIMICROBIAL AND A FLAME RETARDANT WITH EXCELLENT DURABILITY. THE FLAME-RESISTANT ANTIMICROBIAL FINISH HAS A CRITICAL ROLE IN THE SAFETY AND PROTECTION OF MEDICAL FACILITIES, MILITARY FIELD HOSPITALS, CHILDREN’S CLOTHING, NURSING HOMES, AND MORE. MANY FLAME-RETARDANT TEXTILE FINISHES HAVE BEEN SCRUTINIZED BY THE EPA FOR POTENTIAL HEALTH EFFECTS AND ENVIRONMENTAL TOXICITY. OUR PREVIOUS RESEARCH TAUGHT US THAT OUR PATENTED ANTIMICROBIAL FINISH EFFECTIVELY KILLS HARMFUL BACTERIA AND AIR-BORNE FUNGUS ON TREATED TEXTILES. ADDITIONAL RESEARCH VALIDATED THAT OUR ANTIMICROBIAL PREVENTS THE DEVELOPMENT OF MICROBIAL RESISTANCE SO THAT BACTERIAL AND FUNGAL PATHOGENS ARE UNLIKELY TO DEVELOP RESISTANCE TO BEING ELIMINATED BY THE MATERIAL, A VITALLY IMPORTANT PROPERTY TO COMBAT ANTIMICROBIAL RESISTANCE. DURING THE NIH-SPONSORED I-CORPS PROJECT LAST YEAR, WE LEARNED THAT MANY ANTIMICROBIAL APPLICATIONS MAY ALSO REQUIRE A FLAME-RESISTANT FINISH. THIS, ALONG WITH THE ENVIRONMENTAL AND HEALTH RISKS OF MANY CURRENT FR TREATMENTS, HAS PROMPTED CHITOZAN HEALTH AND ITS RESEARCH PARTNERS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF GEORGIA TO DEVELOP A MATERIAL OFFERING BOTH SAFETY FEATURES. THE RESEARCH WILL LEVERAGE THE TWO CORE COMPOUNDS IN OUR CURRENT SILVER SHELL ANTIMICROBIAL TREATMENT, CHITOSAN, AND 0.25- MICRON SILVER CHLORIDE PARTICLES. WE WILL WORK TOWARD PHOSPHORYLATING THE CHITOSAN HYDROXYL GROUPS AND INTEGRATING PHOSPHATE IONS INTO THE SILVER CHLORIDE CRYSTAL LATTICE. THIS WILL REQUIRE DEVELOPING A NOVEL PRECIPITATION CHEMISTRY AND PROCESS. ONCE DEVELOPED, COATED MATERIALS WILL BE EVALUATED FOR ANTIMICROBIAL EFFICACY, DURABILITY, AND FLAME RESISTANCE. WE WILL TEST AGAINST REGULATOR STANDARDS TO ENSURE WE’VE DEVELOPED A SAFE AND ROBUST PRODUCT. FINALLY, WE WILL SCALE UP TO A PILOT COATING MACHINE AND ASSESS MANUFACTURING READINESS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DRUG REPURPOSING FOR THE TREATMENT OF STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS BACTEREMIA - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT CMTX BIOTECH IS A DRUG DEVELOPMENT COMPANY WORKING TO COMMERCIALIZE A PIPELINE OF PROPRIETARY, SMALL MOLECULE DRUG CANDIDATES, COMPOSITIONS, AND FORMULATIONS FOR THE HOST-MODULATORY TREATMENT OF DISEASES WITH HIGH UNMET NEEDS, INCLUDING ORPHAN INDICATIONS AND CONDITIONS FOR WHICH THERE ARE LIMITED TREATMENT OPTIONS. THE GOAL OF THIS PHASE I STTR IS TO DEVELOP A NOVEL LIPOSOMAL FORMULATION OF REBAMIPIDE AS AN ADJUNCTIVE HOST-DIRECTED TREATMENT OF STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS BACTEREMIA (SAB). AN ESTIMATED 119,247 S. AUREUS BLOODSTREAM INFECTIONS OCCURRED IN THE UNITED STATES IN 2017, WITH 19,832 ASSOCIATED DEATHS (CDC). S. AUREUS BACTEREMIA (SAB) IS A LIFE- THREATENING BLOODSTREAM INFECTION THAT CAUSES DIFFICULT-TO-TREAT BACTERIAL DISEASES REQUIRING PROLONGED ANTIMICROBIAL TREATMENT. AROUND 20% OF PATIENTS WITH SAB DIE WITHIN 30 DAYS. MAJOR COMPLICATIONS INCLUDE THE DEVELOPMENT OF METASTATIC FOCI OF INFECTION (UP TO 37%), RECURRENCE OF BACTEREMIA DESPITE APPROPRIATE TREATMENT (UP TO 10%), AND DEATH (15%–30% IN-HOSPITAL). GLOBALLY, S. AUREUS ACCOUNTS FOR THE MOST OVERALL DEATHS DUE TO A BACTERIAL PATHOGEN AND THE MOST DEATHS ASSOCIATED WITH BACTEREMIA. CURRENT TREATMENT OPTIONS FOR SAB INCLUDE ONLY THREE DRUG CLASSES (Β-LACTAMS, GLYCOPEPTIDES, AND LIPOPEPTIDES), WITH ONLY TWO COVERING MULTI-DRUG RESISTANT S. AUREUS (MRSA) BACTEREMIA. PREVALENCE OF MRSA AMONGST S. AUREUS CLINICAL ISOLATES IS UPWARDS OF 50% IN THE U.S. DESPITE THE AVAILABILITY OF SEVERAL NEW ANTIBIOTICS, THE MORBIDITY AND MORTALITY ASSOCIATED WITH SAB REMAINS HIGH (20%-30%). PERSISTENT BACTEREMIA AND TREATMENT FAILURE ARE COMMON, ESPECIALLY IN COMPLICATED CASES INVOLVING ENDOCARDITIS, ABSCESSES, OR PROSTHETIC DEVICES. THERE IS AN URGENT NEED FOR NOVEL TREATMENTS FOR SAB, INCLUDING THOSE THAT ENHANCE THE HOST RESPONSE TO INFECTION BY THIS PATHOGEN. THE PRODUCT OF THIS STTR IS A NOVEL, LIPOSOMAL FORMULATION OF REBAMIPIDE AS A HOST-DIRECTED ADJUNCTIVE THERAPY FOR THE TREATMENT OF S. AUREUS BACTEREMIA (SAB) THAT COMPLEMENTS EXISTING ANTIBIOTICS TO IMPROVE CLINICAL OUTCOMES. THE SPECIFIC AIMS OF THIS STTR ARE (A) TO DETERMINE THE OPTIMAL DOSE OF A NOVEL LIPOSOMAL FORMULATION OF REBAMIPIDE TO IMPROVE SURVIVAL IN A MOUSE MODEL OF S. AUREUS BACTEREMIA (SAB), BOTH ALONE AND IN COMBINATION WITH VANCOMYCIN, AND (B) TO DEMONSTRATE THAT AN OPTIMAL DOSE OF A NOVEL LIPOSOMAL FORMULATION OF REBAMIPIDE CAN ENHANCE BACTERIAL CLEARANCE AND REDUCE DELETERIOUS INFLAMMATORY IMMUNE RESPONSES IN A MOUSE MODEL OF S. AUREUS BACTEREMIA (SAB). THE EXPECTED OUTCOMES OF THIS STUDY INCLUDE A SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENT IN SURVIVAL RATES IN MURINE MODELS OF SAB FOLLOWING TREATMENT WITH THE NOVEL LIPOSOMAL FORMULATION OF REBAMIPIDE. ADDITIONALLY, WE ANTICIPATE A MARKED ENHANCEMENT IN BACTERIAL CLEARANCE FROM PERIPHERAL ORGANS, ACCOMPANIED BY A MEASURABLE MODULATION OF THE INFLAMMATORY RESPONSE. OUR LONG-TERM GOAL IS TO SECURE FDA APPROVAL FOR REBAMIPIDE AS A SAFE AND EFFECTIVE TREATMENT OF SAB PATIENTS. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THESE STUDIES WILL ALLOW CMTX BIOTECH TO (A) EVALUATE REBAMIPIDE IN A NON-RODENT ANIMAL MODEL OF SAB, (B) PREPARE AND SUBMIT A PRE-IND MEETING REQUEST AND BRIEFING DOCUMENT, (C) SCALE-UP PRODUCTION OF THE DRUG SUBSTANCE UNDER CURRENT GOOD MANUFACTURING PRACTICES (CGMP), (D) DEVELOP AN APPROPRIATE INTRAVENOUS FORMULATION OF REBAMIPIDE, AND (E) PREPARE AND SUBMIT AN IND FOCUSED ON THIS INDICATION. AS TECHNICAL AND REGULATORY MILESTONES ARE ACHIEVED, WE WILL WORK TO FORGE A STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP WITH AN ESTABLISHED PHARMACEUTICAL COMPANY IN THE FORM OF A LICENSE, CO-DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT, OR ACQUISITION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DIGITAL ASSESSMENT OF MOTOR SKILLS IN INFANTS AND YOUNG BOYS WITH DUCHENNE MUSCULAR DYSTROPHY USING WEARABLE SENSORS - ABSTRACT DUCHENNE MUSCULAR DYSTROPHY (DMD) — THE MOST COMMON INHERITED X-LINKED NEUROMUSCULAR DISEASE — IS A PROGRESSIVE AND FATAL MUSCLE-WASTING DISEASE WITH AN ESTIMATED INCIDENCE OF ABOUT 1 IN 3,500 LIVE MALE BIRTHS WORLDWIDE. THE LACK OF DYSTROPHIN PROTEIN RESULTS IN SKELETAL MUSCLE WASTING AND REPLACEMENT WITH FIBROTIC TISSUE, WHICH BEGINS IN UTERO AND CONTINUES AFTER BIRTH. THESE PATHOPHYSIOLOGICAL PROCESSES RESULT IN DELAY IN ACHIEVING MOTOR MILESTONES, AND MOTOR WEAKNESS CAN BE DETECTED DURING EARLY CHILDHOOD. WHILE ALL DISEASE-MODIFYING THERAPIES ARE RECOMMENDED TO COMMENCE AT 4 YEARS OF AGE AT THIS TIME, KEY DMD STAKEHOLDERS UNANIMOUSLY AGREE THAT BEGINNING TREATMENT AT THE EARLIEST TIME WILL BETTER PRESERVE SKELETAL HEALTH AND INCREASE LONGEVITY. UNBIASED AND QUANTITATIVE ASSESSMENT OF MOTOR ABILITIES IN INFANTS AND TODDLERS IS PARAMOUNT, NOT ONLY BECAUSE IT IS AN INTEGRAL PART OF THEIR CLINICAL CARE, BUT ALSO BECAUSE IT PROVIDES THE EARLIEST “TREATMENT” WINDOW TO BEGIN DISEASE-MODIFYING THERAPIES, WHICH CAN GREATLY IMPROVE QUALITY-OF-LIFE. A MAJOR BARRIER TO COMMENCING TREATMENT IN INFANTS AND YOUNG BOYS (AGES 0 – 4 YEARS) WITH DMD IS WE LACK THE ABILITY TO DETECT AND CONTINUOUSLY ASSESS CLINICALLY MEANINGFUL, FUNCTIONAL MOTOR ADAPTATIONS OBJECTIVELY AND WITH MINIMAL BURDEN TO STUDY PARTICIPANTS. SOME OF THE METHODOLOGICAL LIMITATIONS OF BAYLEY SCALES OF INFANT AND TODDLER DEVELOPMENT (BAYLEY-III), THE CURRENT USED ASSESSMENT, INCLUDE THAT IT CANNOT DETECT ECOLOGICALLY MEANINGFUL FUNCTIONAL “REAL-WORLD” ADAPTATIONS AS IT CAN ONLY BE ADMINISTERED IN THE CLINIC BY A QUALIFIED PROFESSIONAL. THIS LACK OF ECOLOGICAL RELEVANCE MEANS THAT IT CANNOT BE CONSIDERED AS A POTENTIAL CLINICAL OUTCOME MEASURE IN FUTURE CLINICAL TRIALS, THEREBY EXCLUDING THIS DEMOGRAPHIC AGE GROUP FROM CUTTING-EDGE CLINICAL TRIALS. BAYLEY-III ASSESSMENT ALSO MAY TAKE ~ 2 HOURS OF TESTING TIME, A LENGTH OF TIME, WHICH CAN BE PHYSICALLY EXHAUSTING FOR INFANTS AND TODDLERS. IN THIS PHASE I STTR PROJECT, WE PROPOSE PAMSYS™, A STATE-OF-THE-ART, PATENTED, FDA-LISTED WEARABLE SENSOR, THAT CAN DETECT POSTURE, TORSO/LIMB KINEMATICS, AS A SENSITIVE AND OBJECTIVE TOOL THAT OVERCOME METHODOLOGICAL LIMITATIONS OF BAYLEY-III. WEARABLE SENSORS ARE UNOBTRUSIVE, OFFER FLEXIBLE EVALUATION OF ABILITIES IN BOTH CLINICAL SETTING AND IN A NATURALISTIC ENVIRONMENT (HOME/DAYCARE). FIRST, WE WILL TEST THE CLINICAL VALIDITY OF PAMSYS™ KINEMATIC DATA TO QUANTITATE THE DIFFERENCES IN MOTOR ABILITIES IN DMD STUDY PARTICIPANTS (AGES 0 TO < 4 YEARS), COMPARED TO AGE-MATCHED NEUROTYPICAL MALES (AIM1). SECOND, WE WILL EVALUATE THE ECOLOGICAL VALIDITY OF PAMSYS™-DERIVED MEASURES TO DETECT THE PERSON-CENTERED FUNCTIONAL ADAPTATIONS IN A NATURALISTIC ENVIRONMENT (AIM 2). LAST, WE WILL CONDUCT ONLINE FOCUS GROUP MEETING WITH PARENTS OF STUDY PARTICIPANTS, REPRESENTATIVES FROM PATIENT ADVOCACY GROUPS AND FEDERAL REPRESENTATIVES, USING THE TECHNOLOGY ACCEPTANCE MODEL (TAM) TO UNDERSTAND THE PERCEPTION OF BENEFIT, TECHNOLOGY ACCEPTANCE AND ANXIETY, AND ATTITUDE OF USE.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT OF ARIH1 INHIBITORS AS A NOVEL TARGETED THERAPY IN CANCER - PROJECT SUMMARY ANTHRACYCLINE, ALKYLATOR AND TAXANE-BASED CHEMOTHERAPY IS THE STANDARD OF CARE IN METASTATIC TRIPLE NEGATIVE BREAST CANCER (TNBC). THIS TREATMENT STRATEGY RESULTS IN LOW RATES OF COMPLETE PATHOLOGICAL RESPONSE AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF RECURRENT DISEASE; THEREFORE, THERE IS AN URGENT NEED FOR NOVEL TARGETED THERAPIES THAT CAN IMPROVE PATIENT OUTCOMES. WE HAVE DELINEATED A NOVEL ROLE FOR THE E3 UBIQUITIN LIGASE ARIH1 IN TUMOR INITIATION AND METASTATIC PROGRESSION OF TNBC. IN BC PATIENT DATA, ARIH1 LEVELS ARE HIGHER IN TNBC COMPARED TO NORMAL TISSUE AND HIGH ARIH1 LEVELS ARE ASSOCIATED WITH REDUCED RELAPSE FREE SURVIVAL & OVERALL SURVIVAL IN TNBC PATIENTS. SILENCING OF ARIH1 INHIBITS EMT AND CANCER STEMNESS, LINKED TO TUMOR INITIATION AND METASTATIC PROGRESSION, AND BLOCKS TUMOR PROGRESSION IN MOUSE MODELS OF TNBC. IN ADDITION, ARIH1 SILENCED TNBC CELLS ARE MORE SENSITIVE TO CELL KILLING BY CHEMOTHERAPEUTICS COMMONLY USED FOR THE TREATMENT OF THIS CANCER SUBTYPE. BASED ON THESE FINDINGS, WE AIM TO DEVELOP INHIBITORS OF ARIH1 FUNCTION AS A NOVEL THERAPEUTIC STRATEGY IN TNBC AND OTHER CANCERS. WE HAVE IDENTIFIED SMALL MOLECULE INHIBITORS OF ARIH1 USING MOLECULAR DOCKING STUDIES TO SEARCH FOR COMPOUNDS THAT CAN INHIBIT ARIH1 ACTIVITY. HIT COMPOUNDS AND DERIVATIVES OF THE LEAD COMPOUND A3 CAN INHIBIT ARIH1 UBIQUITINATION IN VITRO AND, LIKE ARIH1 SILENCING, CAN INHIBIT CANCER STEMNESS AND INCREASE CHEMOTHERAPY SENSITIVITY. THE OBJECTIVES OF THIS PROPOSAL ARE TO PERFORM I) LEAD COMPOUND OPTIMIZATION AND II) ADME-PK STUDIES TO GENERATE A MORE DRUG-LIKE COMPOUND, FOLLOWED BY III) EFFICACY STUDIES OF LEAD COMPOUNDS COMBINED WITH CHEMOTHERAPY USING A MOUSE MODEL OF TNBC. STTR PHASE I FUNDING WILL ACHIEVE THE MAJOR MILESTONE OF PRECLINICAL EFFICACY STUDIES OF LEAD COMPOUNDS. WE ANTICIPATE THAT THE COMPLETION OF THIS MILESTONE WILL SUPPORT THE SUBMISSION OF A COMPETITIVE STTR PHASE II PROPOSAL, FOCUSING ON IND-ENABLING STUDIES, INCLUDING PRECLINICAL AND NON-CLINICAL SAFETY TOXICITY STUDIES. BASED ON OUR PRELIMINARY DATA, AND ON THE CONTINUING NEED FOR EFFECTIVE THERAPIES FOR METASTATIC BREAST CANCER, THE COMPOUNDS WE HAVE DISCOVERED SHOW GREAT POTENTIAL FOR DEVELOPMENT AND COMMERCIALIZATION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: LEAD SELECTION STUDIES OF NOVEL ANTISENSE OLIGONUCLEOTIDE FOR CANCER IMMUNOTHERAPY - TWIN PEAKS BIO, INC. ABSTRACT HEAD AND NECK SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA (HNSCC) IS THE SIXTH LEADING MALIGNANCY WORLDWIDE WITH LESS THAN HALF OF PATIENTS SURVIVING BEYOND 5 YEARS. HNSCC TUMORS FREQUENTLY SHOWN CONSTITUTIVE ACTIVATION OF SIGNAL TRANSDUCER AND ACTIVATOR OF TRANSCRIPTION 3 (STAT3), WHICH CORRELATES WITH POOR PROGNOSIS AND RESISTANCE TO STANDARD TREATMENTS, SUCH AS RADIOTHERAPY (RT). STAT3 IS WELL-DEFINED ONCOGENIC TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR AS WELL AS A CENTRAL IMMUNE CHECKPOINT REGULATOR. HOWEVER, THERE ARE STILL NO FDA-APPROVED DIRECT SMALL MOLECULE INHIBITORS AND EFFICACY OF INVESTIGATIONAL OLIGONUCLEOTIDE-BASED INHIBITORS IS LIMITED BY THE LACK OF EFFICIENT AND CELL-SELECTIVE DELIVERY METHODS. TO OVERCOME THESE CHALLENGES, WE DEVELOPED A STRATEGY FOR TARGETED IN VIVO DELIVERY OF STAT3 ANTISENSE OLIGONUCLEOTIDES (ASO) TO TUMOR-ASSOCIATED MYELOID CELLS AS CONJUGATES WITH SYNTHETIC TOLL-LIKE RECEPTOR 9 (TLR9) AGONISTS, CPG DNA. CPG-STAT3ASO CONJUGATES (CSA) SHOW IMPROVED BIODISTRIBUTION TO TARGET CELLS AND AUGMENTED STAT3 KNOCK-DOWN. LOCAL AND SYSTEMIC CSA ADMINISTRATION TRIGGERED POTENT CD8/CD4 T CELL-MEDIATED IMMUNE RESPONSES AGAINST SOLID TUMORS, SUCH AS HNSCC AND PROSTATE CANCERS, LEADING TO LONG-TERM MICE SURVIVAL. THE NOVELTY OF THE BI-SPECIFIC CSA STRATEGY LIES IN THE SYNERGISTIC EFFECT OF BLOCKING STAT3 COMBINED WITH CPG/TLR9-STIMULATION, WHICH TOGETHER UNLEASH IMMUNE ACTIVATION FROM WITHIN THE TUMOR MICROENVIRONMENT. THE FIRST GENERATION OF CSA WAS BASED ON THE STANDARD 2’-O-METHYL-MODIFIED CHEMISTRY OF THE GAPMER ASO. RECENTLY DEVELOPED NEW GENERATIONS OF LOCKED NUCLEIC ACID (LNA)-MODIFIED CSAS SHOWED SIGNIFICANTLY IMPROVED TARGET KNOCK-DOWN AND TUNABLE IMMUNOSTIMULATORY EFFECTS. TWIN PEAKS BIOTHERAPEUTICS INC. PLANS TO MOVE THE BI-SPECIFIC CSA OLIGONUCLEOTIDES INTO CLINICAL TRIALS FOR HNSCC IMMUNOTHERAPY ALONE OR IN COMBINATION WITH LOCALIZED RT. WE HYPOTHESIZE THAT LNA-MODIFIED CSAS INJECTED INTRAVENOUSLY WILL SHOW ENHANCED POTENCY/DURATION OF STAT3 INHIBITION AND GENERATION OF ANTITUMOR IMMUNE RESPONSES, THEREBY PROVIDING LEAD CANDIDATES FOR FURTHER IND-ENABLING STUDIES. WITHIN THIS PHASE I STTR PROPOSAL, WE WILL ASSESS FEASIBILITY AND SAFETY OF USING NEW LNA-MODIFIED CSAS FOR TARGETING STAT3 AND IMMUNOSTIMULATION USING HUMAN AND MOUSE HNSCC MODELS IN VITRO AND IN MICE. THE PROPOSED ANIMAL STUDIES ARE REQUIRED TO EVALUATE THE COMBINED EFFECTS OF LOCAL/SYSTEMIC CSA THERAPY ON TUMOR GROWTH AND ANTITUMOR IMMUNE RESPONSES, AS WELL AS ORGAN SAFETY WITHIN AN INTACT PHYSIOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT THAT CANNOT BE MODELED ADEQUATELY IN VITRO. THESE STUDIES WILL GENERATE ESSENTIAL EFFICACY, PHARMACOLOGY, AND SAFETY DATA NEEDED TO SUPPORT FUTURE IND-ENABLING STUDIES AND CLINICAL TRANSLATION OF CSA FOR HNSCC. OUR AIM IS TO PRODUCE CLINICALLY RELEVANT, EFFECTIVE AND SAFE CSA-BASED STRATEGIES CAPABLE OF OVERCOMING RT RESISTANCE AND GENERATING LONG TERM ANTITUMOR IMMUNE RESPONSES IN HNSCC AND POTENTIALLY IN OTHER SOLID TUMORS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: NUTRI-DEEPDISH: ENHANCING AI-POWERED DIETARY ASSESSMENT FOR ACCURATE, REAL-WORLD FOOD INTAKE MEASUREMENT - ABSTRACT/PROJECT SUMMARY THIS RESEARCH SEEKS TO PRODUCE A RAPID AND RELIABLE TOOL FOR PORTION SIZE ESTIMATION AND NUTRITION LOGGING THAT USES COMPUTER VISION AND DEEP LEARNING TO PREDICT THE NUTRITIONAL CONTENT OF A MEAL BASED ON AN IMAGE. THIS SYSTEM WILL AID NUTRITIONISTS AND PATIENTS IN SUPERVISED TREATMENT PROGRAMS AS WELL AS INDIVIDUAL USERS IN UNDERSTANDING DIETARY INTAKE AS AN INDICATOR OF OVERALL HEALTH. THE PROJECT WILL EXPAND A DIETARY ASSESSMENT SYSTEM BASED ON SEMANTIC SEGMENTATION AND MONOCULAR DEPTH ESTIMATION, IMPROVING THE SYSTEM’S ABILITY TO RECOGNIZE A WIDE VARIETY OF FOODS AND ADAPT TO VARIOUS REAL-WORLD SERVING SCENARIOS. THIS DIFFERS FROM EXISTING METHODOLOGIES IN THAT IT DOES NOT REQUIRE A CALIBRATION MARKER TO BE INCLUDED IN THE IMAGE AND USES STATE-OF-THE-ART MONOCULAR DEPTH ESTIMATION TECHNIQUES INSTEAD OF SPHERICAL OR OTHER GEOMETRIC ESTIMATION THAT IS CONSTRAINED TO A SPECIFIC SHAPES AND PATTERNS. THE GOAL OF THIS RESEARCH IS TO PRODUCE A TOOL THAT PERFORMS BETTER THAN HUMAN ESTIMATION ON REAL-WORLD IMAGES OF MEALS. THIS STTR WILL EXPAND THE RECOGNITION CAPABILITIES OF THE EXISTING SYSTEM, STRENGTHEN ITS CAPABILITIES WITH NON-HOMOGENEOUS FOODS AND LEFTOVERS, AND STATISTICALLY VALIDATE THE SYSTEM AGAINST WEIGHED PLATE WASTE AND HUMAN ESTIMATION CAPABILITIES IN A REAL-WORLD EATING ENVIRONMENT. THE PROPOSED RESEARCH WILL FOCUS ON THREE MAIN AIMS:  • AIM 1: EXPAND THE RECOGNITION CAPABILITIES OF NUTRI-DEEPDISH TO INCLUDE OVER 250 CLASSES OF FOODS  PREPARED IN A FREE-LIVING ENVIRONMENT.  • AIM 2: STRENGTHEN THE SYSTEM’S CAPABILITIES TO ACCURATELY RECOGNIZE NON-HOMOGENOUS FOODS AND LEFTOVERS  WITH OVER 85% ACCURACY FOR CALORIE ESTIMATION.  • AIM 3: STATISTICALLY VALIDATE THE SYSTEM AGAINST WEIGHED PLATE WASTE AND DETERMINE ITS ADDED VALUE OVER  HUMAN PORTION SIZE ESTIMATION CAPABILITIES. THIS RESEARCH WILL ENHANCE THE EFFECTIVENESS OF NUTRITIONAL INTERVENTIONS AND IMPROVE THE RIGOR OF NUTRITION RESEARCH BY PROVIDING EASILY RECORDED, HIGHLY ACCURATE PORTION CONSUMPTION DATA. ULTIMATELY, OUR GOAL IS TO PRODUCE A TOOL THAT PERFORMS BETTER THAN HUMAN ESTIMATION ON REAL-WORLD IMAGES OF MEALS, SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCING USER ESTIMATION ERROR AND COGNITIVE BURDEN IN FOOD LOGGING.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: A COST-EFFECTIVE NEAR-INFRARED IMAGING DEVICE FOR CONTINUOUS AND NONINVASIVE ASSESSMENT OF ENDOTRACHEAL TUBE POSITION IN CHILDREN - OUR GOAL IS TO DEVELOP AND COMMERCIALIZE A COST-EFFECTIVE NEAR-INFRARED (NIR) IMAGING DEVICE, CALLED NIR-ETT, FOR CONTINUOUS AND NONINVASIVE TRACKING OF THE ENDOTRACHEAL TUBE (ETT) IN CHILDREN. ETT INTUBATION IS AN AIRWAY MANAGEMENT PROCEDURE WIDELY USED IN EMERGENCY ROOMS (ERS), INTENSIVE CARE UNITS (ICUS), AND OTHER SETTINGS TO ENABLE APPROPRIATE VENTILATION IN CRITICALLY ILL PATIENTS OR PATIENTS RECOVERING FROM A MAJOR SURGICAL INTERVENTION. ONE OF THE MOST FEARED AND LIFE-THREATENING OCCURRENCES FOR A PATIENT WITH AN ETT IS TO HAVE THE TUBE DISPLACED OR DISLODGED SO THAT ADEQUATE VENTILATION IS NO LONGER POSSIBLE. THE OCCURRENCE OF ACCIDENTAL ETT MOVEMENT IS PARTICULARLY HIGH IN NEWBORNS AND YOUNG CHILDREN DUE TO THEIR SHORTER TRACHEA AND THE USE OF LIGHTER ANESTHESIA. CURRENTLY, THERE IS NO CLINICAL SYSTEM THAT CAN BE UTILIZED TO PROVIDE ACCURATE AND REAL-TIME INFORMATION TO CARE TEAMS ABOUT THE ETT POSITION. THIS STTR PHASE I PROPOSAL WILL ENABLE THE NEXT LOGICAL STEPS IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF A NOVEL AND EASILY SCALABLE NIR-ETT DEVICE RECENTLY DEVELOPED (US PATENT PENDING) BY OUR TEAM AND SUPPORTED BY AN NIH/NICHD R21 GRANT. NIR-ETT WILL ALLOW CARE TEAMS TO CONTINUOUSLY TRACK THE ETT POSITION AND LIMIT COMPLICATIONS FROM TUBE MOVEMENT. SPECIFICALLY, WE PROPOSE FURTHER REFINEMENT OF THE NIR-ETT AS AN ACCURATE, SAFE, AND SCALABLE DEVICE FOR CLINICAL USE. ONCE THE ETT IS PLACED IN THE TRACHEA, ITS ACCURATE POSITION IS DISPLAYED ON THE SCREEN AND CARE TEAMS ARE IMMEDIATELY NOTIFIED IF THE TUBE MOVES BEYOND THE PRESET LIMIT. WE RECENTLY DEMONSTRATED THE PROOF-OF-CONCEPT OF TWO NIR-ETT DETECTION STRATEGIES, USING A DETECTOR BOARD OR A DUAL-CAMERA MODULE, IN ANIMAL STUDIES WITH EXCELLENT ACCURACY. IN AIM 1, A CLINICALLY USABLE AND MASS-PRODUCIBLE NIR-ETT PROTOTYPE BASED ON THE DUAL-CAMERA METHOD AND A PROPRIETARY PYTHON APPLICATION (APP) FOR REAL-TIME DISPLACEMENT CALCULATION AND DISPLAY WILL BE DEVELOPED AND LAB TESTED. AIM 2 WILL TEST THE SAFETY, USABILITY AND FEASIBILITY OF THE DEVICE IN A PRECLINICAL STUDY IN 6 PIGLETS, USING TWO ROUTINELY USED METHODS AS REFERENCE. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THESE AIMS WILL RESULT IN AN ACCURATE, SAFE, AND MASS-PRODUCIBLE PROTOTYPE THAT WILL BE USED FOR INITIATION OF CLINICAL TRIALS, THUS SUBSTANTIVELY IMPROVING OVERALL SAFETY AND QUALITY OF CARE FOR CHILDREN WITH AN ETT WITHOUT INTERRUPTION TO CURRENT ICU AND ER WORKFLOWS, NEED FOR ADDITIONAL EXPERTISE OR PERSONNEL ON-SITE, AND HIGH COST.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT OF THE FIRST STANDARDIZED, COMMERCIAL RETINAL BARRIER-ON-CHIP USING DONOR-MATCHED HUMAN PRIMARY RETINAL PIGMENT EPITHELIAL AND CHOROIDAL ENDOTHELIAL CELLS FOR AMD THERAPEUTIC TESTING - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT: AGE-RELATED MACULAR DEGENERATION (AMD) IS THE LEADING CAUSE OF CENTRAL VISION LOSS IN AGING HIGH-INCOME POPULATIONS, YET RESEARCH PROGRESS IS HINDERED BY THE LACK OF PHYSIOLOGICALLY RELEVANT MODELS. AMD OCCURS IN TWO FORMS: DRY AMD, MARKED BY DRUSEN ACCUMULATION AND RETINAL ATROPHY, CAUSING GRADUAL VISION LOSS; AND WET AMD (NEOVASCULAR AMD, NAMD), CHARACTERIZED BY ABNORMAL BLOOD VESSEL GROWTH UNDER THE RETINA, LEADING TO LEAKAGE, SCARRING, AND RAPID VISION DETERIORATION. NEOVASCULARIZATION IN NAMD ARISES FROM DYSREGULATED INTERACTIONS BETWEEN HUMAN CHOROIDAL ENDOTHELIAL CELLS (HCHECS) AND HUMAN RETINAL PIGMENT EPITHELIAL CELLS (HRPES) ACROSS THE BRUCH’S MEMBRANE. EMERGING EVIDENCE SUGGESTS VASCULAR CHANGES IN THE CHOROID MAY ALSO CONTRIBUTE TO DRY AMD. TRADITIONAL ANIMAL MODELS AND IN VITRO SYSTEMS FAIL TO REPLICATE AMD’S COMPLEX BIOLOGIC PROCESSES THAT LEAD TO INITIATION AND PROGRESSION OF THIS COMPLEX DISEASE. TO ADDRESS THIS IMPEDIMENT, WE WILL DEVELOP A RETINAL BARRIER-ON-CHIP, INTEGRATING NORMAL AND AMD-AFFECTED HUMAN OCULAR CELLS, SPECIFICALLY HCHECS AND HRPES FROM THE SAME DONOR (DONOR-MATCHED). THE ORGAN-ON-CHIP (OOC) TECHNOLOGY WILL REPLICATE THE RPE–BRUCH’S MEMBRANE–CHOROID COMPLEX IN A 3D MICROENVIRONMENT, ENABLING NEOVASCULARIZATION STUDIES AND THERAPEUTIC TESTING. IN PHASE I, THE RETINAL BARRIER-ON-CHIP WILL BE DESIGNED AND FABRICATED IN A 3-PLEX ARRAY (3 OOCS ON ONE SLIDE), AND RETINAL TISSUES WILL BE ESTABLISHED ON-CHIP USING HCHEC AND HRPE CO-CULTURES. AN NAMD BIOASSAY WILL BE DEVELOPED WITH AMD-AFFECTED DONOR CELLS TO MODEL DISEASE CHARACTERISTICS AND EVALUATE THERAPEUTIC RESPONSES, INCLUDING VASCULAR SPROUTING AND BIOMARKER EXPRESSION. CO-CULTURES WILL BE TREATED WITH AN ESTABLISHED AMD THERAPEUTIC, BEVACIZUMAB (AVASTINTM), TO ASSESS PREDICTIVE CAPABILITIES. THE PHASE I FINAL PRODUCT WILL BE A RETINAL BARRIER-ON-CHIP TOOLKIT, INCLUDING THE OOC ARRAY, WELL-CHARACTERIZED PRIMARY HRPES AND HCHECS, SPECIALIZED MEDIA, AND PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS. THIS VALIDATED PLATFORM WILL PROVIDE A STANDARDIZED, PREDICTIVE PRECLINICAL MODEL FOR AMD DRUG DISCOVERY AND TESTING. LEVERAGING SYNVIVO’S OOC EXPERTISE AND ADVANCING SIGHT NETWORK’S OPHTHALMIC BIOREPOSITORY RESOURCES, THE PROJECT IS WELL-POSITIONED FOR SUCCESS. IN PHASE II, THE TOOLKIT WILL BE EXPANDED TO INCLUDE DONOR CELLS FROM DRY AND WET AMD AT DIFFERENT DISEASE STAGES TO MEET PHARMACEUTICAL INDUSTRY DEMANDS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: PRACTICAL DEVICE FOR AUTOMATED MONITORING OF NEOVASCULARIZATION IN DIABETIC RETINOPATHY - PROJECT SUMMARY DIABETIC RETINOPATHY (DR) IS A LEADING CAUSE OF BLINDNESS AMONG WORKING-AGE ADULTS, WITH OVER 9.6 MIL- LION AMERICANS AFFECTED. THE MOST SIGHT-THREATENING PHASE OF DR IS PROLIFERATIVE DIABETIC RETINOPATHY (PDR), MARKED BY THE GROWTH OF ABNORMAL RETINAL BLOOD VESSELS (NEOVASCULARIZATION, NV). TIMELY DETEC- TION OF NV IS CRITICAL FOR PREVENTING IRREVERSIBLE VISION LOSS. THE GOLD STANDARD FOR DETECTING AND MONI- TORING NV IN DR PATIENTS HAS LONG BEEN FLUORESCEIN ANGIOGRAPHY (FA), BUT IT IS INVASIVE AND RESOURCE- INTENSIVE. FUNDUS PHOTOGRAPHY IS WIDELY AVAILABLE AND NON-INVASIVE, BUT IT DOES NOT PROVIDE ENOUGH CONTRAST TO VISUALIZE TINY MICROVESSELS AND HENCE TO PROMPTLY DETECT EARLY NV. OCT ANGIOGRAPHY (OCTA) IS AN INTERESTING NONINVASIVE ALTERNATIVE IMAGING TECHNIQUE, BUT IT HAS A LIMITED FIELD OF VIEW, IT REQUIRES EXPERT READERS AND IT IS TOO COSTLY AND COMPLEX FOR WIDESPREAD ADOPTION, PARTICULARLY IN RURAL RESOURCE- LIMITED SETTINGS AND NON-TRADITIONAL SETTINGS SUCH AS RETAIL LOCATIONS (E.G., CVS, WALGREENS, COSTCO). THIS PROJECT PROPOSES TO DEVELOP AND VALIDATE AN INNOVATIVE IMAGING DEVICE, RETINAL FULL-FIELD AMPLITUDE SPECKLE DECORRELATION ANGIOGRAPHY (R-FASDA), BASED ON OUR PROPRIETARY ADAPTION OF LASER SPECKLE IM- AGING. R-FASDA DELIVERS HIGH-RESOLUTION, NONINVASIVE VISUALIZATION OF RETINAL VASCULATURE AT A COST AND COMPLEXITY DRAMATICALLY LOWER THAN OCTA, WITH A WIDER FIELD OF VIEW COMPARABLE TO FUNDUS PHOTOGRAPHY. THIS DEVICE COULD ENABLE NV DETECTION NOT ONLY IN TERTIARY OPHTHALMOLOGY CENTERS, BUT ALSO IN RURAL UNDERSERVED RESOURCE-LIMITED AREAS CLINICS, RETAIL LOCATIONS (E.G., CVS, WALGREENS, COSTCO), MOBILE CLINICS, AND PRIMARY CARE CLINICS, THEREBY IMPROVING EARLY DETECTION RATES AND ENABLING BROADER SCREENING PROGRAMS. IN AIM 1, WE WILL EXPAND THE PROTOTYPE’S FIELD OF VIEW FROM 7.5 TO 45 DEGREES, AND IN AIM 2, WE WILL CON- DUCT A PILOT STUDY IN DR PATIENTS TO ESTABLISH EQUIVALENCE BETWEEN R-FASDA AND OCTA. FOLLOWING SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION, WE WILL BE WELL POSITIONED TO PRODUCE FIVE CLINICAL PROTOTYPES, LAUNCH PIVOTAL MULTI-CENTER TRIALS, AND DEVELOP AI TOOLS FOR AUTOMATED NV DETECTION. THIS TECHNOLOGY NOT ONLY PROMISES A PARADIGM SHIFT IN DR SCREENING (ESPECIALLY IN UNDERSERVED AND NON-TRADITIONAL SETTINGS), BUT ALSO HOLDS POTENTIAL FOR OTHER RETINAL VASCULAR DISEASES SUCH AS WET AGE-RELATED MACULAR DEGENERATION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: UNBIASED AMPLIFICATION OF SINGLE STRANDED DNA OLIGOS ACROSS VERSATILE APPLICATION SPACES - PROJECT SUMMARY SINGLE-STRANDED DNA (SSDNA) OLIGONUCLEOTIDES ARE FOUNDATIONAL REAGENTS ACROSS GENOMICS, DIAGNOSTICS, BIOTECHNOLOGY, AND SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY. THEY ARE USED IN APPLICATIONS RANGING FROM NEXT-GENERATION SEQUENCING TO GENE EDITING AND DNA NANOTECHNOLOGY. HOWEVER, CURRENT METHODS FOR PRODUCING AND AMPLIFYING SSDNA ARE IN- EFFICIENT, BIASED, AND NOT GENERALIZABLE. MOST EXISTING AMPLIFICATION TECHNIQUES WERE DEVELOPED FOR DOUBLE- STRANDED DNA AND FAIL TO MAINTAIN SEQUENCE FIDELITY OR REPRESENTATION WHEN APPLIED TO SSDNA, PARTICULARLY FOR LONG TEMPLATES, VERY SHORT OLIGOS, OR DIVERSE OLIGO POOLS. THESE LIMITATIONS CONSTRAIN RESEARCH, INCREASE COSTS, AND REDUCE THE ACCESSIBILITY OF SSDNA-DEPENDENT TECHNOLOGIES. THIS PROJECT WILL DEVELOP AND COMMERCIALIZE A PLATFORM FOR UNBIASED AMPLIFICATION OF SSDNA OLIGONUCLEOTIDES. THE APPROACH INTEGRATES ENGINEERING AND BIOCHEMICAL INNOVATIONS TO OVERCOME THE SHORTCOMINGS OF EXISTING METHODS. AIM I WILL EMPLOY LAMINAR FLOW IN MICROFLUIDIC DEVICES TO ENHANCE EFFICIENCY BY IMPROVING REAGENT DIS- TRIBUTION AND MINIMIZING INHIBITORY BYPRODUCTS. AIM II WILL SYSTEMATICALLY SCREEN BIOCHEMICAL CONDITIONS AND STRAND-DISPLACING POLYMERASES TO IDENTIFY OPTIMAL PROTOCOLS FOR HIGH-YIELD AMPLIFICATION OF 200 NT SSDNA, A REP- RESENTATIVE LENGTH RELEVANT TO MANY SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY AND DIAGNOSTIC APPLICATIONS. AIM III WILL MAP PERFORMANCE CHARACTERISTICS ACROSS CHALLENGING APPLICATION SPACES, SPECIFICALLY VERY SHORT AND LONG SSDNA (<30 NT AND >200NT) AND HIGHLY DIVERSE OLIGO POOLS, BENCHMARKING BIAS AND FIDELITY USING HIGH-THROUGHPUT SEQUENCING. IF SUCCESSFUL, THIS PROJECT WILL DELIVER THE FIRST BROADLY APPLICABLE METHOD FOR UNBIASED SSDNA AMPLIFICATION. THE TECHNOLOGY WILL DIRECTLY BENEFIT BIOMEDICAL RESEARCHERS, DIAGNOSTIC DEVELOPERS, AND SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY COMPANIES BY ENABLING MORE RELIABLE, SCALABLE, AND COST-EFFECTIVE ACCESS TO SSDNA. LONGER TERM, THIS INNOVATION HAS THE POTENTIAL TO EXPAND THE OLIGONUCLEOTIDE MARKET BY UNLOCKING APPLICATIONS THAT ARE CURRENTLY IMPRACTICAL DUE TO AMPLIFICATION BIAS, INCLUDING LARGE-SCALE DNA STANDARDS FOR SEQUENCING, EQUITABLE OLIGO POOL REPRESENTATION FOR SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY, AND ROBUST PRODUCTION OF DNA SCAFFOLDS FOR NANOTECHNOLOGY. BY BRIDGING A CRITICAL TECHNOLOGI- CAL GAP, THIS WORK WILL ACCELERATE DISCOVERY, REDUCE BARRIERS TO COMMERCIALIZATION, AND SUPPORT THE RAPIDLY EX- PANDING DNA-BASED ECONOMY.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT OF A NOVEL BIOCOMPATIBLE POLYMER COATING FOR ANEURYSM TREATMENT DEVICES - ABSTRACT OFTEN UNNOTICED AND UNTREATED, INTRACRANIAL ANEURYSMS CAN RUPTURE AND CAUSE A SUDDEN AND CATASTROPHIC HEMORRHAGIC STROKE. WHILE THERE HAVE BEEN NOTABLE ADVANCES IN MINIMALLY INVASIVE ACCESS TO INTRACRANIAL ANEURYSMS USING ADVANCED MICROCATHETER SYSTEMS, THERE HAVE BEEN FAR FEWER IMPROVEMENTS IN ANEURYSM TREATMENT DEVICES. TO DATE, NEARLY ALL ENDOVASCULAR INTRACRANIAL ANEURYSM TREATMENT DEVICES ARE METAL-BASED. METAL, WHILE A DURABLE AND CONVENIENT MATERIAL FOR MEDICAL DEVICE MANUFACTURING, HAS WELL-DOCUMENTED BIOCOMPATIBILITY ISSUES. NITINOL (NICKEL-TITANIUM ALLOY) AND COBALT-CHROMIUM ALLOYS, WHICH ARE INCREASINGLY USED FOR IMPLANTABLE MEDICAL DEVICES, ARE HIGHLY THROMBOGENIC AND REQUIRE THE USE OF DUAL-ANTIPLATELET THERAPY (DAPT). MOREOVER, THESE DEVICES RESULT IN SLOW NEO-ENDOTHELIALIZATION AND ANEURYSM OCCLUSION, OFTEN LEADING TO RECANALIZATION. PREVIOUS STUDIES ON A NOVEL POLYMER BIOMATERIAL (PPODA-QT) SUGGEST THAT THIS MATERIAL HAS SUPERIOR PROPERTIES OVER CURRENT COATING MATERIALS, SUCH AS: BIOCOMPATIBILITY, NON-THROMBOGENICITY (NO DAPTS REQUIRED), AND TISSUE REGROWTH SCAFFOLDING EFFECTS FOR COMPLETE ANEURYSM NECK REPAIR. ADDITIONALLY, PREVIOUS WORK SUCCESSFULLY COATED PPODA ONTO NITINOL WIRES USING A COVALENTLY BOUND INTERMEDIATE SILANE LAYER. THIS PROPOSAL WILL ITERATE ON THIS COATING PROCESS TO COAT NITINOL FLOW DIVERTERS USING METHODS THAT COMBINE BIOENGINEERING EXPERTISE, NANO- AND SURFACE MODIFICATION TECHNOLOGY (CENTER FOR MATERIALS INTERFACES IN RESEARCH AND ACCESS), AND TEST THE COATINGS UNDER CLINICIAN GUIDANCE (BARROW NEUROLOGICAL INSTITUTE). IN AIM 1 OF THIS PROPOSAL, A PRELIMINARY FLOW DIVERTER PROTOTYPE WILL FIRST BE DEVELOPED IN COLLABORATION WITH PIVOT MEDICAL. THEN UNIFORM COATINGS WILL BE CREATED ON FLOW DIVERTERS BY ITERATING ON THE FOLLOWING 4 SILANE FACTORS: SILANE CONCENTRATION, CHEMICAL VAPOR DEPOSITION TIME, CHEMICAL VAPOR DEPOSITION VACUUM PRESSURE, AND AXIAL COMPRESSION AND EVALUATING ROTATIONAL MIXING TO ATTACH PPODA TO THE SILANE. IN AIM 2, COATING INTEGRITY, FLOW DIVERTER MECHANICAL PROPERTIES, AND BIOCOMPATIBILITY WILL BE EVALUATED IN 14 TESTS: COATING INTEGRITY, PARTICULATE EVALUATION, CORROSION, RADIAL FORCE, TENSION, TORSION, BENDING, ENDOTHELIAL CELL PROLIFERATION, DEVICE SURFACE ANALYSIS AFTER BLOOD CONTACT, PARTIAL THROMBOPLASTIN TIME, BLOOD PLATELET AND LEUKOCYTE COUNT, COMPLEMENT ACTIVATION ASSAY, HEMOLYSIS ASSAY, AND BIODEGRADATION. DATA OBTAINED FROM THESE TESTS WILL BE INSTRUMENTAL IN PREPARING FOR PHASE II: FURTHER DEVELOPMENT AND TESTING OF A COATED FLOW DIVERTER PROTOTYPE, INCLUDING IN VIVO ANIMAL STUDIES, FOR EVENTUAL FDA SUBMISSION.

description: VIRTUALLY SUPPORTING SCHOOLS: HISPANIC ADOLESCENT RESILIENCE AND MENTAL HEALTH OPPORTUNITIES IN THE NATION'S YOUTH-US (HARMONY-US) PHASE 2 - THE ISSUE: HISPANIC ADOLESCENTS EXPERIENCE DISPARITIES IN DEPRESSION AND ANXIETY (PARODI ET AL., 2022; WEERSING ET AL., 2022) AND ARE MORE LIKELY TO ATTEMPT SUICIDE THAN WHITE ADOLESCENTS (FALCONE & DAGAR, 2022). MENTAL HEALTH PROBLEMS REPRESENT A CHRONIC DISEASE IN THE US, PARTICULARLY AMONG ADOLESCENT POPULATIONS – AND DEPRESSION AND ANXIETY ARE CLOSELY LINKED WITH OTHER CHRONIC CONDITIONS SUCH AS DIABETES, METABOLIC SYNDROME, AND HEART DISEASE (HUANG ET AL., 2023). IT IS THEREFORE ESSENTIAL TO PREVENT MENTAL HEALTH PROBLEMS AMONG HISPANIC YOUTH, WHO REPRESENT MORE THAN A QUARTER OF ALL US CHILDREN AND ADOLESCENTS (US CENSUS BUREAU, 2023). INDEED, FOCUSING ON TARGETING CHRONIC HEALTH CONDITIONS BY FOCUSING ON MENTAL HEALTH DISPARITIES ALIGNS WITH THE MAKE AMERICA HEALTHY AGAIN AGENDA TO PROMOTE POSITIVE OUTCOMES THAT CAN HELP HISPANIC YOUTH CONTRIBUTE TO US SOCIETY. agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: A NOVEL PREVENTATIVE AND TREATMENT FOR KLEBSIELLA PNEUMONIAE INFECTION - PROJECT SUMMARY OUR GOAL IS TO DEVELOP A FIRST-IN-CLASS, ORALLY ADMINISTERED PROBIOTIC THERAPY FOR THE TREATMENT AND PREVENTION OF KLEBSIELLA (K.) PNEUMONIAE GASTROINTESTINAL (GI) COLONIZATION, TRANSMISSION, AND INFECTION. K. PNEUMONIAE IS A GRAM-NEGATIVE, ROD-SHAPED BACTERIA BELONGING TO THE FAMILY ENTEROBACTERIACEAE. AMONG THE NUMEROUS SPECIES WITHIN THE GENUS, K. PNEUMONIAE STANDS OUT AS A SIGNIFICANT HUMAN PATHOGEN, CAPABLE OF CAUSING A RANGE OF INFECTIONS, FROM PNEUMONIA AND URINARY TRACT INFECTIONS TO BLOODSTREAM INFECTIONS, PARTICULARLY IN HEALTHCARE SETTINGS14, 15. GI COLONIZATION BY CERTAIN K. PNEUMONIAE STRAINS ALSO CONTRIBUTES TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE16 AND FATTY ACID LIVER DISEASE17. THE RISE OF ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE IN KLEBSIELLA STRAINS, FUELED BY THE INDISCRIMINATE USE OF ANTIBIOTICS, PRESENTS A GRAVE CONCERN GLOBALLY. THE EMERGENCE OF CARBAPENEM-RESISTANT STRAINS, OFTEN REFERRED TO AS  SUPERBUGS,  POSES A FORMIDABLE CHALLENGE TO HEALTHCARE SYSTEMS, LIMITING TREATMENT OPTIONS AND INCREASING MORTALITY RATES14, 15, 18-20. EFFORTS TO COMBAT K. PNEUMONIAE INFECTIONS ENCOMPASS A MULTIFACETED APPROACH, INCLUDING STRINGENT INFECTION CONTROL MEASURES, SURVEILLANCE PROGRAMS, AND THE USE OF ANTIBIOTICS. THE HUMAN GUT MICROBIOME IS A DENSELY POPULATED ECOSYSTEM, WHERE OUR BACTERIAL SYMBIONTS ARE IN CONSTANT COMPETITION FOR NUTRIENTS AND SURVIVAL21. A MAJOR STRATEGY EMPLOYED BY BACTERIA TO OUTCOMPETE THEIR NEIGHBORS IS THE PRODUCTION OF HIGHLY SPECIFIC ANTIMICROBIAL PEPTIDES, SO CALLED BACTERIOCINS, THAT TARGET CLOSELY RELATED SPECIES OR STRAINS22. WHILE SMALL MOLECULE ANTIMICROBIALS, SUCH AS PENICILLIN23, HAVE BEEN EXPLOITED FOR DECADES AS TRADITIONAL ANTIBIOTICS, ANTIMICROBIAL PEPTIDES AS THERAPEUTIC AGENTS HAVE JUST RECENTLY GAINED WIDESPREAD INTEREST AS POTENTIAL TREATMENTS OF MDR PATHOGENS24, 25. CLASS IIB MICROCINS ARE RIBOSOMALLY SYNTHESIZED BACTERIOCINS BETWEEN 5 KDA TO 10 KDA IN SIZE WITH ACTIVITY AGAINST CLOSELY RELATED STRAINS OR SPECIES1-3, 26, 27. RECENTLY, OUR PROJECT TEAM IDENTIFIED A NOVEL CLASS IIB MICROCIN MCCI47 (ECI47) THAT DEMONSTRATED POTENT INHIBITION OF NUMEROUS ENTEROBACTERIACEAE, INCLUDING MULTIDRUG-RESISTANT CLINICAL ISOLATES1, 5. WE GENETICALLY ENGINEERED THE PROBIOTIC BACTERIUM ESCHERICHIA COLI NISSLE 1917 (ECN) TO PRODUCE ECI47 FROM A STABLE MULTICOPY PLASMID. WE THEN TESTED THE CLINICAL POTENTIAL OF THE ECN-ECI47-PRODUCING PROBIOTIC IN A MURINE CARBAPENEM-RESISTANT (CR) K. PNEUMONIAE COLONIZATION MODEL AND DEMONSTRATED SIGNIFICANT ECN-ECI47- DEPENDENT REDUCTION OF CR K. PNEUMONIAE ABUNDANCE AFTER SEVEN DAYS OF DAILY ORAL PROBIOTIC ADMINISTRATION1, 5. WE HAVE SINCE IDENTIFIED A SERIES OF NOVEL CLASS IIB MICROCINS THAT ARE MORE POTENT AGAINST K. PNEUMONIAE AND OTHER ENTEROBACTERIACEAE SPECIES. BUILDING FROM THIS WORK, OUR GOAL IS TO DEVELOP A FIRST-IN-CLASS, ORALLY ADMINISTERED, PROBIOTIC THERAPY FOR THE TREATMENT AND PREVENTION OF K. PNEUMONIAE GI COLONIZATION, TRANSMISSION, AND INFECTION. SUCCESSFUL COMMERCIALIZATION WOULD PROVIDE A PROFOUND FRONT-LINE MEDICAL ADVANCEMENT IN COMBATING MULTIDRUG RESISTANT KLEBSIELLA INFECTION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: THE RESILIENT BRACE: A FLEXIBLE, ADJUSTABLE, CONNECTED BRACING SYSTEM FOR ADOLESCENT IDIOPATHIC SCOLIOSIS - PROJECT SUMMARY MORE THAN 12,000 ADOLESCENTS ANNUALLY ARE DIAGNOSED WITH IDIOPATHIC SCOLIOSIS (IS), A PROGRESSIVE ABNORMAL CURVATURE OF THE SPINE. CURRENT STANDARD OF CARE IS FOR PATIENTS TO WEAR A RIGID BRACE FOR UP TO 18 HOURS/DAY TO PREVENT THE CURVATURE FROM WORSENING (PROGRESSING), BUT THIS TREATMENT FAILS FOR ONE QUARTER OF PATIENTS WHO ARE CONSCIENTIOUS IN FOLLOWING IT. WORSE STILL, NEARLY HALF OF ADOLESCENT PATIENTS DO NOT WEAR THEIR BRACE AS PRESCRIBED BECAUSE THE DEVICES ARE UNCOMFORTABLE AND RESTRICTIVE, DIFFICULT TO USE AND ADJUST, AND CONSPICUOUS AND SOCIALLY STIGMATIZING. PATIENTS FOR WHOM BRACING IS UNSUCCESSFUL––EITHER BECAUSE THEY FAIL TO RESPOND OR THROUGH DISUSE– –RISK PERMANENT DEFORMITY AND FREQUENTLY MUST UNDERGO SPINAL FUSION SURGERY. BESIDES COSTING THE HEALTHCARE SYSTEM HUNDREDS OF MILLIONS OF DOLLARS EACH YEAR, THESE SURGERIES LEAVE YOUNG PATIENTS WITH LIFE-LONG CONSEQUENCES INCLUDING REDUCED SPINAL MOBILITY AND INCREASED RISK OF CHRONIC PAIN.  TO IMPROVE PATIENT COMPLIANCE AND TREATMENT EFFECTIVENESS, THINKS WORKS, PBC, IS DEVELOPING A NOVEL PATIENT-CENTERED, LOW-PROFILE, FLEXIBLE SCOLIOSIS BRACE THAT IMPROVES COMFORT, ALLOWS MOBILITY, AND PROVIDES REAL- TIME TREATMENT MONITORING. INSPIRED BY THE HUMAN SPINE, THE TW BRACE HAS A FLEXIBLE MECHANICAL COLUMN THAT ALLOWS IT TO DELIVER TREATMENT WHILE PRESERVING MOVEMENT. FURTHERMORE, WHEREAS CURRENT BRACES, AT BEST, ONLY STOP THE PROGRESSION OF A PATIENT'S CURVE, THE TW BRACE CAN EASILY BE CONFIGURED TO ATTEMPT TO CORRECT THE PATIENT'S CURVE. THE MECHANICAL COLUMN IS TETHERED TO PATIENTS BY A FABRIC STRAPPING SYSTEM THAT IS BARELY NOTICEABLE; IT IS SUFFICIENTLY LOW PROFILE THAT IT CAN BE CONCEALED UNDER CLOTHING.  WE CONDUCTED A PILOT STUDY WITH AN EARLY PROTOTYPE OF THE BRACE. AFTER WEARING THE PROTOTYPE FOR 20 MINUTES, 14 OF 20 ADOLESCENT IS PATIENTS EXPERIENCED A REDUCTION IN AN ABNORMAL CURVATURE. IMPORTANTLY––FOR PATIENT COMPLIANCE––16 PREFERRED THE TW BRACE OVER THEIR EXISTING RIGID BRACE. THESE PROMISING RESULTS SUGGEST THE TW BRACE SYSTEM CAN DELIVER EFFECTIVE TREATMENT THAT IS MUCH MORE ACCEPTABLE TO ADOLESCENT PATIENTS.  HERE, WE PROPOSE TO REFINE ASPECTS OF THE TW BRACE DESIGN AND INVESTIGATE WHETHER SUBJECTS FIND THE BRACE ACCEPTABLE FOR EXTENDED WEAR. IN PARTICULAR, WE WILL TEST ALTERNATIVE MATERIALS FOR THE MECHANICAL COLUMN AND STRATEGIES FOR MARKING THE STRAPS TO MAKE THESE COMPONENTS MORE COMPATIBLE WITH X-RAY IMAGING. WE WILL CONDUCT A STUDY WITH YOUNG ADOLESCENTS TO GATHER FEEDBACK ON THE BRACE'S FASTENING (SECUREMENT) MECHANISM AND TO ENSURE THEY CAN GENERATE SUFFICIENT FORCE TO USE THE BRACE INDEPENDENTLY. THEN, WE WILL CONDUCT A 2-DAY WEAR TEST AND COLLECT FEEDBACK ON SUBJECTS' EXPERIENCES WEARING THE BRACE.  THESE STUDIES WILL PROVIDE CRITICAL INSIGHTS FOR FINALIZING THE DESIGN OF THE BRACE, AND THE RESULTS WILL PROVIDE A STARTING POINT FOR ENGAGING WITH THE FDA TO PLAN AN EXPLORATORY CLINICAL TRIAL. THIS WILL ACCELERATE DEVELOPMENT OF THIS GROUNDBREAKING TREATMENT TO IMPROVE THE OUTCOMES AND QUALITY-OF-LIFE FOR ADOLESCENT IS PATIENTS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: LOCAL NEOADJUVANT IMMUNOTHERAPY TO REDUCE RECURRENCE IN RESECTABLE ORAL CANCERS - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP A SUSTAINED-RELEASE MULTIDOMAIN PEPTIDE (MDP) HYDROGEL FORMULATION OF AN INOS INHIBITOR L-NIL AND THE STING-AGONIST CDN TO BE USED IN COMBINATION WITH AN IMMUNE CHECKPOINT INHIBITOR MONOCLONAL ANTIBODY TO ENHANCE IMMUNE PRIMING IN THE NEOADJUVANT SETTING TO CONTROL RESIDUAL DISEASE FOLLOWING TUMOR RESECTION AND LEAD TO REDUCED RECURRENCE. HEAD AND NECK CANCER (HNSCC) IS AN IDEAL TARGET FOR THIS APPROACH AS THESE CANCERS ARE KNOWN TO BE HIGHLY IMMUNOSUPPRESSIVE. HNSCC IS THE SIXTH MOST COMMON CANCER GLOBALLY AND EACH YEAR OVER 60,000 NEW CASES OF HEAD AND NECK CANCER WILL BE DIAGNOSED IN THE US ALONE AND AN ESTIMATED 12,230 PEOPLE WILL DIE FROM THE DISEASE. DESPITE ADVANCES IN SURGERY AND RADIOTHERAPY, FIVE-YEAR SURVIVAL RATES FOR PATIENTS WITH HNSCC ACROSS ALL STAGES REMAIN 40–50% FOR TUMORS CAUSED BY TRADITIONAL CARCINOGENS (HPV-NEGATIVE). THEREFORE, THERE IS AN URGENT NEED TO IMPROVE TREATMENT FOR PATIENTS WITH RECURRENT OR METASTATIC SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA OF THE HEAD AND NECK. BIOMATERIALS HAVE RECENTLY SPARKED INCREASED INTEREST AS PLATFORMS FOR CANCER IMMUNOTHERAPY. BIOMATERIALS ALLOW FOR SPATIOTEMPORAL CONTROL OVER PAYLOAD DELIVERY MEANING DIVERSE FACTORS CAN BE RELEASED IN A CONTROLLED MANNER WITHIN A SPECIFIC VOLUME, REDUCING OFF-TARGET TOXICITY WHILE ENABLING DOSE-SPARING. OUR SELF-ASSEMBLING NANOFIBROUS PEPTIDE-BASED HYDROGELS THAT WE CALL MULTIDOMAIN PEPTIDES (MDPS) ARE AT THE FOREFRONT OF THIS FIELD. ENCOURAGED BY THE INHERENT ABILITY OF L-NIL-MDP HYDROGELS TO INHIBIT INOS BOTH IN VITRO AND IN VIVO, WE HAVE BEGUN TO ASSESS THESE HYDROGELS IN COMBINATION WITH A STING-AGONIST CDN AS A 2ND-GENERATION BIOMATERIAL PLATFORM FOR COMBINATION IMMUNOTHERAPIES CALLED “SYNERGEL”. PROOF OF CONCEPT STUDIES CONDUCTED BY DR. HARTGERINK, AND HIS COLLEAGUES HAVE DEMONSTRATED THAT SYNERGELS LOADED WITH A CLINICALLY RELEVANT IMMUNOTHERAPY CAN RENDER IMMUNOLOGICALLY REFRACTORY TUMORS SENSITIVE TO IMMUNE-MEDIATED KILLING VIA MULTIPLE MECHANISMS: 1) OPTIMIZING LOCAL EFFECTOR/SUPPRESSOR IMMUNOCYTE RATIOS, 2) PROLONGING IMMUNE STIMULATING AGENT RELEASE, AND 3) ENHANCING RECRUITED EFFECTOR IMMUNOCYTE ACTIVATION. DURING THE FIRST AIM OF THIS PROJECT, WE WILL SYNTHESIZE AND CHARACTERIZE DISTINCT L-NIL MULTIDOMAIN PEPTIDE (LNIL-MDP) HYDROGELS LOADED WITH A STING AGONIST (CDN) AND CHECKPOINT INHIBITOR ANTIBODY (ANTI-PD-1 MAB OR ANTI-CTLA-4 MAB, OR COMBINATION THE TWO MABS) CARGO. THE TEST ARTICLES WILL BE TESTED AND CHARACTERIZED FOLLOWED BY RELEASE KINETICS ANDBIOACTIVITY TESTING. IN OUR SECOND AIM, WE PLAN TO INVESTIGATE THE IMMUNE-STIMULATING EFFECTS, SAFETY PROFILE, AND DISEASE CONTROL OF THE SYNERGEL FORMULATIONS IN CHECKPOINT INHIBITOR RESISTANT MOC2 HNSCC TUMORS. A SYNGENEIC MURINE MODEL CLOSELY MIMICS THE COMPLEX TUMOR MICROENVIRONMENT AND LOCAL IMMUNE INTERACTIONS SEEN IN HUMAN HEAD AND NECK CANCER, OFFERING SUPERIOR TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE COMPARED TO EITHER IN VITRO MODELS OR XENOGRAFT MODELS. THIS PLATFORM ALLOWS PRECISE ASSESSMENT OF HOW NEOADJUVANT IMMUNOTHERAPIES MODULATE THE ENDOGENOUS ANTI-TUMOR IMMUNE RESPONSE IN SITU, SIMULATING THE CRITICAL CHALLENGE OF OVERCOMING IMMUNOSUPPRESSIVE FACTORS BEFORE SURGICAL RESECTION. THEREFORE, IT PROVIDES A VITAL PRECLINICAL TOOL TO VALIDATE DRUG EFFICACY AND DETERMINE OPTIMAL COMBINATION STRATEGIES NECESSARY FOR SUCCESSFUL IMMUNOTHERAPY APPLICATION IN HNSCC.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: MULTI-SCALE NONLINEAR OPTICS LABEL-FREE MICROSCOPY FOR RAPID PROSTATE CANCER RESEARCH ANDDIAGNOSIS - PROJECT SUMMARY PROSTATE CANCER IS THE MOST COMMONLY DIAGNOSED NON-CUTANEOUS CANCER AMONG MEN IN THE UNITED STATES, WITH APPROXIMATELY 313,780 NEW CASES AND 35,770 DEATHS PROJECTED IN 2025. ACCURATE DIAGNOSIS REMAINS CHALLENGING DUE TO THE RELIANCE ON FORMALIN-FIXED, PARAFFIN-EMBEDDED TISSUE ANALYSIS, WHICH COMPROMISES CRITICAL METABOLIC INFORMATION NECESSARY FOR PRECISE DISEASE CHARACTERIZATION. THIS LIMITATION OFTEN LEADS TO DIAGNOSTIC UNCERTAINTY, RESULTING IN OVERTREATMENT OF INDOLENT CANCERS OR DELAYED INTERVENTION FOR AGGRESSIVE DISEASE. THE BROAD, LONG-TERM OBJECTIVE OF THIS PHASE I SBIR PROJECT IS TO REVOLUTIONIZE PROSTATE CANCER DIAGNOSIS BY DEVELOPING A NOVEL WORKFLOW THAT UTILIZES THE TETRAQUANT™ SYSTEM, POWERED BY NONLINEAR OPTICS LABEL-FREE IMAGING (NOLFI) TECHNOLOGY, FOR HIGH-RESOLUTION, METABOLICALLY-INFORMED IMAGING OF FRESH PROSTATE NEEDLE BIOPSY SPECIMENS. THIS APPROACH AIMS TO CAPTURE STRUCTURAL AND METABOLIC SIGNATURES CRITICAL FOR ACCURATE DIAGNOSIS, THEREBY ENHANCING SENSITIVITY, SPECIFICITY, AND DIAGNOSTIC EFFICIENCY. THE PROJECT WILL OPTIMIZE THE TETRAQUANT™ SYSTEM FOR IMAGING FRESH PROSTATE NEEDLE BIOPSIES BY DEVELOPING A CUSTOM HOUSING THAT ENSURES ABERRATION-FREE, HIGH-QUALITY IMAGING. NOLFI DATA WILL BE COLLECTED FROM TWENTY FRESH PROSTATE BIOPSY SPECIMENS, PRESERVING METABOLIC INTEGRITY THROUGH IMMEDIATE IMAGING POST-EXTRACTION. THE PROJECT WILL ALSO DEVELOP AND VALIDATE AN AI- BASED ANALYTICAL FRAMEWORK TO AUTOMATE THE INTERPRETATION OF NOLFI DATA, DISTINGUISHING BENIGN FROM MALIGNANT TISSUES AND PREDICTING GLEASON GRADES WITH HIGH SENSITIVITY AND SPECIFICITY. THE RESEARCH DESIGN INVOLVES ADAPTING THE TETRAQUANT™ SYSTEM FOR OPTIMAL NOLFI IMAGING OF FRESH PROSTATE NEEDLE BIOPSIES, FABRICATING A CUSTOM GLASS HOUSING TO MAINTAIN BIOPSY ALIGNMENT, AND ACQUIRING ANNOTATED DATA FROM TWENTY SPECIMENS. AI MODELS WILL BE DEVELOPED AND VALIDATED TO ACHIEVE AT LEAST 85 PERCENT SENSITIVITY AND SPECIFICITY FOR CANCER DETECTION AND AT LEAST 80 PERCENT ACCURACY FOR GLEASON GRADE PREDICTION. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THIS PROJECT WILL ESTABLISH THE FEASIBILITY OF USING NOLFI TECHNOLOGY FOR ACCURATE, LABEL-FREE PROSTATE CANCER DIAGNOSIS, PROVIDING A ROBUST FOUNDATION FOR CLINICAL VALIDATION AND COMMERCIALIZATION IN PHASE II.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT OF NOVEL WNT INHIBITORS TO TREAT COLORECTAL CANCERS - ABSTRACT COLORECTAL CANCER (CRC) IS THE THIRD MOST PREVALENT CANCER IN THE UNITED STATES, WITH A POOR CLINICAL OUTCOME IN ITS ADVANCED FORM. MUTATIONS IN GENES ENCODING COMPONENTS OF THE WNT SIGNALING PATHWAY (APC AND Â- CATENIN) OCCUR IN OVER 90% OF ALL CRCS. WNT SIGNALING IS HIGHLY EVOLUTIONARY CONSERVED AS A REGULATOR OF DEVELOPMENT AND STEM CELL MAINTENANCE. GENETIC MUTATIONS THAT ACTIVATE WNT SIGNALING CONTRIBUTE TO INITIATION OF CANCER, AND NUCLEAR ACCUMULATION OF THE WNT SIGNALING MOLECULES Â- CATENIN, CORRELATE WITH POOR CLINICAL OUTCOMES, AND UNDERLIE LOW SURVIVAL. FURTHERMORE, WNT SIGNALING FUELS CANCER STEM CELLS AND CONTRIBUTE TO CHEMOTHERAPY RESISTANCE, RECURRENCE, AND METASTASIS. DEVELOPING WNT SIGNALING INHIBITORS AS ANTI-CANCER AGENTS HAS BEEN CHALLENGING NOT ONLY BECAUSE A LIMITED NUMBER OF “DRUGGABLE” TARGETS IN THIS SIGNALING TRANSDUCTION NETWORK, BUT ALSO BECAUSE OF SEVERE ON-TARGET GASTROINTESTINAL (GI) TOXICITY DUE TO FUNDAMENTAL ROLES THAT CANONICAL WNT SIGNALING PLAY IN REGULAR TISSUE HOMEOSTASIS. BCL-9 PROTEINS (INCLUDING BCL-9 AND BCL- 9L) ARE IMPORTANT CO-FACTORS OF WNT SIGNALING, THAT ARE PRIMARILY RESPONSIBLE FOR WNT-DEPENDENT ONCOGENESIS BUT IS LARGELY DISPENSABLE IN PHYSIOLOGICAL SETTING. RECENTLY WE HAVE IDENTIFIED A SERIES OF NOVEL WNT INHIBITORS, SUCH AS OUR LEAD MOLECULE SSTB-178, THAT INHIBIT WNT PATHWAY ACTIVITY BY PHYSICALLY DISRUPTING THE BINDING BETWEEN Â-CATENIN AND BCL-9 PROTEINS. THIS PHASE I SBIR APPLICATION AIMS TO CONTINUE OPTIMIZING THIS SERIES OF MOLECULES TO IMPROVE THEIR POTENCY, SELECTIVITY, DRUG-LIKE (ADMET/PK) PROPERTIES, AND IN VIVO EFFICACY. ANIMAL MODELS ARE ESSENTIAL FOR THIS PROJECT BECAUSE THEY PROVIDE THE ONLY PHYSIOLOGICALLY RELEVANT SYSTEM TO EVALUATE THE INTEGRATED EFFECTS OF BCL-9 INHIBITION ON TUMOR GROWTH, PHARMACOKINETICS, AND SYSTEMIC TOXICITY. IN VIVO STUDIES ARE ALSO NECESSARY TO DETERMINE WHETHER OUR COMPOUNDS CAN ACHIEVE THERAPEUTIC EFFICACY AGAINST WNT-DRIVEN CRC WHILE MINIMIZING THE ON-TARGET TOXICITIES THAT HAVE LIMITED PRIOR WNT PATHWAY INHIBITORS. WE PROPOSE TWO SPECIFIC AIMS: SPECIFIC AIM 1: INCREASE THE POTENCY AND SELECTIVITY OF SSTB-178. SPECIFIC AIM 2: EVALUATE DRUG-LIKE PROPERTIES AND IN VIVO EFFICACY OF ADVANCED ANALOGS. THIS PHASE I APPLICATION OUTLINES THE ESSENTIAL STEPS IN DEVELOPING SMALL MOLECULE BCL-9 INHIBITORS FOR TREATING WNT-DEPENDENT CRC. STEMSYNERGY THERAPEUTICS, INC (SSTI) IS A BIOTECHNOLOGY COMPANY WHOSE FOCUS IS ON THE DISCOVERY, DEVELOPMENT, AND COMMERCIALIZATION OF DRUGS TARGETING WNT, NOTCH, AND MYC SIGNALING PATHWAYS, ALL OF WHICH ARE CRITICAL TO CANCER CELL SURVIVAL. SSTI’S EXPERTISE ON WNT SIGNALING AND MEDICINAL CHEMISTRY ENSURES THE AIMS INDICATED IN THIS PHASE I PROPOSAL ARE READILY ACHIEVABLE. THE WORK PROPOSED HERE ALSO HAVE BROAD COMMERCIAL POTENTIAL.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: IMPROVED MAGNETOMOTIVE EMBOLIZATION FOR HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA - CANCER IS THE 2ND LEADING CAUSE OF DEATH IN THE UNITED STATES (US) AND ACCOUNTS FOR 1 OF EVERY 4 DEATHS. MORE THAN 600,000 AMERICANS WILL DIE OF CANCER IN 2018, WITH ANNUAL US CANCER-CARE EXPENDITURES REACHING $156B BY 2020, AND MORE THAN 10M CANCER-RELATED DEATHS OCCUR ANNUALLY. WHILE CHEMOTHERAPY IS EFFECTIVE, SEVERAL CANCER SUBTYPES (INCLUDING LIVER CANCER) ARE ASSOCIATED WITH A VERY LOW 5-YEAR SURVIVAL RATE OF LESS THAN 20%. IN ADDITION, ONLY A SMALL PROPORTION OF CANCER PATIENTS IS ELIGIBLE FOR TUMOR RESECTION AND ORGAN TRANSPLANT.  HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA IS THE MOST COMMON FORM OF PRIMARY LIVER CANCER, WITH OVER 500,000 NEW DIAGNOSES EACH YEAR AND A 5-YEAR SURVIVAL RATE OF LESS THAN 18%. IT REMAINS THE 6TH MOST COMMON CANCER WORLDWIDE AND THE 3RD MOST COMMON CAUSE OF CANCER-RELATED DEATHS. UNLIKE OTHER CANCERS, THE DEATH RATE FOR LIVER CANCER HAS INCREASED OVER THE LAST 30 YEARS. IN GENERAL, CHEMOTHERAPEUTIC TREATMENT HAS SHOWN LIMITED EFFECTIVENESS, WITH RESPONSE RATES LESS THAN 20% AND SURVIVAL LESS THAN ONE-YEAR. ONE OF THE FEW OPTIONS AVAILABLE TO THOSE DIAGNOSED WITH HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA IS CATHETER-DIRECTED TRANS-ARTERIAL EMBOLIZATION (WITH AND WITHOUT CHEMOEMBOLIZATION), WHICH IS THE GOLD STANDARD OF CARE FOR THOSE DIAGNOSED WITH INTERMEDIATE- STAGE CARCINOMA. HOWEVER, DESPITE THE PROCEDURE’S USE FOR OVER TWO DECADES, IT REMAINS LARGELY UNSTANDARDIZED, WITH VARIATIONS IN THE SIZE AND TYPE OF EMBOLIZING PARTICLES, CHOICE AND DOSE OF CHEMOTHERAPEUTIC AGENT, AND THE TIME INTERVAL BETWEEN PROCEDURES. THOUGH EFFECTIVE, THE PROCEDURE’S BENEFIT IS MODEST IN THAT THE SURVIVAL IMPROVEMENT IS ONLY 4 MONTHS, AND THE TREATMENT IS ASSOCIATED WITH SAFETY CONCERNS, INCLUDING EMBOLIZATION OF UNINTENDED TERRITORIES. THE PROCEDURE’S EFFICACY IS HAMPERED BY THE TUMOR’S COMPLEX HEMODYNAMICS AND TORTUOUS VASCULATURE, RESULTING IN REGIONS WHICH CANNOT BE RELIABLY AND THOROUGHLY OCCLUDED. IT IS GENERALLY BELIEVED THAT PATIENT OUTCOMES WOULD BE IMPROVED IF PHYSICIANS COULD MORE COMPLETELY EMBOLIZE THE TUMOR’S VASCULAR NETWORK. IF THIS WERE ACHIEVED, THE TUMOR WOULD BE BETTER STARVED OF BLOOD FLOW AND CHEMOTHERAPEUTIC AGENTS COULD BE MORE EFFECTIVELY DELIVERED.  UN&UP HAS DEVELOPED A BREAKTHROUGH TECHNOLOGY THAT ENABLES THE PHYSICIAN TO DIRECTLY CONTROL AND IMPROVE THE DELIVERY OF MAGNETIC EMBOLIZATION BEADS INTO AND THROUGHOUT A TUMOR’S VASCULATURE. BY CREATING UNIQUE MAGNETIC EMBOLIZATION BEADS, WHICH WILL BE SAFE IN AN MR ENVIRONMENT, AND USING THE COMPANY’S NOVEL MAGNET SYSTEM WHICH GENERATES SELECTIVE MAGNETIC INSTABILITIES AT THE TUMOR, EMBOLIZATION BEADS CAN BE CONTROLLED IN A WAY NOT OTHERWISE POSSIBLE. THE RESULT IS A TECHNOLOGY WITH THE POTENTIAL TO PROVIDE SUBSTANTIALLY MORE EFFECTIVE AND SAFER LIVER TUMOR EMBOLIZATIONS FOR HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA PATIENTS.  IN THE PHASE I EFFORT, THE COMPANY WILL 1) FORMULATE THE PROTOTYPE MAGNETIC EMBOLIZATION BEADS, 2) ASSESS IN VITRO MODEL EFFICACY AND MR SAFETY, AND 3) ASSESS IN VIVO EFFICACY IN A RABBIT TUMOR MODEL. AN FDA MEETING IN PLANNED IS ADVANCE OF A PHASE II PROPOSAL.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT OF A PHENOLICS DEPLETION CHIP (PDC) FOR USE IN INSULIN DELIVERY PATCH PUMPS - DEVELOPMENT OF A PHENOLICS DEPLETION CHIP (PDC) FOR USE IN  INSULIN DELIVERY PATCH PUMPS PROJECT SUMMARY:  THE OVERARCHING AIM OF THIS PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP A SMALL, LOW POWER, PHENOLIC DEPLETION CHIP (PDC) THAT WILL REMOVE PHENOLIC COMPOUNDS (PHENOL AND META-CRESOL) FROM INSULIN FORMULATIONS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO INJECTION IN A BODY WORN INSULIN INFUSION DEVICE. REMOVING THE PHENOLIC COMPOUNDS WILL REDUCE IRRITATION, MINIMIZE SITE LOSS, PREVENT FORMATION OF INSULIN FIBRILS AND REDUCE INTERFERENCE WITH CONTINUOUS GLUCOSE MONITORS (CGMS). IF SUCCESSFULLY DEVELOPED, THE PDC WILL EXTEND THE LIFETIME OF WEARABLE CONTINUOUS SUBCUTANEOUS INSULIN INFUSION (CSII) DEVICES AND ALLOW FOR INTEGRATION OF CGMS INTO A SINGLE BODY WORN ARTIFICIAL PANCREAS. IN PHASE I, SFC’S PATENTED FLOW-THROUGH RING ELECTRODE STRUCTURE WILL BE MODIFIED WITH SUBSTRATE COATINGS THAT WILL ELECTROCHEMICALLY OXIDIZE AND TRAP PHENOLIC COMPOUNDS. THE PROOF-OF-CONCEPT FOR DEVELOPMENT OF THIS DEVICE WILL BE DEMONSTRATED BY ACCOMPLISHING THE FOLLOWING TASKS. TASK 1: MODIFY THE FLOW-THROUGH RING ELECTRODE BY COATING WITH VARIOUS SUBSTRATES FOR ELECTROCHEMICAL OXIDATION AND REMOVAL OF PHENOLIC PRESERVATIVES FROM SOLUTION. TASK 2: OPTIMIZE DESIGN AND OPERATIONAL PARAMETERS OF PDC FOR REMOVAL OF PHENOLIC COMPOUNDS. TASK 3: DESIGN PROTOTYPE PDC TO REDUCE PHENOLIC LOAD WITHOUT DAMAGING INSULIN.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: EFFICIENT ACHROMATIC AND CHROMATIC PHOTOSTRESS RECOVERY ASSESSMENT FOR AGE-RELATED MACULAR DEGENERATION - TITLE: EFFICIENT ACHROMATIC AND CHROMATIC PHOTOSTRESS RECOVERY ASSESSMENT FOR AGE-RELATED MACULAR DEGENERATION PROJECT SUMMARY AGE RELATED MACULAR DEGENERATION (AMD) IS THE LEADING CAUSE OF IRREVERSIBLE VISION LOSS IN DEVELOPED NATIONS 1 AND AFFECTS APPROXIMATELY 18.3 MILLION PEOPLE 40 YEARS AND OLDER IN THE UNITED STATES ALONE (REIN ET AL., 2022). RECENT ANTI-VEGF TREATMENTS FOR NEOVASCULAR (EXUDATIVE, WET) AMD AND EMERGING COMPLEMENT PATHWAY INHIBITORS FOR NON-EXUDATIVE (ATROPHIC, DRY) AMD CAN SLOW THE PROGRESSION OF VISION LOSS. IT IS THEREFORE CRITICAL TO DEVELOP SENSITIVE FUNCTIONAL BIOMARKERS THAT CAN DETECT THE EARLY STAGES OF AMD AND THAT ARE SENSITIVE ENOUGH TO DETECT SMALL CHANGES THAT OCCUR DUE TO PROGRESSION OR REMEDIATION OF THE DISEASE. SUCH BIOMARKERS WOULD IMPROVE THE EFFICACY OF EXISTING INTERVENTIONS AND ASSIST THE PATH TO DRUG DISCOVERY. NEURAL, STRUCTURAL, AND VASCULAR RETINAL LAYERS ARE DISRUPTED IN AMD 2 WHICH AFFECTS THE RATE OF PHOTORECEPTOR PIGMENT REGENERATION 3 AND CAN LEAD TO DELAYED PHOTOSTRESS RECOVERY (PR) 4. MANY STUDIES HAVE DEMONSTRATED DELAYED RECOVERY OF PHOTORECEPTOR RESPONSES IN AMD FOLLOWING EXPOSURE TO A BLEACHING LIGHT, FOR RECENT REVIEW SEE 5. THE MAJORITY OF STUDIES HAVE EXAMINED PR FOR ROD PHOTORECEPTORS (DARK ADAPTATION) UTILIZING INTENSE BLEACHING LIGHTS AND LONG TESTING TIMES (UP TO 20 MINUTES PER EYE). THESE TESTS TYPICALLY REQUIRE SPECIALIST EQUIPMENT, DEDICATED LIGHT-CONTROLLED TESTING SPACES AND TECHNICIAN SUPERVISION. A SMALLER NUMBER OF STUDIES HAVE ALSO REVEALED PR DELAYS IN CONE PHOTORECEPTORS IN AMD 6 THAT HAVE FASTER RECOVERY TIMES 7 AND THUS HOLD THE POTENTIAL FOR A FASTER PR ASSESSMENT. IN THIS PROPOSAL, WE DEVELOP A NOVEL, PERSONALIZED, ADAPTIVE METHOD FOR EFFICIENTLY TESTING PR FOR CONE PHOTORECEPTORS IN UNDER 5 MINUTES, AND WE EVALUATE ITS SENSITIVITY TO DIFFERENT STAGES OF AMD AND COMPARE IT WITH CLINICAL STANDARD MARKERS, INCLUDING HIGH AND LOW LUMINANCE VISUAL ACUITY. THE TEST IS SELF-ADMINISTERED, RUNS ON STANDARD COMPUTER EQUIPMENT AND DOES NOT REQUIRE DEDICATED SPACE, LIGHTING OR TECHNICIANS. WE ALSO EVALUATE A VARIANT OF THE METHOD THAT ISOLATES PR ASSESSMENT TO SHORT(S)-, MEDIUM(M)- OR LONG(L)-WAVELENGTH CONE PHOTORECEPTORS TO INVESTIGATE POTENTIAL WITHIN-CONE DIFFERENCES IN AMD AS IT HAS BEEN SHOWN THAT S-CONE COLOR DETECTION SHOWS GREATER DEFICITS COMPARED TO M AND L CONE IN AMD (DOWNIE ET AL., 2014) . THE OVERALL GOAL OF THIS PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP AND EVALUATE NOVEL METHODS TO MEASURE PR IN AMD.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: TESTING OF SCO-116, AN NRF2 ACTIVATOR FOR FUCHS' DYSTROPHY, IN CULTURED HUMAN CORNEAS - ABSTRACT CORNEAL ENDOTHELIAL CELLS (CECS) ACTIVELY PUMP WATER OUT OF THE STROMA AND MAINTAIN CORNEAL CLARITY; THEY ARE REQUIRED FOR VISION. CECS DO NOT REGENERATE, AND ONCE LOST THEY ARE GONE FOREVER. DECLINES IN CEC DENSITY PRODUCE VISUAL DEFICITS AND, ULTIMATELY, BLINDNESS, AND FOR THIS REASON ADVANCED TECHNIQUES TO IMPROVE CEC HEALTH ARE A PART OF THE NEI STRATEGIC PLAN. CURRENTLY, THERE ARE NO APPROVED MEDICINES TO RESTORE CEC FUNCTION ONCE LOST, OR TO PREVENT DEMISE OF CECS WHEN DAMAGED OR DYSFUNCTIONAL. FUCHS’ CORNEAL ENDOTHELIAL DYSTROPHY IS A CHRONIC DISEASE OF THE CEC IN WHICH CELLS DO NOT EFFECTIVELY NEUTRALIZE OXIDATIVE STRESS RESULTING IN CELL DAMAGE AND DEATH. KURIA THERAPEUTICS IS DEVELOPING A NOVEL PRODUCT CONTAINING THE ACTIVE INGREDIENT SCO-116 THAT ACTIVATES NRF2, THE MASTER REGULATOR OF THE ANTIOXIDANT RESPONSE SYSTEM. THROUGH NRF2 ACTIVATION, IT IS PROPOSED THAT CECS WILL BE PROTECTED AND RESCUED FROM OXIDATIVE STRESS AND VISION WILL BE PRESERVED. THE MAIN GOAL OF THIS PHASE 1 APPLICATION IS TO OBTAIN PROOF OF CONCEPT USING CULTURED HUMAN CORNEAS AS A MODEL OF FUCHS’ TO TEST THE EFFICACY OF SCO-116 IN ACTIVATING NRF2 AND PROTECTING HUMAN CEC. STUDIES IN MULTIPLE ANIMAL MODELS, INCLUDING RABBITS AND MONKEYS, HAVE INDICATED SIGNIFICANT INDUCTION OF NRF2 IN CECS FOLLOWING TREATMENT WITH SCO-116. WE THUS PLAN TO PERFORM STUDIES IN CULTURED HUMAN CORNEAS WITH GUTTAE BEFORE PHASE 2 TESTING IN PRECLINICAL ANIMAL STUDIES. THE PROJECT WILL BE COMPLETED THROUGH TWO SPECIFIC AIMS. IN AIM 1, WE WILL TEST A RANGE OF SCO-116 CONCENTRATIONS FOR THE ABILITY TO ACTIVATE NRF2 AND INDUCE EXPRESSION OF ITS TARGET GENES. DECEASED DONOR CORNEAS WITH MILD TO MODERATE GUTTAE COVERAGE MIMICKING FUCHS’ WILL BE CULTURED WITH SCO-116 FOR 5 DAYS AND THEN MRNA WILL BE ISOLATED, CONVERTED TO CDNA AND AMPLIFIED. TEN NRF2 TARGET GENES WILL BE STUDIED ALONG WITH 2 HOUSEKEEPING GENES FOR REFERENCE. ADDITIONALLY, THE POTENTIAL EFFECT OF SCO-116 TREATMENT ON CORNEAL SWELLING WILL BE STUDIED BY DAILY OCT MEASUREMENTS DURING TREATMENT. IN AIM 2, WE WILL TREAT DONOR CORNEAS THAT HAVE MILD TO MODERATE GUTTAE COVERAGE WITH SCO-116 AND ASSESS FOR A REDUCTION IN APOPTOSIS. IT HAS BEEN PREVIOUSLY SHOWN THAT SULFORAPHANE, A NATURAL PRODUCT NRF2 AGONIST, REDUCES APOPTOSIS IN THE ENDOTHELIUM OF FUCHS’ PATIENT CORNEAS. THUS, SULFORAPHANE WILL BE AN IMPORTANT COMPARATOR IN OUR STUDIES. THE ANTICIPATED OUTCOME OF THIS PROPOSED PROJECT IS TO PRODUCE PROOF OF CONCEPT DATA TO SUPPORT A PHASE 2 APPLICATION WHERE SCO-116 IS STUDIED IN LARGER HUMAN CORNEA STUDIES AND PRECLINICAL ANIMAL MODELS OF FUCHS’. THE OVERALL GOAL IS TO TEST SCO-116 IN PATIENTS WITH EARLY FUCHS’ TO PREVENT PROGRESSION OF THE DISEASE AND POTENTIALLY REVERSE THE EARLY VISUAL SYMPTOMS DUE TO CORNEAL EDEMA.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: LOW-COST ROBUST COMPACT 900 NM FEMTOSECOND LASER SOURCE FOR TWO-PHOTON MICROSCOPY - ABSTRACT  ULTRASHORT PULSE LASERS WITH PEAK POWERS >1 KW AND PULSE DURATIONS <100 FS ARE ESSENTIAL FOR TWO-PHOTON EXCITATION MICROSCOPY (TPEM), ENABLING HIGH-RESOLUTION, DEEP-TISSUE IMAGING OF LIVE CELLS WITH REDUCED PHOTOTOXICITY. CURRENT SYSTEMS RELY HEAVILY ON MODE-LOCKED TI:SAPPHIRE LASERS, WHICH OFFER ULTRASHORT PULSES AND BROAD TUNABILITY BUT ARE COSTLY, BULKY, WATER-COOLED, ALIGNMENT-SENSITIVE, AND MAINTENANCE-INTENSIVE. THESE LIMITATIONS RESTRICT WIDESPREAD ADOPTION OF TPEM IN GENERAL LABORATORIES AND CLINICAL ENVIRONMENTS. FIBER LASERS OFFER A TRANSFORMATIVE ALTERNATIVE: COMPACT, ROBUST, ALIGNMENT-FREE, AND LOW-COST SOURCES WITH EXCELLENT THERMAL MANAGEMENT AND BEAM QUALITY. ER3⁺- AND YB3⁺-DOPED FIBER LASERS AT 1.55 ΜM AND 1.0 ΜM HAVE BEEN DEMONSTRATED FOR TWO-PHOTON IMAGING, BUT THEY CANNOT EXCITE COMMONLY USED GREEN FLUORESCENT PROTEINS (GFPS, E.G., EGFP, ECFP), WHICH HAVE PEAK TWO-PHOTON ABSORPTION NEAR 900 NM. TO ADDRESS THIS UNMET NEED, NP PHOTONICS PROPOSES TO DEVELOP A MODE-LOCKED ND3⁺-DOPED PHOSPHOSILICATE FIBER LASER AT 900 NM FOR EFFICIENT GFP EXCITATION.  THE OVERALL OBJECTIVE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP AND DEMONSTRATE A COMPACT, LOW-COST, AND ROBUST ULTRASHORT-PULSE 900-NM FIBER LASER SOURCE FOR TWO-PHOTON EXCITATION MICROSCOPY. THE LONG-TERM GOAL IS TO COMMERCIALIZE A PORTABLE TWO-PHOTON MICROSCOPY PLATFORM BROADLY ACCESSIBLE TO LIFE SCIENCES AND CLINICAL USERS. THE PHASE I GOAL IS TO DEVELOP NEW MODE-LOCKED ND3+-DOPED PHOSPHOSILICATE FIBER LASER AT 900 NM AND DEMONSTRATE ITS CAPABILITY IN EFFICIENT TWO-PHOTON EXCITATION OF GREEN FLUORESCENCE PROTEINS. agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: HIGH-THROUGHPUT SNAPSHOT HYPERSPECTRAL IMAGER FOR MULTIPLEXED FLUORESCENCE MICROSCOPY - HIGH-MULTIPLEX TISSUE IMAGING (HMTI) IS AIDING BIOMEDICAL RESEARCH BY ENABLING SCIENTISTS TO MAP DOZENS OF MOLECULAR MARKERS WITHIN INTACT TISSUES WHILE PRESERVING SPATIAL CONTEXT. THIS ABILITY IS INCREASINGLY IMPORTANT TO UNDERSTANDING CELL BIOLOGY, AND ADVANCING SPATIAL OMICS AND PRECISION MEDICINE. CURRENTLY, HOWEVER, BARRIERS REMAIN DUE TO THE OPTICAL PROPERTIES OF FLUOROPHORES, THE TIME-CONSUMING CYCLIC PROTOCOLS INVOLVING SEQUENTIAL ROUNDS OF STAINING/ILLUMINATION/IMAGING AND INCOMPATIBILITY WITH IN-VIVO IMAGING. ADVANCING THE STATE-OF-THE-ART IN HIGH-MULTIPLEX, WIDEFIELD FLUORESCENCE MICROSCOPY WILL FURTHER HIGH-THROUGHPUT, HIGH-ACCURACY BIOMARKER DISCOVERY, TISSUE MAPPING, AND MECHANISTIC BIOLOGY - AREAS CENTRAL TO THE NIH AND NIGMS MISSIONS. SNAPSHOT HYPERSPECTRAL IMAGING (SHSI) ENABLES THE CAPTURE OF A COMPLETE HYPERSPECTRAL DATACUBE - CONTAINING BOTH SPECTRAL AND SPATIAL INFORMATION OF THE FLUORESCENT SAMPLE - WITHIN A SINGLE EXPOSURE OF A WIDEFIELD FLUORESCENT MICROSCOPE. BY RECORDING A FULL EMISSION SPECTRUM AT EVERY PIXEL, SHSI ELIMINATES THE NEED FOR CONFOCAL SCANNING OPTICS OR REPEATED STAINING/IMAGING CYCLES SINCE EMISSION SPECTRA CAN BE USED TO UNMIX LOCAL FLUOROPHORE CONCENTRATIONS. IN COMBINATION WITH A CUSTOM FILTER CUBE, THE PROPOSED SYSTEM IS A DROP-IN REPLACEMENT FOR STANDARD SCIENTIFIC CAMERAS, LEVERAGING PROPRIETARY PLASMONIC FILTER ARRAYS INTEGRATED WITH MODERN, BACKSIDE ILLUMINATED CMOS SENSORS. IN PHASE I, WE WILL (1) DESIGN AND FABRICATE A FILTER ARRAY OPTIMIZED FOR FLUORESCENCE UNMIXING, (2) ADAPT COMPRESSIVE SENSING ALGORITHMS FOR ACCURATE SPECTRAL RECOVERY OF FLUORESCENCE SIGNALS, AND (3) DEMONSTRATE SYSTEM-LEVEL FEASIBILITY AND QUANTIFY PERFORMANCE BY IMAGING MIXTURES OF FLUORESCENT MICROSPHERES WITH KNOWN EMISSION SPECTRA. FINALLY, A COMMERCIALLY PREPARED AND STAINED SAMPLE WILL BE CHARACTERIZED AND THE RESULTS COMPARED WITH A COMMERCIAL WIDEFIELD MICROSCOPE. COMPLETION OF THESE AIMS WILL ESTABLISH THE TECHNICAL FOUNDATION FOR THE USE OF SHSI IN WIDEFIELD FLUORESCENCE MICROSCOPY.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: FERTILICHIP: AN INNOVATIVE FALLOPIAN TUBE-ON-CHIP MODEL FOR WOMEN'S REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH RESEARCH - PROJECT SUMMARY PELVIC INFLAMMATORY DISEASE (PID) IS A HIDDEN CRISIS AFFECTING WOMEN'S REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH, COSTING THE US OVER $4.5 BILLION ANNUALLY, CONTRIBUTING TO DECLINING BIRTH RATES, AND AFFECTING APPROXIMATELY 750,000 AMERICAN WOMEN EACH YEAR. PID IS TRIGGERED BY SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED INFECTIONS (STIS) LIKE CHLAMYDIA TRACHOMATIS (CT) AND NEISSERIA GONORRHOEAE (NG), CAUSING SEVERE COMPLICATIONS SUCH AS CHRONIC PELVIC PAIN, ECTOPIC PREGNANCY, INFERTILITY, AND INCREASED OVARIAN/CERVICAL CANCER RISK. CURRENT TREATMENTS WITH ANTIBIOTICS CANNOT REVERSE TISSUE DAMAGE OR CURE LONG-TERM COMPLICATIONS DUE TO CHRONIC INFLAMMATION. PID REMAINS UNDERFUNDED AND UNDERDIAGNOSED AND LACKS EARLY DIAGNOSTIC TOOLS AND TREATMENT. CURRENT IN VITRO FT MODELS LACK THE CELLULAR COMPLEXITY AND PHYSIOLOGICAL FLOW CONDITION TO ACCURATELY REPRODUCE THE IN VIVO SYSTEM, AND IN VIVO MODELS ARE EXPENSIVE AND DO NOT REFLECT HUMAN ANATOMY AND RESPONSE. MOREOVER, FEDERAL AGENCIES (FDA, NIH) HAVE CALLED TO REDUCE ANIMAL TESTING IN FAVOR OF NEW APPROACH METHODOLOGIES (NAMS). WE PROPOSE TO DEVELOP FERTILICHIP, AN INNOVATIVE FT-ON-CHIP MODEL TO ADVANCE WOMEN’S REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH RESEARCH. THE FERTILICHIP WILL BE THE FIRST COMPREHENSIVE, VASCULARIZED HUMAN FT IN-VITRO MODEL SYSTEM, INCORPORATING FOUR KEY CELL TYPES UNDER PHYSIOLOGICAL CONDITIONS. THIS PLATFORM WILL ENABLE RESEARCH ON STI OR FT DISEASE PROGRESSION, BIOMARKER DISCOVERY, THERAPEUTIC DEVELOPMENT, HOST-PATHOGEN INTERACTIONS, AND HORMONAL RESPONSES. FOUR FT CELL TYPES, SECRETORY EPITHELIAL CELLS (SECS), CILIATED EPITHELIAL CELLS (CECS), LAMINA PROPRIA FIBROBLASTS (LPFS), AND SMOOTH MUSCLE CELLS (SMCS), WILL BE UTILIZED FOR THE IN VITRO MODEL USING POLYDIMETHYLSILOXANE (PDMS)-BASED MICROFLUIDIC DEVICES. PRIMARY FT EPITHELIAL CELLS WILL BE DIFFERENTIATED INTO SECS AND CECS USING ESTRADIOL. MODEL DEVELOPMENT PROTOCOLS WILL BE OPTIMIZED FOR BASEMENT MEMBRANE, MEDIA COMPATIBILITY, SEEDING DENSITY AND ORDER, FLOW RATES, AND CT MULTIPLICITY OF INFECTION (MOI). SUCCESS METRICS INCLUDE ≥90% CELL VIABILITY, POSITIVE BIOMARKER IDENTIFICATION, CONFIRMED CILIA BEATING FUNCTION, AND OPTIMAL CONFLUENCY WITHIN THE MICROFLUIDIC DEVICES. HEALTHY FERTILICHIPS WILL THEN BE INFECTED WITH CT TO INDUCE AN EARLY PID-LIKE INFLAMMATION STATE. INFECTION PROGRESSION WILL BE TRACKED THROUGH DIRECT CT ANTIBODY STAINING, AND INFLAMMATORY GENE EXPRESSION WILL BE MONITORED VIA RT-QPCR. SUCCESS METRICS INCLUDE AN OPTIMIZED MOI OF CT THAT SUCCESSFULLY INFECTS FERTILICHIPS AND PRODUCES A SIGNIFICANT (P<0.05) OVEREXPRESSION OF ≥80% OF SELECTED KEY PID-INFLAMMATION MARKERS. FERTILICHIP WILL ADDRESS A MAJOR GAP IN CURRENT RESEARCH CAPABILITIES AND ACCELERATE CRITICAL RESEARCH AREAS, PROVIDING BREAKTHROUGH TOOLS TO PREVENT PID FROM DEVASTATING WOMEN'S REPRODUCTIVE FUTURES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: RELIABLE DETECTION OF ROBERTSONIAN TRANSLOCATIONS VIA GENOMIC PROXIMITY MAPPING - ABSTRACT ROBERTSONIAN TRANSLOCATIONS—WHOLE-ARM FUSIONS BETWEEN Q-ARMS OF ACROCENTRIC CHROMOSOMES— ARE AMONG THE MOST COMMON LARGE STRUCTURAL REARRANGEMENTS IN HUMANS, YET REMAIN CHALLENGING TO DETECT WITH CURRENT HIGH-THROUGHOUT GENOMICS TECHNIQUES. THIS IS DUE TO THE HIGHLY REPETITIVE NATURE OF THE ACROCENTRIC P-ARMS IN WHICH BREAKPOINTS OCCUR. THE PROPOSED PROJECT AIMS TO DEVELOP THE FIRST NGS-BASED METHOD FOR DETECTING ALL TYPES OF ROBERTSONIAN TRANSLOCATIONS BY INTEGRATING DISTAL JUNCTION (DJ) COPY NUMBER ANALYSIS WITH GENOMIC PROXIMITY MAPPING (GPM), A HI-C–BASED STRUCTURAL VARIANT DETECTION APPROACH. BY MODIFYING THE REFERENCE GENOME TO MASK ENDOGENOUS DJ SEQUENCES AND INTRODUCING A SINGLE ARTIFICIAL DJ CONTIG, WE WILL ENABLE ACCURATE DJ COPY NUMBER ESTIMATIONS WHILE PRESERVING COMPATIBILITY WITH CLINICAL-GRADE GENOME ASSEMBLIES. COMBINED WITH PROXIMITY LIGATION DATA, THIS APPROACH WILL ALLOW US TO INFER BOTH THE PRESENCE AND IDENTITY OF FUSED ACROCENTRIC CHROMOSOMES, OVERCOMING A LONG-STANDING GAP IN SCALABLE NGS DIAGNOSTICS. THE RESULTING METHODS WILL ENHANCE THE CLINICAL UTILITY OF GPM AND BRING US CLOSER TO A COMPREHENSIVE SEQUENCING-BASED REPLACEMENT FOR TRADITIONAL CYTOGENETICS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: A CARDIOPULMONARY UNIT-ON-A-CHIP TO INVESTIGATE THE PATHOPHYSIOLOGY AND DEVELOP TARGETED TREATMENTS FOR RIGHT VENTRICULAR HYPERTROPHY CAUSED BY PULMONARY ARTERIAL HYPERTENSION - PROJECT SUMMARY: RIGHT VENTRICULAR HYPERTROPHY (RVH), THE PRIMARY CAUSE OF MORTALITY IN PATIENTS WITH PULMONARY ARTERIAL HYPERTENSION (PAH), DEVELOPS FROM INCREASED RESISTANCE IN THE PULMONARY CIRCULATION, NECESSITATING GREATER WORK FROM THE HEART. THE COMPLEX PATHOBIOLOGY OF PAH-RVH INVOLVES MECHANICAL, ELECTRICAL, CHEMICAL, CELLULAR, AND MOLECULAR CHANGES IN THE RV, INCLUDING THE INFLUENCE OF BIOLOGICAL SEX AND SEX HORMONES. DESPITE THE SIGNIFICANT CLINICAL NEED, THE STRUCTURAL, METABOLIC, AND MOLECULAR FOUNDATIONS OF RVH, INCLUDING SEX-BASED DIFFERENCES, REMAIN UNDER- INVESTIGATED. THIS IS DUE TO THE ABSENCE OF SOPHISTICATED MODELS THAT ACCURATELY MIMIC HUMAN PAH-RVH, HINDERING THE DEVELOPMENT OF EFFECTIVE TREATMENTS. TRADITIONAL APPROACHES, SUCH AS ANIMAL MODELS, RV BIOPSIES, AND 2D CELLULAR MODELS, ARE INSUFFICIENT. THESE METHODS FAIL TO CAPTURE THE FULL SPECTRUM OF RVH MANIFESTATIONS IN HUMANS, DIFFERENTIATE ADAPTIVE FROM MALADAPTIVE HYPERTROPHY, OR ELUCIDATE THE INTERACTION BETWEEN THE RV AND PULMONARY VASCULATURE. THUS, THERE IS A CRITICAL NEED FOR AN INNOVATIVE MODEL THAT ACCURATELY REFLECTS PAH-RVH IN BOTH SEXES TO BRIDGE KNOWLEDGE GAPS AND FACILITATE TARGETED THERAPY DEVELOPMENT. MICROFLUIDIC TECHNOLOGY HAS GIVEN RISE TO THE CUTTING-EDGE EXPERIMENTAL MODEL SYSTEM TERMED ‘ORGAN- OR DISEASE-ON-A-CHIP’, ALLOWING FOR MICROSCALE ORGAN SYSTEM REPRESENTATION. IN THE ABSENCE OF EXISTING MODELS FOR PAH, WE RECENTLY DEVELOPED A MICROFLUIDIC CHIP THAT SIMULATES THE CONDITIONS OF PAH-AFFECTED PULMONARY ARTERIES OR ARTERIOLES. WE REFINED THE DEVICE TO MIMIC BOTH THE RV AND PULMONARY ARTERY, SEPARATED BY A COLLAGEN LAYER, ENABLING THE CULTURING OF CARDIOMYOCYTES AND PULMONARY ARTERIAL CELLS. WE NOW SEEK TO DEVELOP A MORE SOPHISTICATED MODEL SYSTEM TERMED ‘CARDIOPULMONARY UNIT-ON-A-CHIP’ BY INCORPORATING THREE MAJOR PHYSIOLOGICALLY RELEVANT FEATURES OF THE RV: RHYTHMIC CONTRACTION AND EXPANSION, BLOOD FLOW-INDUCED PRESSURE, AND ELECTRICAL STIMULATION. THIS MODEL WILL INTEGRATE TWO CHIPS, ONE EMULATING THE RV AND THE OTHER THE PULMONARY ARTERY (PA), EQUIPPED TO PRODUCE RHYTHMIC HEARTBEATS, RIGHT VENTRICULAR OR PULMONARY ARTERIAL PRESSURE, AND AN ELECTROPHYSIOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT. BY CULTURING RELEVANT CELLS ON THE CHIPS, WE AIM TO REPLICATE KEY PAH-RVH PATHOLOGIES, EXPLORE THE EFFECTS OF BIOLOGICAL SEX AND SEX HORMONES, AND ASSESS THE BENEFITS OF CURRENT PAH AND RV-TARGETED MEDICATIONS. THE INVESTIGATIVE TEAM COMPRISES EXPERTS IN PAH MODELS, CARDIAC PHYSIOLOGY, MICROFLUIDICS, CELL BIOLOGY, PATIENT CARE, AND BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, AND IS HIGHLY QUALIFIED TO ACCOMPLISH THE GOALS OF THIS PROJECT. THIS IS A TRULY INNOVATIVE PROJECT, BOTH IN CONCEPT AND POTENTIAL CLINICAL APPLICATION. IT DEPLOYS MICROENGINEERING PRECISION TO UNDERSTAND PATHOLOGICAL PROCESSES AND DEVELOP RVH THERAPIES. THIS NOVEL MODEL HAS THE POTENTIAL TO TRANSFORM EXPERIMENTAL MODEL SYSTEMS, WITH APPLICATIONS EXTENDING BEYOND PAH-RVH TO OTHER CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASES. IMPORTANTLY, THIS NEAR-PHYSIOLOGICAL MODEL, WHICH EMULATES THE TISSUE-LEVEL FUNCTIONALITY OF TWO VITAL ORGAN SYSTEMS (THE HEART AND PULMONARY VASCULATURE), ALIGNS WITH THE NIH PRECISION MEDICINE INITIATIVE'S FOCUS ON PERSONALIZED MEDICINE AND THE FDA’S EFFORTS TO MODERNIZE DRUG DEVELOPMENT, ADHERING TO THE 3RS PRINCIPLE (REPLACE, REDUCE, REFINE) FOR ETHICAL ANIMAL RESEARCH.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: A WEARABLE DEVICE FOR AT-HOME SLEEP STUDIES THAT MERGES COMFORT WITH CLINICAL-GRADE INSIGHTS - OBSTRUCTIVE SLEEP APNEA (OSA) AFFECTS AN ESTIMATED 30 MILLION AMERICANS, WITH 80-90% OF ADULTS WITH SLEEP-DISORDERED BREATHING REMAINING UNDIAGNOSED. THIS WIDESPREAD CONDITION IMPOSES A SUBSTANTIAL BURDEN ON THE U.S. HEALTHCARE SYSTEM, COSTING APPROXIMATELY $95 BILLION ANNUALLY. CURRENT DIAGNOSTIC METHODS FOR SLEEP APNEA—POLYSOMNOGRAPHY (PSG) AND HOME SLEEP APNEA TESTING (HSAT)—HAVE SIGNIFICANT LIMITATIONS. PSG IS PHYSICALLY BURDENSOME, COSTLY, AND INCREASINGLY INACCESSIBLE, WHILE HSAT, THOUGH MORE AFFORDABLE, SUFFERS FROM HIGH FALSE-NEGATIVE RATES AND LACKS CRITICAL SIGNALS NECESSARY TO DIFFERENTIATE SLEEP FROM WAKE STATES. MOST NOTABLY, CURRENT PORTABLE DIAGNOSTICS SACRIFICE CRITICAL PHYSIOLOGICAL INFORMATION LIKE EEG MEASUREMENTS, WHICH CAN LEAD TO UNDERESTIMATION OF OSA SEVERITY AND INABILITY TO DETECT AROUSALS. OUR TEAM AT FASCIA IS DEVELOPING THE FASCIA SLEEP ECOSYSTEM, AN INNOVATIVE HOME-BASED SLEEP MONITORING SYSTEM THAT INTEGRATES FLEXIBLE ELECTRONICS AND ADVANCED FABRIC-BASED SENSING TECHNOLOGY INTO A USER-FRIENDLY WEARABLE DEVICE. THE FASCIA SLEEP MASK CAPTURES COMPREHENSIVE PHYSIOLOGICAL DATA COMPARABLE TO LEVEL II PSG, INCLUDING ELECTROENCEPHALOGRAPHY (EEG), ELECTROOCULOGRAPHY (EOG), ELECTROMYOGRAPHY (EMG), HEART RATE, BLOOD OXYGENATION, SKIN TEMPERATURE, AND MOVEMENT. THE FASCIA SLEEP COMPANION APP AIDS IN SETUP AND TROUBLESHOOTING, WHILE THE FASCIA SLEEP PORTAL LEVERAGES ADVANCED MACHINE LEARNING ALGORITHMS TO INTERPRET RAW SENSOR DATA AND PROVIDE ACTIONABLE INSIGHTS. THERE ARE TWO SPECIFIC AIMS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS PHASE I PROJECT. FIRST, WE WILL EVALUATE THE USABILITY AND COMFORT OF OUR WEARABLE SLEEP TESTING DEVICE ACROSS A DIVERSE POPULATION OF 30 PARTICIPANTS (15 HEALTHY, 15 WITH OSA) WHO WILL RECEIVE $250 IN COMPENSATION. SECOND, WE WILL CONDUCT A PRELIMINARY DATA VALIDATION BY COMPARING THE FASCIA SLEEP ECOSYSTEM TO A COMMERCIALLY AVAILABLE HSAT DEVICE. PARTICIPANTS WILL UNDERGO A FOUR-NIGHT SLEEP STUDY IN THEIR HOMES, WEARING THE FASCIA DEVICE FOR ONE NIGHT, THE HSAT DEVICE FOR ONE NIGHT, AND BOTH DEVICES SIMULTANEOUSLY FOR TWO NIGHTS. FOR THIS PROJECT WE WILL DEVELOP AND TEST TWO HYBRID LSTM-CNN ARCHITECTURES WITH CROSS-ATTENTION MODULES FOR PHYSIOLOGICAL SIGNAL INTERPRETATION—ONE FOR ESTIMATING AIRFLOW AND ANOTHER FOR IDENTIFYING AROUSALS, BOTH CRITICAL MEASURES FOR THE DETECTION OF APNEA/HYPOPNEA EVENTS. THESE MODELS WILL BE TRAINED ON EXISTING DATASETS AND DATA COLLECTED DURING THIS PROJECT. WE WILL VALIDATE THE FASCIA SLEEP ECOSYSTEM THROUGH THREE COMPARISON APPROACHES: (1) COMPARING OUTPUTS TO THE NOX T3 HSAT DEVICE, (2) EXPERT ANNOTATIONS FROM THE UMASS SLEEP LAB, AND (3) BREATH-BY-BREATH ANALYSIS BY SLEEP MEDICINE EXPERTS. SUCCESS IN THIS PHASE I PROJECT WILL DEMONSTRATE THAT OUR WEARABLE TECHNOLOGY CAN BE WORN COMFORTABLY FOR A FULL NIGHT OF SLEEP AND ACCURATELY MEASURE OSA, WITH SPECIFIC MILESTONES INCLUDING AHI AND ODI MEASUREMENTS WITHIN ±5 EVENTS/HOUR OF NOX T3 VALUES, AROUSAL DETECTION WITH ≥80% SENSITIVITY, AND RELIABLE MEASUREMENT OF NIGHT-TO-NIGHT VARIABILITY IN SLEEP APNEA SEVERITY. THESE FINDINGS WILL PAVE THE WAY FOR PRODUCT OPTIMIZATION AND COMMERCIALIZATION EFFORTS IN PHASE II, IN WHICH WE'LL IMPLEMENT DESIGN IMPROVEMENTS AND DEVELOP ALGORITHMS FOR DETECTING SLEEP CONDITIONS BEYOND OSA, INCLUDING PARASOMNIA, NARCOLEPSY, RESTLESS LEG SYNDROME, AS WELL AS IDENTIFYING BIOMARKERS RELATED TO COGNITIVE DECLINE. WE WILL FURTHERMORE PROGRESS TOWARD FDA CLEARANCE FOR DIAGNOSTIC SLEEP SCREENING. FASCIA'S APPROACH TO SLEEP DIAGNOSTICS OFFERS THE POTENTIAL TO REVOLUTIONIZE SLEEP HEALTH MANAGEMENT BY PROVIDING ACCESSIBLE, COMPREHENSIVE, AND ACCURATE SLEEP ANALYSIS. THIS TECHNOLOGY CAN EXPAND ACCESS TO CARE FOR THE MILLIONS WHO GO UNDIAGNOSED DUE TO PHYSICAL, FINANCIAL, OR GEOGRAPHICAL LIMITATIONS, ULTIMATELY IMPROVING PUBLIC HEALTH OUTCOMES AND REDUCING HEALTHCARE COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH UNTREATED SLEEP DISORDERS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: CORFIGO HEARTPAD CRYOABLATION SYSTEM - ABSTRACT ATRIAL FIBRILLATION (AF) IS A HEART RHYTHM DISORDER ASSOCIATED WITH SIGNIFICANT MORBIDITY AND PREMATURE MORTALITY. EARLIER STAGE DISEASE RESPONDS WELL TO CATHETER ABLATION (CA) OF THE HEART VIA THE GROIN. INTERMEDIATE AND LATE- STAGE AF ARE MORE CA-RESISTANT, WITH RECURRENCE OF AF BEING RELATED TO MORE COMPLEX TARGET SUBSTRATE PRIMARILY LOCALIZED TO THE POSTERIOR WALL OF THE LEFT ATRIUM. THE POSTERIOR WALL CAN BECOME DIFFICULT TO TREAT WITH CA FROM INSIDE OF THE HEART BECAUSE OF INFILTRATION OF SCAR AND FIBRO-FATTY TISSUE THAT AFFECT ABLATIVE ENERGY DISPERSION. IN ADDITION, EPICARDIAL ADIPOSE TISSUE (EAT) ON THE OUTER SURFACE OF THE LEFT ATRIUM, IS COMMON IN LATER STAGE AF AND IS KNOWN TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH CA FAILURES. CONVENTIONAL OPEN-HEART SURGERY IS EFFECTIVE BUT HIGHLY INVASIVE. DEVICES EXIST THAT CAN PERFORM ABLATION OF THE CLOSED LEFT ATRIUM EITHER DURING OPEN-HEART SURGERY OR IN A MINIMALLY INVASIVE SURGICAL SETTING, BUT THESE APPROACHES ARE LESS EFFECTIVE IN LATE-STAGE AF. THEY MAY ALSO REQUIRE THE USE OF A HEART-LUNG MACHINE AND USE ENERGY SOURCES THAT CANNOT RELIABLY ABLATE THROUGH EAT. THERE IS A NEED FOR A DEVICE THAT CAN DURABLY ABLATE CONTIGUOUS EAT AND ATRIAL MUSCLE WITHOUT BIPOLAR CLAMPING FROM THE OUTER SURFACE OF THE LEFT ATRIUM ON A WARM BEATING HEART. CORFIGO, INC IS DEVELOPING THE PATENTED HEARTPAD CRYOABLATION SYSTEM, POWERED BY LIQUID HELIUM (-269°C) AND HIGH-EFFICIENCY HEAT EXCHANGERS. CORFIGO’S EPICARDIAL CRYOABLATION PLATFORM LEVERAGES EXTREMELY POTENT COOLING THAT ACCOMPLISHES FULL-THICKNESS ABLATION OF HEART TISSUE FROM THE OUTSIDE OF A WARM AND FULL BEATING HEART DESPITE EAT COVERAGE AND WITHOUT THE NEED TO OPEN A HEART CHAMBER OR USE CARDIOPULMONARY BYPASS. THE OVERALL GOAL OF THIS SBIR IS TO FURTHER DEVELOP THE HEARTPAD IN PREPARATION FOR COMMERCIALIZATION IN THE HEART RHYTHM MARKET. PHASE I EFFORTS WILL FOCUS ON DEMONSTRATING THE OVERALL FEASIBILITY OF THE NEW HEARTPAD DEVICE TO PENETRATE EAT OF INCREASING THICKNESSES IN A BEATING HEART SIMULATION. AIM 1: REFINE HEARTPAD PROTOTYPE DESIGN. THIS AIM FOCUSES ON DEVELOPING A PROTOTYPE THAT MAXIMIZES CRYOABLATION POTENCY IN A CONFIGURATION THAT IS OPTIMIZED FOR POSTERIOR WALL EPICARDIAL ABLATION IN A SIMILAR WAY TO AN FDA-APPROVED DEVICE; IDENTIFY COMPONENTS AND BUILD PROTOTYPES. AIM 2: DEMONSTRATE HEARTPAD PERFORMANCE IN A SOPHISTICATED HEART SIMULATOR. SUBSURFACE TISSUE TEMPERATURES WILL BE MEASURED DURING MOCK ABLATIONS OF VALIDATED SYNTHETIC HUMAN LEFT ATRIUM TISSUE BLOCKS WITH PROGRESSIVELY THICKER EAT IN A SIMULATOR USING THE HEARTPAD PROTOTYPE. AT THE END OF PHASE I, CORFIGO WILL HAVE DEMONSTRATED CONVINCINGLY THAT ITS EPICARDIAL ABLATION DEVICE CAN ABLATE THROUGH THICK EAT UNDER PHYSIOLOGIC BEATING HEART CONDITIONS. PHASE II WILL FOCUS ON FREEZING DEVICE DESIGN AND COMPLETING REQUIRED REGULATORY TESTING IN PREPARATION FOR SUBMISSION TO THE FDA. ONCE COMMERCIALIZED, BOTH CARDIOLOGISTS AND SURGEONS WILL USE THE HEARTPADÒ TO ADDRESS THE STANDALONE LATE-STAGE AF AND OTHER MARKETS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: ADVANCING PEDIATRIC ECMO THROUGH A BIOCOMPATIBLE SYSTEM DESIGN - PROJECT SUMMARY INFLO MEDICAL IS REVOLUTIONIZING PEDIATRIC ECMO WITH A NEXT-GENERATION SYSTEM ENGINEERED TO MINIMIZE HEMOLYSIS AND THROMBOSIS, DELIVERING SAFER, MORE RELIABLE LIFE SUPPORT FOR CRITICALLY ILL CHILDREN. EXTRACORPOREAL MEMBRANE OXYGENATION (ECMO) THERAPY IS ONE OF THE MOST POWERFUL TOOLS IN MODERN PEDIATRIC CRITICAL CARE—OFTEN THE LAST RESORT FOR CHILDREN SUFFERING FROM LIFE-THREATENING HEART AND LUNG FAILURE. HOWEVER, DESPITE ITS LIFE-SAVING POTENTIAL, CURRENT ECMO TECHNOLOGY IS CONSTRAINED BY OUTDATED DESIGNS AND HIGH COMPLICATION RATES, PARTICULARLY IN PEDIATRIC PATIENTS THAT OFTEN PRESENT WITH DISTURBED COAGULATION PATHWAYS.
