THROMBOSIS IN THE PUMP AND OXYGENATOR COMPONENTS REMAINS A MAJOR CHALLENGE, CONTRIBUTING TO A STAGGERING 38% COMPLICATION RATE IN CHILDREN AND LIMITING BROADER CLINICAL ADOPTION. AS THE GLOBAL BURDEN OF CRITICAL ILLNESS— INCLUDING CONDITIONS LIKE SEPSIS, WHICH CAUSES 1 IN 5 CHILD DEATHS—CONTINUES TO RISE, THERE IS AN URGENT NEED FOR SAFER, MORE ACCESSIBLE ECMO SOLUTIONS TAILORED TO THE UNIQUE NEEDS OF PEDIATRIC PATIENTS. TO ADDRESS THESE URGENT GAPS, INFLO MEDICAL WILL OPTIMIZE ITS NEXT-GENERATION ECMO PLATFORM, THE MOBYBOX, FOR PEDIATRIC USE. THIS COMPACT SYSTEM INCORPORATES A PULSATILE DISPLACEMENT PUMP, AND AN ADVANCED GAS EXCHANGER, SPECIFICALLY ENGINEERED TO REDUCE THROMBOGENICITY AND IMPROVE GAS EXCHANGE PERFORMANCE. EARLY STUDIES IN ANIMAL MODELS AND CLINICAL SETTINGS HAVE ALREADY SHOWN A MARKED REDUCTION IN THROMBUS FORMATION FOR THE ADULT MODEL COMPARED TO EXISTING COMMERCIAL SYSTEMS. THIS NIH SBIR PHASE I PROPOSAL AIMS TO EXPAND MOBYBOX’S CAPABILITIES TO MEET THE DELICATE REQUIREMENTS OF PEDIATRIC ECMO THROUGH TWO COMPLEMENTARY AIMS:  • AIM 1: REDESIGN THE GAS EXCHANGER’S FLOW PATH TO ENHANCE HEMOCOMPATIBILITY WHILE MINIMIZING PRIMING  VOLUME. OXYGENATOR GEOMETRIES WILL BE ITERATIVELY OPTIMIZED USING COMPUTATIONAL FLUID DYNAMICS TO ENSURE  UNIFORM BLOOD FLOW AND REDUCED SHEAR STRESS AT LOW PEDIATRIC FLOW RATES. THESE DESIGNS WILL BE VALIDATED  THROUGH BENCHTOP TESTING AND OVINE ANIMAL MODELS.  • AIM 2: OPTIMIZE THE DISPLACEMENT PUMP FOR PEDIATRIC FLOW CONDITIONS AND BENCHMARK ITS PERFORMANCE  AGAINST TRADITIONAL CENTRIFUGAL PUMPS. BECAUSE ADVERSE EVENTS LIKE THROMBUS FORMATION AND CIRCUIT FAILURE  ARE MORE LIKELY AT LOW FLOW RATES, THIS AIM WILL DIRECTLY EVALUATE BIOCOMPATIBILITY AND BLOOD DAMAGE METRICS,  TESTING THE HYPOTHESIS THAT OUR PULSATILE PUMP REDUCES SHEAR STRESS, HEMOLYSIS, AND CLOTTING RISK. BY ADDRESSING THE CRITICAL LIMITATIONS OF CURRENT ECMO TECHNOLOGY, THIS PROJECT HAS THE POTENTIAL TO SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCE COMPLICATIONS AND EXPAND ACCESS TO LIFE-SAVING EXTRACORPOREAL SUPPORT FOR TENS OF THOUSANDS OF VULNERABLE CHILDREN EACH YEAR. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION WILL GENERATE KEY VALIDATION DATA TO SUPPORT FUTURE FDA 510(K) CLEARANCE AND ACCELERATE THE PATH TO COMMERCIALIZATION FOR PEDIATRIC APPLICATIONS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: ASTHMA MANAGEMENT BY MONITORING NITRIC OXIDE (NO) LEVELS IN EXHALED BREATH - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT ASTHMA AFFECTS OVER 28 MILLION PEOPLE IN THE U.S. AND IS THE MOST COMMON CHRONIC ILLNESS IN CHILDREN. EFFECTIVE MANAGEMENT DEPENDS ON ACCURATE MONITORING OF AIRWAY INFLAMMATION. FRACTIONAL EXHALED NITRIC OXIDE (FENO) IS A VALIDATED BIOMARKER OF AIRWAY INFLAMMATION, AND REGULAR FENO MONITORING CAN IMPROVE ASTHMA CONTROL, REDUCE EXACERBATIONS, AND SUPPORT PERSONALIZED TREATMENT. HOWEVER, CURRENT FENO MONITORING TECHNOLOGIES ARE COSTLY, CLINIC-BASED, AND OFTEN NOT CHILD-FRIENDLY. TO ADDRESS THIS GAP, THIS PROJECT PROPOSES THE DEVELOPMENT OF A LOW- COST, PORTABLE FENO BREATHALYZER DESIGNED FOR HOME USE BY CHILDREN AGED 6 AND UP. THE PROPOSED SYSTEM WILL INTEGRATE A COMPACT ELECTROCHEMICAL NO SENSOR, HUMIDITY CONTROL MODULE, AND A BLUETOOTH-ENABLED INTERFACE WITH A COMPANION SMARTPHONE APP. THIS TECHNOLOGY WILL ALLOW CHILDREN AND THEIR CAREGIVERS TO MEASURE FENO LEVELS EASILY AT HOME AND TRANSMIT DATA TO CLINICIANS FOR REMOTE MONITORING. PHASE I WILL FOCUS ON BUILDING AND VALIDATING A HANDHELD PROTOTYPE USING THE ALPHASENSE NO-B4 SENSOR, DEVELOPING A HUMIDITY CONTROL SYSTEM, AND CREATING REAL-TIME SIGNAL PROCESSING ALGORITHMS. THE PROTOTYPE WILL BE EVALUATED IN A CLINICAL STUDY WITH PEDIATRIC ASTHMA PATIENTS AT BOSTON CHILDREN’S HOSPITAL. THE DEVICE AIMS TO PROVIDE ACCURATE, MAINTENANCE-FREE OPERATION WITH A USER-CENTERED DESIGN. A KEY INNOVATION IS ITS ADAPTABILITY FOR PEDIATRIC USE, ADDRESSING CURRENT BARRIERS TO ROUTINE FENO TESTING. THIS SOLUTION SUPPORTS EARLY DETECTION OF AIRWAY INFLAMMATION AND TIMELY THERAPY ADJUSTMENTS. IT ALIGNS WITH THE NIH MISSION BY IMPROVING ASTHMA MANAGEMENT AND ADVANCING HOME-BASED DIAGNOSTICS. A SUCCESSFUL PROTOTYPE WILL LAY THE GROUNDWORK FOR PHASE II DEVELOPMENT, REGULATORY APPROVAL, AND FUTURE COMMERCIALIZATION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: COOLED RF BRONCHOSCOPIC LUNG VOLUME REDUCTION - PROJECT SUMMARY IN THE UNITED STATES, CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISORDER (COPD), RANKS FOURTH IN THE LEADING CAUSES OF MORTALITY WITH OVER 140,000 DEATHS ANNUALLY. COPD IS MADE UP OF CHRONIC BRONCHITIS (INFLAMMATION OF THE BRONCHI RESULTING IN INCREASED PRODUCTION OF MUCUS) AND EMPHYSEMA (A CHRONIC LUNG CONDITION RESULTING IN IRREVERSIBLE DAMAGE OF ALVEOLI AND EVENTUAL NECROSIS). OF THE 16 MILLION PEOPLE DIAGNOSED WITH COPD IN 2016 (1.5% OF THE ADULT POPULATION), 3.5 MILLION WERE DIAGNOSED WITH EMPHYSEMA. THIS HEALTH CRISIS IS COMPOUNDED BY THE ESTIMATED 8 MILLION POTENTIAL COPD CASES THAT REMAIN UNDIAGNOSED EACH YEAR. EMPHYSEMA IS A PROGRESSIVE DISEASE CHARACTERIZED BY THE DESTRUCTION OF LUNG PARENCHYMA AND AN IRREVERSIBLE INCREASE IN THE SIZE OF ALVEOLAR SPACES. THIS LEADS TO HYPERINFLATION, LOSS OF LUNG ELASTICITY, AND REDUCED EXPIRATORY FLOW. THESE MORPHOLOGICAL CHANGES IN THE LUNGS CAUSE STRUCTURAL CHANGES TO IN THE CHEST WALL AND RESPIRATORY MUSCLES, MAKING IT DIFFICULT FOR PATIENTS TO BREATHE. LUNG VOLUME REDUCTION (LVR) IS THE ONLY TREATMENT METHOD FOR PATIENTS WITH SEVERE EMPHYSEMA, BUT ISSUES EXIST WITH THE CURRENT OPTIONS. LVR SURGERY DONE VIA WEDGE EXCISIONS IS THE MOST ESTABLISHED AND VALIDATED OPTION, BUT FEW PATIENTS QUALIFY DUE TO THE INVASIVENESS OF THE PROCEDURE. RECENTLY, THE FDA APPROVED IMPLANTABLE ENDOBRONCHIAL VALVES (EBVS), WHICH ACHIEVE LVR VIA PERMANENT IMPLANTATION OF ONE-WAY VALVES. HOWEVER, 90% OF PATIENTS WITH EMPHYSEMA ARE INELIGIBLE FOR EBVS DUE TO THE REQUIREMENT OF HAVING INTACT FISSURES BETWEEN LOBES. OTHER ATTEMPTS HAVE BEEN MADE TO DEVELOP A SAFE LVR PROCEDURE THAT IS A VIABLE OPTION FOR ALL SEVERE EMPHYSEMA PATIENTS, BUT NONE HAVE BEEN APPROVED BY THE FDA. FOR EXAMPLE, TWO COMPANIES ATTEMPTED LVR VIA ENDOBRONCHIAL STEAM ABLATION, BUT THIS PROCEDURE HAD HIGH RATES OF ADVERSE EVENTS DUE TO UNCONTROLLED DELIVERY OF STEAM THAT QUICKLY SPREAD INTO AREAS OF HEALTHY LUNG TISSUE. THIS PROPOSAL WILL VALIDATE A NEW, MINIMALLY INVASIVE AND COMPLETELY ENDOBRONCHIAL APPROACH TO LVR THAT WILL BE A SAFE AND EFFECTIVE OPTION FOR ALL PATIENTS WITH SEVERE EMPHYSEMA. OUR INNOVATIVE APPROACH IS DESIGNED TO BE USED WITH CURRENTLY AVAILABLE BRONCHOSCOPIC TOOLS FOR LUNG TUMOR BIOPSY OR IMAGING AND CAN ALSO BE USED IN CONJUNCTION WITH CONTEMPORARY NAVIGATION SYSTEMS. THIS PROCEDURE WILL ALLOW PHYSICIANS TO SELECTIVELY TARGET THE MOST DISEASED SEGMENTS OF THE LUNG, THEREBY SPARING THE HEALTHIER TISSUE. OUR PROPRIETARY SYSTEM DELIVERS CONTROLLED RADIOFREQUENCY (RF) ENERGY WITH A DEVICE COMPLETELY IN THE AIRWAY THAT SELECTIVELY HEATS DISEASED PARENCHYMA AND PREVENTS ABLATION OF HEALTHY TISSUE IN NON-TARGET SEGMENTS OF THE LUNGS. LVR IS ACHIEVED BY THE NORMAL HEALING PROCESS AFTER HEATING, WHICH INVOLVES REPLACEMENT FIBROSIS OF THE ABLATED TISSUE. TO INCREASE THE RADIUS THAT THE DELIVERED RF ENERGY CAN REACH WITH SUCH A SMALL DEVICE, OUR SYSTEM ASPIRATES AIR AND THEN INFUSES HYPERTONIC SALINE TO INCREASE CONDUCTION IN THE TARGET ZONE. THE SIZE OF THE ABLATION ZONE IS CONTROLLED VIA OUR PROPRIETARY ALGORITHM AND GENERATOR, WHICH MODULATES BOTH ENERGY AND HYPERTONIC SALINE IRRIGATION RATE IN RESPONSE TO CHANGES IN TEMPERATURE AND IMPEDANCE. WE HAVE ALREADY DEVELOPED A FULL LENGTH, BRONCHOSCOPE-COMPATIBLE PROTOTYPE AND CUSTOM RF GENERATOR AND DEMONSTRATED PROOF OF CONCEPT IN COMPUTATIONAL MODELS, BENCH AND CHRONIC PRECLINICAL STUDIES THAT SHOW OUR SYSTEM CAN MAKE SIGNIFICANT LESIONS (~120 CC) WITHOUT CAUSING PNEUMOTHORAX OR OTHER COMPLICATIONS. IN PHASE I, WE PLAN TO EXTEND THE ABILITY OF OUR SYSTEM TO MAKE LESIONS UP TO 3X THE SIZE ACHIEVED IN THE PRELIMINARY STUDIES BY INCREASING THE POWER, DURATION OF ABLATION, AND BY STAGING THE PROCEDURE. THE INFORMATION OBTAINED IN THIS GRANT WILL BE USED DIRECTLY TO GUIDE EVENTUAL EFS-IDE SUBMISSION WITH THE FDA IN A FUTURE PHASE OF THE GRANT.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: BREATHWISE - AN AI-DRIVEN EARLY WARNING SYSTEM FOR COPD EXACERBATIONS - PROJECT SUMMARY CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE (COPD) IS A MAJOR PUBLIC HEALTH CHALLENGE, AFFECTING OVER 16 MILLION ADULTS IN THE UNITED STATES AND CONTRIBUTING TO MORE THAN 150,000 DEATHS ANNUALLY. EXACERBATIONS, WHICH ARE DEFINED AS THE ACUTE WORSENING OF RESPIRATORY SYMPTOMS REQUIRING ADDITIONAL THERAPY, ARE THE LEADING CAUSE OF HOSPITALIZATION FOR COPD PATIENTS AND ACCOUNT FOR A LARGE PORTION OF THE DISEASE’S ESTIMATED $50 BILLION ANNUAL ECONOMIC BURDEN. THESE EVENTS ACCELERATE LUNG FUNCTION DECLINE, DIMINISH QUALITY OF LIFE, AND INCREASE THE RISK OF PREMATURE DEATH. IMPORTANTLY, RESEARCH SHOWS THAT MANY EXACERBATIONS ARE PRECEDED BY SUBTLE BUT DETECTABLE CHANGES IN PHYSIOLOGICAL AND BEHAVIORAL SIGNALS, SUCH AS OXYGEN DESATURATION VARIABILITY, ELEVATED COUGH FREQUENCY, DISTURBED SLEEP, AND DECREASED ACTIVITY LEVELS. HOWEVER, CURRENT MONITORING APPROACHES, WHICH TYPICALLY RELY ON SELF-REPORTS, ADHERENCE TRACKING, OR INTERMITTENT CLINICAL VISITS, REMAIN NARROW IN SCOPE AND OFTEN MISS THE OPPORTUNITY FOR TIMELY INTERVENTION. LYNNTECH, INC. PROPOSES TO DEVELOP BREATHWISE, AN AI-DRIVEN EARLY-WARNING SYSTEM FOR COPD EXACERBATIONS THAT INTEGRATES MULTIMODAL PHYSIOLOGICAL, BEHAVIORAL, AND ENVIRONMENTAL SENSING WITH MACHINE LEARNING-BASED PREDICTIVE ANALYTICS. BREATHWISE WILL CONTINUOUSLY COLLECT DATA FROM WEARABLE DEVICES AND SMARTPHONES, APPLY ADVANCED TIME-SERIES FEATURE EXTRACTION METHODS, AND GENERATE PERSONALIZED RISK PREDICTIONS USING INTERPRETABLE MACHINE LEARNING MODELS. BY TRANSFORMING RAW DATA INTO CLINICALLY RELEVANT DECISION-SUPPORT ALERTS, THE SYSTEM WILL EMPOWER PATIENTS AND CLINICIANS TO INTERVENE EARLIER, REDUCING COSTLY HOSPITAL READMISSIONS AND IMPROVING LONG-TERM OUTCOMES. THE GOALS OF THIS PHASE I SBIR PROJECT ARE TO DEVELOP AND DEMONSTRATE THE FEASIBILITY OF BREATHWISE’S CORE COMPONENTS. OUR SPECIFIC AIMS ARE TO: (1) DESIGN AND VALIDATE A PASSIVE SENSING FRAMEWORK FOR MONITORING COPD-RELATED PHYSIOLOGICAL AND BEHAVIORAL SIGNALS, (2) DEVELOP A PERSONALIZED AI MODEL CAPABLE OF PREDICTING EXACERBATION RISK UP TO 72 HOURS IN ADVANCE, AND (3) IMPLEMENT AN INTERPRETABLE DECISION-SUPPORT MODULE THAT DELIVERS ACTIONABLE EARLY-WARNING ALERTS TO PATIENTS AND CLINICIANS. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THESE AIMS WILL PROVIDE FOUNDATIONAL EVIDENCE FOR BREATHWISE’S FEASIBILITY AND CLINICAL UTILITY. THIS WORK WILL ESTABLISH A SCALABLE FRAMEWORK FOR PERSONALIZED COPD MANAGEMENT, LAYING THE GROUNDWORK FOR PHASE II DEVELOPMENT AND FUTURE CLINICAL TRIALS. ULTIMATELY, BREATHWISE HAS THE POTENTIAL TO TRANSFORM EXACERBATION PREVENTION, REDUCE HEALTHCARE COSTS, AND IMPROVE QUALITY OF LIFE FOR MILLIONS OF INDIVIDUALS LIVING WITH COPD.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: PROJECT VELA: A CLOUD-BASED, MODEL-AGNOSTIC FEDERATED QUERY TOOL TO ENABLE SCALABLE, INCLUSIVE MULTI-SITE RESEARCH ACROSS HEALTH SYSTEMS - PROJECT ABSTRACT (PHASE I SBIR) ADVANCING DISEASE PREVENTION AND IMPROVING CARE DELIVERY REQUIRES COLLABORATION ACROSS MULTIPLE CLINICAL AND PUBLIC HEALTH SETTINGS. THE INCREASING PREVALENCE OF MULTISITE RESEARCH IS DEMONSTRATED IN INCREASING RATE OF CITATIONS FOR MULTICENTER STUDIES, A 1.6 – 3 TIME INCREASE FOR EVERY 5-YEAR PERIOD BETWEEN 1985 AND 1999. MULTISITE RESEARCH IS INCREASINGLY PREVALENT AND ESSENTIAL FOR ADDRESSING SOCIAL AND COMMUNITY-LEVEL FACTORS THAT SHAPE HEALTH OUTCOMES AND PROMOTING INNOVATION IN HEALTHCARE DELIVERY. HOWEVER, CURRENT INFRASTRUCTURE FOR ENGAGING, RECRUITING, AND RETAINING PATIENTS FOR MULTISITE RESEARCH REMAINS FRAGMENTED. DATA ARE SILOED, ACCESS IS INCONSISTENT, AND AVAILABLE TOOLS REQUIRE HIGH TECHNICAL EXPERTISE OR COSTLY INFRASTRUCTURE—BARRIERS THAT DISPROPORTIONATELY AFFECT LOWER-RESOURCE INSTITUTIONS. WE PROPOSE TO DEVELOP A SECURE, CLOUD-BASED, FEDERATED QUERY PLATFORM THAT ENABLES RESEARCHERS TO ASK CLINICALLY MEANINGFUL QUESTIONS ACROSS DIVERSE HEALTH SYSTEMS WITHOUT REQUIRING DATA CENTRALIZATION OR UNIFORM DATA MODELS ACROSS SITES. IN PHASE I, WE WILL BUILD AND VALIDATE THE PLATFORM USING THE HEALTH CARE SYSTEMS RESEARCH NETWORK’S VIRTUAL DATA WAREHOUSE (HCSRN-VDW), A WIDELY ADOPTED, PRAGMATIC COMMON DATA MODEL. DATANOMY WILL PARTNER WITH SAINT LOUIS UNIVERSITY (SLU) TO DEPLOY AND TEST THE PLATFORM ON THEIR VDW INSTANCE, WHICH INCLUDES DEIDENTIFIED ELECTRONIC HEALTH RECORD (EHR) DATA FROM APPROXIMATELY 11 MILLION UNIQUE PATIENTS ACROSS URBAN, RURAL, AND UNDERSERVED AREAS IN THE MIDWEST. THE VDW’S STRUCTURAL SIMILARITY TO THE OBSERVATIONAL MEDICAL OUTCOMES PARTNERSHIP (OMOP) COMMON DATA MODEL POSITIONS THE PLATFORM FOR FUTURE INTEROPERABILITY. RESEARCHERS CAN BEGIN USING THE SYSTEM LOCALLY AND EXPAND, OVER TIME, TO CONNECT WITH OTHER VDW SITES OR TRANSITION TO OMOP. THIS FEDERATED APPROACH REDUCES TECHNICAL AND POLICY BARRIERS TO COLLABORATION, WHILE OFFERING A SCALABLE PATH TO IMPROVED EFFICIENCIES IN ENGAGING, RECRUITING, AND RETAINING PATIENTS FOR CLINICAL AND POPULATION HEALTH RESEARCH. BY OPERATING IN THE CLOUD, THE PLATFORM MINIMIZES INFRASTRUCTURE BURDEN AND PRESERVES LOCAL DATA OWNERSHIP, GIVING INSTITUTIONS MORE LEVERAGE IN DATA-SHARING COLLABORATIONS, INCLUDING CLINICAL TRIAL NEGOTIATIONS WITH EXTERNAL PARTNERS. RATHER THAN REPLACING EXISTING RESEARCH COHORTS, IT ENHANCES THEM, ENABLING BROADER CONNECTIVITY AND MORE USABLE, REPRESENTATIVE DATA AND SUPPORTS THE NIH CURRENT MISSION FOCUSING ON CHRONIC DISEASE AND SUPPORTING ACTIONABLE RESEARCH FOR A VARIETY OF POPULATIONS. THIS PROJECT DIRECTLY SUPPORTS NIH’S MISSION BY ADVANCING SCALABLE INFRASTRUCTURE THAT ENABLES PARTICIPATION FROM INSTITUTIONS OF ALL SIZES, ULTIMATELY DELIVERING BETTER, FASTER INSIGHTS FOR INDIVIDUAL AND POPULATION HEALTH.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: BUILDING ASSETS TOGETHER: A TOOLKIT FOR YOUTH MENTORS - ABSTRACT LONELINESS, SOCIAL ISOLATION, AND MENTAL HEALTH PROBLEMS ARE WIDELY AFFECTING YOUNG PEOPLE IN THE UNITED STATES. MENTORING, A RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN AND ADULT OR OLDER YOUTH WITH A YOUNG PERSON THAT PROVIDES BENEFITS TO THE YOUNG PERSON, IS ONE STRATEGY FOR ADDRESSING THESE PUBLIC HEALTH ISSUES. IN THE U.S., APPROXIMATELY 4.5 MILLION YOUNG PEOPLE PARTICIPATE IN COMMUNITY-BASED MENTORING RELATIONSHIPS. MANY MORE PARTICIPATE IN SCHOOL OR SITE-BASED MENTORING RELATIONSHIPS. MENTORS ARE TYPICALLY A VOLUNTEER WORKFORCE OF INDIVIDUALS WHO FUNCTION AS A SOCIALIZATION PARTNER, WITH SIMILAR MECHANISMS OF INFLUENCE ON CHILD DEVELOPMENT AS THAT OF PARENTS, PEERS, TEACHERS, AND COACHES. HOWEVER, MENTORS HAVE UNIQUE ROLE AND BOUNDARY CONSIDERATIONS DURING THEIR INTERACTIONS WITH MENTEES THAT PUT BOTH CONSTRAINTS ON THEIR BEHAVIORS AS WELL AS ALLOW FOR UNIQUE OPPORTUNITIES FOR INFLUENCE. MENTORS NEED GUIDANCE ON WHAT SKILLS AND BEHAVIORS THEY SHOULD IMPLEMENT DURING THEIR DAY-TO- DAY INTERACTIONS WITH THEIR MENTEES THAT ARE EFFECTIVE IN STRATEGICALLY PROMOTING POSITIVE GOALS AND OUTCOMES FOR MENTEES. THE MOST EFFECTIVE MENTORING PROGRAMS PROVIDE STRUCTURE AND TARGETED SUPPORT TO MENTORS AND MENTEES RATHER THAN RELYING ON THE INTUITION AND NATURAL SKILLS OF MENTORS. THE PURPOSE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP THE BUILDING ASSETS TOGETHER (BAT) TOOLKIT WITH INTERACTIVE, MULTIMEDIA RICH, WEB-BASED, ASYNCHRONOUS, MICROLEARNING CONTENT TO GUIDE MENTORS IN ESTABLISHING AN ENDURING AND EFFECTIVE RELATIONSHIP WITH THEIR MENTEES. SOFTWARE ENHANCEMENTS TO THE EXISTING MENTORING CENTRAL LEARNING MANAGEMENT SYSTEM WILL ENABLE MENTORING PROGRAM STAFF TO DEPLOY THE TOOLKIT CONTENT AS NEEDED OR ON A CUSTOMIZED SCHEDULE BASED UPON THE MENTORING PROGRAM’S UNIQUE CALENDAR. THE ENHANCEMENTS WILL ALSO ENABLE MENTORS TO EASILY ACCESS THE TOOLKIT CONTENT ON ALL DEVICES, THEREBY IMPROVING ACCESSIBILITY AND ADOPTION. THE PROPOSED PRODUCT WILL BE DEVELOPED WITH INPUT FROM MENTORING PROGRAM STAFF AND EDUCATORS. A USABILITY STUDY WITH MENTORING PROGRAM STAFF WILL BE CONDUCTED TO ASSESS THE USABILITY OF THE SOFTWARE ENHANCEMENTS. A FEASIBILITY STUDY WITH MENTORS WILL BE CONDUCTED TO DETERMINE THE FEASIBILITY AND ACCEPTABILITY OF THE BAT TOOLKIT WITH MENTORS. THE BAT TOOLKIT WILL BE A HIGHLY SCALABLE AND COMMERCIALLY-VIABLE PRODUCT, AND WILL BE DESIGNED TO BE EASY TO IMPLEMENT BY MENTORING PROGRAMS AND ACCESSIBLE TO MENTORS. THIS TOOLKIT IS NEEDED TO IMPROVE THE LONGEVITY AND QUALITY OF MENTORING RELATIONSHIPS AND THE OVERALL IMPACT OF MENTORING ON YOUTH OUTCOMES

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: A NOVEL CELL-CYCLE DEPENDENT REPLICATING AAV PLATFORM FOR NEONATAL INBORN ERRORS OF METABOLISM - A NOVEL CELL-CYCLE DEPENDENT REPLICATING AAV PLATFORM FOR NEONATAL INBORN ERRORS OF METABOLISM SUMMARY INBORN ERRORS OF METABOLISM (IEMS), SUCH AS METHYLMALONIC ACIDEMIA (MMA) AND HEREDITARY TYROSINEMIA TYPE 1 (HT1), ARE LIFE-THREATENING PEDIATRIC DISORDERS THAT REQUIRE DURABLE GENE THERAPIES TO CORRECT UNDERLYING METABOLIC DEFECTS. RECOMBINANT ADENO-ASSOCIATED VIRUS (RAAV) VECTORS, DESPITE THEIR FAVORABLE SAFETY PROFILE AND BROAD TROPISM, ARE LIMITED BY MITOTIC DILUTION IN PROLIFERATING TISSUES, REDUCING LONG-TERM EFFICACY IN GROWING ORGANS. HIGH-DOSE RAAV CAN PARTIALLY OFFSET THE MITOTIC LOSS BUT CARRIES RISKS OF HEPATOTOXICITY AND INSERTIONAL MUTAGENESIS, WHILE NOVEL CAPSID ENGINEERING REMAINS IN EARLY DEVELOPMENT. TO OVERCOME THESE LIMITATIONS, WE PROPOSE A CELL CYCLE–DEPENDENT REPLICATING AAV (CCRAAV) PLATFORM THAT MAINTAINS EPISOMES IN DIVIDING CELLS BY USING SCAFFOLD/MATRIX ATTACHMENT REGIONS (S/MARS) FOR NUCLEAR TETHERING AND REPLICATION INITIATION REGIONS (IRS) TO RECRUIT HOST REPLICATION MACHINERY, ENABLING EPISOMES TO REPLICATE WITH THE HOST CELL AND SUSTAIN LONG-TERM EXPRESSION. PRELIMINARY STUDIES SHOW THAT CCRAAV VECTORS RETAIN 1–2.5 GENOME COPIES PER CELL AND >10% REPORTER-POSITIVE CELLS AFTER ~60 DOUBLINGS IN HEK293T CELLS, IN SHARP CONTRAST TO NEAR-COMPLETE LOSS WITH CONVENTIONAL RAAV. THIS PHASE I SBIR PROJECT WILL ASSESS CCRAAV’S TISSUE-SPECIFIC REPLICATION, EPISOMAL PERSISTENCE, AND LONG-TERM SAFETY AND EFFICACY IN NEONATAL MOUSE LIVER, ESTABLISHING PROOF-OF-CONCEPT FOR A LOW-DOSE, DURABLE, AND SAFE GENE THERAPY PLATFORM. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION WILL OVERCOME KEY LIMITATIONS OF RAAV AND ENABLE TRANSFORMATIVE THERAPIES FOR IEMS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: A NOVEL BIOACTIVE BONE GRAFT TO PROMOTE ACCELERATED BONE REGENERATION - ABSTRACT THERE IS A CRITICAL NEED TO ADDRESS THE SIGNIFICANT CHALLENGES OF REPAIRING LARGE BONE DEFECTS AND NONUNION. THESE MAJOR BONE INJURIES EXCEED 4-5 CM IN LENGTH AND MAY BE CAUSED BY TRAUMA, DISEASE OR TUMOR RESECTION. THEY AFFECT NEARLY HALF A MILLION OUT OF THE 7 MILLION PATIENTS WHO SUFFER FROM ORTHOPEDIC TRAUMA IN THE US EACH YEAR. IN CONTRAST TO SIMPLER FRACTURES (~2CM) WHICH RETAIN SELF-REGENERATION CAPACITY, THESE LARGE DEFECTS REQUIRE COMPLEX RECONSTRUCTIVE PROCEDURES ASSOCIATED WITH HIGH PROCEDURAL RISK, HIGH COSTS, SUBSTANTIAL LONG- TERM DISCOMFORT AND DISABILITY FOR PATIENTS AND PERSISTENT RATES OF FAILURE. CURRENT TREATMENTS, INCLUDING THE ILIZAROV TECHNIQUE (PROLONGED CONSOLIDATION PERIOD), THE MASQUELET TECHNIQUE (MULTIPLE SURGERIES), AND FREE VASCULARIZED FIBULAR BONE GRAFTS (REFRACTURE RATES OF 15–40%), RELY HEAVILY ON BONE GRAFTING, WHICH IS LIMITED BY DONOR SUPPLY. WHILE BMP2- BASED THERAPIES SHOW PROMISE, EXISTING DELIVERY METHODS USING ABSORBABLE COLLAGEN SPONGES RESULT IN RAPID, UNCONTROLLED RELEASE, NECESSITATING HIGH DOSES AND CAUSING COMPLICATIONS. TO ADDRESS THIS, WE DEVELOPED OSTEOINDUCTIVE HYTEC TECHNOLOGY, WHICH ENABLES SUSTAINED BMP2 RELEASE AND DEMONSTRATED SUPERIOR BONE REGENERATION AND HEALING IN PRECLINICAL RAT AND OVINE MODELS COMPARED TO AUTOGRAFTS AND RAPID-RELEASE BMP2. BUILDING ON THESE ADVANCEMENTS, TISSUERATE IS DEVELOPING A CLINICALLY APPLICABLE 3D-PRINTED MODULAR BIOACTIVE SYNTHETIC BONE GRAFT TECHNOLOGY (MST) BASED ON HYTEC. THIS PROJECT WILL DEVELOP MST FOR A SHEEP CRITICAL-SIZED DEFECT MODEL, ENSURE GLP-COMPLIANT DEVICE MANUFACTURING, AND DEMONSTRATE MST’S EFFICACY IN PROMOTING ACCELERATED HEALING COMPARED TO AUTOGRAFTS. SUCCESSFUL OUTCOMES WILL ENABLE COMMERCIALIZATION OF THIS BIOACTIVE GRAFT, OFFERING A TRANSFORMATIVE SOLUTION FOR ORTHOPEDIC TRAUMA AND DISORDERS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: PRECLINICAL DEVELOPMENT OF ANTI-LTPB4 MONOCLONAL ANTIBODIES TO TREAT NEUROMUSCULAR DISEASES - ABSTRACT NEUROMUSCULAR DISORDERS AFFECT MORE THAN 350,000 AMERICANS, CAUSING MUSCLE WEAKNESS AND THE INABILITY TO STAND, WALK, AND BREATHE. DUCHENNE MUSCULAR DYSTROPHY (DMD) IS AN INHERITED NEUROMUSCULAR DISORDER CAUSED BY THE LOSS OF DYSTROPHIN PROTEIN, WHICH RENDERS THE MUSCLE MEMBRANE HIGHLY SUSCEPTIBLE TO INJURY. ALTHOUGH A NUMBER OF TREATMENTS HAVE BEEN RECENTLY APPROVED FOR DMD, THESE DRUGS, EVEN GENE THERAPY, ARE LIMITED IN THEIR ABILITY TO DELAY DISEASE PROGRESSION IN DMD. FURTHERMORE, THERE ARE NO TREATMENTS FOR MANY OTHER FORMS OF MUSCULAR DYSTROPHY. LATENT TGF- BINDING PROTEIN 4 (LTBP4) WAS DISCOVERED AS A GENETIC MODIFIER OF MUSCULAR DYSTROPHY USING AN UNBIASED GENOMEWIDE SCREEN DEMONSTRATING GENETIC SIGNALS IN MICE AND HUMANS WITH MUSCULAR DYSTROPHY. LTBP4 PROTEIN LOCALIZES TO THE MYOFIBER EXTERIOR WHERE IT BINDS AND SEQUESTERS ALL THREE FORMS OF TGF-, REGULATING LATENT TGF- RELEASE AND ACTIVATION AND ITS SUBSEQUENT CASCADE OF PATHOLOGICAL DOWNSTREAM SIGNALING. EXCESS TGF- ACTIVATION IS A PATHOLOGICAL FINDING IN MANY FORMS OF NEUROMUSCULAR DISEASE, ESPECIALLY DMD, THE LIMB GIRDLE MUSCULAR DYSTROPHIES AND THE CONGENITAL MUSCULAR DYSTROPHIES. IN THE MUSCULAR DYSTROPHIES, EXCESS OR HYPER-ACTIVATED TGF- TRIGGERS FIBROTIC INFILTRATION OF MUSCLE AND IMPAIRED MUSCLE REGENERATION. THE GENETIC DATA DEMONSTRATED THE CRITICAL NATURE OF LTBP4’S HINGE REGION OF LTBP4 FOR RELEASE AND ACTIVATION OF LATENT TGF-. LTBP4’S HINGE REGION IS STABILIZED BY NEUTRALIZING ANTIBODIES, AND THIS ACTION LIMITS LTBP4 CLEAVAGE AND RELASE OF LATENT TGF-. WE NOW OPTIMIZED ANTI-LTBP4 ANTIBODIES FOR DEVELOPMENT AS A THERAPEUTIC AGENT TO TREAT MUSCULAR DYSTROPHY. PROOF OF CONCEPT DATA IN THE MDX MOUSE MODEL OF DMD DEMONSTRATES THAT AN ANTI-LTBP4 ANTIBODY DIRECTED AT THE HINGE REGION CAN BE USED TO REDUCE FIBROSIS AND IMPROVE MUSCLE STRENGTH. WE NOW SELECTED AND SEQUENCE OPTIMIZED SECOND GENERATION, HIGH-AFFINITY HUMAN MONOCLONAL ANTIBODIES TO LTBP4 AND SELECTED A CANDIDATE LEAD FOR DEVELOPMENT. IN THIS DIRECT TO PHASE II APPLICATION, IKAIKA THERAPEUTICS WILL COMPLETE NON-GLP PRECLINICAL STUDIES ON OUR LEAD MONOCLONAL ANTIBODY, IKN-003, WITH TREATING DMD AS THE INITIAL INDICATION. IN AIM 1, WE WILL MANUFACTURE AND OPTIMIZE SUBCUTANEOUS FORMULATION OF IKN-003 WHICH WILL SUBSEQUENTLY BE USED IN PRECLINICAL IN VIVO DOSING AND EFFICACY STUDIES IN DYSTROPHIC MICE. ADDITIONALLY IN AIM 1, WE AIM TO IDENTIFY DRUG-RESPONSIVE SERUM BIOMARKERS. IN AIM 2, WE WILL DEVELOP AND QUALIFY SERUM ELISA AND ANTI-DRUG ANTIBODY ASSAYS. IN AIM 3 WE WILL CONDUCT NON-GLP PHARMACOKINETIC AND TOXICOKINETIC STUDIES IN MICE AND NON-HUMAN PRIMATES. COMPLETION OF THESE AIMS WILL ALLOW THE ASSEMBLY OF A PRECLINICAL DATA PACKAGE REQUIRED FOR PRE-IND SUBMISSION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: LEVERAGING CODED PTYCHOGRAPHY TO DELIVER AI-POWERED RAPID ANALYSIS OF UNSTAINED LUNG BIOPSY SAMPLES AT THE POINT OF CARE - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT THIS SMALL BUSINESS INNOVATION RESEARCH (SBIR) DIRECT-TO-PHASE II PROJECT AIMS TO CONTINUE RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT OF A NOVEL IMAGING PLATFORM COMBINED WITH ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) ALGORITHMS TO ANALYZE THE ADEQUACY OF LUNG BIOPSY SAMPLES AT THE POINT OF CARE (POC). LUNG CANCER IS AMONG THE DEADLIEST OF ALL CANCERS AND IS THE FIRST LEADING CAUSE OF CANCER DEATH IN THE UNITED STATES. EARLY DIAGNOSIS AND TREATMENT OF LUNG CANCER IS ESSENTIAL, GIVEN THE SURVIVAL RATE PLUMMETS FROM 63.7% FOR LOCALIZED STAGE CASES TO 8.9% FOR DISTANT STAGE CASES. UNFORTUNATELY, FEWER THAN HALF OF THE CASES ARE IDENTIFIED IN EARLY STAGES.40,41 ACCURATE DIAGNOSIS OF A SUSPICIOUS LESION REQUIRES THE PROCEDURALIST TO ACQUIRE ENOUGH SAMPLE FROM THE CORRECT LOCATION. UNFORTUNATELY, MANY BIOPSY PROCEDURES MUST BE REPEATED DUE TO A LACK OF SUFFICIENT CELLULARITY FOR DIAGNOSIS—ESPECIALLY FOR EARLY-STAGE CASES WHEN THE TARGET NODULE TENDS TO BE SMALLER AND THEREFORE HARDER TO ACCESS WITH THE BIOPSY TOOL. THE RESULT OF THIS DELAY CAN BE DEVASTATING ON PATIENT OUTCOMES BY INCREASING THE TIME TO DIAGNOSIS AND TREATMENT BY UP TO 90 DAYS, THUS INCREASING THE LIKELIHOOD OF THE CANCER UPSTAGING.2 RAPID ON-SITE EVALUATION (ROSE) OF BIOPSY SPECIMENS MITIGATES THE RISK OF REPEAT PROCEDURES BY VERIFYING THE DIAGNOSTIC QUALITY OF A SAMPLE AT THE POC DURING THE BIOPSY PROCEDURE. YET, DESPITE A HIGH RATE OF NON- DIAGNOSTIC SAMPLES, ROSE HISTORICALLY IS UNDERUTILIZED IN LUNG BIOPSIES DUE TO FINANCIAL AND OPERATIONAL BARRIERS, INCLUDING OPPORTUNITY COSTS AND THE LACK OF ON-SITE PATHOLOGIST AVAILABILITY. THROUGH NIH GRANT FUNDING AND PRIVATE RESOURCES, PATHWARE IS DEVELOPING TECHNOLOGY THAT AUTONOMOUSLY PROVIDES RAPID BIOPSY SAMPLE FEEDBACK TO THE PROCEDURALIST DURING THE BIOPSY PROCEDURE AND SLIDE PRIORITIZATION TO PATHOLOGY FOR DOWNSTREAM WORKFLOW EFFICIENCY. THIS DIRECT-TO-PHASE II PROJECT IS DESIGNED TO BUILD UPON PROMISING INITIAL PROOF-OF-CONCEPT RESULTS TO CONTINUE DEVELOPMENT AND VALIDATION OF THIS NOVEL TECHNOLOGY WITH THE FOLLOWING AIMS: 1) OPTIMIZE A NEXT GENERATION BIOPTIC® SYSTEM FOR CLINICAL ADOPTION AND AI ANALYSIS TO NON- DESTRUCTIVELY IMAGE UNSTAINED LUNG LESION CYTOLOGY SPECIMENS RAPIDLY AND EFFICIENTLY; 2) COLLECT MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL DATA ON FRESH, UNSTAINED LUNG TISSUE SAMPLES TO EXPAND AI MODEL DEVELOPMENT AND TRAINING TO A LARGE AND DIVERSIFIED POPULATION; 3) REFINE AUTONOMOUS ALGORITHMS TO DETERMINE ADEQUACY OF UNSTAINED LUNG QPIS TO DEVELOP A ROBUST AI SYSTEM FOR A DIVERSE AND REPRESENTATIVE PATIENT POPULATION. ACHIEVEMENT OF THESE AIMS WILL ENABLE PATHWARE TO TAKE THE KEY NEXT STEPS OF SUBMISSION FOR FDA REGULATORY CLEARANCE AND SUBSEQUENT COMMERCIALIZATION. THIS SBIR FUNDING IS VITAL TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF A PRODUCT THAT WILL IMPROVE TREATMENT AND OUTCOMES FOR LUNG CANCER PATIENTS BY ENABLING HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS TO PERFORM LUNG BIOPSIES MORE EFFECTIVELY AND BY IMPROVING THE DIAGNOSTIC PATHWAY FOR ONE OF THE DEADLIEST CANCERS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEMONSTRATING SAFETY AND COMBINATION THERAPY POTENTIAL OF A NOVEL NANOPARTICLE DELIVERY SYSTEM - SUMMARY INTERDISCIPLINARY BIOENGINEERING APPROACHES FOR THERAPY AND DRUG DELIVERY ARE ESSENTIAL TO OVERCOMING THE LIMITATIONS OF IMMUNE CHECKPOINT INHIBITORS, WHICH ARE OFTEN INEFFECTIVE AGAINST “COLD” TUMORS THAT EXCLUDE T-CELLS. ACTIVATING THE CGAS-STING PATHWAY HOLDS PROMISE, BUT FORMER AND CURRENT STING AGONISTS FACE CHALLENGES SUCH AS RAPID CLEARANCE, POOR CELL PENETRATION, LACK OF TARGETING TO IMMUNE CELLS, AND VARIABILITY ACROSS STING HAPLOTYPES. SAROS THERAPEUTICS IS ADDRESSING THESE ISSUES USING A NOVEL NANOPARTICLE PLATFORM, KNOWN AS SMP. THIS DRUG DELIVERY VEHICLE FORMULATION INCORPORATES MANGANESE AND A STING AGONIST INTO NANOPARTICLES, ENHANCING STING ACTIVATION, EXTENDING THE HALF-LIFE OF THE STING AGONIST, AND IMPROVING TARGETING TO DENDRITIC CELLS AND MACROPHAGES. THIS DESIGN ALLOWS FOR INTRAVENOUS ADMINISTRATION, ENSURING SYSTEMIC EXPOSURE AND IMPROVED RESPONSES IN METASTATIC CANCER. ANIMAL STUDIES DEMONSTRATING EFFICACY AND ACCEPTABLE TOXICOLOGY PROFILE FOR AN IV FORMULATION ARE REQUIRED BY REGULATORY AGENCIES FOR ADVANCEMENT TO HUMAN CLINICAL TRIALS. SCALABLE AND COST-EFFECTIVE PRODUCTION METHODS HAVE BEEN DEVELOPED, SIMPLIFYING MANUFACTURING. ONGOING STUDIES WILL FINALIZE THE SMP FORMULATION, TRANSFER MANUFACTURING TO A CDMO, EVALUATE THEIR SYNERGY WITH OTHER IMMUNOTHERAPIES, AND DEMONSTRATE THEIR SAFETY PROFILE TO SUPPORT AN IND APPLICATION AND ADVANCE THIS INNOVATIVE PLATFORM TOWARD FIRST-IN-HUMAN TRIALS, AIMING TO BRING IMMUNOTHERAPY BENEFITS TO MORE CANCER PATIENTS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT OF MANUFACTURING CONTROLS FOR ORL1: A FLUORESCENT IMAGING AGENT FOR IN VIVO MOLECULAR IMAGING OF MELANOMAS - PROJECT SUMMARY THIS DIRECT-TO-PHASE II PROJECT FOCUSES ON DEVELOPING CHEMICAL MANUFACTURING CONTROLS FOR ORL1, A FLUORESCENT IMAGING AGENT USED BY ORLUCENT'S SKIN FLUORESCENT IMAGING (SFI) SYSTEM FOR IN VIVO MOLECULAR IMAGING OF MELANOMAS. IN OUR PRELIMINARY STUDIES, ORL1 HAS SHOWN 100% SENSITIVITY AND 95.7% SPECIFICITY IN DISTINGUISHING MELANOMAS FROM NON-MELANOMAS. THE LONG-TERM GOAL IS TO ENHANCE MELANOMA DIAGNOSIS BY REDUCING UNNECESSARY BIOPSIES AND IMPROVING EARLY DETECTION THROUGH ADVANCED MOLECULAR IMAGING TECHNOLOGIES. AIM 1 WILL VERIFY THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS AND CONTROLS FOR ORL1 DRUG SUBSTANCE (DS) AND DRUG PRODUCT (DP) ACCORDING TO CURRENT GOOD MANUFACTURING PRACTICE (CGMP) STANDARDS. KEY ACTIVITIES INCLUDE DRAFTING A MASTER BATCH RECORD, INTEGRATING STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURES (SOPS), WORK INSTRUCTIONS (WIS), AND IMPLEMENTING A COMPREHENSIVE CONTROL STRATEGY. AIM 2 WILL DEVELOP AND ADAPT TEST METHODS FOR QUALITY CONTROL AND STABILITY STUDIES, ENSURING COMPATIBILITY WITH THE SMALL MANUFACTURING LOT SIZES FOR ORL1. AIM 3 WILL PRODUCE THREE TECHNICAL LOTS OF ORL1 DS AND DP TO DEMONSTRATE MANUFACTURING REPRODUCIBILITY, VALIDATE QUALITY CONTROL METHODS, AND ESTABLISH A FULLY CHARACTERIZED REFERENCE STANDARD. AIM 4 WILL INVOLVE MANUFACTURING THREE GMP- COMPLIANT REGISTRATION LOTS OF ORL1 DS AND DP. COMPREHENSIVE QUALITY CONTROL TESTING WILL BE PERFORMED, AND A TWO-YEAR STABILITY PROGRAM WILL BE INITIATED TO SUPPORT REGULATORY SUBMISSION.  THE RESEARCH DESIGN EMPHASIZES ESTABLISHING AND DOCUMENTING THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS, DEVELOPING AND VALIDATING ROBUST TEST METHODS, CONDUCTING FORCED DEGRADATION STUDIES, AND OPTIMIZING PROCESSES FOR SMALL LOT SIZES. THE PROJECT WILL VALIDATE QUALITY CONTROL METHODS, CHARACTERIZE A REFERENCE STANDARD, AND CONDUCT STABILITY STUDIES TO DEFINE A TWO-YEAR EXPIRATION DATE FOR ORL1. BY ENSURING THAT ORL1 MEETS GMP FDA REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS, THIS PROJECT WILL PAVE THE WAY FOR THE SFI SYSTEM TO IMPROVE MELANOMA DIAGNOSIS, REDUCE UNNECESSARY BIOPSIES, AND ENABLE EARLIER, MORE ACCURATE DETECTION OF MELANOMA THROUGH INNOVATIVE MOLECULAR IMAGING.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: TRANSLATION OF THE NOVEL ONCOLYTIC IMMUNOTHERAPY VET6-PDI - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT THE GOAL OF THIS PROJECT IS TO COMPLETE MUCH OF THE TRANSLATIONAL STUDIES NECESSARY TO PREPARE A NOVEL ONCOLYTIC VIRAL (OV) THERAPY, VET6-PDI, FOR CLINICAL EVALUATION IN COLORECTAL CANCER (CRC). CRC IS THE PREDOMINATE FORM OF GI CANCER, AND A LEADING CAUSE OF CANCER DEATH IN THE UNITED STATES. RECENTLY, IMMUNOTHERAPIES HAVE EMERGED AS A POTENTIAL NEW TREATMENT APPROACH IN CRC BUT HAVE BEEN LIMITED BY LOW RESPONSE RATES, ESPECIALLY IN MSS AND RAS WILD TYPE SUBTYPES. HOWEVER, THE ABILITY OF OVS TO EXPLOIT THE IMMUNE SYSTEM HAS BEEN DEMONSTRATED IN OTHER SOLID TUMOR TYPES, SUCH AS MELANOMA AND BLADDER CANCER, AND SO THEY HOLD PROMISE FOR USE IN CRC, ESPECIALLY IF EFFECTIVE SYSTEMIC DELIVERY WERE POSSIBLE. ONCOLYTIC VIRUSES HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO INCORPORATE MULTIPLE FEATURES INTO A SINGLE VIRAL BACKBONE, TO TARGET CANCER CELLS DIRECTLY (TO INDUCE CELL DEATH), TO OVERCOME LOCALIZED IMMUNE SUPPRESSION WITHIN THE TUMOR, AND TO BOOST THE ANTI-TUMOR ADAPTIVE IMMUNE RESPONSE WHILE EVADING ANTI-VIRAL IMMUNE RESPONSES. TO DATE, NO EFFECTIVE OV THERAPIES HAVE BEEN DEVELOPED FOR USE IN CRC, PARTLY DUE TO THE HISTORICAL NEED TO DELIVERY MOST OVS DIRECTLY INTO THE TUMOR, A DELIVERY MECHANISM THAT IS OFTEN NOT FEASIBLE IN DISSEMINATED COLORECTAL CANCER. VET6-PDI REPRESENTS A NEXT GENERATION OV THERAPY AND HAS BEEN ENGINEERED TO CONTAIN MULTIPLE GENETIC MODIFICATIONS AND EXPRESSES SEVERAL TRANSGENES, WHICH, COLLECTIVELY, OVERCOME MANY OF THE LIMITATIONS FACING PREVIOUS GENERATIONS OF OVS. MODIFICATIONS IN VET6-PDI ALLOW FOR GREATLY ENHANCED INTRAVENOUS ADMINISTRATION, INCREASED TUMOR-SELECTIVE VIRAL REPLICATION, AS WELL AS INDUCTION OF MULTIPLE STEPS ALONG THE ADAPTIVE T-CELL RESPONSE AND MAINTENANCE PATHWAYS. PREVIOUS PRE-CLINICAL WORK HAS DEMONSTRATED VET6-PDI’S MECHANISM OF ACTION AND POTENCY AGAINST TUMORS, INCLUDING MOUSE MODELS OF CRC, AND MATCHING HOT AND COLD TUMORS. WE BELIEVE THIS THERAPY HAS SIGNIFICANT POTENTIAL TO ADVANCE THE TREATMENT OF CRC, AND ADVANCING VET6-PDI TO CLINICAL TESTING IS OF IMPORTANCE. THE WORK DESCRIBED IN THIS CURRENT PROPOSAL IS SPECIFICALLY AIMED AT COMPLETING THE STUDIES NECESSARY TO PREPARE FOR CLINICAL EVALUATION. AS SUCH, WE WILL DEMONSTRATE THAT OUR EXISTING MANUFACTURE PROCESS CAN BE USED TO CREATE VET6-PDI AT CLINICAL GRADE AND IN SUFFICIENT QUANTITIES FOR USE IN CLINICAL TESTING, WITH THE ULTIMATE GOAL OF PRODUCING AN ECONOMICALLY VIABLE PRODUCT. IN ADDITION, WE WILL COMPLETE THE FDA-MANDATED SAFETY AND TOXICOLOGY TESTING THROUGH A SERIES OF MOUSE STUDIES. WE WILL DEVELOP ALL ASSAYS NECESSARY TO CONFIRM THE CLINICAL PRODUCT (VET6- PDI) IS AS INTENDED, AND THESE WILL BE QUALIFIED IN-HOUSE. IN ADDITION A VIRAL BANK OF VET6-PDI WILL BE MADE AND RELEASED IN OUR CGMP FACILITY FOR USE AS SEED MATERIAL IN ALL FUTURE MANUFACTURING RUNS FOR CLINICAL TESTING AS WELL AS EVENTUAL COMMERCIAL USE. FINALLY, MOUSE STUDIES WILL BE RUN TO HELP DEFINE TARGET POPULATIONS AND A CLINICAL PROTOCOL FOR THE TREATMENT OF CRC. AS A RESULT, FIRST IN MAN STUDIES WILL BE POSSIBLE SOON AFTER THE COMPLETION OF THIS PROPOSAL.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: FROM FORMULATION TO IND: OPTIMIZATION OF A DUAL CROMOLYN-CETIRIZINE ENTERIC SOFTGEL FOR CHRONIC PROSTATITIS/CHRONIC PELVIC PAIN SYNDROME - ABSTRACT CHRONIC PROSTATITIS/CHRONIC PELVIC PAIN SYNDROME (CP/CPPS) IS A DEBILITATING UROLOGIC CONDITION AFFECTING BETWEEN 7-12% OF ADULT MEN GLOBALLY. THERE ARE CURRENTLY NO FDA APPROVED THERAPEUTICS FOR CPPS. MOUNTING EVIDENCE IMPLICATES MAST CELL ACTIVATION AND NEUROIMMUNE DYSFUNCTION IN CP/CPPS PATHOGENESIS, YET NO APPROVED THERAPIES DIRECTLY TARGET THESE PATHWAYS. THE STANDARD OF CARE REMAINS A COMBINATION OF OFF-LABEL THERAPIES. DOLOR THERAPEUTICS HAS DEVELOPED A NOVEL ORAL FORMULATION COMBINING CROMOLYN SODIUM (A MAST CELL STABILIZER) AND CETIRIZINE (A HISTAMINE 1 RECEPTOR ANTAGONIST). PRELIMINARY DATA SUGGESTS THE ACTIVE PHARMACEUTICAL INGREDIENTS DELIVER PROMISING CLINICAL EFFICACY IN CP/CPPS. HOWEVER, LIMITATIONS IN ORAL ABSORPTION OF THE CROMOLYN SODIUM IN THIS COMBINATION RESTRICTED CLINICAL UTILITY. DOLOR WAS FORMED TO OVERCOME THESE CHALLENGES AND DEVELOP A FORMULATION FOR COMMERCIALIZATION TO TREAT CP/CPPS. IN A SUCCESSFUL PHASE I STTR, DOLOR AND ITS COLLABORATORS AT NU DEVELOPED A LEAD FORMULATION (DT101) THAT SHOWED PRONOUNCED IMPROVEMENT IN BIOAVAILABILITY OF CROMOLYN IN DOGS, YIELDING A ~17.7-FOLD INCREASE OVER ORAL GAVAGE. THESE RESULTS WERE OBTAINED WITH DIRECT DUODENAL DELIVERY OF A LIQUID FORMULATION. IN THIS PHASE II SBIR, DOLOR WILL OPTIMIZE THE FORMULATION AND COMPLETE LARGE- ANIMAL PHARMACOKINETIC (PK) AND TOXICOLOGY STUDIES THAT WILL BE PERFORMED IN PREPARATION FOR FDA APPROVAL THROUGH THE 505(B)(2) PATHWAY AS A FIRST-IN-CLASS, MECHANISM-BASED ORAL THERAPY FOR CP/CPPS. AIM 1: OPTIMIZE AND VALIDATE THE ENHANCED CROMOLYN–CETIRIZINE OPTIGEL® DR SOFTGEL FORMULATION (DT101) AND CONFIRM REGULATORY ALIGNMENT THROUGH PRE-IND CONSULTATION. DOLOR WILL COLLABORATE WITH A LEADING CONTRACT DEVELOPMENT AND MANUFACTURING ORGANIZATIONS TO OPTIMIZE INTEGRATION OF DT101 INTO THE OPTIGEL® DR SYSTEM, ALLOWING FOR PRODUCTION OF A GMP-COMPLIANT PILOT BATCH. RELEASE TESTING WILL INCLUDE ENTERIC RELEASE VALIDATION, DRUG LOADING, SHORT-TERM STABILITY, AND ANALYTICAL METHOD DEVELOPMENT FOR POTENCY AND DISSOLUTION. IN ADDITION, THE COMPANY WILL ATTEND A PRE-IND MEETING WITH THE FDA. AIM 2: COMPLETE DOG PK AND PHASE 1 ENABLING TOXICOLOGY STUDIES AND COMPLETE FDA SUBMISSION UNDER 505(B)(2) PATHWAY. DOLOR WILL PARTNER WITH A CONTRACT RESEARCH ORGANIZATION TO CONDUCT GLP-COMPLIANT PK AND TOXICOLOGY STUDIES IN BEAGLE DOGS. THE PK STUDY WILL FOCUS ON DETERMINING THE APPROPRIATE DOSING SCHEDULE FOR DT101. TOXICOLOGY STUDIES WILL EVALUATE CLINICAL SAFETY, PATHOLOGY, AND TOXICOKINETICS ACROSS THE IDEAL DOSE DETERMINED IN THE PK STUDY. STUDIES ARE EXPECTED TO DEMONSTRATE NO TREATMENT-LIMITING TOXICITIES. A FINAL PHASE II MILESTONE WILL BE A FULL PACKET SUBMISSION TO THE FDA. AT THE END OF PHASE II, DOLOR THERAPEUTICS WILL BE POSITIONED TO ESTABLISH A STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP WITH A LEADING UROLOGY PHARMACEUTICAL COMPANY. PRELIMINARY DISCUSSIONS WITH SUCH COMPANIES SUGGEST INTEREST IN MILESTONE-BASED AGREEMENTS CONTINGENT ON FAVORABLE PK, TOXICOLOGY, AND ALIGNMENT WITH FDA REQUIREMENTS. COMBINED PHASE IIB/CRP FUNDING AND ANTICIPATED PARTNER INVESTMENT WILL SUPPORT PHASE 2 CLINICAL TRIALS, WHILE LONGER-TERM EFFORTS WILL EXPAND DT101 AND DOLOR INTO ADDITIONAL INDICATIONS DRIVEN BY MAST CELL ACTIVATION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: ROLE OF NANOPARTICLE MEDIATED DRUG DELIVERY IN PREVENTING ARTERIOVENOUS FISTULA STENOSIS - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT THERE ARE 880,000 PATIENTS WITH END STAGE KIDNEY DISEASE (ESKD) IN THE UNITED STATES AND 70% OF THESE PATIENTS UTILIZE HEMODIALYSIS AS THEIR PRIMARY MODE FOR RENAL REPLACEMENT THERAPY. VASCULAR ACCESS THROUGH AN ARTERIOVENOUS FISTULA (AVF) IS REQUIRED FOR OPTIMAL HD AND CLEARANCE OF UREMIC TOXINS. THE PATENCY OF AVFS AT ONE YEAR IS ESTIMATED TO BE ONLY 62%. VENOUS STENOSIS, WHICH OCCURS BECAUSE OF VENOUS NEOINTIMAL HYPERPLASIA (VNH), IS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE MAJORITY OF AVF FAILURES. OVER THREE BILLION DOLLARS ARE SPENT ANNUALLY TO MAINTAIN THE FUNCTION OF HEMODIALYSIS AVFS. THERE ARE NO THERAPIES WHICH CAN PREVENT AVF VS. EFFECTIVE, NON-INVASIVE METHODS THAT REDUCE AVF VENOUS STENOSIS WOULD BE OF TREMENDOUS BENEFIT TO PATIENTS WITH ESKD. PAVAJ VASCULAR IS DEVELOPING AND COMMERCIALIZING A NOVEL THERAPY THAT CAN PREVENT AVF VENOUS STENOSIS. WE HAVE PUBLISHED DATA SHOWING THAT VS/VNH IN AVF IS ASSOCIATED WITH INCREASED EXPRESSION OF IMMEDIATE EARLY RESPONSE GENES (IEX-1/IER3) IN CLINICAL SPECIMENS WITH FAILED HD AVFS. EXPERIMENTALLY, IEX-1-/- MICE (GENETIC ENGINEERED ANIMALS THAT LACK IEX-1) WITH AVFS HAVE LESS VS/VNH THAN CONTROL MICE. IEX-1 EXPRESSION IS DOWN- REGULATED BY THE CALCIOTROPIC HORMONE, 1,25(OH)2D3 (1,25), THE ACTIVE FORM OF VITAMIN D3, WHICH IS USED IN CKD PATIENTS FOR CALCIUM HOMEOSTASIS. ORAL ADMINISTRATION OF 1,25 VITAMIN D3 DOES NOT REDUCE AVF VS AND DOES CAUSE HYPERCALCEMIA. ADVENTITIAL DELIVERY OF NANOPARTICLES COMPOSED OF POLY (LACTIC-CO-GLYCOLIC ACID (PLGA) ENCAPSULATED WITH 1,25(OH)2D3 (1,25 NP) IN A THERMOSENSITIVE HYDROGEL TO THE AVF OUTFLOW VEIN REDUCES VS/VNH IN MICE AND PIGS WITH CHRONIC KIDNEY DISEASE (CKD) WITHOUT HYPERCALCEMIA. FURTHERMORE, WE HAVE SHOWN THAT IN MICE AND PIGS, ADVENTITIAL DELIVERY OF 1,25 NP REDUCES IEX-1 EXPRESSION AND INCREASES BLOOD FLOW BY REDUCING VNH. THESE DATA SUGGEST THAT 1,25 NP MAY BE A USEFUL TREATMENT FOR IMPROVING MATURATION AND PREVENTING VS/VNH IN AVF. WE OBTAINED A PATENT (US10098897B2) FOR THESE FINDINGS, LICENSED THE TECHNOLOGY FROM MAYO CLINIC, AND STARTED PAVAJ VASCULAR TO COMMERCIALIZE THIS TECHNOLOGY. GMP GRADE 1,25 NPS WILL BE MANUFACTURED BY ASCENDIA PHARMACEUTICALS AS PART OF A CURRENT R44 PROPOSAL. IN THE PRESENT PROPOSAL, WE WILL PERFORM IND ENABLING STUDIES BY CONFIRMING THE EFFICACY OF THE GMP GRADE 1,25 NP IN OUR IN VITRO AND IN VIVO MICE AND GLP PIG MODELS AT NAMSA. PAVAJ VASCULAR WILL USE THE DIRECT PHASE II SBIR TO COMPLETE TWO MAIN GOALS: 1. EVALUATE THE EFFICACY OF GMP-GRADE 1,25 NP USING A MOUSE AVF MODEL WITH CKD. 2) DETERMINE THE LONG-TERM SAFETY AND EFFICACY OF GMP-GRADE 1,25 NP ON REDUCING AVF VS/VNH USING A PORCINE MODEL WITH CKD. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THIS PROPOSAL WILL ALLOW US TO OBTAIN DATA NEEDED TO APPLY FOR FDA INVESTIGATIONAL NEW DRUG (IND) APPROVAL TO PERFORM FIRST IN MAN STUDIES TO EVALUATE THIS PROMISING TECHNOLOGY.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: A NOVEL IMMUNOLOGICAL-DIRECTED LIVE BIOTHERAPY PRODUCT FOR TREATING CROHN'S DISEASE - PROJECT SUMMARY THE GOAL OF THIS PROJECT IS TO EVALUATE THE SAFETY AND CLINICAL EFFICACY OF R-3750, AN ENGINEERED LIVE BIOTHERAPEUTIC PRODUCT (LBP) DESIGNED TO MODULATE INTESTINAL IMMUNE RESPONSES AND RESTORE GUT HOMEOSTASIS, IN PATIENTS WITH CROHN’S DISEASE (CD). THIS PROPOSAL IS BASED ON THE PROMISING SAFETY PROFILE AND INITIAL CLINICAL ACTIVITY OBSERVED IN THE ONGOING PHASE 1 TRIAL FOR ULCERATIVE COLITIS (UC). GIVEN THE OVERLAPPING IMMUNOLOGICAL PATHWAYS BETWEEN CD AND UC, R-3750 REPRESENTS A NOVEL THERAPEUTIC APPROACH WITH THE POTENTIAL TO ADDRESS CRITICAL GAPS IN CD TREATMENT. AN ESTIMATED 800,000 TO 1 MILLION ADULTS IN THE U.S. SUFFER FROM CD, A CHRONIC INFLAMMATORY DISORDER OF THE GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT. CD IS TYPICALLY DIAGNOSED IN YOUNG ADULTHOOD BUT CAN DEVELOP AT ANY AGE, IS LIFE-LONG, AND HAS NO CURE. CURRENT TREATMENTS CAN HAVE SIGNIFICANT SIDE EFFECTS, AND MANY PATIENTS BECOME REFRACTORY TO AVAILABLE THERAPIES. THERE IS AN URGENT NEED FOR NOVEL, TARGETED INTERVENTIONS THAT RESTORE THE INTEGRITY OF THE INTESTINAL BARRIER, REGULATE IMMUNE RESPONSES, AND MODULATE THE GUT MICROBIOME. INTESTINAL IMMUNE REGULATION IS ESSENTIAL FOR MAINTAINING GUT HOMEOSTASIS, AND ITS DISRUPTION IS CENTRAL TO CD PATHOGENESIS. THE HUMAN MICROBIOME PLAYS A CRUCIAL ROLE IN THIS REGULATION, WITH COMMENSAL BACTERIA SUPPORTING EPITHELIAL BARRIER FUNCTION AND IMMUNE BALANCE. INITIAL PRECLINICAL STUDIES HAVE DEMONSTRATED THAT ORAL DELIVERY OF R-3750, A SLPA-EXPRESSING LACTOCOCCUS LACTIS SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCED GUT INFLAMMATION, REINFORCED MUCOSAL BARRIER FUNCTION, AND IMPROVED MICROBIOME COMPOSITION, PROPELLING THE CLINICAL TESTING OF THIS RECOMBINANT PROBIOTIC. R-3750 IS BEING EVALUATED IN AN ONGOING OPEN LABEL PHASE 1 CLINICAL TRIAL FOR MILD-TO-MODERATE UC (IND 28994, NCT05666960). THE STUDY DEMONSTRATED EXCELLENT SAFETY, WITH NO SERIOUS ADVERSE EVENTS (SAES) OR DRUG-RELATED ADVERSE EVENTS (AES). INITIAL CLINICAL READOUT SHOWED A SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENT OF THE DISEASE SYMPTOMS ACCOMPANIED BY RELEVANT BIOMARKERS CHANGES SUCH AS UPREGULATION OF TREG. GIVEN THE OVERLAPPING IMMUNOLOGICAL MECHANISMS BETWEEN UC AND CD, THESE FINDINGS PROVIDE A STRONG RATIONALE FOR EXPANDING CLINICAL EVALUATION INTO CD. THIS PHASE II SBIR PROPOSAL SEEKS TO CARRY OUT A PROOF-OF-CONCEPT CLINICAL TRIAL OF R-3750 IN PATIENTS WITH CD. GIVEN THE STRONG PRECLINICAL RATIONALE, CLINICAL SAFETY AND PHARMACODYNAMIC DATA, AND THE URGENT NEED FOR NOVEL CD THERAPIES, THIS PROJECT HAS THE POTENTIAL TO INTRODUCE A SAFE, EFFECTIVE, AND MICROBIOME-TARGETED THERAPY FOR PATIENTS SUFFERING FROM THIS DEVASTATING DISEASE.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT OF AN EARLY DETECTION TEST FOR TYPE 1 DIABETES VIA NGS-BASED ANALYSIS OF Β CELLS-SPECIFIC METHYLATION PATTERNS IN CFDNA - PROJECT SUMMARY  TYPE 1 DIABETES MELLITUS (T1D) AFFECTS ~1.5M AMERICANS AND IS CAUSED BY AUTOIMMUNE DESTRUCTION OF INSULIN-PRODUCING Β CELLS IN PANCREATIC ISLETS. BECAUSE INSULIN PRODUCTION IS INITIALLY SUSTAINED BY SURVIVING Β CELLS, OVERT SYMPTOMS ARISE ONLY WHEN 80%+ OF Β CELLS ARE LOST, MAKING DIAGNOSIS POSSIBLE ONLY AT ADVANCED DISEASE STAGES. ISLET AUTOANTIBODIES, THE ONLY ESTABLISHED T1D BIOMARKERS, ASSESS LONG-TERM RISK BUT CANNOT PREDICT DISEASE TIMING SINCE THEY DO NOT INFORM ON Β CELL DEATH RATES. A TECHNOLOGY IDENTIFYING Β CELL DEATH DURING ASYMPTOMATIC T1D STAGES WOULD ENABLE EARLY INTERVENTION WITH THERAPIES LIKE TEPLIZUMAB THAT DELAY DISEASE PROGRESSION.  PUPIL BIO HAS DEVELOPED AN APPROACH USING NEXT-GENERATION SEQUENCING FOR METHYLATION ANALYSIS (METHYL- SEQ) OF CELL-FREE DNA (CFDNA). EACH CELL TYPE CARRIES UNIQUE METHYLATION PATTERNS THAT INFORM ON CELLULAR ORIGIN OF DNA MOLECULES. CFDNA RELEASED BY DYING CELLS CAN REVEAL ONGOING TISSUE DAMAGE DURING PATHOGENIC PROCESSES. WE HAVE DEMONSTRATED THAT HIGH SENSITIVITY IS ACHIEVED BY (I) COMBINING NUMEROUS METHYLATION MARKERS WITH NON-ZERO SENSITIVITY, AND (II) IMPLEMENTING AMPLICON-BASED NGS WORKFLOWS THAT MINIMIZE SAMPLE LOSS COMPARED TO TRADITIONAL HYBRID CAPTURE METHODS THAT REQUIRE HIGH BLOOD VOLUMES.  BUILDING ON SUCCESSFUL PHASE I WORK, PUPIL BIO VALIDATED A DISCOVERY PANEL IDENTIFYING OVER 357,000 CANDIDATE ULTRA-SPECIFIC PHASED METHYLATION PATTERNS (UPMPS) WITH 100% SPECIFICITY TO PANCREATIC ISLETS AND DEVELOPED A VALIDATED 50-PLEX AMPLICON-BASED PANEL WITH SUPERIOR PERFORMANCE OVER HYBRID CAPTURE APPROACHES. WE ALSO OPTIMIZED OUR PROPRIETARY DIMPLE ALGORITHM FOR HIGHLY MULTIPLEXED PRIMER DESIGN IN METHYL-SEQ APPLICATIONS.  IN THIS PHASE II SBIR APPLICATION, THE PUPIL BIO TEAM WILL REFINE MARKER SELECTION TO IDENTIFY PATTERNS ULTRA- SPECIFIC TO Β CELLS ONLY VIA HIGH-DEPTH SEQUENCING AND FLUORESCENCE-ACTIVATED CELL SORTING (FACS). WE WILL EXPAND OUR AMPLICON-BASED PANEL TO 500-1000 TARGETS USING ITERATIVE SUB-ASSEMBLY APPROACHES AND CONDUCT COMPREHENSIVE ANALYTICAL VALIDATION INCLUDING LIMIT OF DETECTION, LIMIT OF INPUT, AND REPRODUCIBILITY TESTING. FINALLY, WE WILL CHARACTERIZE CLINICAL SENSITIVITY USING N=100 PLASMA SAMPLES FROM RECENT-DIAGNOSIS T1D PATIENTS COLLECTED THROUGH CLINICAL COLLABORATIONS, DEMONSTRATING HIGH SENSITIVITY WITH MINIMAL BLOOD REQUIREMENTS. COMPLETION OF THESE STUDIES WILL ENABLE PUPIL BIO TO ESTABLISH A CLIA-CERTIFIED LABORATORY AND COMMERCIALIZE THE FIRST TEST FOR EARLY T1D DETECTION AS A LABORATORY-DEVELOPED TEST (LDT).

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: A ROBOT TO ENABLE BROAD DEPLOYMENT OF THE LEAST INVASIVE UTERINE FIBROID SURGICAL INTERVENTION - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT: THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS PROPOSAL IS TO CREATE A NEW SURGICAL ROBOT TO ENABLE MINIMALLY INVASIVE REMOVAL OF UTERINE FIBROIDS. OVER TWO-THIRDS OF WOMEN WILL HAVE FIBROIDS IN THEIR LIFETIMES, AND MANY WILL NEED SURGICAL INTERVENTIONS. HYSTERECTOMY (WITH MANY ASSOCIATED LIFELONG COMPLICATIONS) IS OFTEN THE DEFAULT, BECAUSE TODAY ONLY ELITE SUR- GEONS CAN PERFORM MINIMALLY INVASIVE HYSTEROSCOPIC FIBROID REMOVAL, DUE TO THE DIFFICULTY OF THE PROCEDURE. OUR ROBOT WILL MAKE THE PROCEDURE FAR EASIER TO PERFORM, BY DELIVERING NEEDLE-SIZED INSTRUMENTS THROUGH A STANDARD HYSTEROSCOPE. THIS WILL ENABLE INDEPENDENT TISSUE MANIPULATION, RETRACTION, AND VISUALIZATION TO FACILITATE PRECISE, ACCURATE, AND EFFICIENT INTRAUTERINE SURGERY. CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE: FIBROIDS ARE PERVASIVE; NEARLY 90,000 WOMEN – EACH YEAR – WILL LOSE THEIR UTERUS TO FIBROIDS THAT THE CLINICAL LITERATURE SHOWS CAN BE REMOVED SAFELY AND EFFECTIVELY HYSTEROSCOPICALLY. THERE JUST ARE NOT ENOUGH ELITE SURGEONS TO OFFER THESE PROCEDURES WIDELY. INSTRUMENT DEXTERITY LIMITATIONS PREVENT TYPICAL SURGEONS FROM PERFORMING THESE PROCEDURES. BECAUSE OF THIS, ONLY 1 IN 10 WOMEN ARE CURRENTLY ABLE TO BENEFIT FROM A MINIMALLY INVASIVE HYSTEROSCOPIC APPROACH. INNOVATION: WE DELIVER TWO MINIATURE ROBOTIC INSTRUMENTS THROUGH A STANDARD CLINICAL HYSTEROSCOPE, ENHANCING DEXTERITY AND ENABLING TWO-HANDED MANEUVERS INCLUDING SIMULTANEOUS INDEPENDENT RETRACTION AND CUTTING OF TIS- SUE. OUR NEEDLE-SIZED ROBOTS BEND AND ELONGATE LIKE TINY TENTACLES. THEY ARE MADE FROM TELESCOPING, CURVED, ELASTIC TUBES. WE AXIALLY ROTATE AND TELESCOPICALLY EXTEND EACH TUBE INDEPENDENTLY. THE RESULT IS CONTROLLABLE BENDING AND ELONGATION THAT ENABLES TWO-HANDED SURGERIES IN SMALL SPACES IN THE UTERUS – DELIVERED THROUGH A STANDARD CLINICAL ENDOSCOPE TRANSVAGINALLY. BY PROVIDING DEXTERITY, DECOUPLING VISUALIZATION FROM TOOL MOVEMENT, AND ENABLING COUNTERTRACTION, OUR SYSTEM MAKES THESE PROCEDURES MUCH EASIER TO PERFORM, ENABLING SURGEONS TO ACCURATELY AND EFFICIENTLY REMOVE FIBROIDS. APPROACH: IN AIM 1 WE DESIGN, CONSTRUCT, AND TEST A CORKSCREW INSTRUMENT TO SECURELY MANIPULATE AND RETRACT FIBROIDS. IN AIM 2 WE CONDUCT FORMATIVE AND SUMMATIVE HUMAN FACTORS EVALUATIONS TO ENSURE SYSTEM USABILITY AND SAFETY. THE PURPOSE OF AIM 3 IS EXPERIMENTAL VALIDATION. THESE EXPERIMENTS WILL DEMONSTRATE RESECTION OF FIBROIDS OF VARIOUS SIZES FROM ALL RELEVANT LOCATIONS OF THE UTERUS IN AN EX-VIVO MODEL AND CADAVER MODEL. THE ENDPOINT OF THIS PHASE II PROJECT IS FULL VALIDATION OF OUR SYSTEM IN IN CADAVERS, SETTING THE STAGE FOR CLINICAL TRANSLATION AND REGULATORY APPROVAL.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: GENERATING PHOSPHOBODIES TO ACTIVATED PROTEIN KINASES - POST-TRANSLATIONAL MODIFICATIONS (PTMS), INCLUDING PHOSPHORYLATION, METHYLATION, AND ACETYLATION, PLAY A CRUCIAL ROLE IN CELLULAR BIOLOGY AND DISEASES. UNFORTUNATELY, THE TOOLS FOR SELECTIVELY MONITORING PTMS IN VIVO AND IN VITRO ARE SCARCE. ANTIBODIES HAVE OFTEN BEEN POWERFUL TOOLS FOR BASIC PTM RESEARCH AND CLINICAL TESTING BECAUSE THEY CAN DETECT PROTEINS OF INTEREST FROM COMPLEX MIXTURES WITH REASONABLE AFFINITY (NM RANGE). HOWEVER, MANY ANTIBODIES RAISED TO PHOSPHORYLATED PEPTIDES TO MONITOR SPECIFIC PHOSPHORYLATION EVENTS ARE ANIMAL-DERIVED AND LACK RENEWABILITY AND PROTEIN ENGINEERING. FURTHERMORE, SOME POLYCLONAL ANTIBODIES ALSO BIND TO THE NON-PHOSPHORYLATED FORM OF THE PROTEIN, LEADING TO MISINTERPRETATION OF RESULTS.  TANGO BIOSCIENCES OFFERS A UNIQUE SOLUTION TO THE CHALLENGES ABOVE BY GENERATING A REVOLUTIONARY RECOMBINANT ANTIBODY MIMIC LIBRARY THAT IS SELECTIVE TO PHOSPHORYLATED SITES ON PROTEINS. THIS APPROACH HAS BEEN VALIDATED IN OUR SUCCESSFUL PROOF OF CONCEPT PHASE I SBIR (1 R43 GM146514-01), WHERE WE DEMONSTRATED OUTSTANDING SELECTIVITY OF OUR PHOSPHOBODIES AGAINST 53BP1, A PROTEIN INVOLVED IN DNA DAMAGE REPAIR. OUR INITIAL FOCUS WILL BE EXPANDING OUR EXTENSIVE, DIVERSE PHOSPHOBODY LIBRARY TO INCLUDE MORE OPPORTUNITIES TO DISCOVER BINDERS TO 10 ACTIVATED HUMAN PROTEIN KINASES. THE MOST SELECTIVE REAGENTS WILL BE SEQUENCED, PERMITTING RENEWABILITY AND EXPRESSION AS RECOMBINANT PROTEINS.  THE WORK WILL BE ACCOMPLISHED AT TANGO BIOSCIENCES OVER TWO YEARS WITH THE HELP OF TWO CONSULTANTS. THE ACHIEVEMENT OF THE PROPOSED OBJECTIVES WILL ENABLE TANGO BIOSCIENCES TO ADVANCE OUR CLIENT’S BIOLOGY WITH THEIR DRUG DISCOVERY PROGRAMS BY PRODUCING WORLD-CLASS RECOMBINANT AFFINITY REAGENTS. IT IS EXPECTED THAT THE TECHNICAL ADVANCES HERE WILL NOT ONLY ATTRACT NEW SERVICE CONTRACTS BUT ALSO ESTABLISH TANGO BIOSCIENCES AS A TRUE INNOVATOR IN MONITORING PHOSPHORYLATION WITH EXQUISITELY SELECTIVE AFFINITY REAGENTS, WHICH MAY ADVANCE BIOMEDICAL SCIENCE AND POTENTIALLY LEAD TO NEW THERAPEUTIC OPPORTUNITIES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: BINDING FREE ENERGY PREDICTIONS FOR PEPTIDE DRUGS: A NOVEL MACHINE LEARNING-BASED PEPTIDE SIMULATION MODEL FOR HIGH-THROUGHPUT COMPUTATIONAL LEAD OPTIMIZATION WITH QUANTUM MECHANICAL ACCURACY. - PROJECT SUMMARY OLIGOPEPTIDES REPRESENT A POWERFUL THERAPEUTIC CLASS FOR TARGETING CHALLENGING PROTEIN-PROTEIN INTERACTIONS IMPLICATED IN NUMEROUS HUMAN DISEASES, YET THEIR RATIONAL DESIGN IS HINDERED BY THEIR CONFORMATIONAL FLEXIBILITY. THIS CREATES A DUAL CRISIS IN PREDICTIVE SIMULATION, WHERE BOTH THE ACCURACY OF THE UNDERLYING FORCE FIELDS (ENERGETICS) AND THE ABILITY TO EXPLORE THE VAST CONFORMATIONAL SPACE (SAMPLING) ARE INADEQUATE. CURRENT COMPUTATIONAL TOOLS SUFFER FROM SYSTEMIC INACCURACIES, A LACK OF PARAMETERS FOR NOVEL CHEMISTRIES, AND A FAILURE TO CONVERGE CRITICAL CALCULATIONS LIKE BINDING FREE ENERGIES, CREATING A MAJOR BOTTLENECK IN PEPTIDE DRUG DISCOVERY. THIS PROJECT WILL DELIVER A TRANSFORMATIVE COMPUTATIONAL PLATFORM THAT RESOLVES THIS CRISIS. THE LONG-TERM OBJECTIVE IS TO ENABLE THE RELIABLE, FIRST-PRINCIPLES PREDICTION OF PEPTIDE BINDING AFFINITY AND KEY ADME PROPERTIES. THE CENTRAL INNOVATION IS A SYNERGISTIC PLATFORM THAT COMBINES A SECOND GENERATION VERSION OF QUAIPA, A SELF-IMPROVING, QUANTUM-ACCURATE MACHINE-LEARNED FORCE FIELD (ML-FF) FIRST DEVELOPED IN PHASE I, WITH QUELO-PE, A PROPRIETARY, GPU-ACCELERATED QM/MM SIMULATION ENGINE ENHANCED FOR PROTEIN DISCOVERY (“- PE”. QUAIPA’S GRAPH-BASED ARCHITECTURE IS AUTOMATICALLY EXTENSIBLE TO NOVEL CHEMISTRIES, SOLVING THE  PARAMETER GAP  FOR MM, WHILE QUELO-PE WILL SIMULTANEOUSLY PROVIDE ENHANCED SAMPLING METHODS REQUIRED FOR PEPTIDES AND OTHER TOOLS TO ALLOW FAST QM/MM-MD TO BE APPLIED TO OLIGOPEPTIDES. THE SPECIFIC AIMS OF THIS PHASE II PROJECT ARE TO: (1) SPECIALIZE AND OPTIMIZE THE QUELO/QUAIPA PLATFORM FOR PEPTIDE-SPECIFIC CHALLENGES, INCLUDING THE INTEGRATION OF ADVANCED SAMPLING METHODS; (2) IMPLEMENT A COMPREHENSIVE VALIDATION AND BENCHMARKING FRAMEWORK TO ENSURE PREDICTIVE ACCURACY AND ESTABLISH USER CONFIDENCE; (3) DEVELOP AND VALIDATE NOVEL WORKFLOWS FOR PREDICTING HIGH-VALUE ADME PROPERTIES, SPECIFICALLY PASSIVE MEMBRANE PERMEABILITY AND METABOLIC STABILITY; AND (4) INTEGRATE ALL COMPONENTS INTO A SEAMLESS, USER-FRIENDLY SOFTWARE PLATFORM WITH BUILT-IN UNCERTAINTY QUANTIFICATION. BY OVERCOMING THE INTERTWINED BOTTLENECKS IN FORCE FIELD ACCURACY AND CONFORMATIONAL SAMPLING, THIS PLATFORM WILL DRAMATICALLY ACCELERATE THE DISCOVERY AND OPTIMIZATION OF NOVEL PEPTIDE THERAPEUTICS. THIS WORK IS HIGHLY RELEVANT TO THE NIH'S MISSION AS IT WILL PROVIDE A POWERFUL NEW TOOL TO DEVELOP MEDICINES FOR PREVIOUSLY  UNDRUGGABLE  TARGETS, ULTIMATELY REDUCING THE TIME, COST, AND FAILURE RATE OF BRINGING NEW TREATMENTS FOR A WIDE RANGE OF HUMAN DISEASES TO THE CLINIC.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: LACTATE MEASUREMENT USING A NOVEL NON-INVASIVE DEVICE - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT THIS IS A PHASE II SBIR AWARD BY CAMBRIDGE MEDICAL TECHNOLOGIES (CMT), LLC TO FURTHER DEVELOP A NONINVASIVE BIOSENSOR FOR MEASUREMENT AND SERIAL MONITORING OF LACTATE LEVELS USING INTERSTITIAL FLUID (ISF). LACTATE IS A KEY BIOMARKER IN SEPSIS, A COMMON AND DEADLY ILLNESS THAT AFFECTS MORE THAN 1.7 MILLION ADULTS IN THE UNITED STATES WITH MORTALITY AS HIGH AS 30% IN SEVERE CASES. ELEVATED LACTATE IS A MARKER OF TISSUE HYPOXIA AND SHOCK, AND EARLY ASSESSMENT OF LACTATE LEVELS ENABLES PROGNOSTICATION AND MORTALITY PREDICTION IN PATIENTS WITH SEPSIS. CMT HAS DEVELOPED A NOVEL BIOSENSOR DEVICE THAT NONINVASIVELY SAMPLES ISF AND MEASURES THE LEVEL OF ANALYTE OF INTEREST. THE DEVICE WORKS BY TEMPORARILY DISRUPTING THE STRATUM CORNEUM EPIDERMAL BARRIER USING SMALL CURRENT PULSES, WHICH ALLOWS FOR EXTRACTION OF A SMALL VOLUME OF ISF FROM JUST UNDERNEATH THE SKIN LAYER. THE ISF SAMPLE FLOWS INTO A MICRO CHAMBER WITHIN THE CMT BIOSENSOR DEVICE AND PERFORMS ELECTROCHEMICAL REACTION TO MEASURE THE LACTATE LEVEL. CMT HAS DEVELOPED THE HARDWARE AND ISF EXTRACTION TECHNIQUE DURING PRIOR WORK ON ALCOHOL AND GLUCOSE BIOSENSORS. THE CURRENT PROJECT WILL EXTEND THE TECHNIQUE TO LACTATE MONITORING. AS PART OF THE PROJECT, THE CMT WILL PARTNER WITH A TEAM FROM BETH ISRAEL DEACONESS MEDICAL CENTER (BIDMC) WHO HAVE EXTENSIVE EXPERIENCE IN CLINICAL RESEARCH, ESPECIALLY WITHIN SEPSIS AND OTHER CRITICAL ILLNESSES WHERE LACTATE IS A KEY BIOMARKER. THE BROAD AIM OF THE PROJECT IS TO DETERMINE WHETHER THE CMT LACTATE BIOSENSOR HOLDS PROMISE TO NONINVASIVELY MEASURE ISF LACTATE LEVELS; AND, IF THESE LEVELS WILL CORRELATE WITH BLOOD LACTATE LEVELS, LEADING TO CLINICAL AND COMMERCIAL SUCCESS. THE SPECIFIC AIMS OF THE STUDY ARE TO: 1) IMPROVE DEVICE HARDWARE AND SOFTWARE FOR CLINICAL USE, 2) PERFORM IN VITRO EXPERIMENTS TO OPTIMIZE UNDERLYING ELECTROCHEMISTRY FOR IMPROVED LACTATE MEASUREMENT ACCURACY, FREEDOM FROM INTERFERENT MOLECULES, AND INCREASED PRODUCT STABILITY, AND 3) PERFORM EARLY IN VIVO TESTING IN EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT PATIENTS AS PART OF A CLINICAL STUDY TO ENABLE RAPID ITERATIVE DEVICE DEVELOPMENT. THE CMT TEAM WILL MAKE HARDWARE AND SOFTWARE DEVICE IMPROVEMENTS, AND PERFORM IN VITRO TESTING TO IMPROVE THE PRODUCT. AFTER INITIAL IMPROVEMENTS, THE BIDMC TEAM WILL USE THE CMT LACTATE BIOSENSOR TO PERFORM IN VIVO TESTING IN EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT PATIENTS WITH SUSPECTED SEPSIS WHO ARE UNDERGOING CLINICAL LACTATE MEASUREMENT AND COMPARE THE RESULTS. ACHIEVING THE PROPOSED AIMS WILL POSITION CMT TO CONDUCT FDA PIVOTAL TESTING DURING ITS PATH TO COMMERCIALIZATION. THE RESEARCH PLAN WILL USE AN ITERATIVE APPROACH BY WHICH CMT WILL DEVELOP AND IMPROVE THE DEVICE AND BIDMC WILL TEST IT IN A REAL CLINICAL ENVIRONMENT ACROSS A BROAD RANGE OF HUMAN SUBJECTS AND A CLINICALLY RELEVANT RANGE OF LACTATE LEVELS. FULL EXCHANGE OF THE DATA WILL PERMIT RAPID ADJUSTMENTS TO THE PROTOTYPES SO THAT MODIFIED VERSIONS OF THE DEVICE ARE TESTED IN A TIMELY AND ITERATIVE MANNER.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT OF AN AUTOMATED SAMPLE PREPARATION PLATFORM FOR HIGH THROUGHPUT MASS SPECTROMETRY CHARACTERIZATION OF BIOTHERAPEUTICS - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT BIOTHERAPEUTICS REPRESENT THE FASTEST-GROWING PHARMACEUTICAL SEGMENT, OFFERING TRANSFORMATIVE TREATMENTS FOR PREVIOUSLY INTRACTABLE DISEASES LIKE CANCER AND GENETIC DISORDERS. HOWEVER, THESE COMPLEX BIOTHERAPEUTICS FACE SIGNIFICANT ANALYTICAL CHALLENGES RESULTING IN EXTENDED DEVELOPMENT TIMELINES AND HIGH COSTS, DIRECTLY LIMITING PATIENT ACCESS. MODERN BIOTHERAPEUTICS AND EMERGING MODALITIES ARE INCREASINGLY LARGE AND STRUCTURALLY COMPLEX, REQUIRING MORE SOPHISTICATED CHARACTERIZATION TECHNIQUES TO ASSESS CRITICAL QUALITY ATTRIBUTES IMPACTING SAFETY AND EFFICACY. MASS SPECTROMETRY (MS) SERVES AS THE GOLD STANDARD FOR BIOTHERAPEUTIC CHARACTERIZATION. WHILE TRADITIONAL MS APPROACHES DENATURE PROTEINS DURING ANALYSIS, ADVANCED MS TECHNIQUES LIKE NATIVE MS (NMS) AND CHARGE DETECTION MS (CDMS) PRESERVE AND ANALYZE INTACT, BIOLOGICALLY RELEVANT STRUCTURES WHILE EXTENDING CAPABILITIES INTO THE MEGADALTON RANGE. THESE NATIVE-LIKE ANALYSES PROVIDE CRITICAL INSIGHTS ESSENTIAL FOR UNDERSTANDING THERAPEUTIC EFFICACY AND SAFETY. BOTH TECHNIQUES RELY ON NANO-ELECTROSPRAY IONIZATION (NESI), WHICH PRESERVES DELICATE BIOLOGIC STRUCTURES WITH ENHANCED IONIZATION EFFICIENCY. WHILE NEARLY ALL FDA BIOLOGICS APPLICATIONS USE MS, FEW UTILIZE NMS OR CDMS DUE TO TECHNICAL COMPLEXITY OF NESI AND LABOR-INTENSIVE SAMPLE PREPARATION, REDUCING REPRODUCIBILITY AND THROUGHPUT AND SEVERELY LIMITING ADOPTION DESPITE THEIR ADVANCED CAPABILITIES. THIS PROPOSAL ADDRESSES CRITICAL BARRIERS BY DEVELOPING ANDSON BIOTECH'S AUTO-DYNACHIP PLATFORM - A COMPACT SYSTEM INTEGRATING AUTOSAMPLER CAPABILITIES WITH IN-LINE MICROFLUIDIC SAMPLE PREPARATION FOR STREAMLINED NESI TO ENABLE HIGH-THROUGHPUT NMS AND CDMS ANALYSIS. BUILDING ON ANDSON'S EXISTING DYNACHIP X1, THE FIRST COMMERCIALLY AVAILABLE SYSTEM COUPLING RAPID MICROFLUIDIC SAMPLE CLEANUP WITH NESI, THE AUTO- DYNACHIP WILL TRANSFORM BIOPHARMACEUTICAL WORKFLOWS BY BRIDGING HIGH-THROUGHPUT NEEDS WITH NATIVE CHARACTERIZATION OF LARGE BIOMOLECULES. THE SYSTEM FEATURES ADVANCED MICROFLUIDICS ENABLING: (1) AUTOMATED SAMPLE CLEANUP AND BUFFER EXCHANGE IN MINUTES, (2) PRECISE DIGITAL FLOW CONTROL FOR CONSISTENT NESI OPERATION, AND (3) OPTIMIZED DELIVERY FOR DIRECT MS COUPLING. AIM 1 WILL DEVELOP APPLICATION-SPECIFIC MICROFLUIDIC CHIP DESIGNS AND ROBUST MANUFACTURING PROCESSES, OPTIMIZING CHANNEL GEOMETRY AND MEMBRANE PARAMETERS FOR VARIOUS PROTEIN TARGETS. AIM 2 WILL INTEGRATE AUTOSAMPLER CAPABILITIES FOR HIGH-THROUGHPUT WORKFLOWS, ENABLING AUTOMATED SAMPLE PROCESSING WITH MINIMAL INTERVENTION WHILE MAINTAINING STABLE NESI PERFORMANCE. AIM 3 WILL VERIFY AND VALIDATE CONSUMABLES AND THE COMMERCIAL INSTRUMENT THROUGH INTERNAL TESTING AND CROSS-LABORATORY VALIDATION USING STANDARDIZED PROTOCOLS AND REFERENCE MATERIALS. THE SUCCESSFUL DEVELOPMENT OF THE AUTO-DYNACHIP WILL ADDRESS A CRITICAL TECHNOLOGICAL GAP IN BIOTHERAPEUTICS CHARACTERIZATION WHILE ADVANCING THE BROADER FIELDS OF MICROFLUIDICS AND BIOANALYTICAL CHEMISTRY. BY ENABLING UNPRECEDENTED HIGH-THROUGHPUT ADVANCED MS ANALYSIS, LIKE NMS AND CDMS, THIS INNOVATION WILL ACCELERATE DEVELOPMENT TIMELINES, REDUCE COSTS, AND ENHANCE DATA QUALITY, ULTIMATELY EXPANDING PATIENT ACCESS TO TRANSFORMATIVE MEDICINES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: HIGH-YIELD, HIGH-PURITY EXTRACELLULAR VESICLE ISOLATION COLUMNS FOR HIGH-THROUGHPUT PLATE-BASED BIOMARKER DISCOVERY AND DIAGNOSIS - PROJECT SUMMARY  IN THIS DIRECT-TO-PHASE II SBIR APPLICATION, EVEREST BIOLABS PROPOSES TO ADVANCE THE DEVELOPMENT OF INNOVATIVE PLATE-BASED METHODS AND MATERIALS FOR ISOLATING EXTRACELLULAR VESICLES (EVS) FROM BIOFLUIDS USING DUAL- MODE CHROMATOGRAPHY THAT COMBINES SIZE EXCLUSION CHROMATOGRAPHY WITH AFFINITY-BASED DEPLETION OF COMMON CONTAMINANTS. IMPACT: THIS PROJECT IS EXPECTED TO DELIVER THE FIRST HIGH-PERFORMANCE, HIGH-THROUGHPUT TOOL FOR USE WITH FULLY-AUTOMATED LIQUID HANDLING ROBOTS THAT CAN ISOLATE EVS WITH THE HIGH YIELD, HIGH PURITY, AND BROAD SIZE DISTRIBUTION REQUIRED TO FULLY REALIZE THE ENORMOUS POTENTIAL OF EVS IN RAPID, REPRODUCIBLE, AND COST-EFFECTIVE BIOMARKER DISCOVERY AND DIAGNOSTIC TESTING.  VIRTUALLY ALL LIVING CELLS RELEASE EVS THAT DIFFUSE THROUGH EXTRACELLULAR SPACES, TRANSPORTING MATERIALS AND INFORMATION TO OTHER CELLS TO AFFECT THEIR FUNCTION. SOME OF THESE EVS ARE EVENTUALLY CIRCULATED IN THE BLOOD STREAM OR SHOW UP IN SALIVA, URINE, AND OTHER BIOFLUIDS. THE CONTENTS OF EVS, AS WELL AS THE PROTEINS EMBEDDED IN AND ATTACHED TO THE MEMBRANE SURFACE, PROVIDE A RICH SOURCE OF INFORMATION THAT CAN BE ANALYZED TO DETERMINE WHERE THE EVS ORIGINATED IN THE BODY AND ASSESS THE PHYSIOLOGICAL OR PATHOLOGICAL STATE OF THE ORIGINATING TISSUE. DESPITE ENORMOUS INTEREST IN LEVERAGING EVS TO DIAGNOSE ILLNESS, IDENTIFY PATIENTS WHO MAY BE MORE OR LESS RESPONSIVE TO A PARTICULAR TREATMENT, ASSESS THE EFFICACY OF A TREATMENT, OR EVEN DESIGN AND DELIVER NEW THERAPIES, THE TRANSLATION OF EVS INTO ROBUST RESEARCH AND DIAGNOSTIC TOOLS REQUIRES THE DEVELOPMENT OF RAPID, REPRODUCIBLE, AND SCALABLE METHODS FOR ISOLATING AND ANALYZING THEM. CURRENT METHODS FOR EV ISOLATION REQUIRE TRADE-OFFS BETWEEN EV YIELD AND EV PURITY, WHICH ARE BOTH CRITICAL FOR MAKING USE OF LOW-ABUNDANCE EVS TO STUDY OR DIAGNOSE ILLNESS IN SPECIFIC TISSUES. IN PRELIMINARY WORK, EVEREST BIOLABS ESTABLISHED PROOF-OF-CONCEPT FOR A MULTI-LAYER EV ISOLATION COLUMN THAT COMBINES A SIZE EXCLUSION CHROMATOGRAPHY LAYER WITH AN ADDITIONAL RESIN CONTAINING ANTIBODIES THAT SPECIFICALLY TARGET LIPOPROTEINS, A MAJOR CONTAMINANT OF EVS ISOLATED FROM PLASMA AND SERUM. THESE COLUMNS EXHIBITED ALMOST NO LOSS IN EV YIELD COMPARED TO SEC COLUMNS ALONE WHILE ELIMINATING > 99% OF LIPOPROTEINS.  IN THIS DIRECT-TO-PHASE II SBIR APPLICATION, EVEREST BIOLABS PROPOSES TO BUILD ON THIS FINDING TO A) OPTIMIZE COLUMNS FOR CAPTURING THE THREE MAJOR CONTAMINANTS FOUND IN EV ISOLATES FROM PLASMA AND SERUM (I.E., ALBUMIN, IMMUNOGLOBULINS, AND LIPOPROTEINS) AND B) ADAPT THESE COLUMNS FOR USE IN A FULLY-AUTOMATED HIGH-THROUGHPUT 24- WELL PLATE-BASED EV ISOLATION METHOD. AIM 1. OPTIMIZE A DEPLETION-INTEGRATED EV ISOLATION COLUMN FOR ACHIEVING HIGH PURITY WHILE RETAINING HIGH YIELD. AIM 2. ADAPT MULTI-LAYER EV ISOLATION MATERIALS FOR A PLATE-BASED FORMAT. AIM 3. COMBINE AND VALIDATE THE OPTIMIZED DEPLETION CHEMISTRY AND MULTI-LAYER EV ISOLATION FORMAT IN A PLATE- BASED DESIGN FOR HIGH-PERFORMANCE, HIGH-THROUGHPUT EV ISOLATION.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: NANOVIAL KITS FOR LARGE-SCALE CELL-CELL INTERACTION SEQUENCING - ABSTRACT THERAPEUTIC DISCOVERY INCREASINGLY DEPENDS ON UNDERSTANDING HOW DEFINED SINGLE CELLS INTERACT AND ON LINKING THOSE FUNCTIONAL OUTCOMES TO MOLECULAR READOUTS AT SCALE. TODAY’S HIGH-THROUGHPUT APPROACHES OFTEN FORCE TRADE- OFFS BETWEEN FUNCTIONAL RELEVANCE, ACCESSIBILITY, AND COST, WHICH LIMITS THE SIZE AND INTERPRETABILITY OF DISCOVERY DATASETS. NANOVIALS, ENGINEERED HYDROGEL MICROCONTAINERS DEVELOPED BY PARTILLION BIOSCIENCE, UNIQUELY ENABLE SCALABLE ASSAYS OF DEFINED SINGLE-CELL AND CELL–CELL PAIRS THAT ARE COMPATIBLE WITH STANDARD FLOW CYTOMETERS AND SEQUENCING WORKFLOWS. NANOVIALS COMPARTMENTALIZE PAIRS, PRESERVE FUNCTIONAL OUTCOMES (SECRETION, ACTIVATION, CYTOTOXICITY), AND ARE ALREADY COMMERCIALLY ADOPTED FOR SINGLE-CELL ASSAYS. IMPORTANTLY, NANOVIALS ARE COMPATIBLE WITH OFF-THE-SHELF SINGLE-CELL SEQUENCING KITS, ENABLING IMMEDIATE EXECUTION OF LARGE-SCALE PROOF-OF-CONCEPT STUDIES. THIS PHASE II PROJECT WILL (1) EXPAND COMPATIBILITY ACROSS WIDELY USED OFF-THE-SHELF SINGLE-CELL SEQUENCING CHEMISTRIES TO BROADEN USER ACCESS AND REDUCE COSTS, AND (2) DEMONSTRATE GENERATION OF LARGE, INTERPRETABLE DATASETS AT A SCALE SUITABLE FOR THERAPEUTIC DISCOVERY AND FOR TRAINING AI FOUNDATION MODELS. AIM 1 DEVELOPS AND VALIDATES NANOVIAL WORKFLOWS FOR THESE KITS, INCLUDING CAPPED FORMATS TO LOCALIZE INTERACTIONS, LIBRARY-PREP INTEGRATION, AND QUANTITATIVE SUCCESS CRITERIA FOR LOW CROSS-TALK AND ROBUST TRANSCRIPT CAPTURE. AIM 2 EXECUTES TWO LARGE-SCALE USE CASES TO ILLUSTRATE GENERALITY AND VALUE: ANTIBODY DISCOVERY WITH HYBRIDOMA OR B-CELL–ANTIGEN PAIRS, AND INNATE IMMUNITY WITH NK–TUMOR PAIRS. ACROSS BOTH AIMS WE WILL BENCHMARK AGAINST STANDARD METHODS, DELIVER SOPS AND KITS FOR IMMEDIATE USE, AND RELEASE CURATED DATASETS WITH METADATA FOR REUSE. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION WILL YIELD TURNKEY KITS AND DATASETS THAT INCREASE DISCOVERY THROUGHPUT WHILE PRESERVING FUNCTIONAL FIDELITY, ENABLING BROADER PARTICIPATION BY LABS THAT RELY ON STANDARD FACS EQUIPMENT. THE ANTICIPATED IMPACT IS FASTER IDENTIFICATION OF FUNCTIONAL ANTIBODY AND CELL THERAPY CANDIDATES AND RICH TRAINING DATA FOR COMPUTATIONAL MODELS THAT LEARN FROM TRUE CELL–CELL BEHAVIOR.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: HIERARCHICAL IN VIVO ASSEMBLY FOR RAPID AND HIGH-THROUGHPUT CONSTRUCTION OF LONG DNA SEQUENCES - ABSTRACT ADVANCES IN SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY, BIOLOGICAL CHEMISTRY, GENOMIC ENGINEERING, AND DRUG DISCOVERY INCREASINGLY RELY ON CONSTRUCTING LONG AND COMPLEX DNA SEQUENCES. APPLICATIONS SUCH AS ENGINEERING BIOSYNTHETIC PATHWAYS, DESIGNING SYNTHETIC CHROMOSOMES, AND OPTIMIZING COMBINATORIAL GENETIC LIBRARIES REQUIRE EFFICIENT AND RELIABLE ASSEMBLY METHODS FOR DNA CONSTRUCTS EXCEEDING 20KB. WHILE EXISTING TECHNOLOGIES LIKE GIBSON AND GOLDEN GATE ASSEMBLY ARE EFFECTIVE FOR SMALLER CONSTRUCTS, THEY FACE CHALLENGES WITH LONGER AND MORE COMPLEX SEQUENCES. YEAST-BASED ASSEMBLY, THOUGH CAPABLE OF HANDLING LARGER CONSTRUCTS, IS LIMITED BY LOW YIELDS, LONG TURNAROUND TIMES, AND SCALABILITY CONSTRAINTS. TO ADDRESS THESE CHALLENGES, BACSTITCH DNA HAS DEVELOPED A NOVEL IN VIVO DNA ASSEMBLY PLATFORM IN E. COLI. THIS PLATFORM INTEGRATES BACTERIAL CONJUGATION, IN VIVO DNA CUTTING, AND HOMOLOGOUS RECOMBINATION, ENABLING HIGH-THROUGHPUT, SEAMLESS, AND MODULAR ASSEMBLY OF CONSTRUCTS EXCEEDING 80KB. BY ELIMINATING IN VITRO STEPS, SEQUENCE SCARS, AND THE NEED FOR REFACTORING, THE PLATFORM REDUCES COSTS AND ACCELERATES THE DESIGN-BUILD-TEST CYCLE. KEY FEATURES INCLUDE MODULAR WORKFLOWS THAT ALLOW BUILDING BLOCKS TO BE REUSED AND SHUFFLED WITHOUT PCR AND BARCODED ARRAYS FOR HIGH-THROUGHPUT SEQUENCE VALIDATION. IN THIS PROJECT, WE AIM TO ENHANCE THE PLATFORM BY TRANSITIONING FROM SEQUENTIAL TO HIERARCHICAL ASSEMBLY WORKFLOWS. THIS EXTENSION WILL ENABLE SEAMLESS TRANSITIONS BETWEEN INTERMEDIATE CONSTRUCTS AND FINAL ASSEMBLIES, SIGNIFICANTLY IMPROVING SPEED, SCALABILITY AND EFFICIENCY. SPECIFIC AIM 1 FOCUSES ON DEVELOPING, OPTIMIZING, AND SCALING THE HIERARCHICAL IN VIVO DNA ASSEMBLY PLATFORM. BY INTEGRATING ORTHOGONAL CONJUGATION SYSTEMS WITH CONDITIONAL ORIGINS OF REPLICATION, THE PLATFORM WILL STREAMLINE WORKFLOWS, REDUCE HANDS-ON TIME, AND ENHANCE THE ACCURACY AND THROUGHPUT OF DNA ASSEMBLY. CONSTRUCTS EXCEEDING 100KB, INCLUDING THOSE WITH COMPLEX SEQUENCE FEATURES, WILL BE EFFICIENTLY ASSEMBLED. SPECIFIC AIM 2 WILL DEMONSTRATE THE PLATFORM’S UTILITY BY CONSTRUCTING BIOSYNTHETIC GENE CLUSTERS (BGCS) ENCODING POLYKETIDE SYNTHASES AND NONRIBOSOMAL PEPTIDE SYNTHETASES. THESE CLUSTERS, WHICH OFTEN INCLUDE REPETITIVE SEQUENCES AND HIGH GC CONTENT, ENCODE VALUABLE PRODUCTS SUCH AS ANTIBIOTICS, IMMUNOSUPPRESSANTS, AND ANTICANCER AGENTS. THE PLATFORM WILL FACILITATE THE REUSE, SHUFFLING, AND OPTIMIZATION OF GENETIC ELEMENTS, ACCELERATING THE DEVELOPMENT OF NOVEL DERIVATIVES AND IMPROVING PATHWAY PRODUCTION IN HETEROLOGOUS HOSTS. THIS PROJECT WILL DELIVER AN INNOVATIVE DNA ASSEMBLY TECHNOLOGY THAT REDUCES COSTS, ENHANCES SCALABILITY, AND EXPANDS THE RANGE OF ACCESSIBLE DNA SEQUENCES. BY ENABLING THE RAPID CONSTRUCTION OF LONG AND COMPLEX CONSTRUCTS, THIS PLATFORM WILL EMPOWER RESEARCHERS AND DEVELOPERS ACROSS SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY, GENOMICS, AND BIOPHARMACEUTICAL INDUSTRIES TO ADDRESS CHALLENGING PROJECTS, DRIVING INNOVATION AND DISCOVERY.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: HEALTH360X.AI: ACCELERATING ACCESS TO MEDICAL BREAKTHROUGHS AT THE POINT OF CARE - PROJECT SUMMARY ACCELERATING HEALTH RESEARCH AND MEDICAL BREAKTHROUGHS ARE TOP PRIORITIES FOR THE NIH, THE FDA, THE NATIONAL ACADEMY OF MEDICINE, AND THE PHARMACEUTICAL RESEARCH AND MANUFACTURERS OF AMERICA (PHRMA). THE GOAL OF THIS SBIR FAST TRACK PROPOSAL IS TO IMPLEMENT AND SCALE THE HEALTH360X CLINICAL RESEARCH PLATFORM SERVICE FOR POINT OF CARE DECENTRALIZED CLINICAL TRIALS. THE FAST TRACK PROPOSAL IS A COLLABORATION BETWEEN ACCUHEALTH, YALE AND CLINIAL TRIALS ACCESS COLLABORATIVE (CTAC) AND WILL LEVERAGE OUR DECADES LONG EXPERIENCE WORKING WITH COMMUNITY PROVIDERS TO IMPLEMENT INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS TO THE RESEARCH DEFICIT PARTICIPATION. THIS MODEL ALSO EMPHASIZES THE IMPORTANCE OF DATA PROVENANCE AND TRANSPARENT GOVERNANCE. THROUGH PRIVACY-FIRST DESIGN AND INTENTIONAL EFFORTS TO PROMOTE HEALTH DATA LITERACY, HEALTH 360X FOSTERS LONG-TERM TRUST WITH BOTH PROVIDERS AND PATIENTS. THE OUTCOME IS A SUSTAINABLE, COMMUNITY-LED APPROACH TO TRIAL ACCESS THAT IS NO LONGER CONSTRAINED BY PRACTICE SIZE, GEOGRAPHY, OR PRIOR EXPOSURE TO THE RESEARCH ECOSYSTEM. AIM 1. AIM 1 (PHASE I). EHR OPTIMIZATION FOR CLINICAL TRIAL ACCESS OBJECTIVE: ENABLE ACCESS TO CLINICAL TRIALS BY INTEGRATING AND OPTIMIZING THE HEALTH 360X CLINICAL RESEARCH PLATFORM WITHIN EXISTING EHR SYSTEMS, AIDED BY YALE, AT COMMUNITY-BASED AND SMALL TO MID-SIZED PRACTICES. AIM 2. (PHASE II) EVALUATE PLATFORM IMPACT IN A REAL-WORLD USE CASE OBJECTIVE: ASSESS THE ADOPTION, IMPLEMENTATION, AND EFFECTIVENESS OF HEALTH 360X TOOLS IN A THERAPEUTIC TRIAL USE CASE AIDED BY CTAC’S FUNDING, CONDUCTED ACROSS A NETWORK OF COMMUNITY- BASED PRACTICES. THIS FAST-TRACK SBIR PROJECT WILL DIRECTLY ADDRESS NIMHD AND NCATS PRIORITY ON RESEARCH EFFICIENCY BY IMPLEMENTING OR ENHANCING COMMERCIALLY VIABLE PLATFORMS THAT MEET COMMUNITY PRACTICES WHERE THEY ARE TO ENSURE ACCESS TO CUTTING-EDGE CLINICAL RESEARCH AND SCIENTIFIC INNOVATION BY ALL POPULATIONS.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: MOLECULAR IMAGING OF PERIPHERAL AND CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM MYELIN - PROJECT SUMMARY  DEMYELINATING NEURODEGENERATIVE DISEASES—INCLUDING MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS (MS) AND CHARCOT–MARIE– TOOTH DISEASE (CMT)—AFFECT OVER 6 MILLION PEOPLE GLOBALLY AND REMAIN AMONG THE MOST DEBILITATING AND COSTLY CHRONIC CONDITIONS WORLDWIDE, CAUSING OVER $100M IN GLOBAL HEALTHCARE AND SOCIETAL COST EACH YEAR. DESPITE DECADES OF DRUG DEVELOPMENT, THESE DISEASES CONTINUE TO CAUSE SUBSTANTIAL NEUROLOGICAL MORBIDITY, IN PART DUE TO OUR LIMITED ABILITY TO NONINVASIVELY DETECT AND MONITOR THE HALLMARK PATHOLOGICAL FEATURE—MYELIN LOSS. ACROSS ALL DEMYELINATING DISEASES, TOOLS THAT CAN QUANTIFY MYELIN INTEGRITY AND MONITOR REMYELINATION ARE CRITICALLY NEEDED TO GUIDE CLINICAL DECISION-MAKING AND ACCELERATE THERAPEUTIC DEVELOPMENT. CURRENT CLINICAL APPROACHES RELY ON INDIRECT, OFTEN INVASIVE TECHNIQUES THAT FAIL TO CAPTURE SUBCLINICAL CHANGES OR QUANTITATIVE INSIGHT INTO DEMYELINATION AND RECOVERY. OUR TEAM HAS PIONEERED THE DEVELOPMENT OF A FIRST-IN-CLASS PLATFORM OF MYELIN- SPECIFIC SMALL-MOLECULE FLUOROPHORES THAT ENABLE HIGH-CONTRAST IMAGING OF NERVE TISSUE IN VIVO. OVER THE PAST DECADE, WE HAVE SYNTHESIZED AND SCREENED >400 NEAR-INFRARED (NIR) OXAZINE-BASED FLUOROPHORES, IDENTIFYING LEAD CANDIDATES WITH STRONG AFFINITY FOR MYELINATED NERVE FIBERS, HIGH SIGNAL-TO-BACKGROUND CONTRAST, AND EXCEPTIONAL IN VIVO PERFORMANCE ACROSS RODENT, LARGE-ANIMAL, AND HUMAN SPECIMEN MODELS. FROM THIS PLATFORM, WE HAVE ADVANCED TWO LEAD AGENTS—LGW16-03 AND IT14-63—THROUGH IND-ENABLING STUDIES, DEMONSTRATING SAFETY, ROBUST PHARMACOKINETICS, AND BROAD COMPATIBILITY WITH HUMAN NERVE TISSUE. IMPORTANTLY, BOTH COMPOUNDS HAVE SHOWN THE ABILITY TO DISTINGUISH HEALTHY FROM DEMYELINATED NERVE TISSUE IN BOTH THE PERIPHERAL NERVOUS SYSTEM (PNS) AND CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM (CNS) WITH HIGH SENSITIVITY, AND RECENT STUDIES CONFIRM THEY DIRECTLY BIND MYELIN AND CAN REPORT ON SCHWANN CELL AND OLIGODENDROCYTE HEALTH. WE HAVE ALSO DEMONSTRATED THAT FLUORINATED DERIVATIVES OF THESE MOLECULES PRESERVE THEIR MYELIN-TARGETING PROPERTIES IN VIVO, SUPPORTING DEVELOPMENT OF 18F-LABELED PET TRACERS. HEREIN, WE PROPOSE TO TRANSLATE THESE AGENTS INTO A NONINVASIVE PET IMAGING PLATFORM FOR MYELIN-SPECIFIC ASSESSMENT AND QUANTIFICATION ACROSS CNS AND PNS SYSTEM DISEASES. IN THIS FAST-TRACK PROPOSAL, THE IMMEDIATE MILESTONES INCLUDE IN PHASE I: 1) SYNTHESIS AND CHARACTERIZATION OF ≥5 FLUORINATED SMALL-MOLECULE TRACER CANDIDATES, 2) EVALUATION OF PHARMACOKINETIC AND IMAGING PERFORMANCE, AND 3) SELECTION 3 LEAD COMPOUNDS FOR RADIOLABELING BASED ON OPTIMAL MYELIN SPECIFICITY, CONTRAST, AND IMAGING WINDOW COMPATIBILITY WITH 18F DECAY; IN PHASE II: 1) SYNTHETIC OPTIMIZATION OF RADIOLABELED DERIVATIVES, 2) DEMONSTRATION OF DIAGNOSTIC ACCURACY IN DEMYELINATING DISEASE MODELS (MS AND CMT), 3) SELECTION OF A LEAD FOR CLINICAL TRANSLATION, 4) TOXICOLOGY AND DOSIMETRY ANALYSES FOR CLINICAL READINESS, AND 5) VALIDATION OF THE MECHANISTIC LINK BETWEEN IMAGING CONTRAST AND MYELIN GENE EXPRESSION. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THIS PROJECT WILL YIELD THE FIRST CLINICALLY TRANSLATABLE PET IMAGING PLATFORM FOR DIRECT, NONINVASIVE, AND QUANTITATIVE ASSESSMENT OF MYELIN INTEGRITY ACROSS BOTH THE CNS AND PNS—FILLING A CRITICAL GAP FOR NEURODEGENERATIVE DISEASES.

agency: Department of Health and Human Services
description: DEVELOPMENT OF A NON-ADDICTIVE INTRANASAL NERVE BLOCK TO PROVIDE RAPID ACUTE TREATMENT FOR HEADACHE DISORDERS - PROJECT SUMMARY ACCORDING TO THE US CENTERS FOR DISEASE CONTROL, 14.2% OF US ADULTS REPORT EXPERIENCING MIGRAINE SYMPTOMS WITHIN ANY GIVEN 3-MONTH PERIOD, MAKING IT THE SECOND MOST DISABLING ILLNESS IN THE WORLD. DIAGNOSED MIGRAINE IS TYPICALLY CATEGORIZED AS EITHER EPISODIC (2 – 14 DAYS PER MONTH) OR CHRONIC (15 OR MORE DAYS PER MONTH), WITH EACH ACUTE OCCURRENCE IDENTIFIED BY A COMBINATION OF DEBILITATING PAIN AND SYMPTOMS THAT PERSIST BETWEEN 4 - 72 HOURS. THERE IS NO ABSOLUTE CURE FOR MIGRAINE, AND THE OVERALL FINANCIAL BURDEN ASSOCIATED WITH THESE DISORDERS IS MORE THAN $72B ANNUALLY IN THE US AND EUROPE. FOR INDIVIDUALS AFFECTED, HOWEVER, THE PERSONAL “COSTS” GO WELL BEYOND FINANCIAL AND PHYSICAL PAIN AND ARE REFLECTED IN DECREASED RELATIONSHIP SATISFACTION, INCREASED DEPENDENCY ON CAREGIVERS, AND LOSS OF WORK AND SOCIAL PRODUCTIVITY. DESPITE INCREASED RECOGNITION OF PARASYMPATHETIC ACTIVATION OF THE TRIGEMINOVASCULAR SYSTEM THROUGH THE SPHENOPALATINE GANGLION (SPG), THE MAJORITY OF ACUTE MIGRAINE THERAPIES TARGET DOWNSTREAM EFFECTS OF TRIGEMINOVASCULAR ACTIVATION, INCLUDING CGRP RECEPTORS AND 5-HT RECEPTORS. NONSPECIFIC PAIN MEDICATIONS USED IN MIGRAINE (ACETAMINOPHEN, NSAIDS, OPIOIDS) MAY HAVE A MORE DIRECT ANTI-NOCICEPTIVE EFFECT ON THE TRIGEMINOVASCULAR SYSTEM, BUT THEY EITHER LACK ADEQUATE POTENCY FOR SEVERE MIGRAINE SYMPTOMS OR CAUSE SIGNIFICANT ADVERSE EFFECTS. SPG BLOCK PROCEDURES DIRECTLY TARGET THE TRIGEMINAL NERVE, HAVE DEMONSTRATED EFFICACY FOR RAPID ACUTE MIGRAINE SYMPTOM RELIEF, AND CAN BE ADMINISTERED WITHOUT THE POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE OR ADDICTIVE SIDE EFFECTS. TO DATE, THESE PROCEDURES HAVE NOT BEEN CONSIDERED A STRONG ALTERNATIVE TO FRONT-LINE MEDICATIONS DUE TO THEIR 1) NECESSITY FOR ADMINISTRATION BY A TRAINED HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONAL, 2) DIFFICULT AND UNCOMFORTABLE ROUTE OF ADMINISTRATION, AND 3) HIGH SUPPLY AND PROCEDURAL COSTS COMPARED TO SINGLE-DOSE MEDICATION. IN RESPONSE TO THE INCREASING CLINICAL NEED FOR ALTERNATIVE MIGRAINE THERAPIES, OUR TEAM COMPRISED OF MIGRAINE CARE SPECIALISTS, DEVICE AND DRUG DEVELOPERS, AND CLINICAL RESEARCH SPECIALISTS HAS CREATED RELASPEN – A FIRST-IN-CLASS, NASALLY ADMINISTERED DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCT THAT TRANSLATES EFFECTIVE SPG BLOCK PROCEDURES FROM THE CLINIC INTO THE HANDS OF PATIENTS. IN THIS PHASE II APPLICATION, DIVIDED INTO THREE DISTINCT SPECIFIC AIMS, OUR TEAM WILL BUILD UPON PREVIOUSLY ESTABLISHED TECHNICAL AND CLINICAL FEASIBILITY TO COMPLETE DEVELOPMENT OF THE NASAL DELIVERY DEVICE AND SATISFY FDA REQUIREMENTS FOR PRE-CLINICAL SAFETY AND USABILITY. THE FINAL PROJECT AIM WILL BE A 6-MONTH TOXICITY STUDY IN CANINE, WHICH IS REQUIRED BY THE FDA TO SUPPORT CHRONIC INTERMITTENT DOSING AND PIVOTAL CLINICAL STUDY IN HUMANS.
